title: Technical support is always available...

title: I've been using Axvoice for a while and...
review: I've been using Axvoice for a while and overall I've had a good experience with it. The setup was fairly straightforward, and call quality has been good for my day-to-day calls. I also like having the additional calling features without making things overly complicated. Support has been helpful when I've needed it. Overall, it's been a solid option for my needs.

title: We used Vonage for our business phone...
review:
We used Vonage for our business phone line and experienced repeated, unresolved service outages — our line would go dark or drop calls daily, which is unacceptable for a business relying on phone communication. After dealing with this for months, we made the difficult decision to port our number out to a different provider.

Despite switching providers over a year ago, Vonage auto-renewed our account into a new one-year contract without any notice. We had explicitly requested cancellation with a Vonage agent months before our contract ended. When we contacted them about the unauthorized renewal, we were told we could not cancel without paying a $1,500 early termination fee — for a contract we asked to cancel and hadn't used in over a year.

Between the unreliable service that forced us to leave in the first place and the way they've handled cancellation and billing since, we cannot recommend Vonage to any business considering them.

title: I am an Accountant and still need to...
review:
I am an Accountant and still need to fax or receive documents from time to time. I have been using Nextiva for many years and have found it reliable, easy to use and affordable. No need for a fax line or fax machine. Email notifications for incoming faxes with a preview to the document so you can tell if it is important.
Nextivia has few "bells and whistles", they didn't pay a programmer to make it look gorgeous. It is a work tool and it works just fine. Faxing is kind of boring, not sexy, and I like Nextivia and its simplicity.

title: We have been using their services for...
review: We have been using their services for almost 5 years now and have rarely had outages or issues that weren’t resolved in a timely manner. I do appreciate the app as it’s a much easier way for me to check messages after hours or on weekends. Usually when we call for support, the issue is resolved in the same few hours.

title: We were significantly overpaying for...
review:
We were significantly overpaying for our previous office phone system, so switching to Nextiva was a game changer. We’re paying about half the price and have received significantly better service.

From the initial setup and onboarding to the ongoing support whenever we have questions or run into an issue, the Nextiva team has been incredibly helpful and responsive. The transition was smooth, and we’ve been very happy with both the service and the value.

My only regret is that we didn’t make the switch sooner! I would absolutely recommend Nextiva to any business looking for a reliable phone system with great customer support at a much better price.

title: RingCentral has been an important part...
review: RingCentral has been an important part of my company’s day-to-day operations. The platform is reliable, easy to use, and keeps all of our communication in one place, which has made a huge difference in our efficiency. We use it for calls, messaging, and meetings, and everything runs smoothly without any issues. What stands out the most is the consistency. In all the years we’ve used RingCentral, we’ve never experienced any major problems or downtime, which is critical for maintaining strong communication with our clients. It gives us confidence knowing we can depend on it every day. Overall, I highly recommend RingCentral to any business looking for a dependable and professional communication solution.

title: I’ve been a Vonage customer since...
review: I’ve been a Vonage customer since 2010, going back to when the company was Vocalocity. Unfortunately, over the past 5 years, I’ve watched the quality of customer service decline. The call center operations seem to have moved from Latin America to India and other locations, and with each change, it has become increasingly difficult to get knowledgeable representatives who can actually resolve an issue. Untrained professionals, heavy accent that it is impossible to understand what they are saying, the service today is marginal at best. Representatives often seem unable or unwilling to take ownership of problems, and getting a straightforward issue resolved can be unnecessarily frustrating and time-consuming. After more than 15 years as a customer, it's time to leave. It feels less like the customer-focused company I originally signed up with and more like another large telecommunications company focused on cutting costs and maximizing profits rather than providing quality service and support. I would not recommend Vonage to anyone.

title: Our three stores Greenville TX, Sherman...
review: Our three stores Greenville TX, Sherman TX and Durant OK all use this telephone service and it has always worked well for us. Our new employees are able to pickup fast on how to use. The connection between all three stores is also another feature that makes this telephone service a pleasure to use daily.

title: We've had an overall positive...
review:
We've had an overall positive experience with Nextiva. Call quality and reliability have been good, and the platform provides most of the features we need to manage phones across our organization. Features like call groups, forwarding, business-hour routing, delegation, and centralized administration give us quite a bit of flexibility.

Deployment and provisioning are generally straightforward, especially with supported desk phones, although some of the more advanced configuration options can be difficult to find or aren't as intuitive as they could be. A lot of phone specific features are locked behind Support-Only tools. The self-provisioning of devices is nice. We have a lot of different locations and being able to simply ship a phone to a user and have it be virtually plug-and-play is very convenient.

Support has been a mixed experience. They're generally able to help resolve problems, but more unusual issues can sometimes require additional troubleshooting or escalation before reaching a solution.

Pricing is reasonable considering the number of features included, although it can become fairly significant as the number of users and devices grows.

Overall, Nextiva has been a reliable business phone system for us. There are areas where the administration and support experience could be improved, but the reliability and feature set have made it a good fit for our organization.

My latest annual contract bill had only regulatory and 911 recovery fees that sum to $6.88/month. No admin fee or Canadian sales tax. This is a modest decline from recent years. While recovery fees might still be on the high side, they certainly are not exorbitant.
Renewing my 2-year plan requires I phone in shortly after the contract expires. Otherwise it gets switched to a monthly plan.

Customer support has also been responsive when I had a small question during setup. It didn’t take long to get the help I needed. Overall, it’s been a dependable option for both personal and light business use. If you’re considering switching to a VoIP provider, AXvoice is definitely worth trying.

title: Avoid this provider.Imagine your...
review:
Avoid this provider.

Imagine your company’s main business line going out of service without warning. No explanation. No resolution. You spend over 10 hours trying to reach and dealing support. After hours on hold, you are told, “We will call you back.” No one calls. When you follow up, calls get disconnected. No ownership. No urgency.

Now imagine your company being effectively offline for days because your phone system provider does not treat your outage as a priority.

Think about the revenue loss. The missed customers. The damage to your reputation.

For any service-based business, your phone line is critical infrastructure. When it fails and support does not respond with urgency, your operations stop.

If you value your time, your customers, and your revenue, consider carefully before relying on a provider that does not treat business outages as emergencies.

Save yourself the frustration ,and the financial loss.

title: I love Ring Central. It's far better...
review:

For me, I run a small hotel. I use it mostly to text guests various pictures and info. The ability to save pre-made templates and add to messages is very convenient.
By far the best is having a dedicated desktop app that I don't have to constantly refresh/login to every 10 minutes (vs web based app).
Support is real people that answer the phone. No phone tree.

Cost. For just ring x I pay something like $20/month plus I pay another $20 every 3 months for 1000 text messages. This is a fantastic price for this software and half what I was paying for evoice.

Down sides,
> sending text pictures sometimes doesn't work. Some kind of algorithm decides if the image might be spam.
> cancelling products. I happily let the sales rep sign me up for a free trail of all their stuff... and was quickly overwhelmed. I paired it down to just ring x. But removing all the extra features was a multi-step process. Not terrible, but a bit of a pain.

pros: Can use on the desktop or cell phone

The fees might be waived as long as you give us a call to make a payment using a debit or credit card over the phone.

Wow, that's interesting, that email had different numbers then the original letter. The delivered mail notice that said I owed $136($111.71+25) turned into $142.15. They are basically a scamming company that steals your money, I haven't used their service for over a year and they billed me $142. title: Vonage’s Fraud Department contacted...
review:
Vonage’s Fraud Department contacted me via email on a Friday morning, claiming that my business was not legitimate due to the use of a virtual office and a UPS P.O. Box—something I’ve been using without issue for over five years. Despite multiple attempts, I was unable to speak with anyone directly; I was only able to leave a voicemail, which was never returned.

Over the next five days, I received a few emails from Vonage requesting a long list of documentation—during which time my phone service remained shut off, causing significant disruption to my business operations and financial loss. At no point did anyone clearly explain the basis for the fraud accusation or why such drastic action was taken without warning or investigation.

I ultimately submitted approximately 12–14 documents and/or answering questions in response to their request. My service was finally restored five days later, but I still have not received any explanation or acknowledgment of the error.

This experience reflects a lack of professionalism, poor training, and a disregard for customer service. Shutting down a business customer’s phone service without cause, communication, or accountability is simply unacceptable.

title: AxVoice: Unreliable Service, Hidden...
review:
AxVoice: Unreliable Service, Hidden Fees, and Nonexistent Customer Support

I signed up for a full year of VoIP service, expecting reliable communication and a smooth experience. However, after just three months, my account was suspended due to an alleged "failure to pay"—despite already paying in full upfront.

The service quality is questionable at best. Calls drop after 15 minutes, making it unreliable for any serious use. There’s also a 10-second delay after dialing before calls even begin to ring, which adds to the frustration.

One of the biggest disappointments is their false advertising of a live chat support feature—it does not exist. Clicking on “Chat Now” simply redirects you back to their website, and the only contact method available is a webform, which they never respond to.

Before signing up, check their BBB rating—it reflects a troubling pattern of unresolved complaints and questionable business practices. Once they have your payment, don’t expect any real service or support, and if you run into problems, don’t expect them to help. Their lack of customer service and dishonest practices make AxVoice a high-risk choice for VoIP services.

title: Service is abysmal, texting bare...
review:
Service is abysmal, texting bare basics

Customer help is great, but I've had to contact them way too many times, to no good use. Problems with the app, problems setting it up, but the worst have been texting.

1. We are completely unable to text anyone using T-Mobile. It's a problem they've had for 6 months, and nothing has changed. No expected time line on that getting fixed.
2. They claim the texting does not support MMS, yet I can send pics. Videos are limited to 1 MB, rendering it totally useless.
3. We cannot send links in text messages. Nothing.
4. Contacts added do not sync across devices or even across the users in the same account. They each have to be added individually. This problem has been going on for years, and yet they've made no progress on this feature. To me, this is the most insane problem.

This complete lack of very basic functions renders it unusable for all but basic texts. As a business owner, I have to use my personal, unregistered number to contact customers.

Deeply regret wasting the money and time on this company, and we'll be looking for another company soon.

Be cautious and be sure to read all the small print that may come back to haunt you years later.

title: I am long time user (6+ years) and...
review:
I am long time user (6+ years) and implementer of 8x8 Hosted VoIP and can say that they are one of the top in the hosted VoIP space, and I've used a number of others out there. Overall, 8x8 is excellent in a couple of areas, with pricing and simplicity especially, and does everything else pretty well or above average for the most part. 8x8 is a feature rich platform and is simple to administer, offers a lot of bells and whistles, but doesn't bury them like other platforms. It makes them easy to see, understand and set up without overwhelming you with their UI. All of the Contact Center platform features are there, some more mature than others, but readily available to implement and getting better. My only two pitfalls with 8x8 have been the lack of consistency on the Support side and there seems to be several consoles, especially when you're on the Contact Center licensing and platform - it would be nice to have a more unified single pane of glass.
Overall, I would still recommend 8x8 to anyone over the other platforms out there.

title: Overall, it does what it is designed to...
review:
Overall, it does what it is designed to do with additioanl perks. Calls have a typical delay that you would expect from a VoIP service, about 2 seconds. Sometimes more, sometimes less. Texting feature is very nice once you get approved. Had some issues with users being reported as spam but was able to have support clear those out pretty quickly.
The app is excellent. You can opt to your your personal service or wi-fi if you don't want to use data. Scheduling out or setting forwarders for out of office time is pretty easy.
I really enjoy the data analytics, which is available from the web-browser. It's a great feture to display productivity.
On the cons side, we have had issues company wide, when I am able to get support, I very rarely get feedback or follow-up. Recently (two days ago) was on a support call with them, after which I was told I would be contacted within the hour with additional details. This call never happened.
My biggest issues is the lack of transparency with network connection as it is reported on their site. I asked my support person about this, and items are only reported if "enough" reports are made. I asked how many is enough, since they told me this was a known issue, and they were unable to give me an answer. So don't rely on their site for actual statistics of connectivity.

The staff is loving it and is keeping our communication with our customers more organized. The price was great for us as we are a relatively new company and need to stretch our budget. 5 STARS!

title: It was a huge undertaking to switch but...
review: It was a huge undertaking to switch but they made it as easy as could be. When we ran into a hitch, their support was amazing. I couldn't ask for more and the features are great. It has expanded our abilities to communicate within our teams and has really opened some new doors for us. We are pleased with the service.

cons: Lack of dev and features, support is scripted
title: The actual service is stable and uptime...
review: The actual service is stable and uptime is good. That is where the good ends. 8x8 ownership is only focused on profit and will nickel & dime you for every feature that should be included, get ready to pay for a user license just to hot desk a phone. The admin scheduling is terrible, no recurring events, you can't set users passwords as and admin. The call analytics are useless. The support is scripted and takes forever to get to a competent agent, calling in will have you waiting forever. they will rob you of any referral fees. The ownership is deaf to any concerns.

title: I always have a difficult time reaching...
review:
I always have a difficult time reaching a live person for technical support and the online AI support has never been helpful. Once you reach a support tech they are very friendly and willinig to assist. The installation process for new hardware is always difficult to follow without tech support.
The quality of the product is good though and we have never had any downtime due to interruption.

title: 8x8 answers all of our needed, and if...
review:
8x8 answers all of our needed, and if they don't, they have amazing customer services to correct any issues at hand! The online access really makes managing all your needs a simple, mindless task. If an issue does arise, customer serves wastes no time in getting to fixing the problem!

As a Hybrid employee, the 8x8 App makes on the go communication straight forward and simple.

title: We were contacted by RingCentral and...
review: We were contacted by RingCentral and informed that our account with Mitel will reach end of life in June and they were the new partner for Mitel. We were also, told by Mitel and RingCentral that they will waive our Early Termination Fee, if we went to RingCentral. RingCentral told us is was a $3900-$6200 fee to set up our hunt groups, routing, porting, etc. Mitel's auto-attendant informs you they are reaching EOL and they suggest that you find phone providers outside of Mitel. Now we decided to go to another VOIP provide and they are refusing to honor the ETF waiver. Now saying that our Connect plan was not reaching EOL it was only the Business plans that were reaching EOL and were the only contracts that were eligible to wave the ETF. All of this because we chose not to go with RingCentral and bought phones from another provider and intend on moving forward with a different VOIP provider. Great work Mitel and RingCentral!!!!

title: Very robust option for any company that...
review: Very robust option for any company that needs an online phone service. I have never had issues with calls dropping, and there are lots of options and ways to customize most aspects of the experience. You can also send texts from your personal extension, and set your own voicemails. We have been using 8x8 for over a year now and it's been very good.

cons: A lot of times you still need their tech support.
title: I have worked with 8x8 with a couple of...
review: I have worked with 8x8 with a couple of different companies now. At first I really didn't care for them. They have come a long way in the last two years. The sound quality is better, the random issues have seemed to disappear, well most of them anyway. Setting up a new user is not that bad but it's a learning process and not quite straight forward on the back end as is true with adding the licensess but once you are shown how the process is not that bad. The main thing is the users are happy with it and honestly I think a lot of people add the app to their phone and because of the number of clients they have they use 8x8 more than their regular provider. I use it on my computer and I haven't had any issues. Their customer service has gotten a lot more responsive as well and fix issues really fast. If you have never used them, I think you will be pleased. If you have but not in awhile, honestly they are worth taking another look at.

title: This is a very good software and easy...
review: This is a very good software and easy to use. I love that you can answer the phone either from your desktop or through the ap and that you can set the hours on the ap so it isn't disturbing you when your business is closed. The only thing I recommend is that you be able to transfer a call from the ap directly into an individuals voicemail if you know they are out of the office.

title: The phone works okay, but customer...
review: The phone works okay, but customer service is terrible. Beware when you order a phone, it probably will be missing parts. Bought a brand new phone and they don't even send a power cable with it. Those you have to buy separately. Then, I tried to return it, good luck with that. Here I am 2 months later with a worthless phone still on my desk that they haven't sent return info for. You can't call for help, and when I email my "assigned rep" doesn't respond. Got to find a better solution for our phone needs.

title: Zero support.All hidden behind email...
review:
Zero support.
All hidden behind email and tier one help that isn't.
They're very sorry. They really understand. That's it.
Do not use them unless you have your own in house tech team.
No. Still avoid.
Promised SMS functionality never materialized. Reasons why shifted endlessly.
At no point were we ever in communication with anyone who could address the issue.
Avoid.

cons: Analytics bugs out a lot, call queues/ring groups do lack compared to other VOIP providers
pros: Support is great, reliable connection in calls, easy interface for user end application in 8x8 Desktop Managed
title: 8x8 is a great application for the mom...
review: 8x8 is a great application for the mom and pop shop (8x8 Work) and even better with the 8x8 Contact Center (enterprise). The best part about their organisation is the diversity of the org and how great their support is at getting back to you even though they must be swamped with requests daily and globally.

pros: easy to set up, easy to use
title: I was resistant to giving up my old...
review: I was resistant to giving up my old fashioned landline, but the transition to 8x8 was seamless! Excellent training at the outset was key. The porting of my number was done without a hitch, and I was up and running in no time. Love that I can be away from my office and have my calls come directly to my cell without clients knowing. Highly recommend!

title: Been using it for the past couple of...
review: Been using it for the past couple of months and works wonder. The call quality is amazing, the mobile phone app is very easy to use and adding more account is pretty simple as well. The cellular app allows employees to walk while on a call, which is beneficial when they need to see what someone may be calling about.

title: I recommend using 8x8 for all of your...
review: I recommend using 8x8 for all of your buisness needs. The customer service associates are very helpful and quick to respond with any questions or issues you may be having. They have some nice features to use as well. You can have multiple phone and texting lines and the app on your phone is easy to navigate.

title: It started out a little shaky but has...
review: It started out a little shaky but has gotten better over time- For the most part the users now love the system and it is so much easier to maintain now- The Cisco system we previously had was very difficult to maintain- There are so many features that we now user with 8x8 and especially the reporting options are great-

title: Prompt technical support. 8X8 is the...
review: Prompt technical support. 8X8 is the right business system for our Practice. We can run reports for each extension to get information on the call volume, answered and unanswered calls. Very reliable service. Calls transfers are easy. Phone quality is really good. 8x8 provided many features, beyond common needs.

title: Positive: I've had the pleasure of...
review:
Positive: I've had the pleasure of interacting with 8x8's customer service team on multiple occasions, and I must say, their dedication to resolving issues is unmatched. When facing technical challenges that even our in-house IT team struggled with, 8x8's support representatives stayed on the line with us until the problem was fully resolved. Their commitment to customer satisfaction truly shines through in these moments, providing reassurance and peace of mind during critical times.

Cons: One minor issue we encountered was the lack of training materials accompanying our phone equipment. While this might not be directly attributable to 8x8, having comprehensive training resources readily available, such as a website with user guides or instructional videos for the different model phones, would be incredibly helpful for users like us. However, this is a relatively minor concern compared to the excellent support and service provided by 8x8's team.

Overall, my experience with 8x8 has been overwhelmingly positive. Their outstanding customer service sets them apart in the industry, making them a trusted partner for our communication needs.

title: I have been working with 8x8 now for...
review: I have been working with 8x8 now for several months and the product works great. I see a phone number on my screen or Customer System and when I click it, the number is dialed and my desk phone starts ringing. Very convenient and reliable. The pricing is very reasonable as well. I have used vonage in the past and 8x8 is miles ahead.

pros: Extremely easy to use and understand.
title: I love the flexibility 8x8 provides. We...
review: I love the flexibility 8x8 provides. We have the app on our cells so that when we are away from the office we don't miss a single call. Love it! I have used 8x8 in two companies now and have worked great both times. Support is always there and will most likely find a solution to your problem instantly or within a couple of hours.

title: The best customer service in the...
review: The best customer service in the industry. The reliability and quality of the mobile and desktop applications leave something to be desired but the hardline works great. I wish there were more synchronization between Google and 8x8, but it;s generally effective. Also a number of popular CRMs integrate well with 8x8.

title: Generally, it is a good and reliable...
review:
Generally, it is a good and reliable system with many convenient features. Phone, fax, video, mobile, softphone - they have it all. The quality is good if your network is perfect. However, some network imperfections may result in the quality decline, and it may be hard to find exact reasons.
When we started using 8x8 some years ago, support was not always good, but it is significantly improved lately.

title: As an IT Manager who heavily relies on...
review:
As an IT Manager who heavily relies on robust and reliable communication tools, I've been thoroughly impressed with 8x8's services. Their VoIP solutions are not only efficient but also incredibly easy to integrate and manage across our team's diverse tech landscape.

The clarity of calls and minimal downtime have significantly improved our team's communication efficacy, which is critical in our fast-paced environment. Furthermore, 8x8’s customer support has been responsive and helpful, addressing our queries promptly and effectively.

Overall, I recommend 8x8 to any business looking for a dependable VoIP service that scales effortlessly with your needs. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction truly stands out in the telecommunications industry.

Cameron Staley
IT Manager
Aero-Tel Wire Harness Corp.

review: 8x8 8s reliable and the tech support always fixes or answers my questions. We have been customers for 5 years and no issues. Everyone on the team is satisfied. title: RingCentral has been an awful...
review:
RingCentral has been an awful experience for our business. We intended to cancel our services, missed the cut off by a few days, and now they want to charge us almost $2k to "buy out" our 6 lines.

My partners wife (who is also our CFO) became very ill and has been hospitalized for the past few months. So naturally we missed the cut-off date to cancel. RingCentral offered absolutely zero flexibility to us.

If you are considering RingCentral, read your contract terms. It's 12 pages of legalese, but make sure you read it so that you do not end up in the same situation as us... paying for a phone system that you will not use.

In my opinion there are better, less expensive options on the market. But the main reason for my negative review is the fact that RingCentral is not being reasonable. We even offered to pay for a few extra months, since we technically missed the cancellation cut off date, but their support is not helpful at all.

title: As another reviewer mentioned, there...
review: As another reviewer mentioned, there are no prorated refunds of annual plans. Their customer support over the years keeps getting worse. title: I've been a PhonePower customer since...
review:
I've been a PhonePower customer since 2009. In the beginning, support was fantastic and the service was high quality for a reasonable price. The cloned line feature allows you to have up to 2 lines/calls active at one time which is nice (your phone adapter must support it). However, it is now 2024.

Over the years the website slowed down and sections of it (like the invoice and payments page) began to fail. It is an old website but still gives you the ability to manage the service. I usually use the website to delete old voicemails. Okay, the site being old technology is a nit.

But let's move on to the BYOD. I selected a replacement device from the list of supported equipment (Grandstream replacing an old Linksys). During the provisioning process, the PhonePower setup process would only activate one of the 2 lines -- the clone line would not get setup correctly. I contacted support and got a live person -- awesome! And they knew what they were doing -- double awesome! However, it became apparent that the only way we were going to get both of my lines active was to do a manual configuration. And since every adapter is slightly different, the best they could do is provide me with a few basic settings. It was enough to get both lines working. But here's the catch: since it was manually configured, PhonePower won't provide support. That means that if you have problems with your adapter or your adapter stops working after PhonePower does periodic maintenance, you get zero help. I've tweaked the settings on the Grandstream several times, each time requesting help from PhonePower and sending in log information to help troubleshoot why my adapter stops taking and making calls after a PhonePower maintenance event -- no reply; no help. I have to restart my adapter to reconnect. So, support has gone downhill. I used to be able to get assistance, even with a manual configuration, but no more.

Then in 2024, got another surprise. My service just renewed. I mentioned earlier that the payment and invoice section of their site doesn't work (at least not consistently). So, my annual service that is about $100 for the service suddenly was over $230. To be fair, my prior years with fees was around $180. When I asked the billing department why my service went up over 33% in 2 years, they replied that it was due to Federal fees. Really? Federal fees went up 33%? Nope. I managed to get a copy of my invoice. The largest fees were not the Federal fees, rather it was a combination of things -- a huge recovery fee, a PhonePower added fee for administrative cost recovery, and an error in sales tax calculation. I compared it to my mobile phone bill -- it had all but the administrative cost recovery fees, but at a fraction of what PhonePower was passing through. The billing department's response was that VOIP vs Mobile isn't a good comparison since the rules are slightly different. Sorry, but it is a perfect comparison. The fees are out of whack on how they are allocated. Oh, and that administrative cost recovery fee from PhonePower -- that was added to help PhonePower cover its various filings, general account servicing, and record maintenance. Um, what? You are tacking on a service fee to cover the costs that are a typical cost of business and should be covered under the service plan!?!

So, to sum it up, support is a shadow of what it used to be, fees and taxes will more than double your quoted phone plan, they tack on extra charges to cover their typical expenses as though they were a co-op or a non-profit instead of a for profit business. I expect 2024 will be my last year with PhonePower.

title: TLDR; LEARN FROM ME - SAVE YOUR MONEY -...
review:
TLDR; LEARN FROM ME - SAVE YOUR MONEY - TRY OOMA INSTEAD
(NOT A SPONSOR JUST A PISSED FORMER AXVOICE CUSTOMER)

I started with Axvoice in 2017 because it was a very inexpensive option for a "landline" where I had internet but no cell reception.

Since then the price went from near $12/month to around $30/month for the services I was using.

Previously "included" features became paid extras and I quite litterally got to the point that my line was being taken over to the point I could not call into or out of my own number 75% of the time.

I would try and call out and get picked up by several different people all with different accents saying "hello,hello." When I knew for a fact I was trying to call my own cell phone number.

I would have to call 3 times to get through to my wife or vice versa, and when I requested help through AXVOICES pathetic excuse for a ticket system they had the nerve to ask if my dial pad was dirty.

I reported the instance to our account manager, Melvin R, and all I got was a generic apology and no attempt to work with us. Just continued abuse of the terms of our contract. title: I've been using eVoice for almost 10...
review:
I've been using eVoice for almost 10 years. Suddenly on 11/17/23 they claimed there was fraud on my phone account and without explaining or asking me about the alleged fraud they deactivated my account! They asked me to send proof of my credit card to prove it was me and I did. They still did not reactive my account. When I called customer support and told them I was unreachable by phone to clients and government officials who contact me and my staff at the phone numbers they would not take immediate action to resolve. I demanded a refund and filed a consumer fraud complaint with the State of Illinois Attorney General's Office. Evoice did not react except to say they would not give a refund. I asked them how they expected me to run my business when the phone numbers advertised on Google, my website and other marketing pages no longer work. They said they could not advise me on how to around it. I asked how long it would take to resolve the issue and they said they did not know. It would take as long as it takes. I told them this was unacceptable and I would be taking action. I paid for the service and it is not fair that they have deactivated my account with no advance warning.

They ended up re-activating the account later in the day, but then again on November 30, 2023 they deactivated it again with no notice. I thought it was a quiet day with no phone calls - but no eVoice cut me off again. This time they claim it was for a "chargeback". Apparently, my credit card refunded the amount they billed me since they deactivated my account Nov 17th and eVoice didn't like that my request for a refund was a success. I told eVoice if they just told me they were re-running my credit card, I would have okayed it. But I didn't even realize my credit card had refunded the amount until today. I told them my contacts could not reach me, and they had no urgency. I'm still waiting for them to email me.

I am also mailing a hardcopy complaint to their legal department -
eVoice
ATTN: Legal Department
114 5 Avenue, 15th Floor
New York, NY 10011

title: Let me start off by saying I work in...
review:
Let me start off by saying I work in customer service and try to be very accommodating.

I scheduled my service to be installed in my new apartment a month before I moved as I have a varying work schedule and never know my days off. To request a day off I have to ask a minimum of three weeks in advance. Yet I was moving into an older building and understood there may be difficulties. The first tech came and said he needed a letter from the management company giving permission to access to something vague. He said if I got the letter that day they could return quickly. My management company had never heard of such a letter but wrote me one. I called TDS, they gave me a link to send the letter to them.

After 24 hours, when I hadn't heard back, I called them and was told it would be over a week before they could reschedule and that I was to give a copy of the letter to the tech. I was understandably disappointed but I tried to be understanding. I scheduled it for Wednesday from 3pm-5pm. I explained that I would not have access to my phone, I would be at work, and a friend would be here for them. They said no problem. Wednesday morning I called to make sure they were coming and once again explained my work and phone situation.

I happened to get a chance to glance at my phone around 2pm only to see the tech had already gone to my house. Panicked I called TDS. I was told the tech had come and gone and I would need to reschedule. Frustrated, I asked to speak to a manager. I was put on hold for about 10 minutes only for the guy to come back and inform me there was no one to talk to and I'd need to leave a message. I have worked in call centers, I know there is always someone you can talk to, but he refused. It was obvious I wasn't important as a customer. It was the first time in my life I nearly screamed at a customer service person. Instead, I said I didn't need their business and hung up. The problem being I really needed internet.

However, I remembered a short time later I had worked with a salesman named Darren and I had kept his contact info. I called him and expressed my frustration. He was awesome. He got the tech to come back. When the tech saw the letter he said it wasn't written the way they would like to see it worded but he would try to work with it. It just gave me another reason for frustration as I had sent a copy of the letter to TDS over a week earlier and no one said there was a problem with it then. But between the tech guy and Darren they got it worked out. The tech, Zackery, was also great and stayed late to make sure I got up and running. Individually, there are some great people at TDS. But I'm not impressed with TDS customer service at this point.

title: I think what many fail to understand...
review:
I think what many fail to understand with Amazon Connect, is that its not really an "out of the box" system. Sure it does work out of the box, very limited.
But it is the foundation from where you then need to develope on top of, such as integrations into CRM systems, Customer CCP panels, Self-service portals, voicemail portals and so on.

Many complain about the audio quality, which we also had a lot of problems with in the beginning, but that was after coming from an installed application and no on a cloud based browser system, so the requirements are different and so is the quality (not extremely different), it did require some older laptops and headsets to be replaced, as well as some network reconfiguration for voicebased trafic.

So i would say that the pros with amazon connect is that you have almost unlimited freedom to develop whatever you need it to do and with it supporting so many different programming languages, almost anyone with programming experience can start working on it.

The cons which i personally think is the cause of many bad reviews, is that it is not for "beginners", thinking its just to install, setup and ready to go. It requires more than just a flow at first, internal network configuration, integrations into current systems to avoid working in different tabs and so on, without the proper knowledge or an integration partner, this can be a rough thing to get started.

title: I don’t usually post reviews, but I...
review:
I don’t usually post reviews, but I felt like I had to here, as I can’t begin to recommend Nextiva enough! We shopped around quite a bit for an “IP phone provider” for our small business, before initially landing on “Ring Central”. WHAT A HORRIBLE MISTAKE THAT WAS! Hour+ wait times to speak to customer service, insane costs (everything was an add on), and they ported our numbers over, despite our canceling their service, and refused to give them back to us until we paid for another month of their service!! Frustrated, angry, and feeling defeated (with thousands of dollars spent on IP phones, not to mention hours on the phone with ring central “support”), I remembered seeing “Nextiva” when we were shopping around, and we contacted them. OH MY GAWD WHAT A HUGE DIFFERENCE!!! :)

Nextiva has been AMAZING, both as a service and in their support! All of our calls, texts, picture messages, etc. now come to the SAME PLACE. No longer do we have to forward a message, (sometimes 3-4 times, to different employees), to ensure everyone has a copy of the information. Now, it automatically comes in to the app, in one place, where we can all access the same information we need, which saves HOURS of employee time! When a call comes in, it opens our CRM software, creates a call note, tells us who is calling, and allows us to record the call so we can use it later…automatically!! We can also click the phone number in our CRM that we want to call, and it automatically pushes the call to our IP yealink phones, so when we pick up, it is already calling!

Unfortunately, our business still has to use “fax” quite a bit, and now ALL of our faxes, both incoming and outgoing, are attached to an email, and sent to ALL employees that we choose to receive them! This has made things incredibly simple, in terms of “supervisor oversight”, as I no longer have to ask an employee: “hey, did you remember to send that fax?” Or “What day was that fax sent to X client?” Instead, I can just check our email and know right away if it was sent or received. Same for SMS and texts!!

Setup was a breeze on Mac computers (I assume it’s as easy on PC). The few times we’ve had any tech support issues, we’ve been able to get in contact with tech support reps very easily via chat or email, and they have been able to pretty easily fix the few issues we’ve seen.

In the beginning, when we first started with Nextiva, the apps, desktop and mobile, were somewhat “in their infancy”, and they have really been built out and improved seemingly, within the past year or so (and they seem much more stable, especially with the releases within the last month or two).

If you’re considering a phone system that is a “little smarter” than your current one, and have looked into ring central, vonage, etc., I IMPLORE you to give Nextiva a chance…they have totally changed the way we handle our day to day business and client contact in SUCH a positive way, that I don’t know how we got along in the past without them!!

We found Nextiva to be cheaper, easier to use, and exactly what we needed for our small business. I can’t speak to how the system would work in a “bigger environment”, but everything I’ve seen so far leads me to believe the system would work as well, or better, for larger companies too!

Can’t wait to see what they do next!!

Unfortunately, they do not disclose in any of their limited advertising I have seen, nor did the rep on the chat helpline I asked before subscribing, nor did the PC Mag article that recommended it as best VOIP for international calling, that CALLS TO MOBILE PHONES in our countries of interest ARE NOT INCLUDED. We already signed up for the one-year offer, so I will reevaluate our options at the end of the subscription period.

Installation is a no-brainer, as expected. I suggest a power supply backup for your router and Voiply box if the service is important to you in the event of an outage - in all likelihood your network does not provide power for your service. Depending on where you are, cell phone coverage may only last a few hours in the event of a widespread power outage (https://www.lightreading.com/security/5g-providers-reject-mandates-for-backup-power-at-cell-sites/d/d-id/774260).

If there is a problem outside of those hours, GOOD LUCK. NO ONE HOME!! What kind of a service provider does not even have emergency after hours support. Do not even consider this provider. We are changing as fast as we can.

title: This platform doesn't offer direct...
review: This platform doesn't offer direct dialing of customer extensions... Which I would say is pretty normal for other platforms, and being a phone provider... That should be a pretty pressing issue for them. Support was more confused than helpful.

title: Set up is kind of a hassle but it works...
review: Set up is kind of a hassle but it works after that. When I got a phone, it was tricky to get it set up on the system. Also, they give you a main number and a direct number but the main number is just a distribution number so it requires you to get a separate line for a receptionist if you plan to have one.

title: This is a great app! I love that we can...
review: This is a great app! I love that we can integrate with many of the other apps we use. The features are fantastic and very user-friendly and easy to use. This app has definitely bridged the gap between us and our clients to make our conversations flow easier and more smoothly. I would recommend this to all companies who want to ensure that they get the best connection time with their clients.

title: RingCentral has a good price for...
review:
RingCentral has a good price for performance. Their product is constantly evolving. But I like about it is that it works well with my CRM, recruiting software, with screen pops and notifications.
Their mobile product is very good and works very well with my cell phone.
They were very good video and screen sharing capability albeit sometimes slow to load.

title: It's fantastic so far.  The...
review:
It's fantastic so far. The interoperability of choosing who calls will go to, the call trees, the ease with which you can add lines - it all makes managing a small business easier.

I was especially impressed with the ability to make message recordings by phone when my computer mic wasn't working. It really seems very well thought out.

title: The service has been awesome with...
review: The service has been awesome with RingCentral. They have always taken care of our business and the way that Customer Service is fast and reliable is the reason we’re still here. We have instances where we’ve needed to adjust our amount of users, and how we manage our text messages, and in every case the customer service has gone up and beyond what we expected. There’s even shown as features that we didn’t even know that RingCentral had that I’ve benefited our business.

title: The experience with ring central has...
review: The experience with ring central has been great! They have group texting feature which I’ve been looking for! I had a questions/issue and their customer service called me right away and resolved my issue. I was so grateful. And their pricing is competitive! Out of all the services I’ve looked at, this is best!

pros: Easy to learn & use, great support
title: I've only been using 8x8 for a short...
review: I've only been using 8x8 for a short time but have been very pleased with the service I've received. Training is readily available & I have had no issues in using this system. I'm very pleased with my decision to go with 8x8. Customer service walked me through the initial setup which was quick & easy and felt like I had a new friend in the process.

pros: make long calls without paying any extra money
title: Great for bulk calls and easy on...
review:
Great for bulk calls and easy on pocket
I can make long calls without paying any extra money and Axvoice works with my old hardware but the finest part is that it is great for bulk calls. This means I can make multiple calls throughout the day without having to worry about any hidden charges or extra costs

title: Ring Central is a great phone service...
review: Ring Central is a great phone service for any office job - I love how I can easily send texts and faxes all in the app, and I love being able to route my calls to my cell phone if I am out of the office. I like having the option to intercom to my co-workers verses having to email or call. I like that is easily accessible and easy to learn.

pros: great integration process and team, low cost.
title: Had a great experience from start to...
review: Had a great experience from start to finish. My sales rep Karen, to the implementation team, the process is easy and interface is user friendly. The low cost is great, especially for a small company that is just starting out! The customer service is on point and I know if I need them for something in the future, they will be there to address any issues. Thank You!

title: Awesome customer service. Was able to...
review: Awesome customer service. Was able to get with an agent right away who resolved my problem within minutes. The agent listened attentively and compassionately. They listed what they could do for me and how I would like to proceed. Communicated her actions every step of the way while working with me. Loved it.

title: We have used Ring Central for about 1...
review: We have used Ring Central for about 1 years. It is VERY pricey. We don’t use most of the features. What is unfortunate the business has to close for a period of months (due to a mandate, it was not voluntary), they want me to pay over $6,000.00 to go from 9 to 2 lines. I offered to keep the original 36 month contract when we go back to 9 lines in the future (ie extend the contract). They were not even reasonable, saying they could not change the initial contract. Bull! The business is not bringing in any income for the short term. I wonder how they will feel when the business does not pay them anything, a real lack of business retention. No customer service. Don’t do it! Whatever you do don’t sign a contract!!!!

title: I recently had an unfortunate...
review:
I recently had an unfortunate experience with Ring Central that compelled me to share my honest feedback and recount the challenges I faced with their services. As a business owner, I relied on Ring Central to meet my communication needs, but unfortunately, their downgraded service, unauthorized charges, and poor messaging system caused significant setbacks, ultimately resulting in the loss of valuable customers.

One of the primary issues I encountered was the gradual decline in the quality and reliability of Ring Central's services. From dropped calls and frequent disruptions in call quality to intermittent issues with the system's overall functionality, my business suffered due to these service shortcomings. Despite reaching out to their customer support team on multiple occasions, the problems persisted, leaving me with a diminished level of trust and confidence in Ring Central's ability to provide a dependable communication solution.

To add insult to injury, I discovered unauthorized charges on my account, which was truly disheartening. As a vigilant customer who diligently reviewed my invoices, I was shocked to find charges that were neither authorized nor communicated to me beforehand. This breach of trust not only affected my financial well-being but also highlighted a significant flaw in Ring Central's billing practices. The lack of transparency regarding these charges further exacerbated my frustration and led me to question their commitment to ethical business practices.

Furthermore, the messaging system offered by Ring Central proved to be highly inadequate and inefficient. In today's fast-paced business environment, effective and timely communication with customers is paramount. Regrettably, Ring Central's messaging system fell short, causing missed or delayed messages that ultimately resulted in misunderstandings and, more importantly, the loss of valuable customers. This detrimental impact on my revenue and customer satisfaction was a direct result of the poor performance of Ring Central's messaging system.

Given the significant concerns mentioned above, I made the difficult decision to terminate my services with Ring Central. I firmly believe that as a customer, it is essential to hold service providers accountable for their shortcomings, as it not only affects individual businesses but also helps others make informed decisions.

In conclusion, my experience with Ring Central has been disappointing, characterized by a downgraded service, unauthorized charges, and a poor messaging system. I would caution other businesses to carefully consider these factors before choosing Ring Central as their communication solution. Transparency, reliability, and efficient customer service are crucial aspects that every service provider should prioritize, and unfortunately, Ring Central failed to deliver on these fronts.

It is my hope that Ring Central takes these issues seriously, addresses them promptly, and implements necessary improvements to ensure a better experience for future customers.

title: After being a customer since 2014 I...
review: After being a customer since 2014 I called to cancel one phone line. My one staff person is retiring at the end of this month. They said I couldn’t because I had a contract. Apparently, they automatically renew your contract without telling you. Now, I have to wait almost a year before they will cancel it. The supervisor I asked to speak with parroted the same thing. They will not work with me despite being a customer all of these years.

title: Make sure to call in if you have an...
review: Make sure to call in if you have an issue with service (this is my first service call in 3 years since joining), Alexandra Brahynets was extremely helpful! I tried putting in a service ticket to begin with but I do not recommend trying to fix any issues that way as they do not think about your business hours and if you do not reply do to not being open they just close out the service call. But calling in got the issue fixed in less than 30 minutes.

title: The system is greatFast updating of...
review:
The system is great
Fast updating of people and changes.
Support is fast to get online and quick to make changes.

Every time I call for support, they clearly understand my changes, make the changes with a check - to - verify that all is good. They even have ideas on the changes and can make suggestions that are right inline with my needs.

Available 24/7 and always has a smile to help.

pros: helpful support, quality service, good resources for transitioning from a different provider
title: I recently helped my company switch...
review:
I recently helped my company switch over to Nextiva from a different service provider. Nextiva's resources and staff were helpful, patient and clear and made the transition nearly seamless.

Since then the support has been stellar and the quality of our calls is significantly improved. The team has done a great job of helping specifically tailor the service to our needs as a company.

title: We use Nextiva in our organization of...
review: We use Nextiva in our organization of @ 115 staff. It is user friendly, the administration portal for setting adjustment is intuitive. The app for the cell phone is very problematic. That is my only complaint. Often at the beginning of the call there is an echo & the calls drop frequently. I hope Nextiva can fix this at some point in the near future.

title: Very good service and features, easy to...
review:
Very good service and features, easy to use. Support is readily available, but can vary depending on issue and CS personnel, but overall, very helpful!
Cost and features are very good, better than most other providers I looked into.

The equipment and processing speed in better than other providers along with the system redundancy.

title: Great for making multiple callsAxvoice...
review:
Great for making multiple calls
Axvoice is great for making multiple calls per day because I work internationally so its international calls package suits me. Plus I am able to with zero lag or connection issues making it ideal for all professionals who have to make international calls throughout the day.

title: Works smoothly on old hardwareI am...
review:
Works smoothly on old hardware
I am really happy with my purchase of Axvoice because it works smoothly on old hardware so I don't have to pay extra for new devices. The Axvoice team is quite helpful when they are not busy and can set up the devices for you so you can immediately start placing calls. Two thumbs up.

title: I have been a customer of 8x8 for many...
review: I have been a customer of 8x8 for many years. Our office has six phones. I don't remember ever having any problem. Recently I was interested in establishing a sms message campaign. I requested assistance, and one of their associates walked me through the process very efficiently. I highly recommend 8x8 voip.

title: Excellent support and sales team, very...
review:
Excellent support and sales team, very friendly and helpful.
App features and quality is great.
I have been using RC for over 10 years now both on mobile and desktop version and ease of use on both platforms is excellent.
It is a great solution for small business to stay connected anywhere.
Overall very satisfied.

title: When you started a year ago with...
review:
When you started a year ago with RingCentral you might have missed a lot of feautres you would think are standard. In the meantime RC did catch up on a lot of things, which is great. The reliability is almost 100 %. The support people are helpful and skilled, but the tickets system is not very good from customer perspektiv.

The analytics part is great and still devloping. If you want to analyze the data on your own, you need to build it your self without much support from RC.

title: Very easy to use. Would recommend this...
review: Very easy to use. Would recommend this to any small business owner. I am glad i made this choice. The installation support was very helpful. I was looking for other VOIP services and ringcentral tops them all. I am saving significant amount of money. Using ring central for my virtual assistants has been my best choice.

cons: When you need help you go through many departments before getting to the person who will help you.
pros: Onboarding process was easy with a knowledgeable representative.
title: No real complaints so far.  Easy...
review: No real complaints so far. Easy service to learn with tutorials and service reps calling to ensure you are all set in the beginning. We are a small business and being able to use phone and or computer has been a plus for us. My only issue has been in checking on the texting process and registration, I had to talk to 7 different people, only to learn that it takes 5-20 days and we are on day 14. Hopefully we will have texting capabilities within the next 6 days.

title: They were able to set it up exactly how...
review: They were able to set it up exactly how I wanted it. I get calls to my mobile phone, desk phone and computer. I will never miss a call. The customer service has been great so far, they are very patient. They have met every single one of my requests. I would recommend this to anyone, whether its big or small business.

pros: Intelligent call routing for better lead management Advanced reporting and analytics for data-driven decision-making Easy-to-use interface for improved productivity Seamless integration with CRM for streamlined workflows Increased efficiency and productivity for sales teams Higher customer satisfaction through personalized connections More effective lead management resulting in increased conversion rates Greater visibility into team performance and areas for improvement.
title: As a marketing manager, I highly...
review: As a marketing manager, I highly recommend CONVOSO's dialer. It has increased our team's productivity and efficiency with intelligent call routing, advanced reporting and analytics, and seamless integration with our CRM. Its user-friendly interface and valuable insights make it an indispensable tool for any sales team looking to maximize their performance.

title: Excellent product and service....
review: Excellent product and service. Experience has been exceptional and has exceeded our expectations. We haven't used all the features as of yet, but love the idea that they are there. Nextiva customer support has been marvelous. Our only question is why haven't we received our Amazon card from a previous established other account we were promised?

title: Poor Service for Broken AppsThe...
review:
Poor Service for Broken Apps

The Android App does NOT sync with the desktop. It frequently just returns a "Cannot connect to messaging service" error (but oddly, I'll get a phone notification of a message, but it wont display IN the app!).
Customer support is non-existent (outsourced to a chat-bot, but you can get to a human after an hour or so).
They keep adding "new feature bells and whistles" that small businesses don't need. By trying to please everyone, they are really just letting their customers down. I'm looking to replace them

pros: simple, user friendly, easy to understand,  cost effective
title: I find Nextiva to be a very user...
review:
I find Nextiva to be a very user friendly system that is cost effective. Does it have all the bells and whistles other providers have? I don't know cuz I don't need them. I only need a phone system that works.

The biggest drawback for this provider occurs during set up. While installation is really plug and play, customers are kind of left on their own to set the system up and it's hit and miss if the system works as it should with the hardware provided by your internet service provider. That can lead to a lot of frustration.

However, Nextiva seems to understand the pain points and have invested in the support department. Support provided by Nextiva is timely, efficient, knowledgable and courteous making this a valuable service.

title: We using it at least 4 month and is soo...
review: We using it at least 4 month and is soo good, we have some problem with setup the all things but the Support is one of the best what I see. One of the misunderstanding is the price and features included. But is maybe my problem when I talk with a sales manager. In general i absolutely recommend this.

cons: We have never had them even set up Wright, you tell us we have a different phone from what we have. You say our phone is old yet we have had them 6mo.
title: Do not recommend this system, we have...
review: Do not recommend this system, we have had it 6mo. Customer service has no clue how our phones work. We get different answers from every person we talk to. Now I'm paying for two phone systems. We switched to to Verizon and they work well. 4000 times better. We can do more with much less hassle, I hope to get a refund from Nextiva.

title: I have personally used the Nextiva VoIP...
review:
I have personally used the Nextiva VoIP phone system for the last 5 years, and have implemented the Nextiva system for several clients, as well. Our client base is varied across healthcare, government and other private commercial industries. Each installation has been a bit different, but the Nextiva system is adaptable to the needs of the clients.

The installation project is streamlined and you truly have a "partner" in the implementation process, as well as after the installation, when needed. As an Admin on the Nextiva system, one can make many of the changes that may be needed to add/delete a user, change call flows or group, etc; however, if I'd rather have some assistance or just work with support, they are able to assist. Nextiva offers multiple options for support when it is needed - chat, email, online portal access with quick videos, and via phone. They have a support team that is knowledgeable but have an escalation path for more advanced features, when needed. I personally use the Nextiva mobile and desktop app, as do many in my company, as well as our clients.

In short, I'm a fan of the Nextiva system for small to large businesses.

title: Convoso team is great to work with and...
review: Convoso team is great to work with and the system has been very useful for my team. Simple start up process. From the discovery call to roll out everyone was nice to work with and its priced very fair. The system is very user friendly for both admins and agents. Never have had any tech issues and anytime I have had a user question its answered almost immediately.

title: 8x8 helped with my issues over the...
review:
8x8 helped with my issues over the phone. It was easy to get into contact with support. They were very patient with me as I need extra time to explain the problem. There were able to fix all my problems quickly and correctly the first time.

I would recommend 8x8 as your voice over IP as they are able to connect you with real help instead of bots.

title: I'm a new hire at EnableTo, and am...
review: I'm a new hire at EnableTo, and am required to install 8X8. Unfortunately, I managed to do everything wrong and then made it worse by trying to fix it myself. I was connected with Rahman, who was so genuinely considerate, patient, and knowledgeable, that I was able to calm down and go through the steps with him. I was very favorably impressed with the customer service of 8X8.

pros: very responsive and helpful staff, easy to use software and quantifiable results with real-time reporting
title: Excellent and helpful staff, as well as...
review: Excellent and helpful staff, as well as an excellent and useful product. Convoso has allowed our company to level up our less successful sales reps and showcase our sales superstars with call recording and real-time reporting. Stellar product at a great price. I Would definitely recommend this software for any company with a sales department

title: They rolled out their new desktop app...
review: They rolled out their new desktop app about 6 months ago and it's been nothing but trouble ever since. Let's start with the fact that the answer call popup sometimes does not pop up until the 3rd ring (BTW, there is no other wasy to answer the call without seeing and clicking on the popup). Ghost calls show up in the middle of the night when there isn't even a live internet connection on my desktop and of course the missing calls from my call log. Another irritating thing is having to actually call into your voicemail to erase or mark a message read. (used to be able to do that from the app) There's more but those are the big 4. Their previous desktop app was fine for years and then they had to try to take on the world with SMS (doesn't work well), new contact tracking, and now social media management. You'e a phone company - DO THAT RIGHT!!!

title: Switched for technical support. I have...
review:
Switched for technical support. I have not been disappointed.
I don't have much spare time and it is a great relief having the good tech support available when I need them so that I don't have to spend hours trying to solve the problem alone. If you are looking for a responsive company with a great product and great people; look no further than Nextiva.

title: Thank you to my representative, she was...
review:
Thank you to my representative, she was very attentive, she listened to my concerns and addressed everything. She even made suggestions that worked for me. It was very positive working with her.
The phone service offers so many features that are great attributes to my company.
The rep was very creative and I like that.

title: We switched over to Nextiva in 2020...
review: We switched over to Nextiva in 2020 during the pandemic and it's been a successful switch over for the firm. We were able to work from home and still receive and make calls from our desktop app or mobile devices without clients noticing the difference we were in the office or home. We even switched over our fax service as well to Nextiva so we could fax from desktop.

title: Customer Service by ticket is prompt...
review: Customer Service by ticket is prompt and effective. Call in support can be a long wait. Most of the time, issues are resolved quickly. Service is friendly and patient. the portal is a little confusing and tutorials are hard to follow; however, our phones work well, and there are rarely glitches or downtime. I would recommend Nextiva to business customers.

cons: Long wait time to speak with representatives
title: I had to set up a total of 11 devices...
review: I had to set up a total of 11 devices for our office and reached out to the support team for help. Maria was knowledgeable, patient and helpful. She went above and beyond in explaining the process. Although the entire setup took over 4 hours, she maintained a positive attitude and high level of professionalism throughout. I would highly recommend this provider.

cons: Can have a bit of a wait on hold to talk to a representative
pros: Reps are happy and pleasant to talk to
title: Carl did an awesome job this morning...
review: Carl did an awesome job this morning helping me get me final steps completed in porting over my number and getting my messages set up to be transcribed. Now I’m more efficient and can focus on the other stuff that I need to get done. Great job and a big thanks for coming up with an outside of the box solution

title: Signed up a couple weeks ago to use...
review: Signed up a couple weeks ago to use Nextiva as a soft phone with our inbound call team. So far so good -- the chat support is outstanding, quick, and very helpful. The setup team helped us get up and running the day after we signed up, set up a call flow for us, and got us working quickly. A couple of weeks after we started, one of our agents quit, so I needed help switching her license to a new user, and was able to get that resolved in minutes. Highly recommend Nextiva.

title: Tech support today was very helpful in...
review: Tech support today was very helpful in adding new line and helping set up changes I want. Why do I need so many characters to submit a review. I have said what I want to say but this wont accept it with less than 300 characters when a short review is sufficient in my opinion. The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dog.

title: Very user friendly and offers a lot of...
review: Very user friendly and offers a lot of creative ways to work more effectively. The app works well on my phone so it makes it easier to check in something quickly. We utilize virtual medical assistants who each have their own line, but feel as though they are able to handle more since there is no direct patient care.

title: This is an impartial review.   I...
review: This is an impartial review. I recently started using this service, but I am having some issues. I have several phones that are freezing and neither Nextiva nor the company that installed the phones have any idea what is going on. So, I cannot in good faith give quality a decent score. That also holds true for reliability and support. I would suggest that you ask that the company record logs automatically instead of by request. That would save a lot of time when trying to troubleshoot issues. Once you iron out the bugs, errors, and mistakes, it seems like it might be a pretty solid option.

title: We have been using Nextiva for just a...
review: We have been using Nextiva for just a few week now, and getting to know all the features and options. Everything works great, but there is one option is not available, and that is there is no was to enlarge the photo from the SMS. In order to enlarge image, we have download it to computer and that is now convenient at all, takes some extra time. We would really suggest to work on this future. Other then that, everything else works great. Thank you for all your help.

title: Diana was extremely helpful this...
review: Diana was extremely helpful this morning. For the last few months our office has had our calls forwarded to a call center during business hours, and today I finally needed to cancel the call center and have the calls rerouted to coming into our office at all times. I had blocked off a huge portion of my morning for this task, but Ms. Diana was able to get the issue resolved in less than ten minutes flawlessly. Phones are up and running again, and I couldn't be happier hers and Nextiva's service. Thank you very much from McDaniel Accounting Services PC. <3

title: I've been working with them for a year...
review:
I've been working with them for a year now. No issues. and quick response to problems. They helped me configure the phones and activate the messages on my desktop.
I do recommend their services, the app is easy to use and has a good user experience.
Sometimes they have a long time on waiting through the phone but other than that I love Nextiva.

title: Support is very friendly and attentive,...
review: Support is very friendly and attentive, answered all my questions and they were able to assist and fix the issue.

title: the online system is very simple to use...
review:
the online system is very simple to use and very well set up. Most of the changes that i need to make for the office phone system, i can simply log in to nextiva website and do it. staff when calling are very respectful and knowledge, definitely recommend this phone system.
we have about 30 nextiva lines in the office.

title: Once you find someone to help you, the...
review:
Once you find someone to help you, the support and guidance is amazing. The difficult part is finding someone to help!
The person that helped me via the chat session was very thorough and patient. She provided step by step instructions and got my phone connected and working. As I stated, the challenge is finding someone to help.

cons: not as robust as the cisco call manager
title: Overall we are very happy with the...
review: Overall we are very happy with the Nextiva service. The onboarding team at Nextiva was amazing as well as the ongoing support. The only downside that I've come across is that the management portal is not as robust as the cisco call manager but some may see that as a positive! I would recommend them as a replacement for your current POTS or VOIP system.

title: We have had service for a few years and...
review:
We have had service for a few years and it simple to make adjustments adding/removing users if needed.
Agent was very helpful in setting up our auto attendant. Web portal is very simple to use and I like the fact that you can check voicemails online without having to dial in. I normally recommend Nextiva!

title: I was on with three different divisions...
review: I was on with three different divisions of Nextiva Support today. Each associate was extremely professional, polite and willing to help with our company's issues. They each went through multiple troubleshooting steps and passed me along promptly when the questions was better answered by a different department. I was very satisfied with their service and follow up recommendations.

pros: great support (live, and asynchrnous), affordable, scalable
title: I have been with Nextiva with my...
review:
I have been with Nextiva with my business for almost 10 years. They have always been responsive to my needs for support. They are affordable. They can easily scale up or down depending on your business needs.

Since I first joined them as a customer, their product offerings has increased significantly!

cons: waiting for a rep to call
title: Support is spotty, always have to wait...
review: Support is spotty, always have to wait for a call back if your lucky to receive. You can't just get immediate service, you call one line to get transferred to another just to get transferred to yet another to be told someone will call back in 24hrs. All want to do is purchase a device which is time sensitive.

review: After looking through reviews I decided to get Nextiva because of the features and price, but I would have paid more for better customer service. Porting is a huge hassle. Half the support team has not been trained properly. If you have an issue (and most likely you will) be prepared to waste hours of your time trying to get help. Also, support is prone to having outages/crashes so you may end up starting back at 1 if someone was in the middle of helping you. Besides the awful customer service the phones themselves are ok. There is definitely a learning curve especially with older generations. The app crashes a lot. Just restart until it works again.

pros: Can easily set up new phones or make changes to or phone set up online in same day. or
