After everything was set up Romeo reviewed with me how everything works and provided me with the next steps for setting up our voicemail. I can't say enough good things about Nextiva.

title: I just started using Nextiva last week...
review: I just started using Nextiva last week so I can't rate the quality or relability yet. Several issues arose, as to be expected when transitioning, but the customer support individual (Romeo) was fantastic at fixing most of the issues. the one issue not taken care of was the delivery of the phones, but that was the delivery company's fault, not Nextiva. Porting of our phone number was handled quickly and efficiently with no problems.

title: Excellent customer service. Took care...
review: Excellent customer service. Took care of the question I had and helped me resolve it. Did not have to wait on the phone for very long. Customer service agent was very thoughtful, polite, insightful, and well-versed. She even helped me with detailed instruction and guided me through the set up process.

title: Very simply, easy to use and user...
review: Very simply, easy to use and user friendly interface. It makes my job as a Dialler Manager a breeze due to the dialler running so smoothly on a daily basis with minimum to zero issues and we get the most productivity from our staff compared to working on other dialler systems. The reporting system on Convoso is exceptional and it has great dialling strategies that makes lead management a breeze and they meet every requirement of mines to make my daily tasks easier by the day.

title: This system works great!  I've been...
review: This system works great! I've been working on PBX systems for almost 20 years and this seems to be one of the easiest to use and make changes to. On rare occasions that I need tech support's assistance, they always reply quickly and work diligently toward a solution. I would recommend this system to anyone, anytime.

title: Nextiva has been great to work with....
review: Nextiva has been great to work with. Customer Support has been very responsive to every request we've called in with. After working with customer support we also got follow up emails with links to resources that they thought would be helpful. I would definitely recommend Nextiva for all your VoIP needs.

title: We love the reliability of Nextiva, we...
review: We love the reliability of Nextiva, we never have dropped calls and our customers can always reach us. The system is pretty easy to navigate and figure out on your own. Support is always available to help and can usually resolve the issue you are experiencing in a timely matter or find someone who can assist.

title: A lot of people might be wondering why...
review:
A lot of people might be wondering why you need to use VOIP instead of a traditional landline. VOIP has become extremely popular, thanks to Skype, a service that lets you use your computer to talk to your friends over a broadband internet connection. Right now, most TV cable companies and phone companies offer VOIP handset deals. The reason why they are so popular is that in most places, the old phone company had always a monopoly on landlines. Calls between cities in the same country are considered long distance and don't even start looking at international long-distance calls. The costs are pretty steep. But first of all, what is VOIP? VOIP stands for Voice Over Internet Protocol, a way to talk over the Internet.
Most people use VOIP as a bundled phone service through their cable provider. However many people are not aware that many companies provide a better feature set at a cheaper price! One such provider I used to run my business is VOIPo.com.
They offer many advanced features which many cable companies simply don't offer at a fraction of the price. Here are some examples of how VOIPo makes me more productive every day:
-If I'm going to be out of the office with just a few keypad entries all my calls can follow me wherever I go.
-Thanks to custom caller ID if someone in my online address book calls me from their cell phone I don't have to guess who the number belongs to.
-Some months I do a lot of remote support which has to be billed hourly or flat rate. With the call logs being conveniently logged in a control panel there is no need to watch a call timer.
-I use a service called YouMail which is voice mail on steroids; using VOIP's call forwarding along with YouMail all my messages go to one unified mailbox. That is just my preference and VOIPo in itself has voice-mail that works very well.
-Choice of phones! Whether you want to use your existing phone system with the ATA they send you or want to use a softphone client on your PC, MAC, or smartphone devices one can answer calls where it is convenient for them. Personally, I use a Cisco 525G2 IP phone on my desk along with an ATA hooked up to a waterproof cordless phone.
-Sick of telemarketers and Robocalls? VOIPo has its own telemarketer block list and integrates with NoMoRobo so no longer will they interrupt your dinner.

title: Other companies are not charging their...
review:
Other companies are not charging their account holders for TCR. The fees and taxes that I paid along with the subscription cost should have covered it.

My mobile carrier Verizon is NOT requiring me to register with TCR. They haven't even heard of it.

RingCentral told me that it is not RingCentral who will disable our SMS ability but rather my mobile carrier. I spent 1 hour speaking with two different agents from Verizon's Corporate office. They investigated the TCR requirement and found nothing. Verizon is not aware of this "requirement" and therefore is not going to disable my SMS. If my SMS is disabled, it will clearly be from RingCentral, not Verizon.

I pulled this off of RingCentrals site, FAQ's:
"Carrier fees and account restrictions: Accounts in violation of RingCentral or carrier rules and regulations may be subject to reduced deliverability of messages, additional campaign registration requirements and fees, suspension of service, or termination of service in addition to fines and other penalties passed through RingCentral by the carriers."

RingCentral is blaming the Carriers for the rules and fees. RingCentral has adopted CTIA's rules and regulations, not Verizon. CTIA is not a government agency, there is no government requirement for this. If there are fines and penalties, it will be from RingCentral, not Verizon and not the government.

cons: Inoperative Caller ID, Useless Customer Service & Awful Billing Practices
title: The appeal of Voipo is the affordable...
review: The appeal of Voipo is the affordable service with a variety of features. But, the overall call quality seems inferior. Caller ID has never displayed the Caller, Date, and Time correctly on any of my residential phones. Although, this is a known problem for many customer accounts, they remain unable to address and resolve the matter. Dialing toll free numbers has inconsistent reliability; it only works sometimes depending on the number. The major issues are the Customer Service and Billing Practices. The customer service agents are friendly. However, they only have limited ability for assistance. The billing department is purely a back end operation. It is not possible to speak with an agent directly for billing issues. A support ticket is created for a later response. Customers are unaware that purchasing their service initiates an automated renewal process. Other major providers (Ex: Amazon, Norton, etc) expressly inform customers of automated renewal. This is not the case for Voipo. They remit an invoice 2 weeks prior to plan expiration, which does not mention their intention to process the fee. Then, they immediately charge the original credit card on file without consent. After the unauthorized charge has satisfied the upcoming renewal balance 14 days early, they will generate a new invoice and charge the card again a few hours later! This should never occur under any circumstance with a confirmed $0 balance on the account! It was grossly unnecessary, inappropriate, and deceptive. Moreover, their concerning billing practices fail to protect customer credit card accounts from misuse. I promptly contacted the merchant to file a fraud claim. I also notified Voipo of their duplicative charge to request a refund. Ultimately, they lack accountability, make excuses, and ignore their various system issues. Let the buyer beware.

title: It's hard to believe that 8x8 can...

The original cut-over , incredibly well planned and executed by Fostar Communications and 8x8, was seamless (which never happens with other providers) and we have not had any glitches in our service in the year since we switched to 8x8.

title: I would give zero stars if it was...
review: I would give zero stars if it was possible. They make it extremely difficult to cancel. When trying to cancel, they will give you a low promotional price that then raises up month after month. I had a hard time canceling. When I was finally able to cancel, it was conveniently for Vonage on the 2nd day of the billing cycle. Because you are billed a month in advance, they will not refund any money, even though they are not providing any service. Customer service is out of India and difficult to understand. A year after cancelling, I am surprised to see that I was sent to collections for $20. Do yourself a favor and pick a company with integrity.

review: This is worst company I have EVER worked with. COMPLICATED, glitchy system that never worked right. Massive delays just with installation. Incompetent sales and tech people. How they still have over 4 stars HAS to be due to their own people writing good review.s All I see are 1 star reviews. Do not be fooled. This is a 0 star company.

System is very reliable and devices include all the features you would ever need. Having SMS capability is a huge plus.

title: As a customer for over 12 years,...
review:
As a customer for over 12 years, Nextiva's service & support was hands-down a leader and, in my opinion, the best.

So the kind 1-Star Ding is for the 15-20+ hours I wasted over the previous five months in many unproductive, hours-long chat sessions trying to unblock the read-only restriction Nextiva placed on our business account.

We could receive calls, but only if the caller left a VM. And only on the main number. Without access to the macOS Nextiva App, no outbound calling from any of our numbers for the previous five months it took to fix this problem.

The problem began after our DEC '22 payment failed to process. Even though the account remained current for the next three months until now, that month remained unpaid. So with no way to log in to reset our UID or PW, No phone support, and 1-2 hour chat wait times, until finally, after some very time-consuming investigations, another live chat agent states that the account is current and everything is fine. Try clearing cache & cookies and changing browsers - something I already said at the beginning of every chat with previous chat agents. Then repeat the entire thing with the next agent after confirming that the browsers are not the source of the problem. Support can't access our account to reset UID or PW, so wait for nothing to happen.

And so it repeated until agent "Blessing" guided me step-by-step on the 3-hour chat today to resolve the issue.

We now need total access to port our numbers out. Thank you!

The call quality on Nextiva is top-notch, with crystal clear sound and no lag or interference. This has been a game-changer for my business, as it has improved the overall experience for my clients and has made communication much more efficient.

I have a small business and having this type of Customer service is key. Thank you!

title: Everything on Nextiva is just awesome!...
review: Everything on Nextiva is just awesome! Even the technical support team is great. They can fix your issue in just a couple of minutes and you're already good to go. Exceeded my expectation. Before we were using a different provider and it was a waste of time and money! After switching to Nextiva all of our problems were resolved. Thank you and kudos to you all!

title: As the admin and user of the system,...
review:
As the admin and user of the system, it's a very simple and clean system. The setup of users and assigning to phones and extensions is very straightforward. It's a very user-friendly interface to get used to and work with. The call flow is even easier to set up and it's all web GUI based and drag and drop. In other systems I've used, the call flow is convoluted and has too many moving parts. This one - one screen, simple, clean. Your entire call flow - simple or sophisticated, can be completed on a single screen.

I wish they had 24x7 chat support, but it's only hourly-based. The chatbot is useless especially when you need a human. But I guess since you're paying a lower price for the service compared to others, the chat-based human support isn't bad (but don't expect to get support after hours). However, when you do chat with a human - they get the job done.

cons: Hard to setup, seems to be buggy
title: Currently using this with a VA to run...
review: Currently using this with a VA to run sales calls. It's pretty clunky. The interface and ease of which to access recordings are outdated, we had hours of setup issues with the number, and the verdict is still out on the quality of audio on recordings. Hopefully over the next few months we'll see if this is a long-term solution, but I'm not excited about it yet.

cons: Customer service is not great or quick. Chat support can take hours to reach someone and is usually inconclusive.
title: While Nextiva is a cheap option for...
review: While Nextiva is a cheap option for many small businesses, if you need quick and clear customer support, this is not the option for you. The features are limited and not what I was promised at sign up, and the customer support can take hours just to end up inconclusive. The robot support is not helpful either. Overall 6/10.

title: I'm a new Nextiva client and the...
review: I'm a new Nextiva client and the price, customer service and product is great! I highly suggest this service to any business. I have the voice auto-attendant service for my business. Voicemail services, auto attendant, call forwarding, 800 number, phone extensions, fax number and services for your business.

pros: Exceeds Expectations and the Right Choice For US
title: When we began looking for a new phone...
review:
When we began looking for a new phone provider there were many options that we considered but there were a few things that made Nextiva stand out.

1) They were not pushy. They understood my timeline and respected it. They reached out in a timely manner according to my schedule and what I asked for.

2) There features such as Call Pop and their CRM fit what we were looking for and their demos were realistic and straight forward. I appreciated their honesty up front.

3) The price was very reasonable for what they were offering.

So, we went for it and from the moment we began the onboarding process I knew we made the right choice. Both our onboarding team and the sales provider were timely in their responses and getting me the info that I needed to make sure everything was the way we wanted it. They took their time setting up trainings, and recordings to make sure me and my team had what we needed to be successful now and for the future.

My one complaint was actually solved recently which was it was hard to get in touch with them through the chat feature. In business, time is money and to wait on hold for a while verse being able to have the chat feature up while you continue to work makes the most sense for communication. However, it would constantly cash or continue to spin making it a very frustrating experience. That was until now where they have switched their chat provider and things are running extremely smooth. They continue to update and make improvements with all their features and software which continues to make our business improve as well.

We are excited to see this partnership grow and dive into more features. I would recommend Nextiva to others who are looking for an affordable VoIP system with great features for businesses of all levels.

title: Nextiva is always available to assist...
review: Nextiva is always available to assist with troubleshooting and answering any questions that come up. Some times hold times can be long, exceeding 30 mins. There isn't a projected wait time provided which can be difficult when the issue includes assisting another staff member. We have been with the provider for almost 2 years and the prices are economical and tax exempt status is honored which is a plus. It's a plus to be able to take calls on your mobile phone or desktop and not be tied to a landline phone.

title: We love the versatility of functions,...
review: We love the versatility of functions, but it is easy to get locked out of an account and lose abilities until we reach out to support for assistance. This tends to take a good chunk of an hour out of the day which is costly in the long-run, especially having to call once a month to resolve issues. Sometimes calls do not go through to our cell phones like they are supposed to be, but it is great to be able to receive calls forwarded from our desk phones.

title: Nextiva always provides quick and...
review: Nextiva always provides quick and quality support to their clients and ensure that all of our needs are met. Nextiva's admin portal is also very easy to use and intuitive, which makes my job as an IT administrator much easier. The phones that work with the system are varied and easy to set up. Even when we have run into issues with a phone set up, their customer service always fixes the issue.

title: I have always had a great experience...
review: I have always had a great experience when dealing with Nextiva's customer service peope. They are always pleasant, patient and helpful. Any issues we have run into are always handled quickly. We have had very few equipment problems with our phones, even when switching them to WIFI dongles, and the system is pretty easy to use.

title: Nextiva has seemed perfectly adequate...
review: Nextiva has seemed perfectly adequate so far, but the features do not have the full ease of accessibility that we were led it believe that it did, so setting things up to make the system work for us has taken more time than anticipated. For instance, our old system did not have texting capability; Nextiva does, but not through out main office number, which means that we need to give clients separate numbers for calling and texting, which is fine, but not ideal Support options are there and helpful, but slow. I just spent 1.5 hours chatting with a customer representative, and while I received responses, there was a very long wait time between each of my questions and a response.

title: Started with a simple package and...
review:
Started with a simple package and switched to X2 shortly after due to getting promotional discount and satisfied service. Truly satisfied with their services and highly recommend them to start up companies
In addition, had a technical issue which took a short period of time to resolve
Their customer service team along with tech support are indeed helpful

title: JESUS (IN BILLING) IS OFF THE HOOK. THE...
review: JESUS (IN BILLING) IS OFF THE HOOK. THE OTHER ONE IS GREAT TOO!

title: i like the services , every thing is...
review: i like the services , every thing is looking good , but recently when i forgot to pay the bill , my service got cut and to restore that service i had a horrible time as i was not able to connect to the support at the first place ,this is main thing please work on support better , once i connected its took too long for the team to fix it

title: I needed to find a means of keeping my...
review:
I needed to find a means of keeping my home phone and number after dropping services with Xfinity including the VOIP phone service with them. (I kept my internet service with them) 1VoIP seemed to be the best choice for me of all the ones I looked at online. I chose the annual payment plan which was a substantial savings over the cost at Xfinity.

I spoke with their customer service group several times prior to placing my order and they were all very helpful and courteous. The porting process, receipt of equipment and installation all went very well. I also like the small footprint of the equipment as space is at a premium on the nightstand near the bed where our phone base unit sits.

The sound quality seems to be about the same as earlier services although my recorded message sounds "off" just a bit. The only thing that I miss is the ability to have incoming call information displayed on the TV, but all things considered I would highly recommend this service.

title: I have never ever had a bad experience...
review: I have never ever had a bad experience with Nextiva Support. They have always been very reliable and my favorite person is Anasatiia O. With our company constantly growing, Nextiva is constantly stepping up to the plate.(I hope I spelled her name right). Thank you from the bottom of my heart. Nextiva Rules!!!!!

title: Stay FAR AWAY from this company. My...
review:
Stay FAR AWAY from this company. My client has been with Fusion since they were Birch and even before that. Under Birch, things were okay. Since Fusion took over, they refuse to provide support, they have drastically increased their rates for the same service, etc etc. They are surely going to extract as much money out of the existing user base until they crash and burn.

DO NOT DO SERVICE WITH THIS COMPANY.

title: I am an IT Supervisor with a Law Firm...
review: I am an IT Supervisor with a Law Firm and have been using Nextiva for about a year. It is a wonderful service provider that has very easy installation and maintenance. Whenever I have an issue with our account the Nextiva support staff answers the phone quickly and is very attentive and comforting when assisting you with any of your issues or concerns. 10/10 would recommend to anyone and everyone!

cons: Changing the company greeting for holiday is a a little confusiong
title: Overall, we are very satisfied. Most...
review: Overall, we are very satisfied. Most things are easily managed on the backend. Voice quality is fantastic. The support staff is very helpful, and always very pleasant to work with. The only thing we have trouble with is changing the company greeting for holidays, but the support staff is always available to help.

title: Nextiva is great, there are some parts...
review: Nextiva is great, there are some parts that could use improvements but overall it works great and they're customer support system is great as well.

title: I have found the service to be very...
review: I have found the service to be very reliable. But the standout from the company is the customer service line. I had some issues with having my office setup for 2 location. And customer service stayed on the line for as long as it took and worked very patiently going over many scenarios until we found the right one that worked for our business. I can’t say how much that impressed me. THANKS SO MUCH

title: I really love my Nexitva phone service....
review: I really love my Nexitva phone service. Romeo the tech really helped me a lot on the tech service call with my issues of getting everything setup correctly for my company. Romeo went above and beyond the call of duty for me. I would recommend this service to all of my colleagues and friends. Thanks, Nextiva.

title: I've really got nothing bad to say...
review:
I've really got nothing bad to say about 8x8. The phone equipment, the service, the ability to self-manage everything including adding numbers and voice trees, messaging and voicemail are all as good or better than anything I've ever used in corporations with 55,000 people. Having the ability to add extensions and manage all of this on your own, intuitively without help, is a huge plus.

As a matter of fact, they've added on features such as video calling which can replace your other services like Zoom - and they've done it at NO ADDITIONAL CHARGE. The 8x8 Work tool for tablets, phones, and desktops makes it easy to manage everything right at your fingertips no matter where you are.

The only room for improvement is the customer support. It's not intuitive to find the place to make a payment (of all things) on the application. The 3x I've had to call over the entire time we've been utilizing the 8x8 solutions, it's taken them quite some time to get back. They do, however, have a Quality CSM program in place now and they're trying to improve all of that.

I highly recommend this solution to small businesses that are trying to keep their costs under control!

title: We are happy that we decided to go with...
review: We are happy that we decided to go with Cloudtalk. Compared to other providers on the market, it's very easy to understand, intuitive and user-friendly. The dashboards that keep track of your calls are very comprehensive so you easily see where you perform well and vice versa. Also, the adoption phase was really smooth and their team made sure we are fully onboarded.

title: They are a Great company with great...
review: They are a Great company with great products. Our company has used them for years and we have no plans to change or switch our services to any other company for. I Highly recommend contacting them for your VOIP needs. Their service has always been top notch any time you contact them they are very quick to respond and help.

title: This system was a upgrade from a much...
review: This system was a upgrade from a much older system we had in place, and serves us well and is very easy to use. It allows us to have a better call flow in the office, and give us access offsite while using the Mobile App or on computer. We had a minor issue with a recent software update, but Nextiva support was very fast in making sure our issue was resolved right away! Thank you

title: Nextiva support has been great. If the...
review: Nextiva support has been great. If the wait times were less it would be near perfect. Otherwise very satisfied with the attention from the techs. I will definitely recommend their services. Many of our clients use nextiva and i hear very few complaints. Glad to have a responsive group of service techs on our side.

title: I use Nextiva for all my faxing needs...
review: I use Nextiva for all my faxing needs and the service is fantastic! The customer support is very helpful and resolved the limited issue I had in mere minutes. The competition doesn't stand a chance when it comes to the cost savings compared to traditional analog fax services and it's more reliable. I love my Nextiva services!!!!

title: Compared to other providers, Nextiva is...
review: Compared to other providers, Nextiva is the best. We've used other providers and they don't compare to Nextiva. Support is so helpful and patient. They are always thorough and knowledgeable in answering my questions....from modifying our schedule during the holidays to adding a new line. We wouldn't want any other provider than Nextiva.

cons: Does not work with Poly CCX 600
title: I have thoroughly worked with many VoIP...
review: I have thoroughly worked with many VoIP providers these past weeks and can with out a shadow of a doubt say Nextivia has the best customer service not just with sales but support as well. Terrell in support was professional and patient. Everyone I have spoken to at Nextiva make it very clear their biggest advantage to other providers is the support and service you receive seemingly very US based which is important to me. Just wish my Poly CCX 600 worked with them :(

title: I spoke with Terrell today, and he was...
review: I spoke with Terrell today, and he was a huge help with everything we needed to get our phones up and running. The customer service with Nextiva is top notch, I highly recommend them for any business who wants to operate at a top notch level. The ability to manage and control the call flows on the dashboard on our end is a game changer.

title: I've been using Nextiva in a small...
review: I've been using Nextiva in a small insurance office for over 5 yrs now. The downside is that an issue with your internet service provider can cause you to lose the ability to receive and place calls, including right in the middle of one. Their support personnel has always been extremely helpful when setting up users or troubleshooting. Navigating their online dashboard as an administrator to make updates is easy too.

title: Terrell was our support expert. He was...
review:
Terrell was our support expert. He was very helpful and had a lot of the phone systems knowledge. he was able to help our office phone lines get back on track!! I would definitely recommend this company and especially Terrell if you need assistance with your phone systems. Thank you Terrell for all you have done this morning to help us out!!
The Hercules Fence Team

title: Nextiva has a good feature list, the...
review: Nextiva has a good feature list, the physical phones work, the PC phone works, the cell phone app really depends on your DATA signal. The new NextivaONE PC app is not ready for prime time but the old PC App they are discontinuing was a solid app and worked good. I think they are going through some growing pains, but they need to focus on what the customer needs not what they think the customer needs. Support was hindered by the war in the Ukraine but seems to have come back to normal.

title: I cant compare to other companies but I...
review: I cant compare to other companies but I can say their customer service has been supportive and helpful so far. We've had some issues where the services wouldn't work consistently and the couple of times we called the service was considerate and helpful. I would recommend them on that alone. The services are good but some minor issues have been persistent enough for us to call customer service.

title: Let me tell you my story, one of the...
review: Let me tell you my story, one of the tech support people managed to mess up the base and all the phones that are connected to it. Nobody could fix that mess until Terrell jumped on the phone. Terrell was very helpful, resolved any issues I was having very quickly and efficiently so my coworkers could go back to work. He should get a raise for being so competent.

title: We have used 8x8 for over 5 years now...
review: We have used 8x8 for over 5 years now and are very happy with the support, reliability and features of their service. Tech support wait times are very short, with quick chat options. The agents are very knowledgeable and friendly. They offer excellent phone configuration management, all on-line. It's easy to change/add/delete features. Highly recommend.

pros: Easy to Use. Not marked as scam caller
title: I loved the app in general! It made...
review: I loved the app in general! It made making all work phone calls very easy. It worked very well for both incoming and outgoing calls. Also, Super professional. Made it seem like I was using a business landline, which is exactly what I was looking for. The Nextiva app is Great for small businesses trying to expand and keep a good, professional reputation.

title: Nextiva is a reliable phone service...
review: Nextiva is a reliable phone service provider that we have used in several of our Company's offices. The only complaint I would say is that the wait in the support queue can be lengthy at times. However once a support rep arrives the level of service is fantastic. I would recommend Nextiva to any small / medium size company and even potentially large corporations. Proud customer of over 4 years.

cons: Updating to web app was forced and not ideal
pros: Easy to use, straightforward voip app.
title: I have been using nextiva voice for...
review: I have been using nextiva voice for nearly 5 years now. Overall the experience has been great; everything is very straightforward and simple to use or teach. The versatility of being able to use a physical handset, computer app, or mobile device app is very convenient for myself and others that I work with. The recent update to nextiva one was not necessarily ideal in terms of timing and optimization of the app from a user perspective (especially compared to the old desktop app which was amazing and so simple), but I understand that it is still very new and will be updated and upgraded as time goes on. Overall I would give a score of 5/5; nextiva has been a pleasure to use and any interaction I have had with people on their end has been extremely positive.

title: I recently experienced two issues...
review:
I recently experienced two issues whereby I received excellent customer service. One involved my service temporarily expiring because of my payments. Everything was fixed immediately. The second involved an outgoing message issue that my tech (Terrell Eason) solved by actually converting my audio file for me.

I highly recommend Nextiva, they have a great product with excellent customer service and that is reasonably priced.

title: I love Nextiva!  Their support is...
review: I love Nextiva! Their support is amazing and the ease of use is phenomenal. Their rates are very competitive! I highly recommend for business use you will not be disappointed with the service or connectivity. Also, their support is amazing and always willing to go the extra mile to help you reconnect if you do experience issues.

title: Con: I was told my Act CRM would be...
review:
Con: I was told my Act CRM would be compatible by Eric Mann but after I got it all installed. It is not compatible with my Act CRM.
Pro. I can pick up the phone and call and actually speak to a live person. Big reason I left former provider.
Terrel was professional, knoweledgable , and easy to work with.

review:

I used their service more then 10 years.
When I want to switch to another company they gave me very hard time .

title: We have had them for about 3 years. The...
review: We have had them for about 3 years. The uptime has been very good. I can't really speak on the price because I haven't compared with any other providers. There are some call parking and paging options that I like. It's really easy to set up a phone- the config and firmware is pushed to the phones automatically. I use Polycom phones and the 8x8 app.

cons: Do not work with our internet, non-refundable, poor early support
title: Second review.Our internet is provided...
review:
Second review.
Our internet is provided by the State of Wisconsin, and our router cannot be switched to bridge mode in order to get our phones to work. I tried to return these phones within the 30 day grace period, but no one at Nextiva would authorize the return or send me an RMA. I kept the phones thinking maybe we could get them to work, but our IT manager said there is no way to do what Nextiva requires. I now stand to lose over $400, because of the early non-service (they only wanted me to keep their system. There was no way of knowing this situation would occur.

cons: Reliability only as good as your ISP
title: Nextiva is a great service for VOIP...
review: Nextiva is a great service for VOIP with good options for programming your service to the needs of the business. We use it across all our locations and the only time we have an issue it's due to our ISP, not Nextiva. While it can take a few minutes to get through on busy days, their support staff are some of the most technically competent support teams out there. I've only every had to make one call to address a setup or change and they haven't made a mistake yet. That alone is enough, but they're pleasant and helpful as a cherry on top.

title: Nextiva has been a very difficult to...
review: Nextiva has been a very difficult to work with for my business. The phone lines do not work consistently. It' been extremely hard to get a hold of someone. You may only reach someone via online chat feature. I definitely would not recommend. My overall experience has been poor. It was easy to start with this company but once I got started everything was inconsistent.

title: Our law firm has used Nextiva for years...
review: Our law firm has used Nextiva for years and have been very pleased with the system and app services. We recently transitioned to two firms and the process switching was very smooth with Nextiva. Sometimes the hold time to get to someone is long but they are always knowledgeable and helpful once you get through. And sometimes the wait is not long at all. Overall, we would rate Nextiva as a top quality provider for telephone and fax services.

title: Our phone stopped working due to some...
review:
Our phone stopped working due to some technical glitch; called their support system and they had everything fixed and working quickly.
Easy to work with and they could easily find and solve the issue. We are happy to work with a company that can easily fix any issue we have especially in the middle of a busy work day!

title: Great support initial call with sales...
review:
Great support initial call with sales team, onboard process was easy. Support service was able to answer all my questions on time.
Equipment was deliver to my location very quick
Waiting on phone number transfer to fully function, but the service allows me to start using the service right now. Great experience overall

title: I called a support tech to adjust our...
review:
I called a support tech to adjust our office call flow and was assisted with the necessary revision. It did take awhile (1 hour+) for that revision to happen which seems to be more to do with the actual process of changing the call flow. The woman taking my call was thoroughly helpful. She immediately understood what I was asking and I never had to slow down or repeat myself.

I did have to call back after we hung up because the call forwarding was not working. When I called back I was on hold for 1 hr 15 mins to get to Gregory to fix the forwarding issue.

title: I wasn't able to log in and customer...
review: I wasn't able to log in and customer support was fast and easy. I was able to reach an agent through chat immediately. They walked me through the process and showed me step by step what to do in order to trouble shoot. Once done, I confirmed with agent it was good to go. I was able to go back to work within a few minutes.

title: Helen U was an absolute pleasure to...
review: Helen U was an absolute pleasure to work with. She was able to get my phones up and running in less than two hours, a task that took another agent all day to attempt with no result; she was very knowledgeable and helped me work through all of my issues. Nextiva Sales are also helpful, Matt Gauden is great support.

title: Anytime that I have issues or need to...
review: Anytime that I have issues or need to make changes, we can email into support instead of calling. It cuts down on phone time and allows me to work on other tasks while the changes that we are needing made is taken care of. All of the customer service reps are super friendly and if your unsure how something was previously set up they always look back on the notes to verify.

title: Our company has worked with Nextiva for...
review: Our company has worked with Nextiva for several years now and overall Nextiva is reliable and easy to use/navigate. If an issue occurs, their support staff is willing to help. They even look to see if there are other issues you may not be aware exist. They are always looking at was to improve their service and roll out updates with new features. I would recommend!

title: Support stayed on the phone with me and...
review: Support stayed on the phone with me and made certain my issues were resolved entirely. Very polite and understanding. I have used Nextiva for over 10 years and have been very satisfied with the service and support help. There will always be a few hiccups along the way, however the important issue is whether those issues are resolved in a timely and helpful way. Today's support call was one more example at how Nextiva gets the job done.

cons: does not self update the software, have to reinstall new software
title: would recommend, easy to use and very...
review: would recommend, easy to use and very clear. when you need help there right there for ya. the only thing is the software does not self update you have to reinstall which is a pain to the end users. when you call for help they pick up fast, there friendly and get the job done very fast. i would recommend

title: You can't go wrong with Nextiva VoIP...
review: You can't go wrong with Nextiva VoIP service. The pricing is more than fair, and the implementation is fast. You can change from your old service to Nextiva in as little as 15 days. The ability to customize it for your needs is endless. They have amazing analytics that helps you deliver on customer needs. The wait times for tech support have been a little slow, but they are implementing changes to correct that. Overall amazing product and phone service at an incredibly fair price.

cons: New Nextiva One is not end use intuitive. Support chats can take forever to respon.
title: I am IT with our company so hear the...
review:
I am IT with our company so hear the feedback of the end user on both the handset and computer version of Nextiva.

2) The directory is not visible on handsets
3) The desktop app was ok until the update. I have already submitted my feedback via email on that.

pros: Phones were provided.  On-boarding team was fantastic.
title: From the start to finish, Nextiva was...
review: From the start to finish, Nextiva was there for us every step of the way. All our phones were provided to us for free. I don't understand how Nextiva does it. We had to use technical support for a few eye ball issues, since no two environments are the same. Technical support team offers chat, phone, or remote desktop support. The support team is phenomenal. I say this because they will find a solution to your issue regardless how long it takes them. They are very helpful and patience with their customers. I give them 6 stars without thinking twice.

title: fast and easy sign up and set up. But...
review: fast and easy sign up and set up. But the process took longer than expected. I would recommend Nextiva at this point. Although the assigned agent who signed up my company could not do the actual instillation and I had to be transferred to another department. This caused unnecessary delay and extra wait time.

cons: only reason I gave 4* for Feature is that it took me a while to set it up.
pros: great service, inexpensive, easy to FAX.
