review:
Nowadays I, like a lot of people, don't have stationary phone lines, which makes FAX a quite difficult task. However, from time to time I need to FAX documents so that I went on line and searched FAX service. Compared with others, I found Nextiva is reasonably priced and has online features that make FAX easier and more reliable. So I decided to sign up with Nextiva. The customer support is friendly and competent and they would make sure you get everything right. After I registered I sent a FAX and that takes no time. Job well done!
By my experience I think it is worth to keep such service even you just need a few FAX transactions/month. And I will highly recommend Nextiva to any one who needs FAX service. It worth the money and save a lot of time!

title: The Nextiva team has been a great help...
review: The Nextiva team has been a great help to me on the rare occasion that I experience a hiccup :-) The hardware is quality, the service is quality and the support is fantastic. I have never had a billing issue and they make it easy to switch payment methods. As far as setting things up initially, they were patient and helped me customize my greeting. I am very happy that I chose Nextiva for my business.

title: Could be more user friendly but support...
review: Could be more user friendly but support is quick to resolve issues. Not sure of average price of service but seems inexpensive. Transferring service between companies was a bit of challenge but eventually got done and haven't had too many issues. Phones are a bit price but seem to be pretty durable.

cons: Can't get this system to work
pros: The phones are nice, there are supposedly a lot of features.
title: I have had these phones over 90 days,...
review:
I have had these phones over 90 days, and they still are not working properly.

I am my cell phone every day for hours, working with a different tech trying to resolve issues.

There is no direct number, so I have to wait, listening to the same piece of music over and over, while occasionally a VO guy comes on VERY LOUD and tells me how great their online videos are.

There is no way to circumvent the system with a case number for faster service.
Maybe our situation is unique, we are a small library with 3 phones, I thought this would be a lot more plug 'n play without all this hassle.

I CANNOT AND DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS COMPANY.

Part of the problem is they will not refer a tech call to a supervisor.

I tried to return the phones months ago, within the 30 day period, and they would not give me an RMA,m they just promised to get the phones up and running for me. Which obviously hasn't happened.

"Award winning Customer Service" must mean for the worst customer service.

title: This review is based on the set-up...
review: This review is based on the set-up experience, because we have not had time to utilize the services & apps yet. In the testing phase, all seems to be working well. The price is 3 stars, simply because it's not inexpensive, but it is also not the most expensive. I give high props to Tonia B, the chat support specialist, who worked with me on 3 separate items and was patient throughout. She didn't stop until we found the answer. If I am given the link to review in the future, I will update the stars accordingly - maybe to a 5star! :)

title: When ever we need Nextiva support, they...
review: When ever we need Nextiva support, they have been there to assist and make things a smooth transition. We have been with Nextiva for over 4 years and they continue to get better every year. There portal provides all the access we need to monitor our lines/calls/faxes. Customer service is always pleasant and helpful.

title: I have been using 8x8 form home. ...
review: I have been using 8x8 form home. Simple and easy to use from my home office. I can even transfer back to the office from my home. 8x8 Inc. is an American provider of Voice over IP products. Its products include cloud-based voice, contact center, video, mobile and unified communications for businesses. Since 2018

title: We have been using Nextiva for over 10...
review: We have been using Nextiva for over 10 years in our medical practice. I am always able to call and get support and they walk me through everything. I have the ability to log in from home, my phone or in the office. If I have staff that aren't as knowledgeable as me they can call and someone can walk them through it. It was super helpful during covid when we had to work from home without any notice.

title: Trying to research the many options for...
review: Trying to research the many options for an automated attendant and service to port my toll-free number to was driving me crazy. I selected Nextiva primarily because they followed up on my initial call. the installation and set up process were beyond my pay grade so they had live support set it up via remote control so I could learn as I watched and make future changes myself. One thing that really impressed me was their support (during business hours) is domestic! I could not only understand the support person, he was able to answer my questions, make pertinent suggestions and complete my request. The bottomline is this, my company now has a professional impression, I can route and answer my calls much better and I have ported my toll-free number to Nextiva for half the cost of my previous toll-free provider alone!!! I don't often make recommendations, but in this case I do, Nextiva.

title: 8x8 is a solid company and service that...
review: 8x8 is a solid company and service that my employer uses for hundreds of devices. Their support is easy to reach and they're always professional. I truly feel like they're always improving the services and supporting to the utmost of their abilities. We will continue to use and invest in 8x8 as they support helpful applications and innovative designs.

title: Overall, were very happy with the...
review: Overall, were very happy with the Nextiva platform. We're able to take calls from any device. Now we can also send SMS messages. The support team is great; they're usually able to resolve any issues within a few minutes. It is on the more expensive side, but I think the support is worth it. This is a good option for a larger team that has multiple users that need to contact clients.

cons: Voice quality can be an issue in certain reception areas.
pros: Super easy to use and great customer supoort
title: The 8 x 8 service and app are a very...
review: The 8 x 8 service and app are a very feature rich platform for a very affordable price. The mobil app works exceptionally well and allows me to make and receive phone calls effectively on the app using the business phone vs. my cell phone itself. I have been able to separate and reduce usage on my cell phone and move traffic to the 8 x 8 mobil app. This is a valuable tool. It works really well.

cons: Set up and transfering process was not easy
pros: Easy to use, helpful and friendly staff, many cool fatures
title: Overall we are loving the Nextiva...
review: Overall we are loving the Nextiva system. We are only a week into it though. The launch of the system, transferring of numbers, etc., was rough. I feel as though they would greatly benefit from giving their customers a VERY detailed timeline and checklist to tell them when to do what and how. Their customer service has been a huge help too!

cons: Sometimes it's hard to start a chat  because they time out quickly.
pros: Seems to do everything we need
title: Been with Nextiva for almost 10 years....
review: Been with Nextiva for almost 10 years. The service is great and the tech support is always helpful. We have been able to set up a greeting that then rings all of our phones and then forwards to our answering service if we can't answer. We have added custom hold music. I have an app on my cell that I use when on the road.

title: I Had an issue with one way audio....
review:
I Had an issue with one way audio. After contacting support and speaking with Romeo, we fixed the problem with the sound quality on my pc and got the audio working on my cell phone so I can be heard by clients whenever I use the app.
I had no idea that having my pc speakers plugged in to the pc with my pc headset/mic combo would have an effect on the sound quality. Romeo had me plug my headset in the front of my pc and the sound quality improved! Who new?
I'm very happy to have gotten this taken care of (over the weekend) because it gives me options when I'm working online to be able to answer the phone by cell or pc.
Thanks so much!
Cassandra P from DC

title: our experience with Nextiva is more...
review:
our experience with Nextiva is more than satisfactory, excellent service, quality, technical support and reliability.
We have been with Nextiva for more than 3 years and we hope to continue many more
in addition, the direct platform allows us to analyze the data of our company.
competitive prices

title: We have been using them for a few years...
review: We have been using them for a few years now and have had a great experience. The online chat is very easy and the responses are quick. The staff is very helpful when chatting and resolving any issues that we have ever had, which are few and far between. Great customer services through Nextiva chat.

title: So far we love Nextiva. We are about 2...
review: So far we love Nextiva. We are about 2 months in and still learning how to use our service. Support has been helpful anytime we have had an issue or needed help with troubleshooting something. We have had no issues with the use of our service. I would have liked to receive an onboarding instruction or walkthrough once we started our service. It would have helped us tremendously in getting our team started.

cons: Support may take a while to help
pros: Extremely quick and easy to get business phone numbers ready
title: We have used Nextiva before at a...
review:
We have used Nextiva before at a previous company with absolutely 0 issues. The phones always work, they never have hardware issues, call stay on strong, and billing is consistent. We decided to go ahead with them again, and we the same quality services were delivered to us again.

One of the biggest issues we had with Nextiva was delivery on phones. Nextiva delivered our phones to the incorrect address, and the only way to get them sent to our correct address was if we paid for the entire order of 5 phones again, which wasnt cheap. We are still waiting for the credit to be applied to the account, so that that issue can be resolved.

Other than that, once we finally received the phones, they work great and we have yet to have issues with them, the phone numbers, or the call flows we have set up.

We recommend Nextiva for any small, medium or large sized business for their VoIP needs.

title: We have been with Nextiva for about 2...
review: We have been with Nextiva for about 2 years and are very pleased! The service keeps getting better and better! We like that we can call in if there is a question but we love that we can chat in and the service is equally as professional, timely, and reliable! They also have online support manuals, guides, and videos which are super helpful.

cons: Online support has become slow to answer the chat
title: Been with Nextiva and their  \"the...
review: Been with Nextiva and their "the Amazing Service" for many years now. They are the best for supporting our business. The one and only negative is since 2020 the online chat support can take a while to answer. Once you get a tech the service is over the top amazing. The willingness to help is seconded to none.

cons: Not all support staff are knowlegable
title: If I would have left this review two...
review: If I would have left this review two weeks ago it would have not had as many stars. I spoke with a support staff member that fixed all of the issues I was having with the mobile app or at least he provided solutions for them. The support staff I spoke to before last week said there was no solutions to fix the bugs I had. I hope I get the same support staff if I have issues in the future. Nextiva is 1/3 of the price of my previous phone system provider. I just signed up for a 12-month contract today. They were nice enough to extend the test contract out 3 months for me. I'm currently very happy with the platform.

title: I utilize technical support provided by...
review: I utilize technical support provided by several vendors used by my company. Nextiva support has well-trained technicians who remain active until ALL questions have been answered, ALL changes have been implemented and ALL actions have been executed by the technician. Never have I experienced my hands off during a remote session . What a joy having only to provide answers for a tech to perform without my effort.

title: The handset are very clear and the...
review: The handset are very clear and the speakerphone is also amazing. The LCD screen is very sharp and I like the ability to use a USB drive and record calls if needed. There is no static or noise on the line like some of the cheaper phones and we really appreciate the ease of use when parinking and retrieving calls. Overall a great experience and well worth the cost if you want a complete office VOIP system.

title: Nextiva is very good about support....
review: Nextiva is very good about support. There is sometimes a wait time to get through to an agent. But when I do then I always get very good support agents who go above and beyond to help me. I have been very impressed with the support i have received and the troubleshooting that the agents have done for me..

title: I really apricate them, I am doing my...
review: I really apricate them, I am doing my business smoothly. Totally recommended app. Really good features and pricings. The support group is really helpful, they resolved the issues really quick. Workflows are clear and facilitated as much as possible. The user and their content are as safe as possible.

title: I really apricate the work support...
review: I really apricate the work support group do. My issues got resolved on time and pricing and the services are really good. Totally recommended app to others. I really apricate the work support group do. My issues got resolved on time and pricing and the services are really good. Totally recommended app to others.

title: I had an intermittent issue with my...
review: I had an intermittent issue with my phone not being able to dial some of my coworkers, and after Oleksandr Shevchenko got involved he was able to see what the issue was quickly and had me back up and working right away! He was very polite and professional. I would definitely work with him again. Great work Oleksandr Shevchenko!

title: I needed help setting up my office...
review: I needed help setting up my office phone on my first day, and the tech who assisted me was very professional and helpful. She was able to get me set up quickly. The only negative I would say about my experience was the amount of time I had to wait to get to speak with a tech. I was on hold for about 5-10 minutes before I was able to speak with the tech.

pros: quick response and friendly customer service
title: We had our conference room unit...
review: We had our conference room unit malfunction and I emailed the support team (Kaila Rose W.), she was very attentive and super helpful. We were emailing back and forth until the issues were resolved. She was very on top of our issues and always had an answer to my inquiries. Great experience! I would recommend Nextiva.

title: Nextiva is just downright solid.  I...
review:
Nextiva is just downright solid. I have some issues with the mobile app, but the desktop phones and app work great for us. They are reliable and we have not had any major issues. Whenever we need something, their support team is always able to help in a timely manner.

Additionally, pricewise I think Nextiva is the best value on the market.

title: I have been using Nextiva for my...
review: I have been using Nextiva for my practice since 2013. The services and features have expanded over the years, which provides me with useful features and new capabilities. My account representative has been wonderful, and both customer service and technical support has been excellent over the years. I highly recommend Nextiva, which offers quality and value

pros: Chat option that can resolve some problems.
title: I have had several problems during the...
review:
I have had several problems during the six months I've had the service.
Unfortunately, I always need to contact support to resolve these problems. Although I can review support pages online, I still need to have someone log in to my account to address most issues.

The support team is competent, but I would rather avoid involving them for the most minor problem. It is helpful that I can get started in chat, and sometimes this is sufficient.

My experience to date does not instill confidence.

title: Nextiva has truly been a blessing to...
review: Nextiva has truly been a blessing to our business. From easy everyday use to their CRM integrations, Nextiva has it all. Their onboarding agents are very knowledgeable and they ensure for a smooth transition. Their support team is the best I've ever dealt with. Their hold times are minimal and when you do get a support agent on the phone, they're kind, professional and they assist you fairly quickly.

title: We have been using nextiva for over 5...
review: We have been using nextiva for over 5 years now. There all in one suite allows us to see everything from one centralized place. They have robust reporting and analytics so we can see where calls are coming from, what our call reps are doing, and also allows us to get localized numbers that we can use for our directors. I would definitely recommend Nextiva.

title: We needed a quick solution for an 800...
review: We needed a quick solution for an 800 number that I would be able to easily monitor on my mobile phone. Nextiva is exactly what we needed, and the pricing was very reasonable. Whenever I need assistance, their tech support is helpful and able to resolve my queries quickly & easily. If you are on the fence, I would suggest you go with Nextiva.

title: Today's customer service was very...
review: Today's customer service was very helpful. The wait time was not that long as usually it can be over an hour. I find the call flows and set up to be very complicated, but that may just be user error as I am not used to using these. The site has a few more upgrades I would prefer, but overall, it is good.

title: Nextiva is a great system to have with...
review: Nextiva is a great system to have with many features. We have a call center and have multiple projects at one time, they made the setup very easy. The customer service reps always help fix any issues/problems we experience in a timely manner. They are also very helpful in walking us through their system.

title: We have used Nextiva as our phone...
review: We have used Nextiva as our phone provider for nearly 4 years and have only had a handful of minor issues. Anytime we have a phone issue, I am pleased with the level of professionalism and patience the support team offers to resolve my issue. They see it all the way through and ensure the issue is resolved.

title: This is a great option if you work from...
review:
This is a great option if you work from home and need to not let clients know where you actually are. You can answer from anywhere and it appears you are at the office.
The set up was easy and functionality for cell phone, tablet or desktop/laptop works great.
Need some help with my program and was able to handle it within a good time frame.

title: Thank you for helping us with getting...
review:
Thank you for helping us with getting our phones working smoothly and to be able to move my client numbers from my old system was very helpful and a smooth transition!
They were easy to help with setup and made the installation process also go very smoothly. They also have great video informational videos as well.

pros: Call quality is good when it works
title: After issues with the desktop apps, I...
review: After issues with the desktop apps, I tried to go to mobile app and couldn't log in. Support had me reset my password again and said there was an issue with a password "desync" on the platforms. I was able to get working again, but desktop apps with using headset are still happening, forcing me to troubleshoot frequently. Setting headphone options during a call is a terrible "feature"

pros: Uptime/ Website call flow feature is nice
title: Nextiva simply works. We have had zero...
review: Nextiva simply works. We have had zero voip down time during our 2 years of service. We received our new phones promptly and I was able to install and get setup in a few hours with relative ease. Support has always been quick , helpful and kind . I would definitely recommend to any small business.

title: Nextivia is great!  It can be set up...
review: Nextivia is great! It can be set up and forgot about because you don't have to worry about it. Calls come in and are filtered to the correct person. It's a bit cumbersome to change calls flows because the main incoming number can only be used on one flow but after you get the hang of it, it's not too bad. I would recommend this product to anyone.

title: My last chat with a representative was...
review: My last chat with a representative was extremely helpful. She answered all my questions and solved all my problems quickly. I appreciate the ease of getting help as my days are busy, and rarely do I have time to sit on a long phone call. The chat allowed me to continue working while the representative addressed my problems.

cons: A few things in the interface are still clunky
pros: Fairl simple and easy to use
title: 8x8 has improved support dramatically...
review: 8x8 has improved support dramatically the last few months. The product itself has been pretty quiet, but maybe they have been focusing on support, which is well worth it. Some parts of the interface and functionality should be next. Overall it's coming along but still has a ways to go. Integration with some third-party apps lags.

title: Nextiva VoIP service is really good and...
review: Nextiva VoIP service is really good and economical. Their customer support is very much professional and supportive. Price, of course, as they were half the cost of the VoIP company I was coming from. No high-pressure sales, great communication at every turn. New to the company but very impressed so far. Have been a VoIP user for over ten years.

title: We needed to get our phone number...
review: We needed to get our phone number forwarded as soon as possible and the rep was extremely helpful. Veronika took our security seriously. The process went very smoothly. The timing was important and her quick reply to my email was very impressive. I prefer working with a live person and Veronika made it much easier.

title: I have been a Nextiva customer for...
review: I have been a Nextiva customer for approximately 7 years now and I LOVE IT. It has really made our business phone service and operations much much smoother and versatile. During the pandemic it was SO SIMPLE to just plug in the phone remotely and have our team work from home without missing a beat! There customer service is amazing. I had AJ help with multiple issues and simple easy and seamless.

title: 8x8 is a GREAT communications provider...
review: 8x8 is a GREAT communications provider and the customer service/Tech support is AMAZING!! 8x8 is the ONLY com-system I wish to use!!! Delivery of equipment is nearly overnight, Technical support is amazing--could NOT be happier with that! NOT, however a fan of the installation process although 8x8 tries to make it easy and it is for the most part, I am NOT a telephone installer and required a little extra assistance for that. the One-line tools or the desktop App is PERFECT--really easy to use and I have the ability to use my cell phone, office phone or cordless phone to connect; I have the ability record calls, save and store voicemails, see missed calls and best of all, because I am notified by email of every voicemail, I can listen to them and respond to the caller from anywhere--8x8 is the way to go!!!

title: I had a difficult time understanding...
review: I had a difficult time understanding how to get the system set up. But Support was awesome! Each time, and it may have been a few, they did everything I asked. They got the entire system set up for me. Alex M was the best! And all of this was done through the Chat feature. It took a little bit to get someone "on the line", but it really made it worth it in the end.

title: I had this service for a month and a...
review: I had this service for a month and a half through my business. Customer service was not great and I just learned I was in a 3 month contract that I was unaware of that to get out it, there would be a very large termination fee. Very terrible since most companies like this are not doing contracts and the service wasn’t that great. Call quality was inadequate as sound would just go off for a few seconds at a time. I would never recommend and warn people what they are signing up for.

title: I have experienced nothing but terrible...
review: I have experienced nothing but terrible customer service from your company for years now. I have spent hours on the phone with people who are obviously just guessing and have no idea what they are doing. I just spoke with a rep named Chris who helped us with every thing we needed. He knew what he was doing and was a pleasure to work with. My 'Rate and Review Your Experience' rating is for Chris only. It would be 1 star for the rest of your reps only because there is not a '0' start option. I can assure you if I ever speak with him again he will be working for me and not Nextiva. I had to grab a call or I would taken care of that on todays call. Your company has a big problem when numerous reps cannot solve any issues. I was moving my company next week to another provider but decided to stay because of Chris. Unfortunately I cannot reach him directly so if/when I need customer support in the future I will be stuck in the biggest joke of a company support system I have ever seen. Better knows as the Nextiva customer support system. As a business owner I would want the truth from my customers so please do not take this personal it is simply THE TRUTH.

title: Everything I wanted for my small law...
review: Everything I wanted for my small law practice and nothing I don't. The price is reasonable and the support is great. I'm extraordinarily happy that I made the decision to go with Nextiva. It avoided the added cost and hassle of having to add an extra phone and phone line. I can't recommend them enough.

pros: User friendly, gets the job done
title: Convoso is a good dialer.  Its easy to...
review:
Convoso is a good dialer. Its easy to use and gets the job done. Unfortunately, Convoso doesn't know how to treat it's customers. They act as if they can afford to lose customers instead of valuing them.
They make changes in the dialer, adding features, removing them, or changing them with no notification to the customer. You notice something is different when your calls aren't being dialed correctly and you start losing money. When you call into support they act as if they have no idea what's going on and they have no idea how to fix the issue. The reports feature is terrible, not user friendly at all.
We've been on this dialer for 2+ years despite the cost(which is very high) and the lack of customer support. We stay with it because the dialer itself is good. I wish I could say we are happy customers, but we're not. For me Convoso has one saving grace, one light at the end of the tunnel-my CSM Roger Mohr. They need 100 more like him.
Would I recommend Convoso? Yes, but with a strong warning to expect to be treated poorly.

title: We have been with Nextiva for 3+ years....
review:
We have been with Nextiva for 3+ years. Nextiva is very convenient for all of us on the go; when we are not in the office we are able to call forward to our individual phones and can program/re-program calls depending on circumstances. Customer support is accessible anytime and very helpful technically.
Glad we have it for the company

title: Nextiva is a robust VOIP system that we...
review: Nextiva is a robust VOIP system that we use for our 200+ person law office. It gives many features that help our staff be flexible when communicating with clients, and when working in a variety of locations. The ability to text clients from the desktop application is a game changer. Service has never gone down since we've been a customer. When there are occasional problems, support is always knowledgeable and friendly.

title: The gentleman (Arsen) was very friendly...
review: The gentleman (Arsen) was very friendly and took the time to answer all my questions in detail. He also helped me to file a request to review my billy because it seemed to be higher than the quote I have received from the gentleman from sales that opened the account for me. In conclusion, Arsen was professional and friendly.

title: Nextiva has been great. I recently had...
review: Nextiva has been great. I recently had a huge request and Chris knew exactly how to assist. He had suggestions to ease the process and was very patient with me. I wish I could have him as a personal go to, he was amazing. I learned there are so many possibilities with Nextiva. I’m excited to start using the features I wasn’t aware of.

title: Great Service, Have used them for a...
review: Great Service, Have used them for a decade and have had Zero downtime! I have and would recommend Nextiva to my business owner friends and they also have signed up with Nextiva and had the same great service, never any dropped calls or static on the line, easy reports to look at and the fax service is great!

title: The technical support through...
review: The technical support through phone/chat is amazing and they always resolve any issues I have. The response time is incredibly fast and provide clear responses. I have been provided images to exemplify what I need to do to fix my issue. The administrator portal is great and use it all the time since some days I work remotely.

title: Maryna was extremely helpul today. I...
review: Maryna was extremely helpul today. I probably spent 15+ hours with other reps and watching videos myself trying to make the fixes we wanted. I know we spent a few hours together but I feel much better about how to make edits in the future and understand the system better. thank you so much!

title: I contacted support for help...
review: I contacted support for help transferring numbers and the agent was very helpful. The app and web version are intuitive and easy to use. Although still waiting for the number to officially port over, so far our experience with Nextiva has been excellent! We look forward to continuing this great experience.

title: I am very happy with Nextiva. It is...
review: I am very happy with Nextiva. It is easy to use, set up and support is great too. The internet does not always cooperate and calls can be dropped. It is frustrating but all VOIP connections can be affected the same way. You can reload the page quickly to get back online. Patients state that our calls are clear and love that we can test message them too!

title: Good Service plus excellent Customer...
review: Good Service plus excellent Customer and Tech Support. We have been with Nextiva for several years now and our phone service and billing since switching to Nextiva has saved us money. It took us several weeks to learn the new phones and all of the different options but that comes with any new electronics and software. If there is something that comes up that we don't know how to do with the phones, Nextiva's support team are all very helpful.

title: Nextiva is a business friendly company....
review: Nextiva is a business friendly company. As the accounting representative, I am unsure of the installations quality so I cannot review that. As far as price, it seems fair, but I have noticed a large increase in price. this may be due to more service being needed. Support is very friendly but sometimes if it is busy it is really hard to get service. Also the online portal always has a technical difficulty downloading invoices. I mostly use the online portal for invoices so this is a huge conn for my company.

title: I have been using 8x8 since last year...
review:
I have been using 8x8 since last year and am satisfied with the product. The support team is also accommodating and easily accessible. I am using multiple lines on my desktop and mobile devices.

Definitely recommend using the service of 8x8, we have a small organization and the cost is also affordable for us.

cons: If our internet service is down, we don't have phone service.
pros: Portal access that allows me to see so much about our phone use and employee productivity
title: I have been very pleased with Nextiva....
review: I have been very pleased with Nextiva. It took me a little time to adjust to internet phone service, but I love the support I receive. I like using the Chat option because I can continue working while waiting for an agent. Most problems are solved quickly. I always get helpful agents whether I place a call or use Chat. I especially like the customer portal. I am able to manage so many things from here and I gather information on call volume and employee productivity.

title: Everything works really well.  But when...
review: Everything works really well. But when needing support it's lacking.. Especially if it's after hours. Our company phone are a pretty special case so I can understand some of the issues. But we've had issues where support wouldn't answer or the escalation was very slow when we had no phones. Otherwise the phones, pricing, and features are great.

pros: I can answer my phone remotely and in the office
title: I have recommended Nextiva because of...
review: I have recommended Nextiva because of it’s versatility and affordability. As a medical professional, I appreciate the HIPAA compliance that is included. I can access not only my phone call and messages but I can also access my faxes when I’m not in the office. I highly recommend the services officered by Nextiva.

title: After 10+ years as a customer, the...
review: After 10+ years as a customer, the support has deteriorated completely. They have outgrown small firms like ours. They might be a fit for a medium to large company, but there are far better choices if you are small. We no longer have a contract and they are making it miserable trying to cancel our service.

title: Good customer service. just started...
review: Good customer service. just started using this service though. Will report after 6 months. installation was ok. Took a lot of time. Hoping to use it without issues going forward. Phones have less features than my old Aastra phones. have to see if certain features can be programmed, though I think I will need customer support for that

cons: Very difficult getting through to customer service
title: We have been using Nextiva for at least...
review:
We have been using Nextiva for at least 6 months now. Our initial installation was a complete nightmare. They never sent an email ahead of time letting us know when the system was going live. Instead, we found out in the middle of a business day when our phone system stopped working. I spent 6 HOURS setting up our lines that day and I am confident we lost business and clients as a result. During the transition period of me setting up the phone lines when you would call the response was our number was no longer in service. As a small business that was detrimental to us as we work hard to answer all calls or at the very least have a voicemail system. The entire setup process was a nightmare and required numerous calls, totaling well over 15 hours on with support. The system functions fine for the most part but anytime I have to call customer service or support it results in hours on the phone and that's IF I can wait on hold long enough to be connected to someone. I have had to hang up multiple times after on hour of waiting to be connected to someone. I just don't have that kind of time to wait for help. The online chat feature is nice in theory but most of the time there are HUNDREDS of users ahead of me. I would try to stay "ACTIVE" in the chat while I wait to be connected but more often than not, I am disconnected for my last of activity in a chat that I can't be active in because there are so many callers ahead of me that I can't get a support agent. Tell me how that makes sense?
I have also tried to buy additional equipment like cordless phones, but I have been unsuccessful in that as well due to no agents to help me. This is our first experience with Voip so we don't have much to compare it to, perhaps this the normal service. I even sent a high-priority email requesting someone to call me as opposed to waiting on hold and their response to that was for me to call customer service.

title: Very professional nice job done, I am...
review:
Very professional nice job done, I am happy with the efforts and the outcome .
Very professional nice job done, I am happy with the efforts and the outcome .
Very professional nice job done, I am happy with the efforts and the outcome .
Very professional nice job done, I am happy with the efforts and the outcome .

pros: Technician support is fast and friendly!
title: So far, we’ve had just minor issues...
review: So far, we’ve had just minor issues with our phone systems. For example, we were unaware that different features were not included. It was an easy fix with a phone call into support. Honestly, the customer support is what makes this company. We like the phone systems now that all of the features we need are in place!

cons: It is not an easy software to use and we constantly run into issues  with it.
title: I think that this software has been...
review: I think that this software has been useful in that it does handle calls. However, we have run into a few issues with the usability of the software. It does excel in working dependably though, which is useful as we don't miss calls and have detailed access to our call history. The interface is a little confusing at first as it is hard to know where things are when you are first using the software; however, as one uses the software it becomes easier.

title: The customer service is always top...
review: The customer service is always top notch and always answers my questions! It would recommend this to anyone looking for a good phone system and company. Nextiva is always very helpful and courteous. I appreciate the efforts they go to to make sure my issues are fixed in a very timely manner. The phone system is easy to use as well.

title: It is so easy to use this service. If...
review: It is so easy to use this service. If you ever need to quickly change settings or forward to a mobile device (recent power failure) their excellent customer service is right around the corner and always quickly solve the issue. We also needed to expand the number of devices and setup was a breeze. Highly recommend.

title: We moved to Nextiva from another phone...
review:
We moved to Nextiva from another phone company several years ago .
Their customer service is excellent and very responsive. Their phone app is very easy to use and comes very useful when we need to work from home. It takes some time to set up all the features and understand their website , but once this is done it is very easy to follow

title: Great VoIP for a great value. The port...
review:
Great VoIP for a great value. The port of numbers was easy, and users did not have any problem using the tool. The update is easy, and we always get a notification when an update is needed. The company also acquired the 8x8 fax which was great as well.
Excellent customer service and easy to use. Highly recommend

cons: The initial transition had it's bumps but the team was fantastic in responding to our needs. We've also had soem issues receiving phone calls and photo messages from time to time but they seem to get resolved with time.
pros: OpenPhone allows you to answer calls and texts on multiple platforms, smart phones, tablets and computers. You can also gain acces to your team's phone lines for texting and calls!
title: We can now operate soley from our...
review: We can now operate soley from our laptops. No more transitioning between laptops and cell phones to connect with our employees and those we serve. Our staff also operates remotely so when someone is on vacation or out sick we can share full access to their phone lines with just a few clicks. We used to have to coordinate a phone drop off & pick up, but not any more! Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: I have dealt with several options for...
review: I have dealt with several options for our phone system over the years and Nextiva is by far the best. There are many features, the support is excellent, and the pricing is extremely competitive. I appreciate the ability to work remote using their app. I also value how helpful support has been when we have needed changes. Thank you Nextiva for a job well done!

cons: Management interface is not overly intuitive
title: Ever since we started the business we...
review: Ever since we started the business we have used Nextiva. We are still with them, in spite of the many other offerings out there. That should attest to Nextiva's quality of services. We have recommend Nextiva to our customers, and we always mention them as the first option when companies want to move their phone system into the cloud. Their support team provides great support, and is very response.

title: Technical support very helpful, makes...
review: Technical support very helpful, makes the effort to resolve issue or suggest an alternative. Tests to verify results. Courteous, patient, and knowledgable of product & features that client may not be fully aware of. Overall excellent service experience except for wait time can be longer at times.

title: Everything works great! The only issue...
review: Everything works great! The only issue is when it does not work, due to some kind of technical difficulty, is its always a hit and miss when contacting customer support. Sometimes they are quick and to the point, sometimes I will wait on hold for hours and still not receive anything and end up ending the hold. I recommend the service to all businesses that I come in contact with and have even had a couple switch from their usual phone service to Nextiva.

title: I am only a user and admin for my...
review: I am only a user and admin for my company, but do not make decisions in purchasing. I like the app mostly, but there are some small flaws. If I have a regular account and an admin account for my company, I need to use the same email address, but the system gets confused on that and sometimes I can't log in. It also logs me out after 24 hours and makes me sign in again, which is annoying. The older version of the app did not have that issue.

cons: UI is rather complicated and busy
title: Nextiva has provided great service for...
review: Nextiva has provided great service for me for over 10yrs. I have never even considered switching service providers. Their pro recordings are second to none. We are not a large business but Nextiva allows us the ability to present ourselves as a large organization through professional communication tools.

cons: Number porting can be time consuming
pros: Unlimited calling with no hidden fees
title: Axvoice allowed me to be more proactive...
review: Axvoice allowed me to be more proactive when connecting with my family because of its great quality voice calls and reliable connection. The installation was quick and worked with my old Panasonic phone system saving me money in the process.

cons: Very poor voice quality.  Support reads FAQs to you.
title: Moving to voiply was easy.And price is...
review:
Moving to voiply was easy.
And price is good.
Guess you get what you pay for.
Voices sound broken and sometimes robotic. When calling Cust Serv, they read you the FAQs and force the same square one troubleshooting each time. Then they put me on hold. And come back 10 minutes later telling me that they made a backend change. Reboot and wait. Works for 6 days or so then back.
Service doesn't provide basics, like stutter dial tone is voice messages.
Time to switch.

title: Whenever I run into an issue the help...
review: Whenever I run into an issue the help desk at Nextiva is always fast, courteous & professional! Highly recommend especially Oles K.! I had inadvertantly hit the "do not disturb" softkey and was not getting any calls (didn't even know that existed). Oles K. quickly diagnosed and fixed the issue!

title: Really great app helps really well with...
review: Really great app helps really well with my calls to clients!! Been using this for quite a while now and I can say that this app is also user friendly as a first-timer I have not experienced any difficulty using this. Sound quality is also great. Haven't experienced anything negative so far about this app. Good Job Nextiva team!

title: We have had a really good experience...
review: We have had a really good experience with Nextiva so far! We get support asap either via phone call or through a chat. We always get an answer to the question or concern we have. We also have the ability to control our system to our liking; user settings, call routing and flow...it was a very new system but really like the control and flexibility. It was such a great switch from our old school phone system.

title: We just made the change to Nextiva. ...
review: We just made the change to Nextiva. The company is saving money, and the product is superior to traditional phones. I 100% recommend it! Setup was quick. When we have questions tech support is super helpful in just about any way possible. If you have been thinking about upgrading your phones, DO IT!

title: Great customer service-- anytime I have...
review: Great customer service-- anytime I have a question, I just jump on the chat and someone is quick to help. It makes troubleshooting far less stressful! The whole admin side of Nextiva is easy to navigate and very user friendly. After working with an ancient, out-of-date phone system, switching to Nextiva has been a joy!

title: Kaila Rose W. fixed our problem with...
review: Kaila Rose W. fixed our problem with the Holiday Voicemail in a very short time. I attempted to fix our call flow, but I couldn't figure it out. I emailed her directly and it got taken care of in a short time. Reliability is a must for us and she proved she is reliable! We appreciate the excellent customer service.

title: Oles K was fantastic and answered all...
review: Oles K was fantastic and answered all my questions! They took so much time with us and was extremely knowledgable and helpful. We needed help figuring out how to manage our Administrators since we have a new employee onboarding and one leaving/ Oles K took time to understand our questions via the live chat, offered helpful solutions - and guidance. He not only gave us links to answers when needed, but also explained things to us in a way that would save us time. It was one of the best customer service experiences we have had with Nextiva.

title: New customer to Nextiva. I set up the...
review: New customer to Nextiva. I set up the online portal prior to the transferring. Alex L is amazing and he definitely should be in this Amazing team. Not only answered all my questions with details with clear explanation, he also completed the Callflow setting during our conversation. He is a fast thinker, familiar with the diverse scenarios and he is familiar with their system. (Not all the employees from customer team knew their own systems or products from my customer experience). Because of Alex L, I would love to recommend Nextiva to business owners. I'm ready to explore the features.

title: We have not gone live yet with the...
review: We have not gone live yet with the Nextiva system, but so far the support has been phenomenal. I have been able to live chat with someone right on the spot and the amount of instructional videos are extensive. Looking forward to start using the service at our Harlingen location and will then consider using at our main location in the future.

title: Alisa T. was amazing today. I signed up...
review: Alisa T. was amazing today. I signed up for a fax line over a month ago and have yet to be able to receive faxes. Alisa stayed on the chat line with me for over two hours, until she got to the bottom of the issue. It ended up that she had to log a case with their engineer team to fix things on the back end. She was great!!! I highly recommend this company.

title: Our company started using 8 x 8  about...
review: Our company started using 8 x 8 about 2 years ago and it is a wonderful tool to be able to communicate both internally and externally to clients. Very reliable and easy to use. I would recommend this to any other small businesses that want to increase ease and efficiency. I was very impressed with how easy it is to use.

cons: Wasn't able to port our phone number
pros: Like the integration with the phone as well as the CRM
title: Overall I like the system, wasn't able...
review: Overall I like the system, wasn't able to port our phone numbers as was initially reported we could because of where we are located, but was able to work around that with some extra cost. We still have some issues with connectivity with the phones, with customers being able to hear us consistently, but think that may be an issue with our in house network, but still have not been able to remedy it. We have been a customer for a year now and would hate to go back to our old 1990's phone system. I love the CRM and the customer information you can keep track of in it and be able to access it from anywhere, not just at the office. The NextivaOne App is getting better but still doesn't quite bring all the information together between it and the desktop but maybe we just don't quite have things set correctly. Customer service is good, although in the very beginning it was a struggle to get all the phones setup, finally figured out a mac address had been incorrectly entered, customer service stuck with it till the problem was corrected. As I said, I would hate to go back to the way we were before Nextiva!

title: A new phone for my office line was...
review: A new phone for my office line was order directly from Polycom. When it came, it needed to be provisioned to our network. I was able to get connected to Alisa T. Within a few minutes she was into my account and able to work quickly to get everything taken care of. It was an incredibly easy process, thank you!

title: Great Option for my business. Use it...
Help through the Nextiva phone Support...
review: Help through the Nextiva phone Support Chat feature was quick and the Nextiva representative quickly understood exactly what I was trying to accomplish. Roman walked me through the steps of recording a Holiday closure message and then he tested the new message. He was very professional and knowledgeable.

title: We had an employee change at our...
review: We had an employee change at our company and this person was the only one who had any knowledge of how our phone system worked. Fortunately for me "Max" in the support department of Nextiva was there and came to our rescue!! He was so incredibly knowledgeable and well versed with your system and maintained the utmost professionalism and positive attitude in hour hour plus long call. I could have never done this and resolved issues with his expert assistance. Give that man a raise!! He is definitely a keeper.

cons: Some issues but may be IP phones in general
pros: Desk Phone, PC, Cell, lots of options for WFH users
title: The new NextivaONE isn't as helpful as...
review: The new NextivaONE isn't as helpful as the old PC App but starting meetings with other users and sharing screens is really good. Being able to chat other users is also a big help. We are having some issues with the new NextivaONE PC app working properly. But as far as call quality via a desk phone or using the PC is great. WFH users do have to reboot their home routers at least once a month, but I think this is more of an IP phone issue than just Nextiva. Also, some routers or firewalls can have odd issues and we are testing another brand in office for just IP phones only. But for the most part it works good no matter where you are and helps us have WFH users just like they are in the office.

title: I have had a lot of issues with 8x8...
review: I have had a lot of issues with 8x8 when using multiple platforms (desktop, app on phone, polycom phone) when trying to forward calls, or changing any settings for it to ring in all locations. I like that it has a lot of features but as soon as I add a feature i seem to have a lot of issues with it working correctly. I also have a tuff time understanding the representatives when i call into the 800 number.

title: The support tool has been helpful for...
review: The support tool has been helpful for me due to not being an administrator on the account. Today's support is just one example of needing help quickly and not knowing the in's and out's of the program as they do. Support was in a timely fashion and I was able to get the answer that I had reached out for. Thank you.

title: Very easy to work with and love that...
review: Very easy to work with and love that you can just submit changes to the support email to be handled. When you call in if your unsure of anything they always go back in and read over previous cases to see the changes that were previously made. A very cool feature is the supervisor dashboard so I can monitor my customer service representatives.

title: Sending a fax might sound archaic but,...
review: Sending a fax might sound archaic but, in some industries, we still use that feature. Medical and legal for example. I have been a customer for Nextiva for years. They are reasonably priced and reliable. For someone who ranks low on the tech savvy scale, this service is very easy to use. I would recommend Nextiva and their fax services.

title: Straightforward installation and use. A...
review: Straightforward installation and use. A bit tricky setting up VM messages, greetings, etc. Easy to set up call groups, etc. I have used 8X8 for 4 years. I wish I had found them earlier. I would have saved even more money. My fears of VOIP were just that, fears. Fear of not understanding how easy it is to use . Bottom line- great system , super flexible and great performance.

title: I have had VOIPO for about 7 years now....
review: I have had VOIPO for about 7 years now. I am still a customer. They were great in the beginning, but have gone down hill the past couple of years. Sometimes my phone doesn't even work. I'll have to reboot their supplied router and then it comes back up. For how long no one knows. Debating whether I want to renew for another 2 years.

title: Professionalism and quality customer...
review: Professionalism and quality customer service is important to my organization. Nextiva has been a vital asset in enhancing these qualities. Customer Service has been great! They are timely, patient, and accurate in accomplishing the requested task. I would definitely recommend their services to as many people as possible.

title: We were having some pretty annoying...
review: We were having some pretty annoying issues getting a microphone set-up. We had to wait quite awhile to get someone to answer the support line but once he had, the gentleman was very thorough in attempting to see what the problem was. We had contacted nextiva support before with the same issue and got an iffy answer but the representative we spoke with this time was able to figure out the issue and explained how to address it in the future. Overall, I was pleased with the service. I just wish it was easier to reach someone.

title: Nextiva is a great VOIP service - The...
review: Nextiva is a great VOIP service - The cost is a little more than other carriers but other than being a little slow responding to issues they get the issue fixed. The onboarding process works well. We have around 25 clients using Nextiva from manufacturing to healthcare they all seem satisfied with the service.

cons: The control panel can act buggy
pros: The service works on most older devices.
title: Once I started using Axvoice my...
review: Once I started using Axvoice my business has been booming as I can call more customers and help them with their requests and any issues they have on their order. I am also able to upgrade my connection without hidden charges and even my old equipment is compatible with the service. It has been a game changer for my business and I am happy to recommend Axvoice to other business owners.

title: Nextiva has been a great tool coupled...
review: Nextiva has been a great tool coupled with Microsoft Teams. Setup was easy and downtime was kept to a minimum. The customer support has been awesome the few times we have needed them. Nextiva has allowed us to dispose of our desk phones and strictly use our mobile devises as we see fit. I recommend Nextiva and their team.

pros: Mobile, Ease of UI, Chat support A1
title: Since i had started the contract the...
review:
Since i had started the contract the desktop software and mobile has been easy to use and have had no issues.

The service itself seems pretty good, but here comes the cons.

The contact who i had been talking to since i first inquired about the services Kyle seemed good and did everything with haste initiating the start of the account. However after that was finalized communication fell off, in email and via text.

I ordered service in 10/22 and did not recieve hardline phones well into december and during that time he would reply to email/texts sometimes every few days and when i had a request it would take days or weeks to resolve and some of the most important issues were never resolved just unanswered messages and emails. When i took to chat support the person who aided me got everything fixed and suited in 15 minutes.

For that i give cheers and praise to the chat support however the higher role just didn't have any care to respond.

this is his email contact info
Kyle Barrera  | Senior Account Executive | (480) 462-1546

title: Great phone system for a reasonable...
review: Great phone system for a reasonable price. Support is always willing to work with us on our schedule changes. Sometimes the wait times are a little lengthy to get support but they always get the job done. Greatly appreciate and enjoy working with this company. We have been using them for our phone service for eight years.

title: I've been with Nextiva for a little...
review:
I've been with Nextiva for a little over 9 months now. My service has been nothing less than complimentary. If ever I have to call in, I am never on hold waiting for a long time to get a live representative (instead of an annoying computer). I enjoy their customer service experience and the VoIP product is amazing! The different phones they offer really add spark to any business. I highly recommend Nextiva. Oh, yeah, and by the way - they have an amazing referral program!

Check them out!

cons: Some support staff need more training
title: I have been using Nextiva for 7 years...
review: I have been using Nextiva for 7 years with multiple clients and they are all happy with the service. Nextiva is a great VOIP solution. Tech support staff help walk you through learning their system and help you out when you get stuck. Once programmed, it is very easy to make changes.

title: 8X8 has been instrumental in my success...
review: 8X8 has been instrumental in my success at work for the past 5 years. Being able to easily communicate with co-workers working remotely is essential and 8x8 makes it extremely easy. It also helps me provide great customer service as well. I have rarely had issues, but, when I have called for assistance, they have always worked hard to solve any issue I may have. I would highly recommend 8x8 for it's ease of use. Thank you.

title: Personal phone was ported very quickly...
review: Personal phone was ported very quickly -- Now I can keep my phone number while living abroad! I like that I can keep the same number and for a cheap price every month. I like that it allows me to have a SIM in my phone for my local location, but the OpenPhone number never changes and can still be accessed. It is very business-oriented, which is not my goal in using OpenPhone, so I am paying for features I do not need. Extra phone numbers cost money as well -- it's not limitless! Also, it is sad to lose my good deal with my original US carrier, but that can't be helped when moving abroad. It is solving the problem of having a consistent phone number to keep in contact with people from home. This will also make international shopping and other matters easier. Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

cons: Reporting is Complicated, Unable to Forward Text History H
pros: Client Install, Account Creation, Breadth of User Account Options
title: Our company has hundreds of employees...
review:
Our company has hundreds of employees and several branches setup across the country. We have been able to setup call queues, ring groups and users very quickly. The support process is generally pretty good. It is easy to port or obtain numbers we need for different markets.

Our users are able to learn the product quickly without extensive training.

The product works well on a computer or mobile device and is easy to switch back and forth.

cons: Mobile app could be better, but we don't use it
pros: Great interface, friendly support, solid IVR, good call routing
title: CloudTalk offers everything we need to...
review: CloudTalk offers everything we need to talk to our customers via phone properly. It's an easy-to-use contact center that logs all of our calls; it's easy to tag them, we have a basic IVR that was extremely easy to setup, and their support always helped us when we had any questions. Overal, we couldn't be more satisfied.

title: The new platform was a bit of a...
review:
The new platform was a bit of a challenge to learn and some of the features weren't active for us. Also, somethings didn't merge over so smoothly - our fax feature was completely cancelled.

BUT

Lee H. was a GREAT help to me! After contacting so many others who were unable to help me, he solved a handful of my problems.

title: Have been a user for several months and...
review: Have been a user for several months and while setup will take some time, once it is up and running, it is pretty easy to use. Customer service has always been very good and for the most part they can make your request work for you. I'm a small business and only needed a 3 lines, so Nextiva is working well for us so far, though I'll need to upgrade, I think, to make it work like a regular phone plan.

title: The service seems to be working for us...
review: The service seems to be working for us so far and I have not had issues with getting support help if needed. However, there are things that we have to ask for assistance with that I think we should be able to do on our own. Like setting up a user in the recorder and setting their groups. We are still currently using the old app but have downloaded the new app. I think they should have made sure to move over the best qualities of the old version before changing. For instance in the old app we use groups (departments) to separate the users we need to notify and you can not do that easily in the new app. Our call center uses the Unity app which works for us well but we have to use the app to communicate with other users in the building.

cons: Their dashboard is a little overwhelming
title: 8x8 has a great value, their support...
review:
8x8 has a great value, their support team is somewhat timely on assisting, usually within the day. Their online support could use some work since it's a bot and doesn't answer my questions usually so I have to put a ticket in.
Their dashboard has 4 modules and you have to really read the description to understand how to access if you're not in the system. I think if they simplified it into 1 with menus, it would be more user friendly.
Overall it's a good product and we don't have a lot of problems. Their pricing is very competitive.

cons: Number porting can take some time to complete.
pros: You get unlimited calls without any hidden fees
title: Axvoice is a great VoIP service that is...
review: Axvoice is a great VoIP service that is quick to install. It supports conference calls, emergency services are built-in, and the service even provides free equipment and activation for new users. Other VoIP services don’t have these features and charge extra everytime you want to upgrade. It isn’t the case with Axvoice, making it a great choice on a tight budget.

title: We're a demand generation major...
review: We're a demand generation major working in North America/Canada demography. It's a good product we are using since last 2 years. It's working perfectly fine with us. It's working smooth and service support is good. We didn't face any challenge so far and there was no downtime in general. The online support mechanism is good and effective.

cons: Clunky and ineffective admin/user UI ; less feature rich than other services
pros: Provides VOIP service ; Low cost per user ;
title: Getting to support is nearly...
review: Getting to support is nearly impossible. We have waited 3 weeks to get an email response. You sacrifice things like features and a polished UI for a lower price point compare to Google Voice. For any companies that utilize Google Workspace, it is more effective to use Voice for VOIP due to the ease of use from not only the admin perspective but from the users perspective. Googles chat/email support is also very responsive in comparison.

title: I Had this phone service for 7 months,...
review: I Had this phone service for 7 months, my phone service wasn't working and no one in tech support could figure out the problem when i went to cancel this service they told me I was being held to my contract of 24 months and had to pay $655 to cancel. After 3 days of over 12 hours on the phone no one would help me, my phones did not work, I was paying employees 24 hours a day (as I am a dispatch company) to answer phones that did not work, I had no business since my ENTIRE business is my phones, Ive lost thousands of dollars and the best they can do is hang up on me, tell me to pay or wait for them to figure it out. This is your business, if after 3 days you can't figure it out I want nothing to do with you. You violated the terms of my service contract by NOT providing me service and want me to spend another 5 days and countless hours going from department to department? Tell me what is wrong with this. STAY FAR AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY!!!!! I as a business owner have NEVER encountered such ignorance and incompetence and GREED!!! I will see you in court Ring Central

pros: Communication adjustability, Possibility of assignment to Communication in Hubspot CRM, Interesting reports, Independence from phone numbers - runs on VoIP
title: It is perfectly suited not only for...
review:
It is perfectly suited not only for communication with the customer but also inside the company. It is even super usable autonomously for only selected teams in the company.

Everything runs independently, yet all tools work together to create a synergistic effect.

The reports are interesting, and you can easily see how to optimize the prefixes to make them work at their best.

title: Anastasiia was a very helpful...
review: Anastasiia was a very helpful representative via the chat application. She took her time and found a solution to all my questions. A true example of good customer service. My problem began with a misunderstanding of a sent fax and we figured out how to verify that the recipient obtained the information. We then proceeded to billing issues which were resolved quickly. At the end I was satisfied with the service.

title: They have a great selection of toll...
review: They have a great selection of toll free numbers and the ability to add lines for only $5 a month more is amazing. The UI is really user friendly but they also have true call forwarding that works seamlessly. Conference calling is not an option on the standard plan (I am not sure if it is live yet on the premium plan, but I think it is coming soon if not). Thankfully the true call forwarding allows me to conference call as normal through my phone, but if that were not possible, I would probably have to go elsewhere. I'm glad I don't have to make that choice. A toll-free number dedicated to customer service (with unlimited minutes!) and a local number for outbound calls to prospects and referrals who have not yet become clients. Those individuals get a "VIP" number directly to me which is my business cell, but I could see a world where I get a third OP # for that too. Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: The system comes with great features....
review:
The system comes with great features. It is great and so convenient to be able to handle calls, faxes, and text messages with clients. You can upload documents easily and fax them quickly and the best part is that you always receive copies on your email of the received and sent files.

I would recommend the systems to make life easy.

cons: set up was time very time consuming.  Customer service people do not seem to know what they're doing.
title: It took me hours to get my VoIP phone...
review: It took me hours to get my VoIP phone up and running. The phone was connected to the ethernet but for some reason it didn't work. Had to take the phone to my home because I don't have a PC at the business for them to use remote control. I literally was on the phone with them for over 2 hours. Then, I called them again and asked to remove the call forwarding to my father's cell phone, which does not show up on their portal, but the operator turns off all calls to the VoIP phone at the business. wtf?? Why the hell is this so complicated? They need to hire some competent people who actually know what they're doing. I don't have time to sit here for hours going back and forth on something that is so simple.

title: Their support team, when you can...
review: Their support team, when you can connect with their very busy staff, knows their stuff and was able to deliver exactly what I needed. From porting to setting up my existing phone system, they were able to meet every expectation I could possibly have. So glad I switched over to Nextiva for my small business phone needs! Thanks Lee H.!

title: Very happy to have switched our phone...

And...they also go the extra mile when helping over phone, chat or email. We highly recommend Nextiva for your company phone needs.

title: After trying a few VoIP service...
review: After trying a few VoIP service providers I use Nextiva VoIP and SIP trunks because of their AMAZING service. With the new NextivaONE app I can manage all conversations and engage with customers and teams with one powerful easy-to-use solution that is simple to use. All All my phone, SMS, video, and email conversations are in one place.

title: Thank you for a speedy process. ...
review: Thank you for a speedy process. Jessica from the sales team was awesome. She called immediately and walked me through a couple different contract options. I had an issue with logging in and tech support handled the issue with ease. Looking forward to discovering all the features the desktop application and the phone application have to offer.

title: Nextiva has been a great product for...
review: Nextiva has been a great product for years. Only recently have I had any complaints. This was after the release of Nextiva One. Call centers are robust and full of features. There are lots of places for customization that allows our business to stand out. Support is always available for enterprise and answer the phone relatively quickly.

They also told me that part of our account was ported to the new system but they somehow forgot to port our extensions and agents. It's really a huge mess and I am dreading another call with them!!! title: I had suffered the consequences from...
review: I had suffered the consequences from other agents of Nextiva that clearly did not know what they are doing. I was so frustrated because it took HOURS of my time over several days, and none of the agents knew what they were doing regarding Recording. As I have been a good customer with Nextiva for many years, I was getting fed up with the lack of knowledge from the other agents. Many kept me on hold so they can find out what to do, others tried and tried but could not figure it out. Joey was helping, then the phone went dead, then Joey never call me back even though he had asked for my phone number in case we get disconnected. review: 8x8 been nothing but amazing! I didn't know about them until recently. I been using their system it has done the job for me.
