title: I enjoy using Nextiva as our service...
review: I enjoy using Nextiva as our service provider, and the pricing is far better than what is available through a "regular" phone provider. The features included in our plan are amazing. You can count on getting through to support in a fairly timely manner, and I've been able to get help on every issue I've faced.

title: Overall the product and price are good,...
review: Overall the product and price are good, but if you have anything other than a basic install the rest of the experience was terrible. To be fair we have a more complicated setup, but it took a full month to get it sorted out with outrageous amounts of time on hold waiting and finally speaking with support. The company did compensate for the experience but for the amount of time spent dealing with this was just absurd.

title: Looking to reduce our costs and improve...
review:
Looking to reduce our costs and improve on the over all functionality of our telephone, we looked at VOIPLY. From the start the online ordering wed page was easy to process our order. support group were absolutely great... Responded almost immediately to all our questions, and kept us informed on the number porting (keeping our existing number) process.

The instructions for the installation was so easy to connect to the network and our existing telephones... The entire process took less than ten minutes...

I would Recommend this company and product to anyone.

Thanks Veronique

title: Nextiva is always understanding and...
review: Nextiva is always understanding and very helpful. Everyone I have worked with has always double checked that the problem was solved before I got off the phone with them. The technical support staff has never tries to sell me a product they simply fix the issue and provide several options for how to move forward with what works best for my company.

cons: Sometimes, I cannot connect to a number, although my internet connection is good. I've also received a couple of spam texts which could jeopardize the safety of user informaton.
title: Simple & efficientI love the simple...
review: Simple & efficient I love the simple interface that feels like using a regular phone. Call quality has mostly been great. Ditto with texting. Although I haven't used competing apps, I can tell this Openphone is one of the best apps out there for IP calling. The world is now a much smaller and well-connected place, and an app like Openphone greatly benefits users like me who have a requirement to call and talk to customers around the world, especially in the US & Europe. Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: It could be improved though, i think a...
review: It could be improved though, i think a simpler app will be better suited. When you get used to the app, is everything OK. The price is the major factor when it come to competitors. For the price of OpenPhone, there are no competitors. I like it. I just would love to have some more additional features. I also want it to have a chrome extension I would enjoy if you will develop an app, just for dialing, like RingCentral. I don't use RC, but I have observed this on some of my friends. So, please do an update to windows app. Also, please do some keyboard shortcuts for phone hang-up function. Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

cons: Nothing so far. There is a slight hiccup with billing when you replace a team member assigned to the OpenPhone number but dropping a quick message to the support team gets it fixed without any hassle.
title: We switched to OpenPhone from another...
review: We switched to OpenPhone from another provider. The porting process was smooth. The team management web interface is super slick. So do OpenPhones native mobile apps. But above all, what we like most is the Slack integration. Our usage is very light, so often, we have more than one person who needs to use an OpenPhone number for, say OTP code via SMS. In the old days, the assigned user for that number was required to forward it to their team member/assistant. Now with OpenPhone, these 2-3 people usually share a Slack channel where such SMS codes automically appear in real-time, reducing friction. OpenPhone gives us a business phone number, which is easier to use between teams. While there are other solutions in the competing space, none offer ease of use and a long list of impressive features. Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: The tool is simple to use and the...
review: The tool is simple to use and the subscription easy to set up. The features are good, and somehow surprising like the transcription of the messages on the voicemail box I never had any technical problem Each time I had a question, I was answered very quickly and in detail. The Ringing, and the notification for entering calls could be more powerful (louder, and more vivid) like others are. I have to keep an eye on my phone when I'm waiting for an important call I think that in the future WhatsApp may be a strong competitor at a personal level, if there are not new improvements. Because if I'm using WhatsApp to call people... what do I really need other phones for? We sure need more features. As I travel a lot, I need: 1) a "real" US phone number (mainly to be called from customers from abroad) 2) sometimes to call the US administration because my company is in the US Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: The support they offer to resolve any...
review: The support they offer to resolve any ongoing issue is immense. Really cool and easy to use platform (recommended to first timers too). Would say it is a must have for new businesses/startups to start with. I had an issue using the analytics feature right after we upgarded from basic to premium plan. That was a downside for me but was resolved the very next day. While OpenPhone has a great product to offer, there's still room for improvement. We needed a stable dialer with options to port existing numbers, purchase new (if necessary) and sync contacts to entire team by only uploading once. Great job making it happen ?? It also integrates with major CRMs including Salesforce, Hubspot etc. Great experience so far Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: My search for a way to manage my...
review: My search for a way to manage my toll-free number is finally over! There are many apps out there to manage calls and texts for a business line but some of them either don't work well with toll-free or they don't port from a non-carrier situation (I bought my number from a number website and it had no service yet). I had compared many but OpenPhone has everything I'm looking for. I LOVE the "Notes" feature. Not just a one place for notes but a separate entry for every contact I make with the client is very helpful. I'm also very impressed with their customer support. I was only planning on signing up with the trial at first and emailed them three times about three separate issues and I heard back within the hour once and twice within a few, no longer than that. Lastly, they were the ONLY company I found that was able to port my number directly from NumberBarn. I consider this a huge plus. I also really love that if needed I can add on another number late on for just $5. I'm already signing up for the full account and very satisfied! The size of the text/font on the mobile app (IOS) is very small, even on my iPhone 13 Pro, but it's still worth it compared to all the other apps out there like this one. What problems is the product solving and how is that benefiting you? I hated having to use my regular phone number and messaging system to interact with customers. I wanted to be able to keep my personal and business contacts separate. Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: I work remotely in the Medical Billing...
review: I work remotely in the Medical Billing field and 8x8 is a valuable tool that helps keep me connected to clients nationwide. The product was easy to install, updates are minimal but timely and is very user friendly. review:

Service has been quite reliable compared to our old PSTN service; only a single outage I can recall that lasted about 15 minutes, and the price is right. title: We use 8x8 at work and it does the job...
review: We use 8x8 at work and it does the job beautifully. The software also includes video calls and the option to record calls. I did have an issue with the app as it randomly wouldn't let me call out, but I opened a ticket and the support team worked with me, was patient and ultimately helped me resolve it... which was great because I'm not the most tech savvy! I would recommend this option to other businesses with both in office and remote employees.

title: I have been using Nextiva for about 5...
review:
I have been using Nextiva for about 5 years. Phone service is good.
Some issues, but the were usually resolved. (getting to support can take a long time)
Now they are upgrading their desktop app to a new version NextivaOne.
When you upgrade they try to move your stored contacts to the new version.
The problem is that they only port "Personal Phone Number" to the new app.

To clarify: When you create a contact in the current app you can enter
Display Name, First Name, Last Name, Work Phone, Extension, Mobile Phone, Personal Phone and more.
They only port "Display Name" and "Personal Phone" (the last phone number in the form).
They don't port "Work Phone" (the first phone number in the form)
All my personal phone numbers are blank. This means that it ports Display Name , but no phone number.
This is a phone app.

They are unwilling to create a utility to export contacts.
They are unwilling to add a little code to the port that would find one phone number
if "Personal Phone" is blank (this is supposed to be a business application,
why would I have only personal phone numbers?)

I contacted their support. They maintain that there is "NO WAY" to do this.
Really?
It is perhaps a dozen lines of code to copy a different phone number if "Personal Phone" is blank.

If I have to re-enter all my contacts, perhaps it is time to go shopping for a better VOIP service.

title: Great phone solution for SMB...
review: Great phone solution for SMB teams Great value for the price, onboarding was extremely easy, and the interface is very easy to use. They have some really unique features around being able to assign a call or message to a team member and being able to comment on calls for other team members to see. The mobile app could use some work. The web app is very slick and intuitive, but the mobile app feels a bit clunky. More CRM integrations would be nice (outside of just Hubspot and Salesforce) Having a centralized place to manage business phone calls and keep everyone in the loop of who has spoken to what client --- either via phone or SMS. OpenPhone has also helped our new sales team better interact with prospects. Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

My suggestion is to look at other options. I am not writing this review to recommend any other PBX, just not to use this solution

title: The other reviews about how long you...
review:
The other reviews about how long you will spend on hold and how many transfers it will take before anyone even attempts to resolve the issue are accurate or understatements. They double billed me for phone service since I logged into the phone service administrative account from a different computer. That took almost a half hour of hold and transfers, then another 10 to 15 minutes as the agent "researched" the issue. It was service for 1 phone line (period), so how does logging into the account that lets you change the voicemail message with a different computer constitute another monthly fee? I finally transferred the service to another provider and the phone number was ported over on the 9th. I called and cancelled the service that day. The rep wanted me to send documentation stating that I really did want to cancel the service. To which I had to explain that the number had been removed from their control and there really is no stronger method of lodging dissatisfaction with a voip phone service than removing the phone number from them. So they gave me back about $5 from the over charging and kept the remainder of the month. It took 2 phone calls (they "dropped the call once") which resulted in the 4th person telling me I had to send an email about refunding the remainder of the month, and then 8 days to get a "tough luck" response.

I do not understand how they intend to stay in business with over charging, under performing and service support that is just abismal.

title: I moved 90% of our phone lines to...
review: I moved 90% of our phone lines to another company, yet for months Jive continues to bill us for ALL phone lines. We overpaid August and Sept, got them to finally send a credit receipt, and now they've cut us off due to non-payment when they owe us money???? TERRIBLE. Their customer service doesn't exist

title: I do not recommend Jive/GoTo Connect. ...
review:
I do not recommend Jive/GoTo Connect. They have terrible customer service and have yet to resolve any of our issues. You are much better off elsewhere. We are in the process of switching.

Their people are friendly however if there is an issue they disconnect the calls frequently or leave you on hold for a ridiculously long time (probably hoping you will hang up)

It is insanely difficult to reach a supervisor.

title: We bought into this because we require...
review: We bought into this because we require bids and they came in as a lower bidder. After evaluating them and a few others it was determined we would go with them. From the sales pitch, the features we wanted were there. However, once we had the system and started using it, there were so many little things you don't think about that were missing which we had in our old phone system. Such as a simple notification that a Voice mail was forwarded from another extension. If a person is part of multiple call groups, there is no way to know if what group that call is from unless you create a complex Dial plan that stamps caller ID. Using a Dial plan causes another issue on transferring from the apps. The apps only see actual line extensions. Not call groups, so when someone is trying to transfer, they have to know the extension of the dial plan or have to save it as a contact. This is one area the software is lacking. It should be able to be setup as a virtual phone with buttons or options. Instead it is just a basic dial pad and you have to learn many star codes to do certain functions.

title: I have been using Nextiva service for a...
review: I have been using Nextiva service for a couple of years for our business. title: Nextiva is a very efficient cloud based...

My only critique, if any, would be the frequency of their updates. With a system as advanced as Nextiva, updates will unfortunately be necessary. There are too many moving parts for items to not be constantly evolving. Aside from this small item, it is a great system that works very well! I would definitely recommend this product. 9/10

title: Vonage is a horrible service, They have...
review: Vonage is a horrible service, They have NO phone support at all to help with issues/questions. If you call they force you to go on the online chat and disconnect the call. If you want to cancel your service, nope - you got to wait for a supervisor to call you back (maybe) - so you need to call like 5 times for them to finally call you back to cancel which I'm not sure if that's even legal as PER US LAW proper notification to cancel a trade service should not be that complicated/intentionally made to not happen. Either way, horrible practices/ poor quality of call/lots of better competitors - used Vonage for 3 years, left today - happier.

title: I've gotten support three times. All...
review:
I've gotten support three times. All agents were good but Franz was superlative. Very attentive to the flow and the issues I was raising. Great understanding of the problems I raised. Respectful. Just wonderful in every way.

title: Terrell was great! Very helpful. he...
review: Terrell was great! Very helpful. he Nextiva portal is very user-friendly. Terrell taught me how to put my voice messages where they need to go so in the future, I can do this task myself. He was very knowledgable regarding monitoring the System network since I was having problems with dropped calls. I will recommend Nextiva to other business associates in the future.

cons: I was on hold for an hour and a half
pros: They got my issue handled quickly
title: This is a very good company one of the...
review: This is a very good company one of the issues that I do believe they have is that they need to hire more staff to be able to handle the large amount of calls that come in this was not my first time calling and when you’re dealing with business clients you have to understand that their time is very valuable spending two hours and 10 minutes on a call just to handle a simple issue is not something a traditional CEO have time to do. The company overall is great the time spent to talk to someone need to be reduced.

title: Our number was ported into Nextiva from...
review: Our number was ported into Nextiva from Verizon. At some point we stopped receiving calls on our old phones and new phones were not available for a few hours. I called support and worked for over an hour with Yuliana S. she was very knowledgable and answered all my questions. She setup forwarding and we started receiving calls. Very satisfied and would recommend Nextiva to others.

title: Phone system is easy to use and when...
review: Phone system is easy to use and when you get a live person they are very helpful. Sometimes it is a bit difficult to figure it all out, but once you do, it is very nice with the mobile features etc.. We have a fax number but who uses that anymore. But nice to have for the few customers who need it. Overall, I am very pleased.

title: Nextiva has been a very reliable and...
review: Nextiva has been a very reliable and honest company the past few years. They have many features and add-ons that are available to their customers. The system is very easy to learn and use. The only con we have with Nextiva is the wait time for support. We would definitely recommend them as a provider.

title: Overall, I am very satisfied with...
review: Overall, I am very satisfied with Nextiva. My only conniption is that it takes typically 30-60 minutes to get in touch with support, and sometimes even longer. For example, I spent 1.5 hours on hold waiting for a Nextiva support rep to pick up. Fortunately, I do not have to call very often because everything works great most of the time. Otherwise, the service and everything is great! I would highly recommend to others that they use Nextiva.

title: These guys are awesome. Their support...
review:
These guys are awesome. Their support team is also great. Resolved our issues in no time. Quick responses. Very professional people. This provider serves the best. Our company have used a different provider but 8*8 is best of them all. It provides quilaty services, quilaty and quick support.
Thank you team.

title: Very kind and professional guy, Help me...
review:
Very kind and professional guy, Help me set up everything. Fastly access to my computer remotely and solve all problems as I want.
Price is not so expensive and applications are working good.
Not my first time working with your product, and your good support team is making me choose your company every single time.
thank you for your service

title: Nextiva support always provides me with...
review: Nextiva support always provides me with the help I need. Support staff are very friendly, knowledgeable and professional. Even when they do not know how to do something I'm wanting done, they make the effort to find the answer and make it happen for me. They are always very respectful and take the time to listen.

cons: Long phone wait for support after onboarding
title: Enjoying the phone service. Love the...
review: Enjoying the phone service. Love the features. The support people are very courteous and professional. I’ve only been with the company for two months but so far I am enjoying the product. The phone lines are clear and loving the use of the app in addition to having the desktop phones. If you’re a person whose hand needs to be held with electronics (like me), then get ready for a long wait time for phone support after on-boarding. Haven’t tried chat yet. Once someone is on the phone the support is usually great.

cons: Terrible service. I was told upon signing up that I was getting a “no contract, no commitment” service. This was a lie. Nextiva kept charging me TWICE A DAY despite numerous attempts to cancel my account. Phone calls and emails, all ignored. I even had to freeze my debit card because Nextiva wouldn’t stop charging me every single day. And when I finally got someone on the phone, he was apathetic, making excuses, and trying everything (except actual salesmanship) to avoid closing my account. Good luck actually getting through to someone, and when you do, it’ll be some half-concerned reprobate working from home who really doesn’t care about why you’re calling. Honestly, if I could give zero stars, I would. Absolute scammers! Don’t make the same mistake I did. I’ve switched to another service provider and I’m a lot happier.
title: Absolute scammers. I own a copywriting...
review: Absolute scammers. I own a copywriting agency and was looking for a toll-free number that my clients around the world could call internationally. When I signed up I was told that I was getting a “no contract, no commitment” service, so I trialed it for a month. After I discovered functional elements I didn’t like, I attempted to cancel my account. NOPE! Nextiva simply wouldn’t allow it. Despite numerous phone calls, emails, and hours on hold, Nextiva charges kept coming through on my bank card TWICE A DAY, EVERY DAY. I even had to freeze my bank card just because of Nextiva’s bogus charges! What an annoying mess. When I called and finally got through to someone, I got some half-concerned person working from home who tried everything (except actual salesmanship) to avoid closing my account. He was apathetic, unapologetic, and put me on hold for an unnecessarily long time for no reason, just to annoy me it seemed. Don’t trust the good reviews on other sites — AVOID Nextiva at all costs! Don’t make the same mistake I did!

title: Any issues I’ve had- which have been...
review:
Any issues I’ve had- which have been minimal- have been easily resolved through tech support. I’ve never had an issue with down time or call quality!
I run a small psychotherapy practice and appreciate the HIPAA compliant features! I love the app which allows me 24 hour access to contact info, voicemails and messaging.

title: Nextiva has truly changed the way we...
review: Nextiva has truly changed the way we conduct our business. Coming off a premise based NEC and migrating to the cloud has expanded our ability to serve our clients no matter the time or day. Nextiva's customer service team is beyond amazing. Each rep that you get connected with knows how to fix the issue. No issue is too big or too small and I always walk away with the help I needed and even learned how to fix the issue myself. Modern system that doesn't break the bank!

title: Quality of Service has never been an...
review: Quality of Service has never been an issue with Nextiva. Their support treats the customer well and with respect. After a couple of years of service we have started to look into the other products that they offer and what could benefit our company. The phones are quality and we have never lost service since we started using them.

title: My support provider was very helpful...
review: My support provider was very helpful with me resolving my issue. Was very patient and concise with the directions. I took a minute finding certain information but the specialist didn't get impatient but instead found the issue but also guided me with completing what needed to be done. I would recommend this type of assistance and support.

cons: no phone customer service, wait time was several hours on the chat line
pros: Your agent Liliia fixed our problem quickly
title: Good work tech support Liliia!  thanks...
review:
Good work tech support Liliia! thanks for repairing our call-forwarding back to our office phones.

Hate the fact that I had to wait so long to chat with one of Nextiva's agents. Also, I suggest a phone number with a call back feature. It would allow people to leave their desk with their cell phone or for lunch, etc.

title: Good support, but the hold time to get...
review: Good support, but the hold time to get a rep can be long at times. Even up to 45min before getting a tech on the line. Other than that, I would have to say things are great with them and the uptime has been awesome as well. Alot of customization vs other providers for sure. I have no complaints other wise. They are very detailed with each call.

title: Awesome help - The call que was long...
review: Awesome help - The call que was long but the support tech was a delight to work with . I had a long call wait and expected a support tech that would be tired of taking call after call with customers being on a long wait. This was not the case at all very easy to talk to and got the information i needed very quickly.

title: We went though 2 - 3 services before we...
review: We went though 2 - 3 services before we ended up with Nextiva and we aren't going anywhere. The service and technology is second to none and the price is reasonable! We are a small business so we are very price sensitive. We also need the flexibility that Nextiva offers with it's wonderful mobile app.

title: The online support is not very helpful...
review: The online support is not very helpful and I was on hold for over an hour before I got to speak to a phone support assistant who was able to help, but had to put me on hold several times for a very long time. In total I was on the phone for 2 hours trying to resolved a couple of fairly small issues. And this was after I was hung up on by the first person I was able to get through to.

cons: Issues during initial porting, but being sorted
pros: Customer is excellent. The team is very responsible
title: I was looking for another VoiP provider...
review:
I was looking for another VoiP provider because my current VoiP provider Ooma has a blacklist limit of 1,024. After searching and searching, VoiPLY had the same feature of SPAM Blocker, and they don't have a limit. Best of all, they also offer eFax that is HIPAA compliant!! The no limit blacklist was a win, then the eFax feature was another win. Then, the icing on the cake, CUSTOMER SERVICE. Love love the customer service. Leah was one of the main reasons I switched. She understood and made me feel at ease of all my concerns. The rest of the team was also very responsive. knowledgeable, and understood all my issues and concerns. VoiPLY also have great features and at a reasonable and fair price in my humble opinion. I am a new customer that transferred all my accounts from Ooma to VoiPLY.

Only time will tell if the longevity of the service will remain top notch. From initial experience, I am very happy. No reason to change my mind.

I would highly recommend them.

cons: Horrible service, Horrible support, Horrible system
title: This is the worst company you could...
review:
This is the worst company you could possibly imagine.
The service is constantly breaking and going offline, normally for several days on end,
Their 'support' team are completely clueless and copy paste the same answers every time it happens, normally about once a month. Last time I was told that I was lying when I said the system was offline and was not believed until I sent a video showing the problem.
Today it has happened again. As soon as we are able to we will be leaving Bonline as they are rude and incompetent.
They claim all sorts on their website but the truth is that the iPhone app has never worked, the desktop phones break and the backend service is constantly offline.
Even if the service was completely free we would not return.
Signing up to this company is our biggest business mistake we have ever made.

title: You are always connected but not tied...
review:
You are always connected but not tied to your desk or office. Customer Support team is always helpful. It has inhanced how we are able to connect with our customers. Glad we made the change.
The number of features that come with the service are incredible. I would highly recomend the service for any size company.

pros: exceptional Supprt. On going upgrades for better  experiences.
title: Nextiva is constantly updating and...
review:
Nextiva is constantly updating and upgrading for a better experience.
The support is exceptional. There has not been an issue they could not resolve in a timely manner. I would definitely recommend this company to others.
They just updated and upgraded the SMS services. I can not wait to see what's next for Nextiva.

title: I just moved my second office to...
review: I just moved my second office to nextiva. They helped me through setting up all of my call groups and auto attendants. They also helped create special rings so each office knows which location a customer call is calling from. I need to have alternate numbers enabled to create special rings, but found that i needed to have support enable to option. Every tech i have worked with was very knowledgeable and had the answers quickly!

title: I think the support team is great. They...
review: I think the support team is great. They are knpowledgable and they work with you to find a solution. I dont like the choppyness of the system. we have been having quite a few problems latly with the new app and with the mobile app. we have to sign out several times a day to get goo working serivce. I think the new app will be better with better features so i am looking forward to the new app and the features.

title: I appreciate the support, the level of...
review:
I appreciate the support, the level of support varies with the person on the phone. Julie was a great support. I also spoke with someone on 11/09/2022, he was really helpful as well.
I needed help setting up a user and verifying that I had the license to complete this. On 11/09 the support verified it for me, but my team was having troubles accessing or setting up an account. I called today and Julie quickly set up the account and walked my staff through how to access.

title: When our company started to work we...
review: When our company started to work we needed to find a service which would be understandable, good with price and easy to use. We found Nextiva! The Nextiva is very easy to use and very comfortable, it helps our business , we also use Nextiva Fax a lot, its super easy, looking forward to using Nextiva Texts. Thank you

pros: Phone support solves issues fast a majority of time.
title: The app is great. However it would be...
review: The app is great. However it would be nice to just have an option to turn the calls on and off instead of having to log in and out. The user manuals don’t always include everything. I have had to spend a lot of time trying to find my answers on my own or by trial and error. There are probably features or easier way to do things on our phones but won’t know until you search it.

title: The flexibility of the provisioning of...
review: The flexibility of the provisioning of the service is just what our company needs. I have been very impressed with this company other than tech support. I have waited for over an hour on multiple occasions. This is not acceptable. They should stop taking new customers until they can ramp up their support.

title: Kind and efficient- Thank you! Great...
review: Kind and efficient- Thank you! Great customer service. He helped me to solve the situation quickly. Great representation of the company. So glad that we were able to get the assistance we needed during this call. Helped me as much as he could and transferred me to the appropriate party when he was done.

title: The agent was very helpful and was able...
review: The agent was very helpful and was able to resolve my issues quickly. She was very pleasant and asked the right questions. She took the time to review my account and assist with updating my billing in addition to updating my phone status. One suggestion would be to improve the time it takes for an agent to pick up I waited almost 20 minutes.

title: I can say Nextiva is one of the best...
review: I can say Nextiva is one of the best communications providers I've used in my entire career, It is user-friendly and it has all the features you need for work, especially when you're working rom home. The only cons I can identify is the waiting time to get a customer service representative (which you will seldomly need) BUT when you finally get one, you will surely be assisted kindly and efficiently.

title: Nextiva offers Great Service and...
review: Nextiva offers Great Service and features at fair price to help small business grove. Nextiva offers most services small business will need Phone, Fax, v-fax, Text messaging/SMS etc. also virtual office call diverter. Nextiva phone app is extremely helpful during business off hours to get in touch with clients and accessing voice messages

title: Nextiva has good features when it comes...
review: Nextiva has good features when it comes to call queue's especially. When the new NextivaONE app came along, I was pretty worried because of some features missing, but they have been developing it quickly, and a lot of the features from the old app are already back. The new app is more user friendly and simplified which is nice.

title: I have worked with other VOIP providers...
review: I have worked with other VOIP providers before but after doing extensive research I decided to go with Nextiva. In just our second week of having the phones up and running, it has been the best decision. As their customer service is hands down the best I have ever worked with! They are friendly and work with you to help get your phones how you want them.

title: Nextiva was the fifth provider we...
review: Nextiva was the fifth provider we contacted upon recent comparison shopping. I know the old adage "third time is a charm" but in our case the fifth time was a charm. From initial interest in their products and service to their installation and onboarding process every technician and customer service provider has been competent, thorough and very professional.

title: We are using netiva from last 3 years...
review: We are using netiva from last 3 years and its is very good serivce we received, Easy installation, Customer support is also very good they resolve the issue quickly, Feature as also great, Many thing we can manage from on our own and can be monitor everything from our system and get the reports easly.

title: We have use VOIP for the business since...
review: We have use VOIP for the business since 2012 and 8x8 has been a great company so far. They have a great user friendly platform with features that a not so tech savvy person can understand. Excellent customer service and the overall its a great value for the price of the service . I definitely recommended using their services.

cons: sometime you have to wait quite a while to get on a live chat
pros: works wirelessly on our network with dongels
title: We have never had any real issues with...
review: We have never had any real issues with our service overall. The app is easy to use on our mobile devices when out of the office and gives us a lot of flexibility, especially for our sales department. I have always had a wonderful experience speaking with techs who were very knowledgeable and personable. Overall I would recommend Nextiva.

title: Our Nextiva system is fantastic.   I...
review: Our Nextiva system is fantastic. I want to point out two incredibly helpful employees. Both Mark Finkevych and Kellen Bell provided extraordinary service! Without the efforts of these two employees, I am certain my review of Nextiva would not have been the same. I am grateful to both of these employees for their commitment to the success of our phone systems.

pros: Lots of control and ways to customize your set up.
title: thanks for the support Diane. Wanted to...
review: thanks for the support Diane. Wanted to make a organization wide adjustment to make sure we are serving our customers better. I had to wait through a bunch of hold music to get to you but you were able to fix my problem with ease. Every time I call the support line I have great success getting my issues resolved, the earlier you call the better.

title: Over all good quality service! They are...
review: Over all good quality service! They are always there to help me and are quick to solve the issues! Been working with them for a year! Would recommend. They take time and solve the issue with you, they ask good questions, are very clear and walk you through the struggles you are dealing with! Nextiva is the best

cons: CONTRACT SCAM  - ALMOST IMPOSSIBLE TO CANCRL
title: I signed up and agreed to a 2 yr...
review:
I signed up and agreed to a 2 yr contract with Ring Central and when I attempted to cancel my subscription 5 years later they claim I can’t because I’m still in a contract.

Apparently I signed a small clause in the original contract that said that they can Auto Renew my contract every 2 years without your consent. They are asking for 16 month @ $350 a month to get out of my contract after 5 years????

What a scam … very unfair business practice!!!

title: I needed to add a license today and was...
review: I needed to add a license today and was on hold for over an hour to accomplish this. The Support team was excellent and apologized several times. How can any company survive when it's almost impossible to purchase something from them? On our Zoom account, I can go in add a license, and be done in three minutes, probably why my monthly Zoom invoice is almost $500.

title: I would rather talk to a live person on...
review: I would rather talk to a live person on the phone, instead of chatting. I didn't get any help through chat. The lady I spoke with on the phone stayed with me until we could figure out the problem and fix it. She was very helpful and now my call flow is live and we can except calls. I wish I would of gotten her name so I could give her a shout out! Thank you Lady!

cons: Customer support in the past has not been satisfactory.
pros: Todays phone call with cusomter support was great!
title: My phone call with Diana in Customer...
review:
My phone call with Diana in Customer Support was great today. She answered all of my questions and was able to successfully take care of our issues.

We have been with Nextiva since June 2021. The first year was rocky with 30+ minute waits for customer service, phones malfunctioning, and poor customer service. Things have improved some over the last year. If we continue to get the support we received today that will make us all very happy!

The jury is still out on whether we will recommend Nextiva or not.

title: Our phone system has gone down 2 weeks...
review: Our phone system has gone down 2 weeks in a row both on Mondays!!! Yikes - it's the busiest phone day for us. The reps at support: Esau & Vlad got us up and running but took a very long time. Hopefully it is corrected now .... Esau & Vlad were very nice and worked very hard to help us. Thank you!

pros: If there is any problem, support works diligently to identify and fix the issue
title: Nextiva phone system works great.I...
review:
Nextiva phone system works great.
I really like that there is computer and other function integrations that streamline having to have different apps open and can be used just as effectively on the phone app.
Only one slight con, on my specific headset, the "tap to answer" button does not work as my headset is not fully compatible with the new laptop app. This is only a slight inconvenience and will be resolved with the purchase of a new compatible headset.

title: I must say they work very hard to get...
review:
I must say they work very hard to get the problem resolved for you. I appreciate the fact that they were patient even when I wasn't but they walked me thru the process to get my phones back working. It seem like I have gotten to know half the technical support team because everyone there was trying to help.
Great Team!

Thanks again
Nora Nelson

title: Service - I've noticed a second or two...
review:
Service - I've noticed a second or two delay when I pick up the handset until the person can hear me. Frustrating.

Service - Unavailable if the power and/or internet go down.

Chat Support - Helpful, but once you start a case with the bot, it's a long wait, and don't navigate off the page you're on or you'll have to start over in the queue!

cons: difficult interface, customer support hard to get
title: We started using 8x8 in 2012.  The...
review:
We started using 8x8 in 2012. The phones worked well and customer service was fantastic. Around 2018-2019, the customer support telephone numbers disappeared from the website. We were then told by the website to submit questions ticket. We had several instances where we needed immediate help from Tech Support and it was slow because of the ticketing process.

Overall, the tech support in 2012 was award winning, 10 years later - practically non-existent if you needed immediate help. The biggest issue we had recently was that our 855 numbers were showing up on outbound calls as spam. Repeated requests to get our company name to show up on customers caller ID's were never accomplished. This was the major reason that we changed service providers.

cons: If the internet is down the phones are down
title: Great Service, it's amazing how...
review:
Great Service, it's amazing how customer service is all over the world.
Very professional.
I Will recommend to other Sarpino's location.
Wide variety of services to help your business.

title: Nextiva is a great VOIP solution.  The...
review: Nextiva is a great VOIP solution. The hardware is easy to use and has great accessibility features. The software empowers our staff to communicate internally and externally. We are able to manage our office hours, plan for holiday and vacations, and update our voice recording. The auto-attendant feature helped streamline incoming calls and has saved us on payroll costs.

title: Overall, Nextiva provides an excellent...
review: Overall, Nextiva provides an excellent service. From time to time, their mobile and desktop apps are pretty unreliable, but tech support is always helpful and knowledgeable. The quality of calls is excellent and there are a wide array of features that allow us to customize our settings to optimize our workflow.

title: We've had Nextiva for a few years now....
review: We've had Nextiva for a few years now. For the most part it works well with our management system. The only issue I've had that I can think of is when I call in to tech support. It seems like every time, no matter the issue, it's "weird" or unheard of. Therefore, troubleshooting takes a good amount of time or multiple calls. But no one seems to start with "oh yes, I know what's going on" or something positive.

title: Please do not sign up for one year....
review: Please do not sign up for one year. Phone calls never come through when people call. Every time I report they will have me uninstall app, do something on their end and reinstall. Few days later same issues. After 30 days no money back even though it rarely works. Issues every week for the last few months.

title: My company, Elima-Draft Inc. recently...
review: My company, Elima-Draft Inc. recently switched to NEXTIVA and I/we are totally pleased with the system/service thus far. Exceeded my expectations!!! Customer Service Representative Mariia U. was awesome. She is very knowledgeable, patient, understanding, and personable. Thank you, Bob Elima-Draft Inc.

title: Quick response from Support team. I...
review: Quick response from Support team. I have never had an issue not resolved. The webinterace for support could provide more DIY information. THe FAX interface works but can be confusing. For some reason phones tend to loss their configuration. I am not sure why this happens, but tech support is able to quickly reinstall configuration. Are the configurations not saved after the fix and a reboot "Breaks" the configuration?

title: My company has been using Nextiva for...
review: My company has been using Nextiva for over 2 year at this point. I was there from the initial deploying of the system. We have grown from 4 employees to 39 and the Nextiva system has not skipped a beat, not even when we had massive turnover at one phase or another, including of very key players and the Nextiva account administrator. The support they provided at that time of turnover was not disruptive in any way and it has continued to be seamless throughout the service up through the time I write this review. I would quickly encourage other companies to engage with Nextiva.

title: The onboarding process was easy, and...
review: The onboarding process was easy, and our team was up and running within a few minutes. The process could not have been more straightforward. As we grow our team, this phone system will grow with us and allow up to provide the best services to our participants. We are excited to continue our journey.

title: Extremely knowledge and helpful...
review:
Extremely knowledge and helpful support- always. It is amazing how very helpful they are. Much appreciated.
With Nextiva's VoIP we were prepared for all the work-at-home phone related issues. The Nextiva app also played a key part for our customer service team members, And finally the Polycom phones have all been reliable.

cons: sometime long wait time for cust svc rep to answer calls
title: Been using this app for about a year...
review:
Been using this app for about a year now. App was recently upgraded and it's even better than before. Customer service is EXCELLENT. They are well trained and don't need to go looking for answers when I call with a question/issue.

App is pretty straight forward and help is always just a phone call away.

Would recommend to anyone.

title: Amazing Customer Service Support.  The...
review: Amazing Customer Service Support. The representative makes sure all of our issues where solve, on the same call. Also Nextiva Portal has very helpful information about how we can automated some of our processes. We now spend less time with tech support agents. It’s making problems very easy for us.

title: The tech this morning was very...
review: The tech this morning was very personable, easy to understand and very knowledgeable. I would recommend him to assist anytime. Nextiva overall has provided me with a solution to my business telephone needs. The system works well and has very few issues and when there are issues the tech support is very helpful.

title: Nextiva is a great platform for voip...
review: Nextiva is a great platform for voip solution. We have used it for over 5 years and have no complaints. I like how calls, chats, and now emails are in one application. Also I like how all of our agents can take a caller into a virtual room. The auto attendant feature and acquiring different area code numbers is a breeze with nextiva.

title: Very user friendly experience. I was...
review: Very user friendly experience. I was able to get up and running right away once the phone numbers ported over. I work with 18 different numbers and have 3 reps answering them. Couldn't be easire for me to set it up and for them to quickly learn how to navigate the system. The reporting side could be a little more robust but the key thing that I am looking for within reporting, the support team said they are currently working on and should be here soon. I was able to move from a 3rd party call center that I had been currently using, to a in-house call center that I am setting up on my end. All reps are managed remotely and openphone is a great system for this. Very user friendly experience Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: Definitely interface and the friendly...
review:
Definitely interface and the friendly UI. The way I can manage my team and clients in a single platform it makes everything so much easier. I have a teammate who is almost an elderly person and learned to use the software really quickly from the start, that helps me focusing on business instead of training my employees. Communication, is the most important factor for me and this platform permits me to communicate with my US clients efficiently. I see no delay in the messages or issues by delivering them.

At first my biggest concern is the lack of personalization regarding tex messaging tones but since we work with android devices, that could be resolved easily. Another point of improvement I can see is to add more compatibility with different devices, softwares, common AI used around the globe.

Also as an owner I would like to be able to see all my team's information on the teams tab on the android app. I'm only able to see their names and if they're online

The main concern in my business is communication with our clients and users, we need to be able to communicate via phone or message with them and OpenPhone allow it. No other IP telephony company offers such a realiable service and to include the fact that I can manage and contact my team through the same platform is great.

Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: 8 x 8 has been perfect for the last 10...
review: 8 x 8 has been perfect for the last 10 years. We have no issues with it. Comes with the app. My clients never know I’m not in the office. Very professional. I highly recommend 8 x 8. Welcome to the NASDAQ 8 x 8! 8 x 8 has great customer service. They also have a great administration app website to help facilitate the employees communications.

title: No worthwhile support. Even the...
review: No worthwhile support. Even the simplest issue takes days to resolve. No one is interested in actually helping. Things they know how to fix in seconds, yet insist on providing us (people with no technical know-how) instructions (that don't work--also for probably tiny, stupid reasons that someone experienced would know how to fix) instead of helping. We have a Yealink phone and a Yealink headset. The phone "updated" and now the headset doesn't work. Insanely stupid, ridiculously small problem and yet we're on day four and I've turned into one of those people that posts angry reviews.

title: Nextiva provides all the features we...
review: Nextiva provides all the features we are looking for. They have consistant and reliable service. We have locations all across the U.S. and haven't had any major outages. All the of the customer services reps I've worked with over the past year have been very friendly and knowledgable. They have been able to assist with all of our needs.

title: Nextiva has reinvented the way you do...
review: Nextiva has reinvented the way you do business. Leaving it open to do business anywhere and still have it seem like you're in the office. Their apps are great for mobility and their support staff is friendly and very knowledgeable. They strive on customer service and that shows from onboarding to implementation. If you need a reliable solution with robust features with a great support staff, Nextiva is the way to go.

title: We have used Nextive for about 8 years...
review: We have used Nextive for about 8 years now. Very reliable and super customer service. We have been very pleased and have no plans of considering other providers despite continuous efforts from them. We have grown a lot over this time and Nextiva has adjusted our network to seamlessly handle the increased call flow and complexity of having multiple offices.

title: We have been with Nextiva for over...
review:
We have been with Nextiva for over three years and have only had one issue (it was us, not them who caused the issue). They helped me resolve the issue as soon as I brought it to their attention!
I would definitely recommend Nextiva! Their products have been trouble free and their support is great!
Thank you for your help and support!

title: The Nextiva support team are great!...
review: The Nextiva support team are great! They're always so helpful when I reach out to them. The call quality with our Nextiva VoIP phones is go crisp and clear. We have had a few outages since switching to their, but their engineering team is always quick to resolve any issues that arise. I do installations of the phones in other offices and they are so easy to install and set up.

cons: Long hold times to reach suppoirt, emailing support is a waste of time
title: Every single time you have to email...
review:
Every single time you have to email support you must verify your identity, which is fine. But, following the initial email every single email sent after they do the same thing even though you're still discussing the initial topic in the email thread and you already verified who you are multiple times. The hold time to reach a support rep is slightly exorbitent. Their phone menu does not work properly. The voicemail does not function properly. The actual rep who is supposed to be head of our account is non-responsive. The last time I emailed him he responded 5 months after.

Call quality is good for the most part, transferring and basic stuff works well. You can't text properly off their application though you would have to know which phone provider every person you want to text has example 5555555555@verizon.com which is totally wild in 2022.

The actual agents for their support team though are usually helpful and polite just the amount of times I have to call them to do minor changes is really not normal. I should be able to reset a password, add / change devices, add / change call flows etc. without having to call support.

title: The person was able to help me with my...
review: The person was able to help me with my issue. It did take a bit of time to finally connect with someone, but they had a backlog of over a hundred people waiting. I appreciated the countdown letting me know my place in line. It allowed me to get other work done while I was waiting. My issue was fully resolved.

title: Have had an outstanding experience so...
review: Have had an outstanding experience so far, 2 years in! Any issue or adjustment that may pop up is quickly dealt with, and the support staff is always extremely helpful. Despite being a fairly small company we upgraded to their Call-Center plan for the features, which is cost-per-user, so we're able to scale it down while keeping all the fantastic features - Highly recommend!

title: We have had a wonderful experience with...
review: We have had a wonderful experience with this company and their service since we joined them in Mar. 2022. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable service and a reasonable cost. Added benefit of having out fax and call forwarding directly to cell phone when out of the office has been convenient as well.

title: I am a salesman in the indirect...
review: I am a salesman in the indirect channel. I sell exclusively Nextiva for UCaaS. My value prop for customers is 'you're not buying dial tone, you're buying the best support in the industry'. I've called Support hundreds of times for customers. I can count on the fingers of one hand the times I didn't get an issue solved on the first call.

title: Great customer service, quick,...
review: Great customer service, quick, efficient and friendly. I've had customers ask about our phone service before because of the clarity of the calls and I've referred them to Nextiva. I've always received the help I need when I've inquired. The live chat does have a long wait time, but opening a ticket is usually answered within 24-48 hours and done correctly!

title: Great support from Nextiva. Way easier...
review: Great support from Nextiva. Way easier to get on the phone than our last provider. We would definitely recommend nextiva if you are looking for a phone provider. These guys are great. I really enjoy working with nextiva. Best thing about them is the fact that the phone service is reliable. Great people here

cons: Long wait time on the live chat
title: Overall good service, on line chat...
review: Overall good service, on line chat needs more options for self help. Sales rep was helpful with explaining how the billing works and what the different fees and taxes were tied to. Calling into the support line had a short wait and the support rep was easy to understand and very helpful.

title: Seriously, what a freaking disaster. We...
review:
Seriously, what a freaking disaster. We have about 500 devices (lines of service) at multiple facilities. Nextiva can not even keep the billing information correct! They charge the wrong facilities the wrong dollar figures for services. Heck, they even charged the WRONG END USER, in the WRONG STATE one of our bills!!!!

Called ID (outbound) is frequently broken (presenting local handset name). The mobile application is beyond worthless and on and on.

The management team (I will not name the names as I assume it is not allowed). What a bunch of worthless tools. Quite seriously, the techs in Ukraine are FAR more competent and understanding than the idiots in Arizona...all while being in a nation at war.

We are moving all of our lines away from Nextiva as the contracts expire....heck, even canceling accounts is almost impossible (90+ minute hold times). We simply are blocking credit cards so that they can not charge us...let them charge us, police reports and law suits will follow - that is how upset with their apathetic services we are.

cons: It can be a bit complicated to get it set up the first time.
title: Overall, I enjoy using Nextiva. The...
review:
Overall, I enjoy using Nextiva. The phone app can be better designed and set up process to be a bit more intuitive but it does offer great options to set up the call the way you desire.

The price is reasonable and although annual contracts, it presents great value and flexibility for my office and personal lines

title: Quality service at a great price.  We...
review: Quality service at a great price. We have been using this service for 9 years and have been very happy. Everything just works as it should. Voice quality is superior to other services we have used. The mobile application is also very handy for getting and receiving calls and texts while not in the office.

pros: Allows me to use the phone service all around the world with my phone or computer.
title: I loved that when I tried to change,...
review: I loved that when I tried to change, learn or update anything on the account there were a ton of guides I could use and if not I could call customer support and they will take care of me. We haven't found any issues whatsoever since we started using their services about 3-4 years ago. You can check live daily stats so we can know for sure what we can expect on an average day in advance with the Communication suite enterprise plan we have. I have stop using my personal phone number to text customers. They have the option to text using Nextiva which is great so I don't get to answer questions from the customers when I'm off work or at the most inconvenient time for me. If we have questions they always answer you and follow up by phone call or email to make sure everything is working great.

title: Amazing VoIP company, they've been...
review: Amazing VoIP company, they've been extremely reliable in my 5+ years with them. I would highly recommend their service to anyone that needs a full featured Unified Communication as a Service platform. They 100 percent took us from scratch to a fully operational system within a few days. I can't thank them enough!

title: I called customer service about a...
review: I called customer service about a problem I was having with our VOIP service. Alex was the tech who helped me walk through all the potential issues and was able to fix the problem I was having. He was patient and very understanding of my frustration. This was the absolute best customer service I've received from Nextiva and for this reason I would recommend GetVOIP through Nextiva. Thank you!

title: Nextiva is my first experience with...
review: Nextiva is my first experience with VOIP. The install was relatively smooth- I did have a local IT person helping through the process. The Nextiva app (combined with a different provider for remote access) has really allowed us to be a little more fexible with work from home situations.

title: we use Nextiva VOIP for 7 sites, we...
review: we use Nextiva VOIP for 7 sites, we have over 150 call center agents, and over 100 office staff, the system gives us flexibility for CSR to working from home or any our call center locations. I use to dread calling telecom providers when i needed something changes or there was an issue and every time I hung up always wondered why that was so hard. with Nextiva that is completely different, the vast majority of my issues are simple changes and they just get knocked out quickly and efficiently. The more complex things, ones that go beyond one contact, it seems like they understand the issues and require very little back and forth with me or my team. I have also never had quite as reliable service either. So I have to say Nextiva just works as you think it should and when something needs changed it is simple and efficient, like it should be.

review: Never any issues with faxing through Nextiva. Whether receiving or sending the faxing is always fast and clear. We are 100% happy with Nextiva.

I am waiting for someone to call me in regards to our contract.

title: The service is reliable and support...

At times it is difficult to make changed to settings if you call into the customer care line. The most beneficial thing that have found to change setting is emailing into the support.

title: We just started using Nextiva at the...

Some of our employees work remotely during the week or are on the road so having the ability to use the company phones system at all times no matter your location is nice.

title: Customer service is always on point....
review: Customer service is always on point. Bit of a wait but at least you aren't transferred to 15 different people and then disconnected. They are always friendly, knowledgeable and patient. They are very tech savvy and always know exactly what my trouble is coming from and how to fix it quickly. Nextiva is definitely worth the price.

cons: Price is high but still cheaper than most competitors
pros: Works great in conjunction with  Microsoft teams
title: Nextiva support walks you though the...
review: Nextiva support walks you though the initial onboarding process there is no need to know anything about VoIPs. Call quality is perfect and much clearer than our previous landlines. I would recommend anyone that does use landlines move to a VoIP as it keeps both employees an clients connected no matter where you are working from.

title: Works well and good customer service....
review: Works well and good customer service. Not that easy to figure some things out on your own like switching extensions or adding another extension to your phones but easy to get customer support via chat when I need it. Overall I haven't had any issues with the service and would recommend it to others.

title: We had a few hiccups during...
review: We had a few hiccups during implementation but we were finally able to resolve with the help of the support team. Since then we have not had any issues. The chat feature is a good thing but when I tried the other day there were 62 people ahead of me. I then reached out to our account manager and she gave us the support number to call and the issues was resolved right away.

title: Great support, easy to setup, love the...
review: Great support, easy to setup, love the que calling feature! Never had any down time which is crucial in my business with 5 lines based for customer support. Would highly recommend.

title: We have used Nextiva for 6 months now...
review: We have used Nextiva for 6 months now and have been relatively happy. With the exception of a few dropped calls which were taken care of. The online support is nice for this small business! Keeps me from having to call in and talk to an operator for an hour! thanks nextiva we look forward to working with you in the future.

title: I have had a hard time ordering phones...
review: I have had a hard time ordering phones and adding lines. It would be preferable to do this online in my account, rather than be at the mercy of an account manager who may or may not get back to you. The current model could work if they were more responsive. It took three tries and and a different acct mgr to get the job done. I tried to order phones a few months ago and just gave up and purchased used phones on Ebay.

title: Customer service is so kind and fast!!...
review: Customer service is so kind and fast!! Not that there are many issues to be had but they are all fixed very fast when they do occur! they took their time with my issue and made me feel like they actually cared. i didnt feel rushed at all. A wonderful provider and i hope more people start to use you as a provider.

title: Still working through it as a new...
review: Still working through it as a new customer but so far easy to contact support and all helpful. Easily using extensions to make everything work for our company. Moving away from Comcast. Chat has a long wait but love I can call support and they will call me back when they are available which is also soon!!

title: Easy to order but, I did not understand...
review: Easy to order but, I did not understand the term "porting" for they asked me if I want to keep my number. It would have been nice if they followed the term "porting" with "(keeping your old phone number)" and "porting would take 7 to ten working days" with a brief explanation. I am sure many home users unsophisticated in common terminology used in VOIP would also appreciate this. Install was easy needing only an ethernet cable for connecting to your modem or router (not provided but inexpensive), 110 volt power source and your old telephone cable from your old system - all plug compatible. Email support is superb! So far, very pleased (after one week of use).

title: I have used and setup Voice over IP...
review: I have used and setup Voice over IP (VoIP) for many years on business platforms. And they don't offer the services as simple and as clean as VoIPLy does. And the annual (pay a year at time) is one of the best deals on the market. I did one of the [internet] free setups of a VoIP, but the features were not there and I had to buy the equipment. A few nice features to point out, emergency fail-over, simultaneous ring, and three pre-set voice mails that you can customize and choose on the fly with the app. The emergency fail-over is if your VoIP device goes off-line the call will be sent to another number of your choosing. This means I don't give out my cell phone number, I only use my VoIPLy number. It follows me, it rings on my cell at the same time as at my house. And with their 'extra-line' (for free) I can answer a second call on my cell while my wife is on the phone [with my daughter (very common)]. It was a very easy switch from my Verizon FiOS 'land-line' to port the number to VoIPLy and setup the free VoIP box so that all the land-line phones in my house just work the same as they have for many years. My wife and family knows no difference on the phone services in the house. But I see the benefits both dollars and features; including getting text messages on my VoIPLy 'line'.

title: This system is great! We have a call...
review: This system is great! We have a call center that uses it daily for our high call volume and its so modifiable to what we need which we love. We also love all the new features it offers constantly to keep us up date with the times! It is very user friendly which makes it easy to train to staff members!

title: I had a problem with the app on my...
review: I had a problem with the app on my mobile phone, and the customer support agent was able to promptly solve the problem. The problem was that incoming calls would not show up on the phone screen, so I was unable to answer the calls. The agent recommended I uninstall and re-install the app, and that solved it.

title: My company has been a Nextiva phone and...
review:
My company has been a Nextiva phone and fax customer since VOIP became a thing, their phone products are truly dialed in (pun intended), full featured and intuitive. My users especially like getting their voicemails directly in their email inboxes.
The online fax feature (companies still send faxes!) is brilliant as well. Also, I must say that Nextiva support is stellar. I have been in IT for years and have dealt with support departments from nearly every hardware and software vendor out there and I rank Nextiva support among the very best. Cheers!

title: Absolutely DO NOT sign up with this...
review: Absolutely DO NOT sign up with this company. Read all these reviews!! I signed up, been trying to get it set up for over a month, I can’t port my business phone number so I’m unable to use the service, and now they tell me I can’t cancel unless I pay almost $300. GIVE ME A REFUND YOU SCAMERS!! Hopefully you are reading this before you’ve signed up if you aren’t then you are here to add your one star review to the pile. Booooooo Nextiva!!!!

title: 8X8 is easy to install and use.  No...
review: 8X8 is easy to install and use. No wires to run or phones to maintain, everything routes to our cell phones. The website is easy to navigate to make changes and their customer service is excellent. I'd highly recommend 8x8 if you're looking for a system that's simple to use and easy to set up!!!

cons: It took 7-10 days to port my number
title: The easy installation was a blessing,...
review:

Mark

title: We looked into several different...
review: We looked into several different providers before choosing Nextiva. There price point was great, the onboarding was very smooth, the system is user friendly even for some staff that are technology challenged. Nextiva seems to be adding new components that, unlike some providers, do not increase the cost and are great additions/features. Overall we received a better phone system with more features that streamline receiving, managing and documenting the calls all in one place. Should also add that our Implementation Manager, Kale, was amazing in our transition process to Nextiva. Kale has an extreme attention to detail and always one step ahead in emailing with updates, instructions, following up, check-ins and quick to respond to any emails or calls to him. Implementation for us was almost a year ago. Kale still answers my calls and is always ready to help. That kind of customer service is rare today.

title: Axvoice is a big name in the VoIP...

Axvoice is also backward compatible with old hardware and saves time and money for hardware upgrades.

title: I love this system, and I love...
review: I love this system, and I love proposing this an option to our clients. It's user friendly, intuitive, and the technical support is thorough, reliable, and secure. The only way this could get better is if you all made the service free! (joking). We love the system and will continue to use it and recommend it whenever we can.

title: the representative I just spoke to was...
review: the representative I just spoke to was very helpful he made sure to resolve my issue before we hung up he kept working at it until he got it closed! he was super knowledgeable about what he was doing super friendly and very polite great way to start a Monday morning! nextiva is also a very great product when unexpected things happen to love that I can fwd the calls to my cell phone my all-time favorite feature!

title: Love how I can receive business or...
review: Love how I can receive business or personal calls on my cell phone in the same way but easily distinguish between the two before I answer. The app is also awesome in grouping texts and calling history together. It took a very long time to port my number in, even though the service I was porting from and OpenPhone use the same back-end provider. So really it didn't even need porting. It just needed a change in ownership of the number. The other thing is that I couldn't choose my number up front, and even though I didn't want a new number they charged me for it right away. Then when my number ported in, they immediately charged me for a whole year for a second number, again, even though I had no intention of keeping both numbers. I only wanted the ported one. They say that they'll credit me for the second number since I deleted it, but I'm still waiting on the credit about five days later even though it only took about 5 minutes to bill me in the first place. Oh, it also took almost 10 days to sign up for an account because they were having a tech issue that kept people from signing up. It would time out over and over again and tech support would basically just tell me to keep trying. What problems is the product solving and how is that benefiting you? It allows me to carry my business phone with me when I'm out in the field, which is often. It also enables me to carry only one phone instead of a personal cell phone and a business phone. I love that. Love the app and the service works beautifully Via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

cons: I don't really dislike anything. Setting it up was so easy. I never had an issue while using it. I can call overseas without any problems. I just wish I could use it even when offline in the future.
pros: I like that it's very easy to use. I can make calls and send texts to anyone anywhere. It has a user-friendly interface. I never experienced any connection issues either. It has helped me with important tasks that I have with my client.
