cons: So many new features and settings
title: So it's not really a con cause any...
review: So it's not really a con cause any change is hard but just getting used to the different operating system and how the system defaults and what settings may be different than your old system take time to get us to and learn but the new features for us are great. The support has been great too, easy to open tickets and get resolutions quickly.

title: We have had companies switch to Nextiva...
review:
We have had companies switch to Nextiva from a traditional PBX system. The ability to easily guest-in on phones, manage user’s devices, extensions, and voicemails have streamlined day to day operations. The administrative portal can be difficult and frustrating to navigate at first, especially with the call center section, but once you know where to look there is an endless amount of helpful features.

The VOIP service is incredibly stable with almost no downtime each year and customer support is very helpful with getting issues resolved in a reasonable timeframe.

title: Support quality is Flowroute's weakest...
review: Support quality is Flowroute's weakest point. Their support reps are unhelpful and bordering on downright rude. Dealing with Flowroute's support for number porting has been an absolute nightmare. They take days to respond, if they respond at all. Their response is completely useless, saying it's not uncommon for several days to go by before *their porting agent* submits a porting request to the losing carrier after the customer has submitted it to Flowroute. Follow up emails regarding this *multiple business-day delay* were not responded to. When you're waiting on nothing but a number port to implement a new phone system, the porting process should not take multiple weeks. Looks for another VoIP provider, one that has support that actually responds and is helpful.

title: I've been a ITP Phone customer (5...
review: I've been a ITP Phone customer (5 phone numbers and eFax) for over 10 years, the service has always been excellent. I, however, am quite disappointed that ITP will not fix their system to work with Nomorobo. ITP has their own system which requires incoming callers to press a key on the dial pad to let the phone call go through and ring your line. I've tried this and most of my prospective customers' say they press a key and the phone goes silent and nothing happens and then they just give up and hang up. I may be terminating my services with ITP very soon because I'm tired of getting 10 Spam calls per day.

title: SAVE YOUR MONEY!Bought 3 office lines...
review:
SAVE YOUR MONEY!
Bought 3 office lines for the annual price and Ring Central ended up selling one of the numbers I bought to another person. I had to report it as fraud and it took over 3 months for them to get me an answer while I was paying for the service. I only got a response after about 10 emails etc. once I included the CEO on the email. The fraud department never even responded to me over a span of 3 months. This started back in June of 2022 and I still don't have the service cancelled and my money refunded to me. RUN FROM THIS COMPANY!

cons: Tech support is sometimes not very good - it's usually a communication issue
pros: Great voice quality depending on the phone you pick. Amazing features, reasonable price
title: This is a great and very flexible...
review: This is a great and very flexible system with many features. You must have good internet (as you would need for any VOIP system. Cost is very reasonable and you can purchase the phones from anywhere - we got great pricing from our original sales person for phones. The Polycom phones with HD sound is excellent and speakerphones are excellent as well. Tech support is sometimes challenging as they don't always understand what you are asking.

title: Chris was very helpful for this issue,...
review: Chris was very helpful for this issue, some how, AA changes time/hours of operation. Employees do not know how to change, call rep states system can't change on its own ??? It's happened twice now ??? from open hours 8am to 9am ? We missed calls, twice now from 8a-9a because AA was changed to 9am? Happened in Aug, now again in Sept ?

title: 8x8 is the way to go. Beats Spectrum,...
review: 8x8 is the way to go. Beats Spectrum, and is a heck of a lot cheaper. Gives you full control of your auto attendant system and your ability to add special hours. No need for costly office phones-you can set up everything to go to your cellphones. Just a lot of special features that help small businesses. Definitely would recommend.

title: I love the features and it's really...
review: I love the features and it's really easy to use. The support team is really good and you get timely response. I just contacted them for a basic question and the response was quick. They would also follow up with you via a phone call if in any case you didn't reply right away to through chat. Thus I can recommend 8x8.

title: I tried to place an order for this...
review:
I tried to place an order for this service but the page locked up and never showed a completed order. Customer service chat was a bit disjointed and no emails to confirm order requests were ever received. I decided to cancel since it was a problem from inception. Never used the service, never received any ordered equipment, and never got a refund. The customer service phone number went to voice mail.... Now the number I was going to port over is unusable until it gets released.

The whole experience seemed a bit shady and it was definitely not for me. I will try a different provider.

title: Finding Nextiva was a great opportunity...
review:
Finding Nextiva was a great opportunity for me. While transitioning from an office to work from home, I thought I would test out VOIP. After speaking with several companies, I was most impressed with Nextiva. They had an excellent price offering, more features than I actually need at this time, and great customer support.

Seldom do I need help but when I do their customer support is fantastic and always helpful.

Great service that I would recommend to any business or individual.

title: New to the provider. Easy set up....
review: New to the provider. Easy set up. Support at your fingertips. Extremely user friendly and all in one program. A system that prevents your business to miss any calls. Roman R. was extremely helpful in the set-up of SMS and in creating a call flow. He made sure I understood, and all my questions were answered before disconnecting.

title: After our business branched out as we...
review: After our business branched out as we got busier our needs changed with our phone system. It took a little time, but the support team took the time to listen and understand what exactly we were wanting and needed.bWe we’re transferred to the right department and they were able to get us set up with all of our needs in a reasonable matter of time.

title: Great service for my small business....
review: Great service for my small business. Customer service has always been very helpful and prompt. The various features have really been great for my business also. I would highly recommend this service to large and small businesses. The 1 800 number option has been extremely helpful to for my international clients.

title: Customer service is beyond lacking. I...
review:
Customer service is beyond lacking. I don't know if they are undertrained, underqualified, or under a rock, but they are not, at any point, helpful. Support takes forever to get you through the queue on any day, whether it be phone support or chat, and when they do, they just find a way to get you off the line for the next caller.

Communication with assigned representatives is equally as frustrating. Our implementation manager was replaced in the middle of our project. No one informed us, no one informed the NEW representative, and when communication finally got set up, he just didn't respond. For weeks on end. Neither did his supervisors. Or Management. Total of three months of chasing answers with no movement.

I just cannot, in good faith, recommend anyone go through what our company has been through with Nextiva. Big thumbs down.

title: Customer support is awesome! They make...
review: Customer support is awesome! They make sure all technical issues are taken care of. I switched from a HIPPA account to an account with SMS and I experienced a lot of technical issues. Customer support didn’t quit everything was all sorted out. Now my system is working perfectly. You can even specify what you want your caller ID to show when calling your clients!

title: Very simple switch from another, much...
review:
Very simple switch from another, much costlier provider. The other guys have NO live support- Nextiva always has live folks who are knowledgeable.
I love the phones and I love how the phones are easy to install- great price for thew phones as well. We highly recommend Nextiva for your next phone system......

title: Today I called 8x8 for support with my...
review: Today I called 8x8 for support with my Polycom desk phone disconnecting transferred calls. My technical support representative was very patient and resolved my issue with courtesy and proficiency. My hold time was very brief and should I need assistance in the future, I feel confident my issue will be handled the same way.

title: They have everything on one place, a...
review: They have everything on one place, a direct phone line also toll-free number and a fax number. The only thing is they are kinda pricy about the packets they offer. Anything else is just great, they are responding fast. Working to help you with any issue and question you have so all an all excellent provider on the service

title: I was excited to use 8x8 due to theri...
review: I was excited to use 8x8 due to theri very affordable cost. I know now why they are so cheap, customer service is extremely lacking. I could never get my business number ported over. I kept getting an error message when filling out the online form. I've spent hours on the phone, on the computer and uploading files for them. EVentually, they simply stopped responding to my support ticket.

title: I have been with Nextiva for 3 years....
review:
I have been with Nextiva for 3 years. Roman was one of the rare agents who was able to assist me right away in solving my issues. However, 90% of the time, my issues have taken weeks to months to be resolved. An average phone call to have an agent review an issue is over 60 minutes.
At this point, I am not sure if I would recommend Nextiva. I would suggest you shop around. The options they offer can be good but I think they are too much in the infancy stage and have not worked out the bugs or kinks. It seems they don't do enough beta testing. Instead, the roll out an update then deal with the issues as they arise.

The problem with this approach to the consumer is lost work due to a phone system being down or not functioning correctly.

title: Nextiva Customer Support is always...
review: Nextiva Customer Support is always great at helping us get to the bottom of any problem we encounter. I prefer to log in and chat with them and have always had a good experience with the representatives. We have been Nextiva customers for 3 years now and are looking forward to continuing our partnership with them!

title: I have used Nextiva for over a year for...
review: I have used Nextiva for over a year for my online business and the service has been amazing. Especially the talk to text voice mails. I appreciate and love this feature and being able to SMS with customers. I really can't think of anything else I would improve. The price even works great with my business budget.

title: We have been using Nextiva for at least...
review: We have been using Nextiva for at least 2 years now. We have been very happy with quality of service. Added bonus for our medical practice is that they offer a free HIPAA compliant fax service as well. Customer support is excellent. Very quick response times for Chat and email support. Would recommend to others looking for a new VOIP system.

title: I was a little confused with setting up...
review: I was a little confused with setting up my account. But the agent on the live chat was so helpful and patient. She let me vent about my frustrations and she answered several of my questions all in one sitting. She helped me set up my app on my phone and my call flow in a short period of time and I'm really happy now with my investment.

title: Switching over all of our phones and...
review: Switching over all of our phones and numbers to Nextiva was quite the process but the support has been amazing. They are pretty quick to respond to issues and I really enjoy using their over the phone support to solve a problem quickly. The interface took a little getting used to, but now I know my way around the platform and how to cater it to our companies needs.

title: Sofiia did a wonderful job assisting me...
review:
Sofiia did a wonderful job assisting me today, she was super quick and efficient - helped me complete a big project we have been working on. As a new user who is unfamiliar with the system, she made everything smooth and easy! We now have a setup that will best suit our customers as well as our own internal needs and it was a smooth and easy process thanks to Nextiva support.

Very well done, 10/10!

title: We've been with Nextiva for years....
review:
We've been with Nextiva for years. It's been great seeing them add features to the service and improving it. I've always been impressed with their support team. I am NOT an expert in this tech and the people at Nextiva make sure everything works for our small business.

The only critique I have is that I would like to see Nextiva keep customers updated on what their plans can do for current users. We were shopping for solutions that it turned out we already had access to.

title: We love the service however if you need...
review: We love the service however if you need help with their mobile apps the support is lacking. The installation of the physical phones was easy. The overall set up for everything was super easy. If using the Mobile Phone app, and needing support you have to be very clear when you correspond with support.

pros: I can have all my employees working remote if necesary
title: The most amazing provider ever!!!...
review:
The most amazing provider ever!!! There's no feature that can't be done with them, I'm completely super happy.
I absolutely recommend them if you want to have the most flexible phone provider and if you have remote staff you won't be disappointed.
Can work with a device or via the App which is great!

title: The phone works well.  The calls are...
review: The phone works well. The calls are clear calls. Great customer support the 1 time I needed it! I shopped all available VOIP services and landed here with NEXTIVA. I'm so glad I did. The phone came free when I activated. The back office features serve me well. I'll likely not shop the service anytime soon.

title: It is probably premature for me to...
review:
It is probably premature for me to review my service since we haven't actually been able to start using it. The phones we chose were just released and it has been a nightmare getting the needed power supplies for them. They were supposed to come in the shipment with the phones. Instead I got 4 extra phones of a different model. WTH? Then they were supposed to overnight the power supplies to my house. But instead they sent them 3 day shipping to the office. Throw in a weekend and it will be at least 5 days before I get them.

I have hopes that everything will be fine once we get all our hardware and are up and running. I have used the chat feature and called in direct for tech support. Each time there is a considerable wait- maybe 20 minutes to over an hour, but the techs seem to know how to answer my questions and sound like they actually care about helping me out. So far we have ported in our toll free number and can use that with the app. The rest of it is still a work in progress.

They also seem to be actively looking to improve their service in regards to app functionality and features. That is encouraging.

title: Viktoria is an excellent tier 2 support...
review: Viktoria is an excellent tier 2 support tech. If you have any issues hopefully you get connected to her. She knows her stuff and will patiently make sure everything is working before you end the call. Good support makes or breaks technology. Persons like her are what keep customers like me coming back even if issues come.

title: They are low priced and easy to use. ...
review: They are low priced and easy to use. It was a little tricky to set up though (but then again I am totally new to VoIP). I chose then because the reviews were so high. The support system is great! They patiently answer my questions and walk you through step-by-step. I wish they offered texting, but for the money, it’s hard to beat!

title: I had a need for a second phone line...
review: I had a need for a second phone line for work - as you can imagine, I did not want to carry a third cell phone. I started looking into options and have been very pleased with OpenPhone. It is an app I am able to use on my current personal cell phone. It has it's own phone number that I was able to choose. I am able to tell when calls are coming in through that app - so I know when to answer it with my business spiel. It has many features that make it a great option. You can make and receive calls and texts from the number. Additionally, you can manage the calls from a PC. So if I go on vacation - I can just have a coworker manage the calls and texts, and I don't have to worry about it being on my phone. I have had a few instances where calls have gone directly to voicemail and not rang through for me to answer. I have not figured out why this has happened. Luckily, it has not been any crucial calls. Other than that, it has worked great for my needs. The problem that Open Phone solves for me is not having to carry another phone with me. Additionally, the cost of a second line has been reduced significantly by using OpenPhone compared to purchasing another cell phone. Quality Phone App that doesn't require a second line. via G2 with permission from OpenPhone

title: I have been using Nextiva for the past...
review: I have been using Nextiva for the past 5 years. They have been great to work with while offering affordable VOIP phone lines. We have gone from 9 users down to 1 due to the pandemic. Nextiva was accommodating throughout the process and now we are starting to ramp back up our business! Nextiva has made it easy to turn off / on phone lines as we need them.

title: Nextiva support is the best I've...
review: Nextiva support is the best I've encountered in over 15 years of working in contact centers. I've been working with them for just a couple of months now but I've been blown away by how efficient they are in responding to support issues whether it's urgent or just low-level. They are always extremely helpful and friendly to boot!

title: I am very happy with Nextiva so far. ...
review: I am very happy with Nextiva so far. Our company has been on it for about 4 months and have not had any issues with call quality. The admin panel is very easy to work with and setting up users is a breeze. There are very few issues that I have had with end user administration. The only criticism so far is that I wish reporting was a little more robust. Overall the end users have been happy with the product so far.

title: I like the simplicity of the contact...
review:
I like the simplicity of the contact organization. The auto-calling feature basically eliminates call reluctance by getting you on the phone immediately! It's very user-friendly and the dashboard boldly displays your KPIs.
The only aspect I don't love using Convoso is not having an outbound dialer for leads/contacts not already in the system. But I have found a way around this.
I've solved my call reluctance and overall touching/reaching people. After all, sales is a numbers game. This system has definitely been beneficial for expanding my business.

title: I have started this app since my...
review: I have started this app since my company required us to use it. I have installed both apps on Windows and iOS and so far the Windows app works perfectly fine, the quality of the calls are great and the setting is easy to work with. On the other hand the iPhone app has been problematic a little, but nothing that cannot be fixed, so my admin and Nextiva are working on it.

cons: Not easy to get immediate help. It takes 2-4 days for responses. Diffucult if it is an emergency.
title: We are a small business and have been a...
review: We are a small business and have been a customer since 2019. The installation process wasn't too difficult, and even the support wasn't bad in the beginning. Over the last year I have noticed that the support response time has taken 2-4 days, if any. It has been very frustrating to say the least. Also, they have several different departments with "key" names that are confusing. It is imperative that you understand which department you need to contact in order to cut down your resolution time. Otherwise you get a run around. I would not recommend this provider due to response time.

title: The technical support personnel at...
review: The technical support personnel at Nextiva are REALLY good at customer service. We've had excellent help whenever we reached out, which is when you want to be dealing with people at the top of their game! No matter how many other customers are in the queue, we always feel that we're the top priority.

title: after being on the phone with another...
review: after being on the phone with another tech support person for almost 3hrs, finally got transferred to Chris in Arizona, he is awesome. Super helpful, very knowledgeable regarding your product, as well as willing to stay the course to get the problem resolved. I wish I could have a direct line to Chris so he could help me with future issues!

title: Tonia B. was great to work with....
review: Tonia B. was great to work with. Although it took several tries to get my phone programmed correctly she was able to solve my issue in a very timely manner. She was very professional and explained what she was doing along the way so that I understood what she was doing and what to expect. I would highly recommend.

title: Always helpful, sometimes it can take a...
review: Always helpful, sometimes it can take a while to get someone on the line but once they're there they help tremendously. Love being able to send links and screenshots to them as well.

pros: Easy to use and set up
title: Our organization has been using 8x8...
review:
Our organization has been using 8x8 VOIP for several years now. We have 15 lines of service and everything is easy use and set up, even if you're not a IT guru. The user interface in the admin console is great, and googling just about anything 8x8 is already online for you to search and use.

And if you can't figure it out, OMG support has been amazing for me. The first time I called I got a lady who must have been in downtown Bombay; dogs barking, horns blaring, lol. Was like "rut roh, this doesn't bode well!"

But the lady I spoke with was a total expert. She knew exactly what was wrong and helped me fix it fast.

The only downside is talking to sales people there...I don't care for them very much. Everything else is awesome..

title: We just began using Nextiva in all our...
review: We just began using Nextiva in all our company offices and the installation process was very well organized. The phones and desktop app give us many feature options and have improved our efficiency as a business. The support team at Nextiva is always willing to answer any questions we have. Nextiva is great!

title: Everything works well. Need a smoother...
review: Everything works well. Need a smoother transition for the SMS. Lost all of my text messages for a week. Should have tested everything before rolling out the new version. Otherwise, the phone call clarity is same as any other phone system. Need a simpler system for hold, transfer call, send caller to email, etc. These processes are way too complicated.

title: A shout out to Natalie (x2780) for her...
review: A shout out to Natalie (x2780) for her amazing service. She was extremely patient, polite and helpful while tackling several issues on a call that lasted over 2.5 hours. One issue was particularly complicated and her technical expertise was up to the challenge. Give her a raise and hire 10 more just like her!

title: I had an issues with the users...
review: I had an issues with the users voicemail and The representative was helpful and solved my issues right away. She was very knowledgeable and knew what to do right away. I’m very happy with Nextive support. Every time I have an issue or need guidance on how to solve something they answer promptly. Thank you

title: Great overall phone system many...
review: Great overall phone system many features with the app on desktop and mobile options. Taking communications to the next level its much easier to communicate with clients and colleagues. I can set the phone to ring or stay quiet and also text from the the phone or computer app. I look forward to setting up video meetings as well where I can share my screen.

title: Great customer service and great...
review: Great customer service and great service. The onboarding was painless except for one glitch on my end and they assisted me through that. I was a fax-only client and I am thrilled to use Nextiva for all my phone needs now. And it is inexpensive to boot. A bargain at twice the price. 10/10 would recommend.

cons: need to fix the reports and export of data its laggy
pros: Product is good and support is good
title: Pros -- Product is good and support is...
review:
Pros -- Product is good and support is good though it took awhile sometimes but they will try to resolve the issue even it takes some times.

Cons -- need to fix the reports and export of data its laggy and hopefully they add some of our future request features on convoso to make it better in managing the dialer or reports.

cons: customer support chat has limited hours
title: Yes, I was surprised. I didn’t have...
review: Yes, I was surprised. I didn’t have to buy a bunch of things to use Axvoice. It provided free hardware as a plug-and-play device that I could use to easily set it up and start using it. Definitely an incredible purchase without the chaos that accompanies installation generally. One of the best services.

title: This app is not working. Not one phone...
review: This app is not working. Not one phone call got connected and i trysince August. It's charging without even get connected. Got the rest of my money back. Tried to give them another shut. Nothing changed. No service, no connection, no customer service. Only one toll free number i got connected. The rest nothing, except charged from my $10. Now i try again to get the rest of my money back. Don't waste your time and money.

title: Before the new installation (to...
review:
Before the new installation (to NetivaOne) the app was actually working great, i rely heavily upon this app to get my work done. I installed the new app 2 days ago and it's giving me nothing but trouble, phone calls don't come through anymore, but it will show up on my missed calls notification, I've missed a lot of important phone calls hence impacting my performance. I also can't placed dial outs for my clients, it's creating inconveniences for my clients and I.
It takes. a long time to get through to tech support to get help.

title: Service for 5 years now and never once...
review: Service for 5 years now and never once were the phone line systems down. Amazing customer service, quick service when you have questions. Easy to use phone system with voicemail and clear connection quality. Can transfer calls with ease...Web portal is also a handy feature when you need to make adjustments

title: I had a phone that was not receiving...
review: I had a phone that was not receiving inbound calls and could not make outbound calls. Tried to fix it myself for a long time. Then I called support. The person on the phone, Mark, was phenomenal, he helped me to fix a big problem in 15 minutes. Top class service from Support Department. If you call - ask for Mark.

title: We've had a wonderful experience with...
review: We've had a wonderful experience with Nextiva so far. A bit rocky as far as number porting, but that was due to our old carrier dropping the ball on their end. Transfer of service after everything was taken care of with them was pretty seamless. Call quality has been great, good features, great admin page. Highly recommend.

title: Nextiva Tech Support has been has been...
review:
Nextiva Tech Support has been has been reliable and helpful since the initial account setup. Our current account manager has been awesome as well.
The quality on the hardware phone have great quality. However there have been a few minor hiccups with the mobile app on some staff's devices. However Tech supports always resolves those matters.

cons: customer support chat has limited hours
title: Yes, honestly, I was surprised. I...
review: Yes, honestly, I was surprised. I didn’t have to buy a bunch of things to use Axvoice. It provided free hardware as a plug-and-play device that I could use to easily set it up and start using it (love this). Definitely an incredible purchase without the chaos that accompanies installation generally.

cons: Services and Dave Houser who set up our account had the worst customer service
title: Overall the the product is fine. It...
review: Overall the the product is fine. It took 7 months to transition over to a new account, which I paid for 4 extra lines x 7m and they will not get back to me about a credit or refund. Dave Houser was our account manager which does not return emails or phone calls, very poor service from him. They sent 6 free phones which take about a hour each to set up with their customer service department.

title: Answered my question about whether or...
review: Answered my question about whether or not I can download the new version of NextivaOne but was not a "deep" enough service level to actually make any changes. She did however make the attempt to put in the request to the proper group that actually has the ability to make the update. Good relayer of information, but not service level high enough to actually do much other than answer basic questions.

title: I've been very happy with Nextiva...
review: I've been very happy with Nextiva service and reliability. They are quick to assist us with phone setup. They were also very helpful with call routing setup, letting us direct calls to branches based on area codes. I have two issues. One is that they are using a Broadcom backend, and there are two configuration areas, depending on complexity of the configuration. The more serious issue is cost. We get hit with quite high fees and taxes, even when under contract.

title: The sound quality is mediocre, getting...
review: The sound quality is mediocre, getting setup is more complicated then it should be but the tech support can be good at times and helpful. Every once in awhile some issue pops up but a quick reset of the system will usually resolve it. Overall its good enough that we can make it work for our business

title: Nextiva has been the perfect phone...
review: Nextiva has been the perfect phone system for our transition to a remote office. The Support staff were very helpful during setup and made it very easy for a small business with no IT support. The Admin portal is very user friendly and easy to manage. The tools provided also help our small business work as a large corporation.

cons: Sometimes long waits for chat, but problem always ends up solved!
title: I have nothing bad to say about...
review: I have nothing bad to say about Nextiva. They're as good in the business as it gets these days! Very happy with the product and service and the tech support is head and shoulders above the others! A+++ for a fantastic company with fantastic employees! They epitomize a company that respects its customers!

cons: not enough how to videos online
title: Everything has gone well with Nextiva. ...
review:
Everything has gone well with Nextiva. We have a small business with limited needs, and the flexible scalability of the product matches those.

It was easy to set up and understand - I had one moment of a long wait to get support - but every time I reach an agent they know what they are doing and get me fixed up quick.

Nextiva works well for us at a low cost, and I am happy with it.

cons: support can be a bit slow to come by
title: Feature for feature it is one of the...
review: Feature for feature it is one of the top vendors for the price. Support is a bit difficult to contact if you have immediate needs. Features that we utilize: voice, mobile app, FAX, desktop app and meetings. Currently, integrated to our on premise exchange server for scheduling and status. Overall very satisfied.

title: We've been using Nextiva for years now...
review: We've been using Nextiva for years now and for the majority of that time it's been "set it and forget it" -- it just works. The phone app is a plus; I've used it via wifi from India to make calls back to the US and to receive calls while overseas. Callers have no idea that I'm answering their call from somewhere else.

title: I had gone into the name fields of...
review: I had gone into the name fields of several of our conference phones and made changes to the description however the contacts directory was not reflecting the changes. After submitting a ticket to Nextival, I was able to get a timely resolution to updating the company directory. The task was completed in a shorter amount of time than stated when submitting the ticket (was in a few hours rather than in the 24-48 hours). Excellent work!

cons: Not sure about the cons yet
pros: Efficient provider so far. Great attentive customer service
title: We have been with nextiva for some time...
review: We have been with nextiva for some time now and this is a great service so far. Also good customer service. Almost 24/7 available to attend to your questions. I would say it is also good, cost wise. You can also answer phone calls on the go with their cellphone apps, that is if you need to. So far, so good

cons: Wish the options were more easlity edited.  I generally have to call support for things I feel I should be able to do easly.
pros: I love all of the features, there are many and it is very professional
title: I have used multiple VOIP services as...
review: I have used multiple VOIP services as well as landline phone systems and Nextiva, by far; exceeds them all with price, functionality, professionalism, and options. We love Nextiva service and their staff, we will never use any other VOIP service provider! The options that are available for our use are well thought out and perfect for our business.

title: Nextiva has been solid for a few years...
review: Nextiva has been solid for a few years now, any issues were quickly resolved by their excellent support staff, I have used both live chat and over the phone, for help setting up different features, I would recommend this company to others for sure! The price is right and the service is always good and friendly!

title: I'd give Nextiva a B+. They have a lot...
review: I'd give Nextiva a B+. They have a lot of features we enjoy and the calls are always clear. There is a little issue when first starting and trying to set up the system, just because we were learning a new system. Once it was up and running we've had very few issues. They are always resolved but the wait to get a live person can be long.

title: Nextiva is a great option if you want t...
review: Nextiva is a great option if you want t a phone provider. The way that I can manage the administration process, is awseome. Also, Nextiva has an easy way to install the services in any phone system. The technical support is excellent and faster, each time that I request technical support, the process is clear.

title: Great Service. ...
review:
Great Service.

Incredible

Service with a smile ?

Thank you

cons: Was a little hard for me to discover how to make everything work.
title: Just finished an online chat session...
review: Just finished an online chat session with Helen U. at Nextiva support. I normally don't care to use chat, but I decided to give it a try. Helen was amazing and answered all my questions about a previous service request that I did not realize was still being worked on. The case had been submitted by a tech that had tried to assist me. It had been a couple weeks since I had spoken with the tech and I had submitted a second case (duplicate) that was immediately closed. Helen reached out to the other department to see if the case could be expedited. During the conversation I asked about how the fax system worked and Helen helped me to figure out how to use their system properly. Once we verified I could operate the system, my original service request was no longer needed. Helen made all of the changes I requested and helped ensure that I was able to do what I wanted. She also tried to help me diagnose a problem I am having with my phone system itself. I think on the original service phone call I did not explain my problem very well, so the tech did not understand my needs, and I decided to make a change in the service that was not necessary. It took a little time, but Helen came through with flying colors. I have only been with Nextiva for two months and with the exception of the one phone call, every interaction I have had with sales, tech service, and setting up equipment has been positive. I very seldom write a review, but Helen went above and beyond in my opinion to make sure my problem was solved. It is a pleasure to work with a competent person. Thank you, Helen, for everything.

title: The customer service at Nextiva is...
review: The customer service at Nextiva is super fast and efficient, which has been able to help me get up and running quickly! So far the VOIP service has been reliable and clear. The desktop and mobile apps are not my favorite platforms but it's easy enough to get the job done and stay on track. It's a great option for small businesses and to not feel "stuck" to a landline option. Overall great service, just takes a bit getting used to!

title: I've been using Nextiva for a month...
review: I've been using Nextiva for a month now, it is incredible how convenient it is compared to the old system I was using. Caller ID and messaging is great. The best thing Nextiva provides me is where I don't have to pick up the phone and can listen immediately to the voicemail I want is amazing - a total game changer with the time saved. I love it!

title: We're still waiting on the customer...
review: We're still waiting on the customer service division to contact us about a refund for services that we never received. The staff that I worked with was extremely helpful, but I was passed around to different divisions and each time I was placed on hold for very long periods of time. I suspect this is a systemic problem, not a staffing or efficiency problem. The staff was excellent.

title: I recommend 8x8 all the time to our...
review: I recommend 8x8 all the time to our clients. We have been a client of 8x8 for over 7 years and have never had any major issues. The system is very reliable. The phone calls are always clear and there is never an issue with communications. Support has also been very good and has walked us through all changes and updates we need to be done.

pros: reliable service, quality customer service, bet sech
title: I've had Nextiva at work, and for my...
review:
I've had Nextiva at work, and for my online business. Love it! really appreciate each time the folks at customer service have helped me out.

I recently needed an outside line to help me increase the scope and reach of my private practice. The offering at Nextiva made it easy, with both the regular number (i got a great number) as well as the toll free number. Highly recommend Nextiva!

title: I am very happy with Nextiva service in...
review: I am very happy with Nextiva service in all respects except for the Nextiva phone app. Users with physical handsets or who just have calls forwarded to mobile devices experience no issues. But users of the phone app always have problems. I wish the phone app was more reliable but otherwise service is good and support is really outstanding compared to the support experience I have with other applications I use.

title: A quality service but making changes is...
review: A quality service but making changes is complicated and difficult, and getting help is only as good as the agent helping you, so sometimes it creates further issues rather than helping. All in all Its a good budget choice for smaller businesses and we can always get ahold of the support team or the reps within a timely manner

cons: Custom mustic on hold max file size is max 2Mb
pros: Chat support is efficient and easy to u se
title: I absolutely appreciate how easy it is...
review: I absolutely appreciate how easy it is to obtain support for any issue I might have. In additon, the self-help material available on the Nextiva website along with training videos makes things super simple for checking into an issue or feature. There are many IP phone providers out there and we came from a previous provider who had similar pricing, but their support and documentation was nowhere near to the level of Nextiva. We are glad we switched!

title: We have been having issues with the...
review: We have been having issues with the updated version and trying to work through them. I spoke with Alina and she was SO HELPFUL. She was very pleasant and answered all the questions that I had at the time. We are a small company and don't require as many features that Nextiva has to offer. We are working to utilize as much as we can.

title: Overall Nextiva is a decent service but...
review: Overall Nextiva is a decent service but their call forwarding feature should be way easier to engage/disengage. I call 2-3 times a week for support which seems ridiculous but I am at the mercy of their business, for my business on most occasions. It is frustrating, however, the support team generally does a decent job.

title: We have never had any issues with...
review: We have never had any issues with Nextiva, until the recent upgrade. Our calls do not go through sometimes, no caller ID, etc. Maryna was very helpful in trying to assist me with these concerns and to help me with trying some further steps. We do hope there is a new upgrade from this one as the app is very different and we were very used to and comfortable with the older version.

title: Your customer service agent was...
review:
Your customer service agent was excellent and resolved my issue quickly. The features are great for any kind of business.
My only complaints are that the call quality is not always clear and it is hard to understand people. Also, the website should have a little more detailed instructions in some of the areas.

title: I love the new service. Easy to use and...
review: I love the new service. Easy to use and the customer service has been outstanding. Natalia in onboarding and Alex with support agent have been very accommodating with answering questions and making updates to customize our service. The value for the price is great for a small business. I can't thank you enough.

title: Tech support was excellent. I was...
review: Tech support was excellent. I was guided through some very difficult set up challenges, and we had two new working phones on the other end of the line! In contrast, my experience at 8x8 was pretty poor, especially in terms of getting my new phones set up. I would highly recommend Nextiva to any small business who is looking for a solid VOIP solution.

title: Excellent support from Diana ). Was...
review: Excellent support from Diana ). Was able to walk us through reconfiguration of our Yealink device and via remote support had us quickly back up and running. Also she was quickly able to reset the busy lamp field function and apply the correct settings so I am able to know whom is on the line or available.

title: sometimes i have clicking noises when...
review: sometimes i have clicking noises when transferred to my cell phone. have not found a solution to this yet. it didn't do it at first but has been recently. otherwise service has been good and support has been really good as well. i would and have recommended nextiva to replace cable company rip offs.

title: Helpful support when you get in touch...
review:
Helpful support when you get in touch with them.
Unsure of why my vfax portal wouldn't allow me to reset my password until I called support...

They can take control of your screen for you to make solutions happen more quickly.

Set up and functionality are great, kind and easy to work with staff at Nextiva.

title: I have spoken with several Nextiva...
review: I have spoken with several Nextiva representatives over the last 3 years and they were all very helpful & extremely polite. They quickly and thoroughly take care of my questions and concerns each time I call or message them on chat. It was always a great experience each time I need to contact Nextiva!

title: I have had a great experience dealing...
review: I have had a great experience dealing with the support team and never spoke to anyone who was not extremely helpful. At first, I didn't understand the setup but after working with a team member they took the time to explain the setup and helped me set everything up correctly. The whole platform is helpful and simple to work with. I would recommend their services anytime.

title: Cost effective, quick and easy...
review: Cost effective, quick and easy onboarding. Tech support was quick to resolve an onboarding technical glitch with a 3rd party phone. This is a feature rich solution, with all the bells and whistles of an enterprise solution. I would highly recommend this VOIP solution for and small business customer.

pros: Tons of features to choose from
title: We are a company of about 20 people. We...
review: We are a company of about 20 people. We switched to Nextiva this year and have been very satisfied with the phone system. The service and support team is simply amazing, I have yet to present them with a problem that they haven't been able to resolve. The wait times for customer service have never been too lengthy plus they have a call back feature so I do not have to wait on hold. Once on the phone, they are very professional and extremely knowledgeable about the system and genuinely care about the needs of their clients.

title: Convoso is user friendly and has great...
review: Convoso is user friendly and has great customer service. Easy platform to work off of to streamline my business! Perfect for lead management by allowing me to easily organize lists and workflow automation. Great auto dialer which helps making more connections in a smaller time frame. Easy to use and keep track.

title: We set up the equipment and attempted...
review: We set up the equipment and attempted to port 2 home phone numbers. Twice, for no reason, the porting requests were cancelled, and Ooma customer service representatives were unable to provide a reason. The second time, we decided to go with another provided and contacted Ooma to cancel our account and get a refund. We were told that the numbers were in the process of being ported - even though our account dashboard indicated no active porting requests and another customer service rep had just said that the requests had been cancelled. She had some explanation that made no sense and was impossible to understand. Customer service is awful.

pros: New fiber deploy is reliable, and it's overprovisioned by at least 10%, nice. That's about it.
title: Worst customer service on the planet....
review: Worst customer service on the planet. TDS recently started providing fiber at my location. Good price. More or less. They offer voip for $30/mo. Ok, pricey, but I'll do it. Fine print says 'plus taxes and fees'. Which end up being another $30/mo! $60 for not very good voip? Are you kidding? I then ported my number to another voip provider, $10/mo for far better service, and TDS just decided that meant I wanted to close my acct without any confirmation. Suddenly, no internet. It took me 3 days, talking to 13 different people, and over 3 hours on hold during that time to get them to realize they screwed up and reconnect me. Insane. On the plus side, the local field people have been outstanding. Can't understand why they would stay with just a pathetic company. Just run from anything TDSS.

title: Excellent Service Thaddius and Edward...
review: Excellent Service Thaddius and Edward are 2 of the most attentive professionals in the biz. They helped us register our numbers, create a call-call structure and increase our Dialers efficiency. Highly Recommend! If you are looking for a provider that puts their customers first, this is the option that I would go to. Truly. Thanks Convoso Team. Keep up the great work.

cons: Support is the worst in the industry.

review:
Some issues we have they have no idea how to support and don't have a possible solution. Others they fix but cant answer why we had that problem.
Easiest service to set up in my experience but the worst service available.
There is a trade-off obviously and that's a business decision as the costs are quite competitive.

title: Great customer service and...
review:
Great customer service and support!
Many years working with other phone support companies, this is my first experience with Nextiva and my experience is always exceptional! Thank you so much for providing such amazing service without any hassle or delays. Cannot imagine working with any other provider in the future.

title: The customer support is great. I know...
review:
The customer support is great. I know only a little about how to set up the back end, and customer support does whatever I don't feel comfortable doing myself.

The service itself works really well. We take advantage of being able to listen to calls to do training.
