title: Nextiva is a solid VOIP solution for...
review: Nextiva is a solid VOIP solution for small businesses. The solution is reliable and easy to use, and call quality is excellent. I do wish there was a bit more customizability for end users on the functionality of the app itself, especially allowing for more differentiation between how the desktop app and the mobile app handle the same user

title: When we have any technical problem with...
review: When we have any technical problem with a device their team always guide us to solve the problem and are very knowledgeable. They usually connect to our desktop and help trouble shoot and then we reboot the desktop phone that we want to connect. They are also very good at communicating the steps that need to be made when encountering this issues.

title: We've been using Nextiva since we were...
review: We've been using Nextiva since we were able to get out of our contracts with other providers. They recently helped us through a couple different business transitions, and were able to address all our unique needs. They have managed to maintain the feel of a smaller business better than many of the larger vendors we work with.

title: RingCentral is a contracted plan.  They...
review: RingCentral is a contracted plan. They will scam you and up sale you lines and features you don't need by offering a better rate per line. I was told there was no contract and was an idiot who didn't read the contract while the smooth talking salesman pushed me to just sign it. My fault but still want as many people as possible to know to be careful.

cons: Documentation is weak; communication/notification is weak/no-existent; support is inconsistent/not thorough
pros: Can integrate with our practice management system; doesn't require a desk phone  in order to make calls
title: We implemented Nextiva last August...
review:
We implemented Nextiva last August (21). We went with Nextiva since it would work in our Citrix environment.

We were assigned an implementation manager, but most of the time we had to report the issue/question to her and then be transferred to or schedule a separate call with someone else. I had to document how our users should "sign up"/get into their app. From the beginning, I have noted that their documentation is weak; it does not contain the "Whys" and/or options. Since going live, I have added approximately six new users and finally now, with the newest one added, I was finally told why I kept having to report the same issue over and over again. So, their support is not thorough. They obviously look at only the request, and not at our specific account settings to question or verify everything is correct. Then, in July, they reached out to me to help beta test an upgraded version. I confirmed that I could test the new version, but it would not affect our current version, to which I was reassured it would not. However, come to find out, since the beta version was "available", any new users that were added since it being available were automatically upgraded - without warning! This is not good business practice. We have another new employee starting Monday, so I had to quickly train our employees on the beta version yesterday so that all of us could be on the same version come Monday.

title: I just want to start by saying that...
review: I just want to start by saying that this is the best phone system we have had yet. The power and flexibility of this system is simply amazing. Plus being able to integrate this with our ERP (Netsuite) was a enormous bonus. The customer service is exceptional. I highly recommend Nextiva for any business interested in upgrading their phone system.

pros: I always get Great customer service from the agents and the service itself is great!
title: I love this team of representatives! If...
review: I love this team of representatives! If ever I had an issue, it gets resolved. They are knowledgeable and kind. Thanks for the amazing service!!! Once my call log wasn’t displaying the latest calls, the representative had me to uninstall and resinstall the app, my issue was fixed! I recommend servic

title: Set up for our large company was a bit...
review: Set up for our large company was a bit much, but we were also in the transition phase of a new IT company. The system is very user friendly and easy to use. We have a call center and the agent/queue is very user friendly for in office and work from home staff. The app makes it very easy for those who travel around/work from home to have access as well.

title: Had some initial problems with the...
review: Had some initial problems with the installation that were more on our end than Nextiva's. They were thorough and completely resolved the issue. Porting of my numbers was extremely quick and the port team was responsive throughout the process. I've been very pleased with my choice to switch to Nextiva.

title: Stephi Tyler is an amazing, helpful and...
review: Stephi Tyler is an amazing, helpful and knowledgeable customer service representative. I wish all your customer service representatives were equally good. She was able to identify the issue and help me through a solution, which was fast and accurate. Others were giving us the run around for a week.

title: Overall, I have had pretty good...
review: Overall, I have had pretty good service. My grades would be higher but there have been issues with the device that I had on hand. Nextiva said the device could be reconfigured to work and they did just that. Unfortunately, the configurations have to be updated frequently, which can take anywhere from 30 minutes to an hour. This is extremely frustrating but to their credit, they do fix it every time. I did finally just purchase a new device through Nextiva. Hopefully, that rectifies the problem.

title: I have been using the phone service...
review:
I have been using the phone service with my new PT clinic for the past 3 months without issue. Yesterday I was very pleased with the online chat to help set up my e fax and I submitted a ticket this afternoon regarding changing some of my e fax features and it was answered within the hour.
I just sent several e faxes without any issues. Very nice!

title: Transforms the way I work remotely...
review: Transforms the way I work remotely! It is like I never left the office. I can answer the phone while out for a walk with the kids or at the ball game. I honestly didn't think this would be a significant upgrade from the previous phone system, but boy was I wrong. I can even text from my "office landline" GAMECHANGER!!

title: I run my own small law firm I have been...
review: I run my own small law firm I have been a Vonage customer since 2015. For the most part until about four months ago, I thought their service was great. Over the last 4 months or so my calls have been getting cut off. We've been reaching out to customer service for help. No one will get on the phone and speak to us. They only do chat and no one seems to be able to help solve the problem. I've also e-mailed them and get very dodgy responses. It just seems that they do not care about their customers.

title: Their technical support is...
review: Their technical support is fantastic….They go above and beyond other services….I was having a glitch with my internet provider and they walked me thru it until everything was perfect….Thank you…..The patience and understanding for what was happening to my phone service was unbelievable….I would recommend them anytime !!!!

title: I can't recommend 8x8 enough for...
review:
I can't recommend 8x8 enough for company-wide communication, excellent service quality, and decent prices, and 10/10 for the customer support experience!

We've been using 8x8 in our day-to-day interactions with customers as well as between our different departments and it's super easy to use and adapt to even for the not-so-tech-savvy staff members.

title: The service is great. always up to...
review: The service is great. always up to answer questions and customer service is usually pretty fast no waiting arround fo hours to get your quetions answered. I run my business and need good service to make sure my clients can leave messages and have a reliable way to recieve calls and 8x8 does this i also can text appoinment reminders its great,

title: I searched a lot on the internet and...
review: I searched a lot on the internet and saw that Nextiva is a good service for business phone numbers. I got a free trial for the business phone number. Set up a website is not working, I was told there were fixing. Bad impression. It has been 3 days, I could not even use my business phone number. I talked support team, able to talk with customer service is a headache. Just wait, wait, wait. I am gonna cancel it for sure.

title: 8x8 offers a great service, though I am...
review:
8x8 offers a great service, though I am more familiar with their customer service now. When having issues with setting up my voicemail, Racquel was excellent help. I was probably on the phone for 3 minutes from the start to the end of my inquiry.

I look forward to continuing to use 8x8 through my employer and appreciate the quality of calls and service.

title: My support really went the extra mile...
review: My support really went the extra mile to make sure my issue was resolved. They we prompt and I never felt like they had forgotten about me. They would call me daily to work on it with me. Never once did I feel like I was being talked down to. I would call their support again in a heart beat. They never gave up on me and I doubt they would give up on you either.

cons: A couple times a phone has quit working , reason unknown.
pros: Can use my phone via computer.
title: I love the fact that the phones can be...
review: I love the fact that the phones can be used via our computer or I can bring phone home with me to use if I want to . The only problem we have had, is a few times, a phone will stop working, voice mail, calls incoming etc for no reason. Nextiva has been Johnny on the Spot to get them back up and running. The plan we have is just what we need, no disadvantage that I can see. We have been with Nextiva for just over a year now. I would recommend this company to any other business. The rates we pay are very resonable.

title: You get what you pay for! We have a...
review: You get what you pay for! We have a very simple business that requires 2 phone lines and a fax line. We struggled with the foreign support for weeks trying to get line 1 to roll to line 2 if line one busy and have it ring on line 2. Seems pretty basic to me but it is not possible with this Nextiva system. Constantly drops calls. Support takes forever like you have nothing else to do but sit on the phone. No sense of urgency to fix your problem. If you only need one line its probably ok since the price is so low. If you are a small business owner, run away. I find it very hard to believe this company has this many positive reviews. Oh and good luck trying to cancel.

title: We got the Ooma business phone number,...
review: We got the Ooma business phone number, but it is not working properly, I talked to customer service 3 times, but they did not solve the problem. I called the cancel my subscription, cancelation is hard, just be aware of that. Price is affordable when you compare with other companies, but service is not good.

title: Excellent customer service with quality...
review: Excellent customer service with quality products. 10/10 recommend 8x8. I've been using this app for 3 months and have not had any issues with the service. It does what it says, and the customer support is quick and effective. I needed help getting set up, and they quickly answered my questions. I recommend!

title: Nextiva is reliable, responsive, and...
review:
Nextiva is reliable, responsive, and offers all the features I need! Their customer service is always available and cares about delivering success.

I compared the cost of services with other VOIP providers and Nextiva is very competitive.

The new desktop Nextiva app looks good - but needs to be updated to integrate with Gmail and GCalendar - and Zapier.

title: I have been using 8x8 services for...
review: I have been using 8x8 services for several months now and they are very reliable. With other options that I tried in the past, I had a lot of problems with calls being dropped or not connecting at all. Now I can make and receive calls with no problem and enjoy the many other features they include.

title: Convoso has been a great partner to our...
review:
Convoso has been a great partner to our business. The software has allowed us to manage our call center 100% remotely.

The software lacks gamification and bonus compensation features that incentivize agent performance. However, they have been receptive to this feedback.

Overall, very positive experience working with Convoso.

title: I have had nothing but problems with...
review:
I have had nothing but problems with this company from the minute I started with them. In the first place it took me forever to get manuals for the phone system and I couldn't use the desktop phones properly without them. In the second place their apps are of extremely poor quality - I have spent countless hours with technical support trying to get them to work. Even when they do work they are not well designed. For example, there is no way to sync contacts from anywhere for direct dial - the best you can do is import them. Finally, there is no support for blocking spam calls with NoMo Robo and the company has no plans to provide it in the future. My spam calls are ferocious and there is no way to block them on this service.

To be fair their technical support is polite and you can talk to them directly. However, that is a poor consolation when it requires hours to make something work at all and then when it does work it works poorly. I do not recommend using this company and I am counting the hours until my contract runs out and I can switch.

title: Affordability is the best feature here...
review: Affordability is the best feature here with their support being a close runner up. Good clear VOIP phone service. The business I work for has been using Nextiva for over a year. Their pc interface is a little confusing but the support is so great its a non issue. We have had a good experience so far!

title: I have had to call customer service...
review: I have had to call customer service several times with different questions or support issues and always get great customer service. Calls will sometimes take a too long, but issues usually get resolved. The customer service reps are friendly and helpful.

cons: Number Porting process can be slow but I guess that’s the industry standard.
pros: Unlimited calls and great package plans, with a free phone with my plan!
title: Since Axvoice has been around the VoIP...
review: Since Axvoice has been around the VoIP block for a while, it has an advantage over the competition thanks to its unlimited calls in North America. It allows heavy users and those running a business to make unlimited calls without having to worry about the bill. Additionally, there is no requirement for upgrades or protracted activation procedures because it works with most hardware.

title: From the outset, RingCentral did not...
review: From the outset, RingCentral did not live up to their own hype. The video meeting functionality was difficult for meeting invitees to navigate and often did not work with participants using Safari as a primary browser. The customer service has been inefficient at best and insolent at worst. I would NEVER recommend RingCentral to any person or business.

title: I enjoy the layout and it is easy to...
review: I enjoy the layout and it is easy to navigate as an administrator. Reporting is also easy to use and customize. Not all 5 stars due to some issues with the workflow automation (it just stopped working and we had to find a workaround), but there have not been too many hiccups in our first year. Installation took some time, but that is to be expected for a process like this

title: I really enjoyed their customer...
review:
I really enjoyed their customer support, the upgrade my knowledge throgh using VOIP systems, I already had a very bad experience with other VOIP provider, they gave me a time and be patient on my questions , and of course solve my issues and my clients issues too.
They make me proud that I recommended AceFone for my projects
Thank You,
100& Recommend

cons: The control panel is slow to update and can have refreshing issues.
pros: ackwards Compatible and provide free hardware with most plans, don’t have to buy separate devices.
title: Axvoice has been around the VoIP block...
review:
Axvoice has been around the VoIP block for quite some time now and it edges out the competition due to its secure call management portal where users conveniently log in to get details about their call history and manage their accounts. It is also compatible with most current hardware without any need for upgrades or lengthy activation procedures.
Pro: Backwards Compatible and provide free hardware with most plans, don’t have to buy separate devices.

title: Best Overall Dialer!Convoso has...
review:
Best Overall Dialer!
Convoso has everything you will need to get started as well as a very extensive set of features that will evolve and grow with your needs. It is by far the simplest to get your features implemented and the easiest to navigate around. Did I also mention the unbelievable support you have available 24/7 from their different and wonderful support departments? Besides that, they provide a knowledge base center with almost all the explanations and details you might need for all the different features they offer. Lastly, I'd like to mention that being browser based, you can easily manage to work from absolutely any device you have.

title: When we first started using Convoso it...
review: When we first started using Convoso it felt very overwhelming, but our business had the feeling that if we put the right time in learning and understanding the system it was going to be wonderful for us, and that's exactly what happened. Thanks to their support team our business is now happily using a dialer that works for us all around and we are very grateful.

title: I've only used this dialer for about...
review: I've only used this dialer for about two weeks. So far it's very easy to use and efficient. There are a few things I have issues with but they're more suggestions than issues. Besides that it's very well laid out. I'm sure the more I use it it there will be more and more I'll find that will be useful. So far I highly recommend it!

title: LB provided a very efficient service. ...
review:
LB provided a very efficient service. The issues get promptly resolved,. The agent pays attention to details and takes care of all customer's requests. Professional and polite.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cons: The agent-facing dashboard could use further advancement, including more extensive gamification.
pros: Convoso provides an industry leading, all in one platform for both Outbound and Inbound Call Centers. Their main strengths and value props are in: Outbound dialing capabilities, granular and custom reporting, DID management, API capabilities, and more.
title: Convoso provides an industry leading,...
review: Convoso provides an industry leading, all in one platform for both Outbound and Inbound Call Centers. Their main strengths and value props are in: Outbound dialing capabilities, granular and custom reporting, DID management, API capabilities, and more. One of the major factors that places Convoso at the front of the industry is their focus on Compliance and Regulation, which is increasingly critical for call centers. Overall, Convoso has helped our call center scale from 40 to 100+ fully remote agents over the 2+ years we have been on the platform. They have a team dedicated to driving your success, and have helped us improve in all dialing KPIs from our previous dialer.

pros: You can access your missed calls from anywhere
title: 8x8 is great!! they offer many options...
review: 8x8 is great!! they offer many options that will be a great fit for your business. the support team is very friendly and will take all the time needed to educate you on their system and resolve any issue. The wait time can be long but once you get connected they work relatively fast. I would highly recommend this to all providers.

title: 8x8 does exactly what it says. Hosted...
review: 8x8 does exactly what it says. Hosted PBX. Interfaces with Teams and Okta. I worked with their support to integrate with our identity provider which is Okta. The interface easily allows to connect our users with no manual interaction. The phone service always present very clear calls and allow text messaging from a single app.

title: Customer support has been very helpful...
review: Customer support has been very helpful during the onboarding process. Will update review once we are up and running and have more experience as a customer.

title: Convoso has been great at meeting all...
review: Convoso has been great at meeting all our needs in our call center. The scripting feature is very useful as it is easily customizable and you can set different scripts to individual lists and/or campaigns. The reporting features are also easily customizable and can be set to be autogenerated which is a huge time saver.

title: It's the solution we were looking for,...
review: It's the solution we were looking for, our contact and conversion rates went up as soon we switched to convoso. Another benefit is how they take care of your DIDs reputation, reducing the spam rates to zero and helping to save money and grow your revenue. The support team is amazing, especially the CSM, I love to meet with those guys!

title: Convoso is one of the elite dialer...
review: Convoso is one of the elite dialer systems in the industry. It allows you to work anywhere in the world with your team. You can log in and just see everything on one single page. It has excellent reports and you and over see every member of your team and allows you to interact with them off the fly. It the core of business.

title: It’s a software recommended for...
review: It’s a software recommended for automatic dialer and call touting. The reporting options are very good and the ability to register numbers along with the option to have them assigned to specific area to minimize option to me barked as spam. Lately, we have been facing issues with call recording and after being flagged no updates/solutions have been provided

title: They call you right away if there is an...
review: They call you right away if there is an issue with the system. They also follow up via email and are concerned about your needs. if you are not available to receive assistance they continuously follow up until your issue is resolved.I was satisfied with the service received would recommend to others.

title: Great service and great support   I...
review: Great service and great support I have 8x8 for 8 years and have no problems the technical support are great they know their stuff support has been great and the quality is great. They keep upgrading their service and it keeps getting better! I have contacted their support quite frequently with questions so I can continue learning how to work all of the features. licensing and added features.

title: Convoso is a great system for lead...
review: Convoso is a great system for lead management, call routing, workflows, and much much more. Being able to view what your sales team is doing throughout the day and having the ability to help them in a user friendly dashboard in real time is an invaluable tool for any business. Their customer service team always respond in a timely manner and are super friendly.

title: I was slapped with a two year auto...
review: I was slapped with a two year auto renewal like others posting here with no reminder - I tried to cancel some of our lines that we have not been using and was told I missed it by 7 days so I was on the hook for at least $9,000 to reduce my line count from 20 to 8. They do not send notice or ask for a signature to renew liablity of $24,000 - they just stick you with it. I am stuck with them for a while because we are a medical practice and need continuity of telephones - but as a six year and one week (darn week!) customer I expected a little help to remain a customer, not a $9,000 fine to reduce my line count. They are predatory to say the least. BE CAREFUL if you sign up with them!

title: The service and system has been pretty...
review:
The service and system has been pretty good. My biggest complaint is the hardware we are using, it's failing, so perhaps not on them, but they were able to find a solution that helped us out of the phones being completely dead. Another issue is the phone tree and how many number's we have, it's limited to single digits so we need multiple menus for our phone tree (we have about 30 people, so with a limit of 0-9, we have to have around 4 trees) and customers get a little annoyed waiting to hear which tree to go into.

I like the app, I am the main receptionist and the app is nice because we don't have any "hours" we just have it ring to a group, and then a phone tree, but I can setup my phone to business hours, so my phone only rings during times I choose without affecting the main line. I also really appreciate that it notifies me of voicemails outside of my hours, as we don't have anyone on weekends and we're sales based, so if anyone comes thru on the weekends I can get it and send it off to anyone, even via text.

title: Customer tech support is very helpful...
review: Customer tech support is very helpful resolving problems. 8x8 is easy to navigate and intuitive. It is a very helpful service for those who work remotely. When there are tech issues, they usually are solved by uninstalling and then reinstalling. Can be used on laptop, desktop, web based etc. without background noise.

title: Convoso is a great product that has a...
review: Convoso is a great product that has a great team behind it. No matter what happens during the day, I know that the support team is one click away to get any issues that I may have resolved. The relationships built with the management team go far beyond that of the platform. Everyone seems eager to help and keep our team happy.

title: The transition to 8*8 has been great ....
review:
The transition to 8*8 has been great . The features and app are easy to use. The 8*8 team has been helpful and very available. We are very happy with our choice to move to 8*8 for our communication needs!

8*8 is a wonderful choice for a small business that recieves a many calls and needs to get the calls to the right department.

title: Convoso was great, their predictive...
review: Convoso was great, their predictive dialer showed everything we needed and helped us administrate granular rules. We really appreciate their implementation team. Nikolai from their team was beyond awesome, so has Roger Mohr. The people at convoso are fantastic and understanding of company needs and willing to work with you.

title: We have been using Nextiva for about 5...
review: We have been using Nextiva for about 5 years with minimal issues/complaints. Every now and then we have service and quality issues but nothing that really impacts our business. I have noticed that it is taking a little longer to reach customer service for assistance. There is room for improvement here. Overall, we are happy.

title: Overall it's a good system, platforms...
review: Overall it's a good system, platforms could be more user-friendly, such as eFax and app. We struggle when using the app to add other/ new users to a chat. Also with efax, it can be a bit slow to load the faxes and it does not show you who the fax is from. Efax platform is a bit outdated. A 3-year minimum contract is not great to start, it would be better if it was 1 year.

pros: Good if you don't need any support
title: Your staff told me the only reason I am...
review:
Your staff told me the only reason I am unable to self-service register my replacement phone, is because YOU, cannot authenticate the user calling.

Voice, text, and email verification services are used by countless businesses for more than a decade. Why is 8x8 so far behind?

I fail to understand how you cannot authenticate my account via any of the above methods?

Furthermore, you could have verified my account via the softphone client.

I can login to the 8x8 portal, I must have the proper credentials to access the website. Why not provide the option from MY user page to obtain the activation code.

This is a 100% broken process, that is down to pure laziness.

title: Support has been great and the quality...
review: Support has been great and the quality is great. They keep upgrading their service and it keeps getting better! I have contacted their support quite frequently with questions so I can continue learning how to work all of the features. My account manager has also been great in terms of helping me out with licensing and added features.

title: Trying to call a customer overseas and...
review: Trying to call a customer overseas and all the calls are dropping. Called customer service and I got through to a representative after 27 minutes waiting. Talking to him about the problem I could hear kids voices in the background so I asked him where he was located. He told me at the Philippines

pros: Fast, efficient, customizable, profitable and easy to use.
title: Where do I start? My onboarding...
review:
Where do I start? My onboarding experience was amazing and super enjoyable.

Mark and Douglas were incredible. My onboarding process took about 3 weeks and it was a bit fast tracked since I needed to leave Vanilla Soft by a certain date and they jumped through hoops and bent over backwards to make sure I was ready.

On our Whatsapp chat, I was able to ask any question I had and they were very responsive and made the educating process for me very smooth and simple. I have learned so much about the Convoso platform and with their help, assistance and training, I’ve fallen in love with this CRM and it’s easily the best CRM I’ve ever used and I’ve used many of them including Velocify, Salesforce, Vanilla Soft, iSalesCRM, Xencall and a few others.

I have learned so much due to their help and many others in the help department and I’m super grateful. I have lot more to learn and love digging into the admin platform and can’t wait to learn more.

Mark and Douglas are head and shoulders above the rest and should be models to learn from in the onboarding process.

Convoso is light years ahead of any other CRM and if you want to increase sales and profitability you would be silly not to switch to Convoso.

Love you all and thank you very much.

P.S. Paige was pretty awesome too.

title: From the Nextiva support chat, I found...
review:
From the Nextiva support chat, I found an exceptionally helpful, courteous, patient, and knowledgeable support response. I am so glad Ms. Anna S. of Nextiva can provide this level of support.

I wish it would be easier to reset the voicemail attendant pin, but once I was shown the process, I got the hang of it.

title: Amazing customer service from the sales...
review: Amazing customer service from the sales team to the support team if you need help getting everything set up. As we grow our company, we can't wait to expand our business relationship with Nextiva, as their phone service and customer service have out done other VOIP companies. They are pleasant to work with and will go above and beyond for you.

title: From a small business user, Nextiva is...
review: From a small business user, Nextiva is great for us. Most features can be handled directly from the customer login or chatting with a representative online. Rarely have issues with dropped calls/bad service. The only problem I have ever had was getting ahold of my account manager but I can usually handle anything on my own. Wait times for customer service reps via phone call are long as well. I rarely have to do either of those things so I don't mind.

title: Nextiva has good sound quality and when...
review:
Nextiva has good sound quality and when you speak to a US based support specialist, the quality is TOP NOTCH. However, if you try to use chat support, often you will get connected with a Ukraine based support specialist who is distracted with other chats or doing something other than helping you. I recently had an experience where i had to repeat my information 4 times because she didn't bother to read what I had written already. She was unwilling to connect to a supervisor and was generally snotty. She provided inaccurate information, and took a long time to do that.

The other issue I have is the unreliability to upload recordings and sometimes to make feature changes. Several times when I have tried to upload a new recording, or change a feature, it had to be done by support personnel. The self service portal would not allow the task to be done and refused my selection to change an option. Support personnel did fix it promptly, but I had to wait for support to get it done.

title: Good customer service via chat. Always...
review: Good customer service via chat. Always responsive and manageable wait times. We chose Nextiva because it was one of the most cost effective solutions for remote work teams. They offer many features we need to scale our company and remain engaged with our customers. We have about 30 phone numbers for individuals along with a main company line and a toll free line and we haven't had many unsolvable issues. They recently released a new version of their app which has been buggy and the reason why my Reliability is not 5/5. They have informed us that they are working away diligently on improving the experience.

cons: desktop app hasn't been as easy to navigate as other voip desktop apps
title: I'm happy with my service so far. I...
review:
I'm happy with my service so far. I had used a different voip provider in the past and the call quality and ability to use the phone app is much better with Nextiva.
The sales person who set me up was easy to talk to and he made sure I got the service that suited our needs and I didn't feel like he was trying to oversell me.

title: We have been using Nextiva for years....
review: We have been using Nextiva for years. By using their service we have the ability for our entire team to have access to our main phone line. Also for those times that we need to use a fax number we have that also thanks to Nextiva. Another great feature is the Voice mail to Text email! Excellent service and support!

title: Nextiva has provided more technology...
review: Nextiva has provided more technology for our business to function. The Nextiva system allows you to no longer be tied down to a desk phone. With the desktop and Mobile app, you truly can work from anywhere. A lot of customers like to text so the Nextiva allows you to text your clients and send pictures if it's applicable to your business. My favorite feature would be the call pull feature where you can answer the call on your desk phone and pull the call to your mobile app so you can get up and walk away. If you want to upgrade your phone system without breaking the bank, Nextiva is the provider!

title: I am new to the next Nextiva service....
review: I am new to the next Nextiva service. So far, I like the phone app, as it seems easy to use. The web interface also seems well thought out. I like the flexibility of both text and talk and how easy it is to find voicemails. This seems to be a great option for staying in touch with US users while traveling abroad.

title: I have used a ton of VOIP in my years...
review: I have used a ton of VOIP in my years of customer service and this one has be the easiest to set up & use amongst others. The portals that they offer along with tutorial videos make it even more easy plus their customer service. The biggest pro for my company are the apps for your computer and cell phone so it allows it to be on the go if need. Would definitely recommend to smaller or bigger companies.

title: Great product! And the live chat is...
review: Great product! And the live chat is VERY helpful! The app is a great tool to keep your personal phone separate from the work phone. The physical phone is easy to use. Navigating the call flows, admin screen, and settings on the internet is easy. If I am not able to figure out something the Live Chat representative jumps in and preforms the task for me which is great.

title: I have used other providers before and...
review: I have used other providers before and I have been with Nextiva few years and I would not use anyone else anymore. I use alot of phone numbers and they are always able to get me new phone numbers if I need more. The customer service team is awesome they always answer quickly when you call in and very polite.

cons: Missing our customer base that use landlines
title: We started a contract with ringcentral...
review: We started a contract with ringcentral after buying an insurance company in rural Molalla Oregon that had a land-line. It took over 40hrs of my time on the phone with ringcentral to get our number supposedly ported from Wave Communications. We have now missed months of landline customers and or new customers from getting a hold of us, their message is we are no longer in service. Anyone calling form a cell phone is able to get through to our office. So we have made many attempts to let ringcentral know our concerns. They are not helpful and do not care. In my opinion now that ringcentral made 1.2 billion in sales last year they are prejudice against the rural communities that only have 6 lines or less of service. We are a small company that cannot afford to miss calls from current customers or new business. We do not get help from a chat with ringcentral or on the phone. In my opinion they do not care about small business. We have lost businesses and are trying to survive and pay bills. Would not recommend ringcentral.

pros: 24/7 tech support is a HUGE plus
title: We have had the system for about 5...
review: We have had the system for about 5 years. We recently expanded it to include 3 cordless options. The support is amazing and being 24/7 we can make adjustments to the system anytime. I have called for support and they are able to log into the system and see "real time" what's going on. They always provide great service.

title: Nextiva is a breath of fresh air after...
review: Nextiva is a breath of fresh air after we Ring Central! There are so many options with Nextiva. The customer support is excellent! You will always get someone on the phone or with chat within a couple minutes. Everyone from support is on point, and if they cannot answer a question, they will contact someone else, and the issue is resolved right away! I will defiantly, recommend Nextiva!

cons: Documentation not thorough and/or not up to date
pros: Ease of use; integrates with our practice management software
title: We have been utilizing Nextiva for...
review:
We have been utilizing Nextiva for almost a year. I have found that the online documentation is not very thorough and/or is not always up to date. It also doesn't identify what tasks/changes can be done by a client administrator and which have to be done by Nextiva support.

Speaking of support, the support team is very responsive. I get a ticket number assigned immediately, and then usually, depending on issue/request, it is completed the same day and/or within a day.

It is great that it integrates with our practice management software so that we can call directly via such software.

title: This is a great solution for businesses...
review: This is a great solution for businesses with specific call flow needs. It can handle simple call flows from basic ring groups to more customized set-ups with auto attendants and call queues. It does help to have good network support and a partner familiar with VoIP features and set-ups. Reliability is good. Reliability issues that others have complained about can often be tied to the users' networks, not the Nextiva solution itself. Customer service and support is friendly with the end goal of customer satisfaction and problem resolution. It might take some time to get there, but they are willing to get the customer to a support level that can provide what is needed if something cannot be resolved right away. Shout out to Stan with Nextiva support who most recently helped me.

cons: IMPOSSIBLE TO GET RESOLUTION TO ISSUES
title: We are a call center and we have been...
review: We are a call center and we have been having troubles with our customers getting through to our company because the line keeps dropping. We've been dealing with Vonage for over a week trying to get this resolved. They told us someone would reach out to us the next day and of course, they did not. Called the company on hold for over half an hour and they said they had moved our issue to the platnum team and someone would call us. No one has. Have made 2 calls to their escalation team, no one has called us back. Left a message with their Executive Team, no one has called us back. I'm currently on hold 26 minutes and counting to get a hold of someone who can get our business lines back up and running. We are a business and our business is PHONES which Vonage doesn't apparently seem to be able to fix. This is not the first time we've had horrible experiences with this company. I would never recommend this company to anyone who needs reliable phone service.

title: Nextiva has continued to be reliable...
review: Nextiva has continued to be reliable and efficient. My organization has been with Nextiva for almost a decade now and they have continued to stay in communication with any and all new features, updates and resources. Customer service has always provided authentic and helpful support in a timely fashion. The product itself has been 99.9% user and trainer friendly. Tracking analytics and productivity in real time as well as running reports are always a breeze. Highly recommend Nextiva to anyone looking to take their business to the next level.

title: Great Customer Service, was able to...
review: Great Customer Service, was able to help get our new phone going, and helped me discover an awesome feature that Nextiva really ought to advertise more. She spent the time needed to also make sure that the call flow worked properly on the phone that we just set up. She knew what to do when the phone would not provision properly.

pros: Lots of customization, and available features. The ability to use a softphone instead of a traditional phone. The support seems to be very good.
title: I like Nextiva over having a hosted PBX...
review: I like Nextiva over having a hosted PBX device. We haven't really had issues with downtime or any major issues that I can think of, which is great. The ability to have a mobile app that can serve as your desk phone has also been nice. We've noticed some intermittent issues with the mobile app and calls, and some hiccups when "Upgrading" to the NextivaOne app, but their support has been very nice. I'm hoping with some time, the minor issues we've had with the app will be ironed out. I will say a small downside of the new app for me, is that when using the softphone on my work computer, it will not pop up with a notification on the taskbar if a call comes in, and you can only adjust audio settings (to make sure your microphone is set as the default device) during a call.

title: Romeo the support technician was...
review: Romeo the support technician was absolutely phenomenal with assisting me in setting up our call flows and telling me how it was going to work instead of just doing it for me. He tested every single step, explained it and made it very easy to understand. Something that's been confusing me is now simple and easy.

title: Just excellent support service!        ...
review: Just excellent support service!

title: We're saving over $350 a month and...
review: We're saving over $350 a month and getting much better service and far more features than we had with our old landline business system provider. There's much more control over voicemail than before. Nextiva works seamlessly with our cell provider. Voice quality is crisp and clear. The support is live and easy to reach by phone or chat. It's also great having Nextiva on desktop, since we're in front of a computer more often than we're on mobile.

title: Every step of the way - 8x8 has helped...
review: Every step of the way - 8x8 has helped make my phone system work the best. I keep coming up with challenges that weren't there a month or year ago, and each time they find a solution and teach me in the process. You can even be part of virtual meetings that are WAY over my head, yet may fit your want for knowledge.

title: Have been using Nextiva for a few years...
review: Have been using Nextiva for a few years now and they are great! Even when we've had issues on big holidays for example Christmas day, they've been easy to reach and fast to correct the issue. We use IP desk phones and a lot of times have to forward/roll lines/extensions on the go, and Nextiva is always a phone call or email away to assist as needed. I also enjoy the Nextiva app on my cell phone, it's great to have my "office phone" wherever I go.

title: Installation was a bit confusing based...
review: Installation was a bit confusing based on the guidance I was provided to build the call flow. After several calls we figured out the issues. As of now we are being billed double and triple for international calls to Austria and I am waiting on a resolution and credit for that. Other than that calls are clear and stable - no issues with this. Caller ID is working if you use the regular number and not the toll free number. Thank you

title: Startup and customer service are...
review: Startup and customer service are amazing. Love the upgrades that have happened with the caller ID. Voicemail being sent to my email is very convenient. We've been with Nextiva since November 2019 and have never had any issues with voice quality or service interruptions. Would most definitely recommend Nextiva to other local small businesses.

title: I can vouch for this company's...
review: I can vouch for this company's customer support. They go above and beyond to help their customers, specially in the technical support areas. Highly recommended. We had a few issue regarding the caller ID (normally these problems arises from the providers i.e. ATT&T, Verizon), however, the technical support team helped us solving our caller ID issue and gave us a full training session to become more familiar with their platform.

title: Nextiva customer support has been...
review: Nextiva customer support has been terrific. We have migrated multiple systems to Nextiva and continue to recommend the platform to other peers in the industry. The system has been stable and reliable since deployment, and the portal is easy to use for setup and configuration changes. The electronic fax service has also met all of our faxing needs.

title: The service can be as easy or...
review: The service can be as easy or complicated as you want it to be. Perfect solution for rural areas where internet service is more reliable than cell service. Could be used in an office of two or 100! Tech support is thorough and easy to understand. The call quality is usually excellent too. It's a great service!

title: Nextiva has been a fantastic VOIP...
review: Nextiva has been a fantastic VOIP provider for our office. We have been customers for 4 years and have been pleased! The customer service team is always helpful and easy to get in touch with via phone call or text. There are many helpful tutorials for the administrator and users. The online access to your account dashboard is very helpful.

title: Decent performance for what you get out...
review: Decent performance for what you get out of the Nextiva phone packages. For any business with phones VOIP services are a no brainer and we highly recommend VOIP to our business partners. Nextiva was our top selection in the industry however I do wish their pricing was more competitive and easier to deal with. Having a sales rep for everything can be frustrating at times when he/she isn't available.

cons: Takes about 5 min to get someone to start chat
title: Porting was difficult. Came to find out...
review:
Porting was difficult. Came to find out that my rep did not have our equipment checked to see if it was compatible with the Nextiva system so that is why we spent too many hours to count troubleshooting.
Once ported though, customer service is amazing. The Chat option is so convenient and the agents are very helpful! My new rep is fast and helpful.

title: Overall a very good system at a...
review: Overall a very good system at a reasonable price. The system offers many different options and features - very customizable to your needs. Our experience with support has also been very quick and helpful. I would definitely recommend. My only complaint is that the Nextiva App on our cell phone can be glitchy and hard to make calls through the Nextiva App because it can be difficult to hear.

title: We have used Nextiva for 5+ years now...
review: We have used Nextiva for 5+ years now and have been happy with it overall. During COVID support has been clunky, but that's expected. It seems they are finally getting back on track and will answer support emails within 24 hours. You can also call customer service and they will get back to you same day.

title: The call was incredible. He was clear,...
review: The call was incredible. He was clear, thoughtful and very helpful. He was so helpful with my issue. asked the correct questions and generally made me feel at ease. I believe some of the instructions on implementing our new phone system were vague for non IT people but with this type of customer service and online support who caresw!

title: The call quality has been great and the...
review: The call quality has been great and the end-user support has been very good. I have not had any issues to this point that could not be resolved. The on-boarding team has also been very helpful in submitting requests on our behalf have made sure that we are receiving updates as progress was made on anything that was submitted.

title: Everything is going well except my 866...
review: Everything is going well except my 866 number was down for several month.Other than that my service is well. I would recommend nextiva to my friends. I have been with nextiva for about 6mos.and my services has been a the hit except my 866 number being down for several months. I really enjoyed my services.

cons: MY SIGN ON REP IS NO LONGER AT THE COMPANY SO THERE WAS A TRANSITION, BUT THEY FIXED IT
pros: EASY TO SET UP, EASY TO USE, SUPER SIMPLE
title: nextiva offers amazing service, we have...
review: nextiva offers amazing service, we have now been with them since the start of the pandemic, and really, we should have made the switch much sooner. the flexibility offered in how you can set up your products makes things totally amazing. remote phones to be able to work from home or office work seamlessly and customer service is top notch. 5 stars all around for nextiva from our law firm, everyone should check them out

title: Recently became a Nextiva user. So far...
review: Recently became a Nextiva user. So far my onboarding has been very easy. Had an amazing customer service experience with any issues I have had while learning the system. I would for sure recommend this company to other people I know with small businesses. The system has been working great for me so far.

title: We have had this service for about 3...
review: We have had this service for about 3 months. It was a very long installation process but we also ported numbers, which may have complicated things. The call quality is very good, which is something I was worried about with VOIP overall. Not to worry about that here. I do feel as if the system is confusing and while some may love the endless features, I find it overwhelming. We recently had issues and I was on with support for a good hour, and felt that the person I spoke with was not highly trained and could have solved the issue faster. When I asked for a call back (while she figured out the problem) she said it was not possible for her to call out. I sat on the phone for a long time waiting for a solution. I will stay with this service, but feel it will take a long time to learn it.

title: I had the opportunity to work with...
review:
I had the opportunity to work with Vasylysa Tamchenko - Technical Support Specialist at Nextiva today!

She was awesome! Her knowledge and understanding of the issues were having were without equal. She was polite, perceptive and worked quickly to resolve a very complex issues! Just the best that I have had the opportunity to work with.

title: I've been using Nextiva for a couple...
review: I've been using Nextiva for a couple months now and the service is fantastic, both the actual VOIP service and their support team. I had a couple issues getting some BYOD hardware setup and their support team hopped in and helped me setup everything quickly. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for an easy to use and so far rock solid VOIP service.

title: Working with Nextiva has been very...
review: Working with Nextiva has been very smooth! The support team handles everything we need with a simple phone call or chat. The system rarely has any issues and price is right! We have been working with them for almost 6 years. The equipment provided has been reliable and has never had an issue or needed any replacement.

title: I have been using Nextiva for over a...
review:
I have been using Nextiva for over a year now I totally recommend it, easy to use and very reliable. Recently I started using the video conference feature and the internet fax feature, they both work great!
Guys at support are great, very friendly and fast to answer any questions I had. In my opinion, Nextiva is the best service provider out there!

title: Our small business uses Nextiva and we...
review: Our small business uses Nextiva and we love the options. New features are well thought out and welcome additions to our current use. Using Nextiva Chat for assistance is so easy. Within a few minutes I was able to use Chat to set up the SMS messaging feature. It was tested and works perfectly.

title: Pros: This VOIP system is great for...
review:
Pros: This VOIP system is great for Administration phones with great Features, specialty, with multiple satellite office.
Cons: Call center Features needs a lot improvements.

title: This phone service is beyond what I...
review: This phone service is beyond what I could've imagined for my small business! The convenience of having a business phone that is an app on my current phone is a cost cutter right there! The support team is knowledgeable and able to assist with any concern I have had. The referral program is top-notch! I have sent many of my customers over and they have loved it! Thank you Nextiva! I am glad I found this service!

title: Support is usually very helpful....
review: Support is usually very helpful. Sometimes it can be very frustrating dealing with them. Sometimes when we need something done for future (having phones off during holidays) they say we are all set to go, and they still ring on that holiday. In turn, upsetting our clients. Overall though, I am happy with our service.

cons: a bit complicated for self service
title: VOIP systems are a bit confusing to me,...
review: VOIP systems are a bit confusing to me, so the self service options are a bit over my head, however, the chat support is great so that I am not required to 'self service'. I have always had good experience with the chat support as well as phone support. Nextiva is great for the price, and works well most of the time.

title: We love the flexibility that Nextiva...
review: We love the flexibility that Nextiva provides. As small business owners, we don't have a huge staff but want our customers to receive excellent customer service. Having the ability to work from any location is such a huge help because we are home builders so we're "in the field" most of our day. We are so glad that our Comcast rep connected us with Nextiva service.

title: Our onboarding person was terrific,...
review: Our onboarding person was terrific, knowledgeable, patient, articulate and always available. We're still getting used to the system, which of course does way more things than our former 25-yr old PBX system. We only have five users but Nextiva was terrific in making us feel welcome and appreciated during our startup phase.

title: I recently switched to Nextiva and the...
review: I recently switched to Nextiva and the customer support is amazing. The price is 1/3 of what we were paying, services are great, support has been amazing and installation and set up was a breeze with the videos. Every small issue that we had when we were working out the kinks was handled quickly and efficiently. So far I do not have one bad thing to say about Nextiva.

cons: Shady Business Practice with Long Term Commitment
title: I have been a long-term customer/client...
review: I have been a long-term customer/client of Ring Central. Every 2 years they make me renew (why? ) with no additional costs to recoup - they are not providing new equipment or upgrading any service or feature. There long term committments seem to be a red-flag for they think we need to be trapped into staying with you as a company. This last renewal (unbeknownst to me (and different than every other renewal) - they slammed in a little "auto-renew clause" that Auto-renews for 2 more years. ... why? was it that difficult to get someone to sign electronically every 2 yrs? This shady business practice means that I am now trapped into a contract with them for a few extra months. They get to steal from me at $125/mo but I am going to share my experience with others and let it be known that this tacky business practice is unappreciated by businesses who must legitimately ask their customers to renew with them. I can understand an auto-renew for month to month.. but 2 years "auto-renewed" without consent is excessive.

title: Very satisfied, will continue calling...
review:
Very satisfied, will continue calling support for all my needs. Would recommend this provider. Currently an active user.

Very satisfied, will continue calling support for all my needs. Would recommend this provider. Currently an active user.

Very satisfied, will continue calling support for all my

pros: Quick response, no frequent issues, Love the service
title: We do not have frequent problems...
review: We do not have frequent problems although when there is a issue, Nextiva support quickly fixes the problem. Installation went as explained and there was no concerns. The equipment is sturdy, works well and support is willing to assist when an issue arises. The fee is worth the service that we receive. The online service and the mobile application is a great addition to having the landline service. Thank You

title: I have been loving the ease and quick...
review:
I have been loving the ease and quick setup of my Nextiva VOIP for my insurance company, I love all Nextiva has to offer and would never switch :)

The quick access of the desktop, to Nextiva aapplication work flawlessly, my calls never drop and are very good quality, in a sales position I must be able to hear my customers and I do quite well!

pros: Web Interface is easy to navigate
title: I have been using Nextiva for about a...
review:
I have been using Nextiva for about a year, from self-installation of ~70 phones to current usage throughout the company. I came into the project after the initial planning was completed, so I am unable to speak to that, but setup of the phones was simple. Customer Service Staff are overall very friendly and easy to work with. Had trouble in the past with reaching my account manager, but most issues can be handled via chat or phone.

Web interface allows you to modify call flow on the fly. It is very intuitive. Unfortunately, the web interface has had multiple errors for me, usually related to licenses per location. Also unfortunately, the errors are not user-friendly to read.

title: I had the absolute pleasure of getting...
review:
I had the absolute pleasure of getting Robert as my agent today, I cannot say enough about 1) his professionalism, 2) his willingness to hear what my concerns was in its entirety, 3) knowing that he would have my issue resolved with me being completely satisfied at the end of the call, 4) he tested the work that he completed… this was major because so many do the work but will not quality check the work and then I find myself calling back frustrated. Which brings me to number 5) I was not frustrated and the issue was resolved completely 6) I’m able to text message from the app now, 7) he restructured my call flow so that I’m able to view and make changes to the direct line number in a separate place (AWESOME) and put a “do not use” on the old one simply by listening to my request… again he was hearing my pain points and ready to resolve. 8) can we please have more agent like Robert, willing to resolve issues not just get someone off the phone. Robert deserves the highest compliment that I can give! He did this all in a short period of time!!!

Robert, I must say thank you! There's so much more that I could write. I appreciate you, for not only going the extra mile but by making sure I understood what workflow you put in place. You dove deep into my concern to ensure I had a pleasant experience with a resolution and that I’m grateful for.

title: I have been working with Nextiva for 4...
review: I have been working with Nextiva for 4 years, and they are my primary recommendation for anyone looking for cloud-based telecommunications systems. From system options to upgrading their online portal, they are constantly researching and implementing improvements to their suite of offerings, and have the best technical support team in the industry.

title: Had Vonage and their customer support...
review: Had Vonage and their customer support was terrible. Nextiva has been great so far. A few issues getting going as would be expected, but much better than Vonage. Two issues I am currently having is not being able to get my outlook contacts to load. Other issue is an echo when using the app on my cell phone.

title: Nextiva is an easy to use system and...
review:
Nextiva is an easy to use system and the support team is quick and efficient should any troubles arise! As a small company, we have utilized Nextiva from the start and continued to grow. They are able to assist with any of our needs and questions within 2-3 hours, if not sooner.

Highly recommend this for anyone who is looking for a supportive company for their Business!

title: Setup and Installation is very easy and...
review:
Setup and Installation is very easy and communication with support and setup teams are phenomenal. Will always recommend Nextiva. App is great to use as well!

Anytime there is an issue they have been quick to find a resolution to get the system up and running smoothly again.

Great team and great system.

title: The product itself is super easy to use...
review: The product itself is super easy to use and has very functional features. I'd like to give a shout out to their tech support, most recently Diana O.. Anytime there is an issue, they hang in there with me until they figure it out. Love that, as it is hard to come by these days. Great customer service on the tech support side!

title: Their system and service is the best in...
review:
Their system and service is the best in the industry.

Evetime, you can get a hold of anyone 24/7 no joke.

There is rarely any down time with them.

I would recommend this system for anyone business small or large, it is very scalable as well. Meaning you can take your business from 1 to millions.

title: Great customer support, helped me with...
review:
Great customer support, helped me with call forwarding.
All the agents I talked to know what they're doing and take their time and make sure all issues have been resolved. I recommend this provider and we are currently an active user.
................................................................

title: The Technician I spoke with on the...
review: The Technician I spoke with on the phone today was very helpful. We were on the phone for over one hour, and he was very patient and knowledgeable. We were able to diagnose the issue on the phone and point out that it was our connection from the wall to the router that was the issue. He was great!...

title: We switched over to Nextiva about a...
review: We switched over to Nextiva about a year ago, haven't encountered any major problem and if needed their support number and online chat is always helpful their admin portal is also easy to use and has explanation to what these options do. I do have to say in the initial months of the switch there was often large waiting queue for support over the phone but recently have not has such long wait times and have gotten through to help almost instantly.

pros: good quality phones and tech supportort
title: We have been working with Nextiva for a...
review: We have been working with Nextiva for a few years now. The phones and technical support have been great. The chat feature is very easy to use and you can get to an agent very easily. Speaking to people on the phone or virtually is important to me when I need help. They have always answered and only had to wait a few minutes on hold. Additionally, their sales rep are timely in answering questions or helping you figure out exactly what you need and what's possible. The only reason there is a 4 in the reliability is I believe their app could use some improvement.

title: Nextiva is very easy and user friendly....
review: Nextiva is very easy and user friendly. If you cant figure something out their support is very quick to answer questions via chat(my fav) or email. I think they also have a phone number you can call. Their new NextivaONE app allows the team to collaborate like never before. We where also able to drop our zoom account because video conferencing/calls are included!

title: We have been using Nextiva for years. ...
review: We have been using Nextiva for years. The process of onboarding was well documented and fully supported. The service is very reliable. We get rarely have any issues. If we do, support always works to get everything resolved quickly. The system has many useful features that work well in our environment. Highly recommend.

title: Nextiva has excellent service and...
review: Nextiva has excellent service and support. They offer a website that is easy to navigate where you can control your multiple phone lines from more than one location, transfer calls from one office to another easily, and can track the number of calls made and received easily. The product quality is great and their support staff are patient and helpful.

pros: Best support team out there. easy to d the provisioning yourself.
title: Best support team out there. easy to do...
review: Best support team out there. easy to do the provisioning yourself. Techs are always friendly and very knowledgeable. Service is top-notch and the account manager is always in touch. My favorite way to get in touch with them is through the chat feature. The chat makes it so much more convenient when you are multi-taking to just fire up the chat and get the much needed help that way.

title: Great service, extremely reliable. ...
review: Great service, extremely reliable. Support is always very helpful, there can be somewhat of a wait right now but that is due to general market conditions I am sure. We are able to self administer via the portal easily. having the ability to login as other users makes for supporting end-users much easier.

cons: Asks repeatedly for information already submitted through a case ticket.  DC
pros: Responds via email in timely matter
title: We have been using Nextiva for more...
review: We have been using Nextiva for more than a year and we have consistely reported dropped calls, texting is lost or unable to respond, missed calls altogether. Service asks if our routers are compatible when we have it hard wired. If we could terminate the contract today, we would. Calls and texting is 100% of our business, but we have stopped using the app on our phone and computer and starting using our personal cell phones. When adding a new line, it is time consuming and takes multiple emails to have the new user added to our company phone directory.

title: This is the most customizable and...
review:
This is the most customizable and reliable VoIP system I've had the pleasure of working with. I've tried several over the last couple of years and had issues with every single one. Either the call quality is poor, the customer service is bad or it's too complicated to use.

Nextiva stands out with its excellent customer service. So far I've always been able to reach a live human quickly with any issues I had and those issues have been taken care of quickly and completely.

It is highly customizable. I can make any change I want pretty much with the use of external add-ons and APIs. Bottom line: it's a wonderful platform, at a reasonable price with quality service.

title: Our company just signed up for Nextiva...
review: Our company just signed up for Nextiva service. I missed the first onboarding meeting due to connectivity issues. I have rescheduled 4 times and each time I have to keep calling to ask for dial in information for the onboarding process. I spent over 2 hours on the phone trying to get the problem solved and get a new appt scheduled. I will say everyone I spoke to was very nice, but I'd prefer competent over nice. I have now rescheduled and actually received log in information after 3 hours spent on the phone trying to get rescheduled and the issue resolved. So far not impressed.

title: We switched from Comcast VoiceEdge...
review: We switched from Comcast VoiceEdge because of the more robust features offered by Nextiva. It was an easy setup, they offer an easy interface which is simple to program and when I've run into trouble their tech support has been outstanding and solved my issues every time. They also have tech support via LiveChat which is very helpful

title: We are looking into other providers....
review: We are looking into other providers. Nextiva is pretty terrible. We are having to replace phones every year at over $300 EVERY time, customer service is terrible, and our call forwarding never works. The support team can't figure it out. It would be much better if you didn't have to purchase their products that don't last.

title: Alisa T. was extraordinarily helpful in...
review:
Alisa T. was extraordinarily helpful in changing voicemail and username information. She made it a very quick and easy process, as well as being very courteous and friendly. Great customer service skills and eager to help. A+!
Very happy to use Nextiva. Would recommend to anyone for their company.!

title: We left team 'V' for Nextiva and...
review: We left team 'V' for Nextiva and couldn't be happier! From the porting of our number to hooking up our equipment all the way to setting up our Call Flow. Working with a much easier "user friendly" format has been such a relief. Since we aren't IT professionals we couldn't figure out their competitions setup and would spend literally hours typing into a chat window with zero positive results. Much happier, thanks Nextiva!

title: Nextiva support staff are quick to...
review: Nextiva support staff are quick to respond and resolve our technical issues. Our organization has partnered with many VoIP vendors, with varying levels of satisfaction. Partnering with Nextiva has provided us with the best experience to date.

title: I am happy with the service from...
review: I am happy with the service from Nextiva, on every single call, email or chat. They have tools to set up the system and they are very helpful in getting it set up for you. The service has never been a disappointment. I've had it 2 years now and haven't looked back. I ported over 833-4my-401k (8334694015) feel free to reach out when you are searching.

title: Excellent customer service! Whenever we...
review: Excellent customer service! Whenever we have an issue, Nextiva customer support always works diligently to resolve it. They are available any time, day or night and follow up with customer service questionnaires and make sure that your issues have been resolved. The chat feature is the best, because you can get help from your device.

title: I had an issue with access to my fax,...
review: I had an issue with access to my fax, and the issue was resolved immediately! With the email support I didn't expect an answer in the same day, but I got one in the same hour! They took the proper steps to authorize me as a user and get me back into the fax feature of my account. It was a very important fax too!!

review: I this Nextiva is an excellent product. The support team is professional and accommodating.
