I spend at least a half hour waiting between calling the main number giving my information than being transferred to HIPPA support and giving them the information again. It is very time consuming. Perhaps a direct line could be created for HIPPA customer.

title: Nextiva has been a great phone service...
review: Nextiva has been a great phone service provider. Their customer support has been very helpful and thorough with solving any of the issues we've had. And I especially appreciate how friendly their customer service agents are and how quickly I am able to speak to someone when I call to get help with an issue.

title: Nextiva's VOIP core product is solid. ...
review:
Nextiva's VOIP core product is solid. We've had just about zero issues. It's very simple to deploy and maintain. Number porting is also quite easy. Lots of features, soft phone for PC, mobile, etc.

We also use their call center software. If you need the basics, it works well. As our company grows, we're finding that there are some advanced features that more expensive solutions offer but Nextiva does not. It's great at what it does, for the price you pay.

title: SYSTEM HAS DONE WELL FOR US. I REALLY...
review: SYSTEM HAS DONE WELL FOR US. I REALLY LIKE THE CONSISTENT BILLING. THE SITE ISN'T SUPER EASY TO NAVIGATE. I WAS TRYING TO UPDATE MY CREDIT CARD AND IT WAS A CHALLENGE. ALL IN ALL WE ARE HAPPY WITH NEXTIVA. THE ONLINE CHAT HELP IS SOMETIMES NOT SO GOOD AND THE ENGLISH COMMUNICATION OF SOME ON THE PHONE IS ALSO NOT SO GREAT AT TIMES.

title: Our owner has 2 businesses a Hospice...
review: Our owner has 2 businesses a Hospice and a Home Health agency and we both use Nextiva. The Home Health has been using Nextiva for more than 3 years and they have NEVER let us down! Always professional, efficient and super helpful. Setting up the new acount took some time but everyone has been very hospitable and pleasant as they worked on getting all of the initial issues corrected. I would say, so far so good. Our company is satisfied with the way the phones and fax services are being handled. Highly recommended to anyone who needs VOIP service.

pros: Streamlined, efficient customer services, customer service c
title: Anytime I need support regarding our...
review: Anytime I need support regarding our new phone system the customer service always goes above and beyond. They walk me through the issues I'm having and can explain it so I can quickly solve the problem. The phone call quality is good as well. I also love the ability to switch between my desk phone and my cell phone without any problem when I need to be on the go.

title: I have enjoyed getting to know and...
review: I have enjoyed getting to know and understand just how Nextiva works. It is a great system for all types of business from large to small! Anytime I have needed any type of assistance, they have been there to help me along the way. Theyre response time is great and set up can be a bit tricky but with their help it was easy!

title: I was able to work with support person...
review: I was able to work with support person Chris and he was extremely patient and quickly resolved the issue I was having. It is a pleasure to work with their Customer Service team. Then method that was used to troubleshoot the problem was easy on the customer end and we were able to quickly make phone calls for our site.

title: Nextiva's Customer Support is...
review: Nextiva's Customer Support is fantastic, always able to answer our questions quickly and completely and resolve any issues that we might (rarely) come across. Our company switched over from a landline service and the process was quick and easy, not to mention that it saved us money while providing a much more robust and flexible service. The referral program is awesome too!

title: This time there was good service, but...
review: This time there was good service, but sometimes is is hit or miss, i believe its a training issue where they are not sure how to work on an enterprise account and don't escalate when necessary so it causes some frustration and confusion. Some time I have to go back and resubmit requests or call. But then i get someone who is amazing and puts customer first.

title: Support chat feature is really helpful,...
review:
Support chat feature is really helpful, as we are new to using Nextiva.
Our account manager is also helpful and responsive. The online portal is also useful. They have a wide variety of phones available. They have been reliable so far. we made the switch from a previous provide a few months ago. Thanks!

title: Robert did an amazing job walking us...
review: Robert did an amazing job walking us through our setup and making sure that we had everything configured properly! He answered all of my questions and went into detail about things that are going to make our business run smooth. From listening to my challenge, helping me trouble shoot and other small setup best practices, Robert did an amazing job.

title: Excellent company that offers a great...
review: Excellent company that offers a great service, value and great support! They offer some amazing technology and features that a lot of the other companies that are in this field don't offer. They also allow us to scale our business based on our needs. I have been a customer for many years and will continue to be.

title: Our client needed a reliable VoiP...
review:
Our client needed a reliable VoiP provider with the added wrinkle of installing emergency phones in resident facilities. Support was exceptional and helped get us to where we needed quickly and effectively. The only reason it took me multiple calls to their team was because I didn't fully understand the initial instructions I received, which ended up being exactly what I needed to do.

Keep up the great work, and thank you for all of the support during onboarding!

title: I signed up a few months ago and was...
review:
I signed up a few months ago and was surprised to see the billing paper used. I got a different usage fee paper than the first advertisement.
1. I used it for the first time, but I didn't know how to do it, so I tried to change the number while looking at this and that, but it was deleted. So I contacted us through contact us and made the number alive, but he added the cost.
2. The cost in the advertisement was 14 dollars for example, so I signed up and finished it.... The bill I received came out to be 30 dollars. They changed my rating at will.
3.I was so angry with various problems that I called to delete my account, but when the company asked me if I would continue using it if they offered me a cheaper rate, I said no and I do not want to use it anymore, but I got the bill again.

I am writing about our experience with this company. Others may have a different opinion than me. I believe that those who read this article will make their own decisions.

title: RUN...RUN AWAY FAST.......Birch was...
review: RUN...RUN AWAY FAST.......Birch was fine until Fusion bought them out. We had used Birch for 6 years . Fusion claims it has a Contract Termination Fee- $835.37 that renews every year without ANY input from the customer. I was told that there may have been an old 1 year only contract with Birch from many years ago that they were trying to enforce as current. Many angry calls and threats of action from my lawyer finally got my business away from these leaches. Spectrum offered me the same service for around half the cost without any contract.

title: Agent solved issue with Lightning Fast...
review: Agent solved issue with Lightning Fast Customer Service. Hardly any waiting on the phone for someone to respond. The Technical Team also sent a a service request to Sales to answer another question I had about an additional issue not related to Technical Support. It is easy to contact them and request assistance.

title: It's always a relief when Nextiva...
review: It's always a relief when Nextiva support has your back! I've taken advantage of their help line multiple times to get me out of a pickle, and when your phone system is down YOU ARE DOWN. My favorite feature is call forwarding so when we are out of the office a simple request can be called in to forward our office phone lines without having to stress over missing an important call.

title: Nextiva has been an excellent asset to...
review: Nextiva has been an excellent asset to our business. I've used them for over 5 years with another company and now using them again with a new business. I would recommend them to anyone for their service and reliability. Their customer support is great anytime you have issues, which is very rare. Great company!

title: We've been using Nextiva for several...
review: We've been using Nextiva for several years for our business. I searched the internet for a while looking to swap from a traditional phone company. I came across Nextiva and it's been great ever since. I really like how you can control everything about the system with ease from the dashboard. Reliability has been great and their support is the best in the business!

title: This company is extremely frustrating...
review:
This company is extremely frustrating with NO customer service! The phones themselves come with a noise cancelling feature. Sounds nice? It is not! the only time you hear anything is when someone speaks into the phone otherwise you would think that no one was on the phone with you.

Service - They were fast at taking our account and money however it took over a month to actually get the phones going. So basically they make money while you have no phones.

There is NO follow up once the phones are installed. They do 1 meething that gives an overview of the software, they record it for you so they do not have to speak to you again..... So if you have a questions you must go through an hour of video trying to find the answer to a question you have.

They send the phones in....again no follow up! - They sent one of the phones as a desk phone rather then an wall phone - however if you don't change it within 30 days your SOL! Remember they wont have your phones set up for at least a month! Hence they don't have to give any service because that is there company policy!

WORST COMPANY!!! RUNNNNNN

title: Nextiva is a reliable VOIP provider...
review: Nextiva is a reliable VOIP provider with good scalability as a small business grows. They offer the customer a good tool to manage call flows and teams in real time, from simple to complex flow structures. Nextiva is supported by knowledgeable, customer-focused service/support representatives should intervention be needed quickly. We're satisfied with our switch.

title: Nextiva is the perfect solution for any...
review: Nextiva is the perfect solution for any company looking to expand its ease of simplifying everyday office tasks while providing accessibility, quality of life, and amazing customer service. Setup is simple and you can automate the rest. However, their customer support call wait time can be long, so chatting with them online is highly recommended if you can't reach them by phone within a reasonable amount of time.

title: I recently took over responsibilities...
review: I recently took over responsibilities for our phone system. Nextiva's online chat option has been very helpful. Someone gets to me quickly and stays on until my problem is resolved. The same happened when I needed to call for customer support- the representative was helpful, patient, and knowledgeable.

title: A great app with good features suitable...
review: A great app with good features suitable for small, medium, and large companies. I personally use it for my small business, their service is very affordable and convenient for all of my needs. They gave me one month free trial and I will be paying $15. I think I'm extremely satisfied with their service within that price range.

title: Features are good and solid, I would...
review: Features are good and solid, I would like it better if mobile worked every time. It's frustrating that sometimes it doesn't allow me to login and says "webpage unavailable." This doesn't happen on desktop luckily. Best features are the texting and faxing--much simpler than having multiple apps for each thing.

title: I find that Voiply was a very good...
review: I find that Voiply was a very good choice in my cord cutting away from Optimum. The price is right and the few problems that I have had have been cleared in the chat. Let me just say the problems were few. I have and will continue to recommend Voiply. On another note, there have been times in a long conversation where the call is dropped. I am sure some of the reasons are on the other end and not a Voiply problem. Still, that is not enough to nor recommend the service.

pros: The cons far out weigh the cons
title: You cannot speak to customer service. ...
review: You cannot speak to customer service. You can only chat via text on your phone. They change functions randomly - your voicemail will act up randomly. Getting your issues addressed takes far longer than it should. They started charging me for extra lines that we do not use - refused to give proper refund. Do not recommend Vonage. We are changing service.

pros: Great customer service and a great product
title: I have been a customer for around 15...
review: I have been a customer for around 15 years. This is the best phone service I've ever had. I'm especially pleased with their customer service which is easy to reach and always solves any issue quickly. Their plans are flexible and their website lets you easily make changes to your account as well as listen to messages, block unwanted numbers, and a few other useful features.

title: good tool to work, especially for...
review: good tool to work, especially for calls. In addition, it is a great tool for video conferences especially with a huge number of people. We use 8x8 for organizing meetings and for doing the business calls and this tool rarely gives us issues and if these arises the support is always open to support and help the customer. Thanks for this!

title: Christiana is a fantastic part of your...
review: Christiana is a fantastic part of your team. She walked me through intricate details of all parts of our account, helped me set up many different features, helped us clean up out of date features, and was very patient, professional and extremely helpful. She spent nearly 2 hours of her time helping us to make our nextiva experience better than it’s ever been. Thank you Christiana!

title: This app is great. It is easy to use...
review: This app is great. It is easy to use and makes calls easy for work. I use every day for work and I usually have no issues at all. Today I had an issue with my audio and it was easy to submit a ticket for help. My Issue was resolved right away and I was able to continue using the app without an issue.

title: Convoso continues to set the mark when...
review: Convoso continues to set the mark when it comes to contact center software. I for one get to have my hands in many different instances and love challenging myself to discover the uniqueness about every one using Convoso as a call center solution. The true beauty of Convoso is the make-up of system's brain for detecting live callers and distributing them to high priority agents. You can manipulate settings on the fly, or set them to match the flow of certain days/times of the week. Each characteristic of the vast campaign settings are available to you with it's very own definition of how it may influence your call connection. The agent dashboard displays a competitive sale person's atmosphere with call stats/logs to track success along with calendar reminders for callbacks and follow ups. The administrator's site offers a bird's eye view of your entire operation and can be magnified down to shadow a specific call tied to any agent. I can't say enough about the reporting and the cost tracking dynamic offered through the array of special applications and tailored customizations built into the platform. No matter the size of your operation the scale will always tilt towards your goal so long as you fill yourself with knowledge and monitor the growth of your business with the hand held support provided by Convoso. The owner/operators are the best in the business, the Client Success Managers are renowned in the industry and the support team is without exception the hardest working individuals in the space. A big thank you to Nima, Lisa, Meg, Tom, Ron, Scott and the numerous support agents I have the pleasure of working with daily. Wouldn't be possible without you!

review: Great support, the agent that help me knew what he had to do found the problem and solved my issue. Great communication as well. Keep up the good work.

title: I have been using the service for about...
review:
I have been using the service for about 4 months now, and we have gone from simple call queue to full call center in that time period. I am the IT Manager for a Property Management Company managing 400+ short term properties and 65 long term properties. When we first started with Nextiva we just wanted to replace our old ESI system that we had outgrown. Original setup was a copy paste from that call queue, then we saw more options, and more options, now we have multiple direct line numbers, two main numbers going to two facilities, one facility with five separate departments. It has provided answers for managers needing an app based softphone, conference setup for meetings, full call center for our reservations department, cordless phones for our linens department, a sales department that is reached via the main number but has a different set of hours than the rest of the building. In the future we will be expanding it further into our maintenance department so they can also take advantage of the app based softphone, and will be taking advantage of their chat program. I also work as an IT vendor locally and have already set up Nextiva system for a restaurant that needed a system for reservations, take out, a brewery attached, and a convenience store attached. The restaurant was able to achieve a good setup with just the lowest level license available.

Difficulties we did have, the original setup was less than optimal. When we upgraded to full Call Center the group that attempted to set it up actually took our original call queue down during the process, approximately one hour during peak hours, peak season. During the process of upgrading I never could get a clear cut sheet of, this level has these features, and was actually forced to upgrade a level to get a feature I had believed I already had. The did attempt to make it right and I did receive a percent discount and a flat price reduction for our troubles.

We are using the Enterprise Call Center license from Nextiva, which is very robust with options. If you are a smaller company it may be more options than you need honestly. As a medium or larger company, with people capable of going through the options, you will find that nearly any set up can be accomplished.

Support is wonderful, the wait was longer than desired, but once through the queue every question I had was answered, specific shout out to *Anastasiia O.* as they stayed on the line with me for nearly two hours resolving issues and making improvements.

review: We have had some issues getting set up with Nextiva but the support staff have been super helpful in trying to fix all of the issues.

cons: You give up a little control
title: As long as you have a reliable internet...
review:
As long as you have a reliable internet connection, Nextiva provides a robust & reliable, fully featured phone setup for a small or large business. Previously my company hosted our own Avaya IP Office system which you could do anything you wanted with. Of course after reading and learning how to program it. There are very few Avaya technicians and resellers in our area. The world is moving to voip rapidly and finding the older phones and modules to keep our system running became a challenge.

It can take some extra work by some skilled engineers at Nextiva to fine tune your setup exactly the way you want it and some of those controls are not customer facing. However for 90% of regular changes a customer needs to make such as adding users or schedules, the web based dashboard is extremely easy to use with detailed descriptions when you hover your mouse over some items, to extremely detailed help documentation. If there is something I can't figure out, it just takes asking for help. For most situations like that, usually their chat support technician is able to accomplish the task in minutes. Beyond that, Nextiva has some of the smartest experts at their disposal.

We chose Nextiva to unify our remote locations and employees. It also took a huge load off of myself trying to source Avaya parts and learning to program features. They have a detailed, well planned on-boarding process for a company of our size (around 100 employees) which helps you get up and running as soon as you go live. Rarely do I need to reach out to support, but when I do they always are able to help. I can't recall their phone service being down at all for the couple years we've used them as our provider. Couldn't be happier.

title: Great and overall easy product to use....
review: Great and overall easy product to use. The VOIP is smooth and it's also versatile between using in office and on the go. We have it connected to a phone, installed on the desktop, and also on our smartphones for on the go. Different extensions and sign-in allow for easy access and even transferring lines to others in the office.

title: It's a one stop solution for a fairly...
review: It's a one stop solution for a fairly low price. Tons of features at my fingertips and that really made my workload more efficient as well as keeping the headaches away. I'd like to mention a shout out to Christiana, the amazing customer service representative who helped us to solve a major issue so very quickly and efficiently!

title: i like using nextiva for my voip needs....
review: i like using nextiva for my voip needs. It compliments hubspot really well. In my opinion, this suite is probably the best phone company out thre in terms of voip and sip solution for a small business owner. Really a big fan of the brand and their support department as well. The guy I just spoke with was awesome and got my issue handled.

pros: Customer support is awesome! Extremely friendly and helpful. They have always assisted me and answered all my questions and fixed anything that I needed to change.
title: Leah helped me today and she was so...
review: Leah helped me today and she was so much fun to talk to on the chat feature. Friendly, funny, but most of all was knowledgeable! Took care of what I needed and made me laugh at the same time. If all companies had people like Leah, they would be much better off. Leah is an asset to Voiply! Give Leah a raise, Voiply!

title: the initial onboarding was a bit rough...
review: the initial onboarding was a bit rough but as soon as I got on with the support rep, he had us building out our phone tree and users configured in what seemed like a few minutes! Now we have Nextiva up and running, and I cant imagine ever going back. 10/10 support and honestly once we got into customizing the environment, it was easy to take over and go the rest of the way. wonderful interaction!

title: Our organization is a very unique...
review: Our organization is a very unique non-profit. Because of its uniqueness, we have had to reach out several times to their support. They have been very patient and very very knowledgeable and got everything set up and personalized for our business! Highly recommend Nextiva!!! We have no complaints!

title: I haven't had an issue with our...
review: I haven't had an issue with our Nextiva phone service in about 3 years and the few times that somethings has been wrong. I just call support and they help me with the issue. They always has been very polite and knowledgeable and help me to fix the issue without to much frustration. The service is great! If you are looking for a phone system for your business give Nextiva a try, will no disappoint.

title: I've used 8x8 Express for over 2 years...
review: I've used 8x8 Express for over 2 years after leaving a few other companies for various issues. While there are a couple of nits (below), I am very happy with the service and Express is a bargain. I use the app on my cell phone and computer -- no hardware phone. Quality is generally very good to excellent, and the ability to hot transfer a call between devices means any temporary network glitch a minor inconvenience. My initial setup and porting was seamless. Video conferencing works well. The nits are the customer service bot can be very annoying and it can be difficult to get it to transfer to a human when the bot can't help. Fortunately, I haven't needed support more than once or twice. Second nit is the service does not support texting on the main number when it's not tied to an individual, so I have to pay a second company for texting so clients can text my main number.

title: Nextiva has been excellent at resolving...
review: Nextiva has been excellent at resolving issues quickly over both phone and email as well as providing a reliable and constant phone service with very minimal interruptions. The Nextiva app is not phenomenal however the ability to use teams integration and physical VOIP phones makes the Nextiva experience great!

title: I've been using nextiva for over 2...
review: I've been using nextiva for over 2 years and i dont think to change my provider in a long term. I had some issues with the Nextiva analytics and since is my daily platform to work with direct Cx pluse leading our teams with the different dashboards availables i needed to be fixed immediately. I used the customer service team and they helped me out same day and were very efficient

title: My only complaint is that some of the...
review:
My only complaint is that some of the features (Warm Transfer, Park, Transferring using BLF keys) are not as simple as some other providers.
However, they are great to deal with. Nextiva Support (via both phone or chat) is always great. I administer 200+ users, and Nextiva Support is much better than other providers. They work towards a resolution, and are not afraid to escalate if necessary.

title: Nextiva has been a great VOIP system...
review: Nextiva has been a great VOIP system since our company installation. When a problem arises, which isn't often, the support has been excellent. The support reps are knowledgeable and efficient with support requests. The system is also easy to use. I would recommend Nextiva to other small businesses who are looking at a VOIP solution.

title: So far so go. We have had minor issues...
review: So far so go. We have had minor issues but able to get them fixed within a few days. The app is bulky to use and could use more user friendly items. Set up is easy/complicated depending on what you want. Overall this is okay as our first VOIP system to use for our business. I do look forward to upgrades to make thing better.

title: I have had issues with poor voice...
review: I have had issues with poor voice quality on the outgoing calls. (ie. people I called said it sounded like I was underwater) That issue was finally resolved after I purchased a desk phone from Nextiva. I have had other issues and it usually takes two or three calls to support to resolve the problems. The good thing is you are not kept waiting for support help and you do not have to go through a telephone maze to get through to them. The support techs are polite and most of them have English as a first language. Occasionally, I will get someone who is hard to understand.

pros: The agent on the call was phenomenal - Christiana Adenieniyi
title: I called and spoke with your agent...
review: I called and spoke with your agent Christiana Adeniyi - who provided phenomenal customer service! This agent answered all my questions and provide solutions to any issues I had. She was was patient, gave clear instructions, walked me through all the steps to troubleshoot the issues, and provided an overall excellent customer service! I will recommend Nextiva to all others! This is truly what every customer should experience, speaking with knowledgeable, positive agent!

title: Maryna is simply amazing. Everytime I...
review: Maryna is simply amazing. Everytime I see her name pop up as my support person I know my issues will be resolved. Thank you so much Maryna. I reached out today with multiple issues from multiple users and she broke it down and prioritized each issue in order to make sure all issues were taken care of.

title: We went through three other phone...
review: We went through three other phone service providers before finding Nextiva and I am so glad we did. Calls dont drop, support is quick to respond, the interface is so simple to use. It's where we do 60-65% of our business, so we have to make sure our phones are reliable. We don't worry about a thing with Nextiva!

title: Like the service overall. Easy to use....
review: Like the service overall. Easy to use. Getting calls and listening to my voicemails is really easy. I use a microphone which makes it easy to answer phone calls. I like getting emails when I step away and miss a phone call. it is just like having a landline except on the computer. It has been good so far.

title: We've been with Nextiva for about 6...
review: We've been with Nextiva for about 6 months and really have had no complaints. Their support is very helpful. Call quality is excellent, and we've had no outages since we started using them. I do wish I could do more of the really technical settings without contacting support but that's probably not the norm

title: The Nextiva call flow tool is SUPER...
review: The Nextiva call flow tool is SUPER user friendly. Adding new users, navigating permissions and teams is a breeze. The only down side is that the call flow system seems to be fragile at times? A small change can(but not always) result in the call flow deactivating itself. The helpdesk is VERY quick to fix any issue that may arise, so it takes some of the sting off of the situation.

title: This system is so easy to use. I love...
review:
This system is so easy to use. I love how easy it is to use on my cell phone as well. Faxing is super easy.
Customer service is top- notch. I have not had any bad experiences with them. Eve when the problem turns out to be something as simple as unplugging the phone to restart the program, they make you feel important.

cons: new support technicians need additional training
title: Nextiva allows our company to configure...
review: Nextiva allows our company to configure our phone systems for our ever changing needs. Whatever I can think up, they will make it happen. As long as your internet connection is good, their phone service works 24/7. Their support is really great, they can program and/or fix your issues for you or teach you how to do it yourself. I have learned so much from them.

title: Great phone, fax and text messaging...
review: Great phone, fax and text messaging system for a small business and the price point is definitely a bonus! A lot of features are available to allow you to tailor your phone system to your business needs. Switched to another carrier a few years ago but realized what a huge mistake that was, as they could not provide anywhere close to the options and features provided by 8x8!

title: We've been using Nextiva for several...
review: We've been using Nextiva for several years. It's been great to have a service that we can use in the office with desk phones but our remote staff can access via a cell phone app or desktop app. Whenever we need assistance, online chat support is quick to help resolve issues in real-time. We look forward to several more years to come.

title: The Nextiva Support has been great and...
review: The Nextiva Support has been great and the system works great also. Several nice features and you are able to customize it to meet your needs. I had several questions throughout the year and all of them were solved on the spot. Their dashboard is easy and user-friendly. We would recommend nextiva for your services.

pros: Customer support is quick to respond a to issues. The tutorials are good.
title: They provide great customer service....
review: They provide great customer service. The online "university" provides pretty good tutorials. The platform is intuitive. The only issues we ever have deal with connection reliability; which is an issue that has to do more with our internet service provider than the services 8x8 provides. I would recommend them.

title: The support experience is great because...
review: The support experience is great because if I have an issue I can not figure out, or needs extra troubleshooting, I can always call support and get some assistance and figure out the problem. We have been with the provider for a number of years, and there are still some things we get stumped on, so it helps to be able to work with support to get something figured out.

title: All the support tech I have reached to...
review: All the support tech I have reached to about efax, set up of efax and blocking phone numbers have all been so patient, courteous and very knowledgeable with the products and services that Nextiva offers. I hope to learn more about it because it's such a user-friendly service and if I have a question, I'm always routed to someone right away either by phone or chat.

cons: Interface can be slow at times
title: Our experience with Nextiva has been...
review:
Our experience with Nextiva has been great. We have experience absolutely no downtime and the online fax function is so easy to use!
The support staff, in our experience, was friendly and quick to help us find a solution to our needs.
Communication has been clear, fees written plainly - no hidden charges.

title: We have been using 8x8 for about 3...
review: We have been using 8x8 for about 3 years now. The VoIP portal has tons and tons of features, many of which we don't use but are still cool. You can do all kinds of things that are beneficial for business, but the feature that I like the most is that by using the smartphone app you can forward all of your office calls to your smartphone but still filter your calls based on whether they come to your personal number or through the app. I also like that you can set up business hours so the calls don't ring through to your phone after hours or on the weekends

title: We have been using 8X8 for several...
review: We have been using 8X8 for several years now. I rarely have a customer service issue, but when I do, the response is prompt and thorough. The follow-up is exceptional, and any concerns are resolved. There are many resources and guides available, which is very helpful, also. I especially appreciate 8X8 Work, which allows for texting, faxing and phone calls right through the computer.

cons: Not able to label extensions to know what option customer selected in IVR
pros: The ease of use and setup.
title: I'm glad I did my research online...
review: I'm glad I did my research online about 8X8 I was stuck in a nasty contract with Vonage and the poor customer service and difficulty to use options on the desktop version of the business app was a nightmare. I was able to upload what I want customers to hear when calling my company and they can hear all of the recordings from beginning to end which is an issue with vonage. The options to set up after hours or if you are not available are great. Vonage makes you pay for each number one for the auto-attendant and then another to be able to receive the calls when making the selection in the IVR I was paying over $40.00 per month which is insane. I would recommend any small business owner on the go use 8X8.

cons: If you don't know your password, you're support is delayed
pros: Everything is accessible through online services. You don't have to call in only to be put on hold forever. Yo
title: I'm new to Nextiva but so far it's...
review:
I'm new to Nextiva but so far it's been a positive experience. Last month the company I worked at was using ShoreTel but I find Nextiva a bit more user friendly. I would love to get a user guide though so that I can truly take full advantage of all the features of my phone system.

I tried looking or the user guide online but wasn't successful. I was only able to find a cheat sheet that shows some of the basic features.

title: Once we signed up for Nextiva we were...
review:
Once we signed up for Nextiva we were left to contact support with any questions about set up. Support was very helpful, since then we have been in contact with support on multiple occasions which has solved the issues.

One down fall is having to deactivate the entire call flow to make adjustments. This makes our 24/7 business vulnerable to missed calls if we have to adjust the call flow or work with support over an issue.

Calls are a little sketchy at times and it doesn't always flow the way we have set it up, but support has been a good help.

title: Chris was extremely helpful with my...
review: Chris was extremely helpful with my login issues that we were having and I would highly recommend him. I was having difficulty getting multiple profiles set up on my web browser and he is very patient and courteous in solving my various login issues. I took about 30 minutes to solve everything completely

title: Knowledgeable, very patient, and both...
review: Knowledgeable, very patient, and both agents I dealt with were extremely helpful, and resolved my issue. Highly recommended. Call took a long time, and involved a transfer to s differing Department, but it was all handled very professionally. They were available to assist me on a Sunday, which was a very pleasant surprise.

title: I would really recommend using nextiva...
review: I would really recommend using nextiva to others with excellent service and customer support. Installation is quick and easy . No one can beat. I called the customer support and without any hesitation they help us on our inquiry and they never leave us during the process. I would give nextiva my 5 stars because they deserve it.

title: We have been using ringcentral for 3...
review: We have been using ringcentral for 3 years, but can't wait to change. They have terrible customer services. We had two phone lines with them for the last 3 years. All of sudden, one line is dead. We called them and their rep kept saying our second phone was not added in the system. She never bothered to find out the issue. Instead, she told us that we have the issue of not adding the phone. All the abroad agents did not understand and listen to the issues properly. It will take forever to have an issue resolved. Run!

title: We have been with Nextiva for about 3...
review: We have been with Nextiva for about 3 yrs now, and love the system. The support staff is very helpful and patient with us trying to explain what we need. My most recent experience via chat with Taisia F was absolutely wonderful. I appreciated her willingness to work with me. I felt like it was a complex issue we were having but she solved it very quickly.

title: 8x8 equipment is fairly priced, quality...
review: 8x8 equipment is fairly priced, quality equipment with technically savvy staff. In today's world, can't really ask for more. I've been an 8x8 client for over 10 years and many VOIP companies have approached me to switch, but quite honestly I could not find a reason that would motivate me to consider making the switch.

pros: Pretty easy to setup and use!
title: I looooooooooooooove 8x8! Affordable,...
review: I looooooooooooooove 8x8! Affordable, easy to understand, and at this time, it meets my needs! We use it for our business and I believe we haven’t had any problem with this company. I would love to recommend it to anyone looking for an affordable and reliable business phone. I would like to see if it works when we are out of the country.

pros: IVR, supports BYO Phone on my preferred Cisco device
title: The overall service is consistent and...
review: The overall service is consistent and reliable, the iOS application more than meets out needs when team members are remote. The IVR feature assigned to our main line more than meets our call routing and sales management needs after a little learning curve. Overall, bargain for the features and service.

title: She was very friendly and was able to...
review: She was very friendly and was able to complete the task. Alot of people had looked this over and transferred the task to her. Shen found the issue and solved it. Im very busy and had to put her on hold a lot to help my customers and she was very polite and humble about me putting her on so many times.

title: Our business representative and...
review: Our business representative and customer support are always great and responsive with Nextiva! Phones and devices are easy to use, install and manage. I have not come across an issue with our Nextiva devices that I could not easily replace myself or have support help replace/fix. Nextiva has a great range of devices for all VOIP needs.

title: 8x8 has been an extremely simple-to-use...
review: 8x8 has been an extremely simple-to-use phone system. It works great for our remote users. We have never had any outages or performance issues. The setup is no 100% intuitive, but they have a great team to help you get everything set up and configured. We can add extensions and physical phones very easily. 8x8 service is very affordable. I highly recommend 8x8.

title: I was with Comcast and eventually...
review:
I was with Comcast and eventually wanted to find a more affordable phone company. I didn't need an unlimited plan but that was all Comcast offered. My main concerns with switching were reliability and call quality.

After researching I came across reviews for 1-VoIP. I ordered the service and crossed my fingers. I was VERY pleasantly surprised with 1-VoIP.
The call quality is clear. The service is reliable and much more affordable than Comcast. I'm saving over $50 per month with 1-Voip. I have the value plan for $8.97 per month. After taxes it's $13.97. I don't know if taxes vary by state or not. The plan has 500 minutes of outbound calls (about 8 hours and 33 minutes) and unlimited inbound calls each month. That's more than enough for me.

1-VoIP offers way more features than I need. So I can't comment on them all. I'm old school. I place one call at a time and hang up when I'm finished.

The customer service is excellent. They are knowledgeable, friendly and speak perfect English.

If you need a voip landline from a solid company give 1-VoIP a try.

title: We have the enterprise plan.  Working...
review: We have the enterprise plan. Working with support has always been above expectations. The call quality is very good. The platform has lots of legacy phone provider features for those migrating from existing systems, but then they have added features for enhancing the experience. We have been a customer for almost a year and I would select Nextiva again.

cons: App. It seems to need some love and attention.
title: Very responsive.  Huge improvement to...
review:
Very responsive. Huge improvement to go to 24/7 support. Nextiva struggled when the Ukraine was invaded, but it has recovered very nicely. Support is definitely a strong selling point.
The system is very easy to self-administer. When I do need to reference it, the online training material that is available has proved very sufficient.

Nextiva does offers many features we do not use.

title: We live in a very rural area of Idaho...
review: We live in a very rural area of Idaho and run a business from our home. Our local telephone company wanted $37,000.00 to run the phone line half a mile to our property. My brother recommended 8x8, and we could not be happier. 8x8 handles both our business phone and fax line. I highly recommend them, and their service is phenomenal.

cons: If your Internet drops then your call also will drop.
pros: Having a landline is key when working from home
title: I have been using 8x8 for the last 3-4...
review: I have been using 8x8 for the last 3-4 years while working from home. I find it to be very useful and reliable. I would recommend having the highest quality of Internet available so that your calls do not drop. That is the one downside. Other than that, I am very pleased with the service, support, and price.

cons: The updating process is too often and nd shuts everything down
title: Service has been well. I am just now...
review: Service has been well. I am just now well with the updating process. It is too often and it shuts down our entire system and if that one person isnt here that knows how to restart it then its disaster. All in all the system has served us and we have not actually used all the features as yet. perhaps some training from you guys could help.

title: We were having issues with assigning a...
review: We were having issues with assigning a phone number to one of our users. I live chatted with Tonia B. and she helped us get everything sorted and honestly, I wouldn't have been able to figure it out on my own. It was simple and easy to get in touch with customer support and get the help I needed. Nextiva has been great to us!

title: Although we had navigate from regular...
review: Although we had navigate from regular phone lines over to VIOP, overall, we have enjoyed our experience with Nextiva. The technical support has been responsive and has been able to understand and correct whatever programming issues we have had with timely solutions. We appreciate all the guidance and expertise that we have received. Thank you!

title: Steer clear of Nextiva unless you're...
review: Steer clear of Nextiva unless you're willing to be committed for life! While we were actively using the phone system it was OK, but when we had questions or needed help good luck. Once we learned we could get better hardware and service for literally half the price, we started trying to cancel our account at the anniversary. That's when the fun really started. We were first told "oh, you can cancel anytime. Don't worry about it". Of course this is not true. You cannot reach anyone EVER who has the authority to help you out. It has been over a months worth of calls, emails, new ticket numbers and "we'll have a manager call you back", none of which has led to any progress in cancelling this account. We've been disconnected, placed on hold for over an hour multiple times and generally ignored while trying to terminate this relationship. We have filed an FTC complaint against Nextiva in the hopes that this may motivate someone somewhere to release us. At this point, they are either A) incompetent, or B) doing this on purpose. Are they hoping we just give up and pay in perpetuity? That is what it feels like! Nextiva has been one of the worst customer experiences I have had in 40 years of work and that's saying something. Beware - enter at your own risk!

title: Excellent resource to have for work...
review: Excellent resource to have for work because it allows you to work remotely w/o having to use your personal phone, keeps track of calls, and easy to use. I can just past the recipient's phone number and press a button on the screen. Customer support is helpful when there is a problem. They will reinstall if necessary remotely.

title: I enjoy using 8x8 because it provides...
review: I enjoy using 8x8 because it provides me a way to contact clients on my personal cell phone without using my personal phone number. I like that I am able to both call, text, and send pictures. Because of the features like being able to text, I am able to reach clients that prefer that method over things like calls.

title: Good company to have Good company to...
review: Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have Good company to have

title: I have been with 8x8 for over 5 years....
review: I have been with 8x8 for over 5 years. I love that the service is always working. Customer service is one of the best I have worked with. Simple to use but has a lot of awesome features. My go-to telephone system for all my companies and future companies I will own. Expansion is easy and offer great telephone products to work right along with my company

title: Very good service.  Easy to use. Helps...
review: Very good service. Easy to use. Helps my staff stay productive. I would recommend this to any business as a way to keep connected. Important for teams working to keep clients happy. Extremely helpful for small business where you can’t always be at your desk. No brainer in todays remote work world.

title: Lots of features.  But for a small...
review:
Lots of features. But for a small office, probably more than necessary. Great sales and install but support is inefficient. But when the right person gets involved, issues get resolved.

Mobile app is very good as is the desktop app. Voice mail is ok but need different code for each extension.

title: Nextiva has been an outstanding product...
review: Nextiva has been an outstanding product and service for our company. We needed a new phone provider and after vetting several options, we went with Nextiva. Customer service has been first rate from the initial contact right thru the implementation. Would definitely recommend Nextiva to anyone looking for a Voip system for their business.

cons: Many Updates to Desktop & Phone Appsss
title: We've used several phone providers...
review: We've used several phone providers over the years and 8x8 has been fantastic! The service and support has been very responsive. The call quality has been good with the desktop or phone app. We are very happy with the texting feature and notifications from their system with regards to messages, voicemails or missed calls. We are very happy with 8x8 and highly recommend!

title: Overall, so far we are happier with...
review: Overall, so far we are happier with Nextiva than we were with our previous provider. The features we are getting are much better. However, the customer service team has let us down multiple times (both in terms of wait time and quality) and we wish it were better. We'd still recommend it and will continue to use the platform as the call flows, analytics, and flexibility provided by the platform is currently exactly what we need.

title: We have been very happy since switching...
review: We have been very happy since switching to 8x8 over a year ago. We were previously using a Toshiba PBX with service through one of the major telecomms companies. There really is no comparison: setup is easy, it has great features, very qood quality calls, the cost is unbeatable and customer support has been prompt and efficient. All our employees use the 8x8 Work app, which has improved a lot since we first started using it, and has become a key tool in our organization.

title: Great reliable service with an...
review: Great reliable service with an excellent customer service department and great tech support. When you call the way they take care of you it makes you feel like you are the number priority for them. As per their tech support department, they go way above and beyond your expectations. They truly value you as a customer.

title: great service, been with them for over...
review: great service, been with them for over a year and no issues. easy to multitask put customers oh hold and transfer calls to other agents. I love how we can chat with each employee and also a group chat reviewing customer information or any info necessary to continue our jobs without having the customer to listen to what we are asking each other. def. recommend this phone service provider.

title: I have been working remote for my...
review: I have been working remote for my company for over a year now, and 8X8 is a communication solution that is ideal in every way for what I need to operate my business, using phone and texting. Their system has worked perfectly all this time, and when I reach out to their support team with questions, it is always fast, friendly and excellent service that I receive. And best of all, they charge a fair monthly price for their system.

title: We were looking for a system to use to...
review: We were looking for a system to use to be able to set hours of operation. Since we work out of our homes, we used our home numbers which left us open to be contacted 24/7-365. 8X8 has been a God send in helping us with being able to keep business hours. It is very easy to set up different settings when going on vacation or taking a day off. And it can be personalized by each person. So glad that we were told about 8X8 as it has worked wonderfully for us.

title: So far 8*8 has worked perfect for the...
review: So far 8*8 has worked perfect for the marketing part of our music academy business. We contact our potential clients using their tools and then manage our communications on an easy way. Service has always been reliable and their platform works on a variety of devices (phone, app, browser app). Their highlight is their customer support. They are always helpful.

title: We have been using Nextiva now for the...
review:
We have been using Nextiva now for the past 3 years and we love it. The main benefit is the ease of setup and access to support when we need it. I would definitely recommend small to medium size business to use this service.

On a side note, we loved it so much that we become an integrator for them!

cons: unreliable, poor support, misrepresentation of "free" international calling (blocks tons of countires and #s)
title: As a FORMER long time customer, I gave...
review:
As a FORMER long time customer, I gave chance after chance and beyond for many years to clean up their act. Reliability and support are beyond pathetic, so my advice is only consider use for a non-primary/cheap backup line or forwarding number as you may not be able to receive or make calls at any given point...
-support can take easily a hold of 20+ minutes to get someone during their advertised hours, nobody responds at times to online chat support from the web site during advertised hours, and then poor support on top of that!
-unreliable SIP server for BYOD devices (e.g. sip client on phone vs. supplied router)
-many events where the service is just completely down with no warnings and not acknowledging most downtimes
-Complete misrepresentation about free international calls for 60 min/month - undisclosed until signed up about severe restrictions to the list of countries plus specifics of carrier and/or type (mobile, landline, etc.) claiming it's due to too much fraudulent calling
-totally botched data center move and lack of redundancy to have stable service - claim that things are fixed and stable that clearly never are and had to fight to get credit for non-working service for several months (e.g. no ring for incoming calls and straight to voicemail, fully down, can't connect to supposedly "working" server(s), etc.)
-made it difficult to switch carriers on the way out claiming they have no control over porting out with nonsense that they don't and can't create a pin for it that many other phone providers require (repeatedly said for the new provider to put in 0000 or 1234 which clearly didn't work in my case and finally I got them to create a pin after several interactions with "support")
-denied my pro-rated refund when I left before end of term

title: Tech support was very helpful in...
review: Tech support was very helpful in addressing an issue. They persistently followed up. The gentleman was very communicative. As for the service itself, I use 8x8 for work and no one I call can tell that I am using a VOIP. The audio quality is clear, plus the text feature is very handy for getting in touch with clients who prefer messaging.

title: support and setup with 8x8 was fast and...
review: support and setup with 8x8 was fast and easy. Whenever there is an issue I can usually find documentation for help, however, when I do need to call, the support team are knowledgeable and quick to fix the issue. I've had very little to no downtime with the service. The only thing I would critique is that some FAQ articles are out of date and should be hidden from the public.

title: Ringcentral tried to steal my money....
review:
Ringcentral tried to steal my money. Closed my account, they said I would get the balance refunded but never did. Had to fight through the credit card company to get my money back. Avoid these jackasses!

When we initially had Ringcentral for just faxing, it was fine. But later they tried to become like Slack and started adding way too many features that were really buggy. At one point, it pretty much became impossible to use the service because we simply could not log into our account. We had to contact support every time for help logging in.

So we switched to Hellofax. We had an annual contract and asked Ringcentral to close the account and refund the balance. They said they would but never did. Called them many times spending hours but each time it was some other rep. who was supposed to handle it didn't do their job. Had to file a dispute with the credit card company. Even then they tried to renege on paying. Not a good company.

cons: Set up took longer than expected
pros: Ease of Use and Call Clarify
title: I LOVE their services thus far.   But...
review: I LOVE their services thus far. But full disclosure we ported our numbers (a bit confusing) and we brought our own equipment - they worked with us through that process and reprogramming the phones took more time and trouble shooting than expected but it's saved us a lot by being able to use this equipment and their advanced support group has been awesome!

title: While 8x8 does service it's purpose in...
review: While 8x8 does service it's purpose in terms of providing customer service for your company, getting support help is very difficult. There are a couple of amazing support specialists (Eric) but other than that, don't rely on getting help in a timely or efficient manner if something goes wrong. Support for this service should be top notch considering it is the communication method between customer and company.

title: The Nextiva support has helped me...
review: The Nextiva support has helped me immensely. They are patient, efficient, and very knowledgeable . I especially appreciate how efficient the chat support is. I work in a busy office and often times do not have time to be on the phone. Everyone I have an encountered has also been extremely friendly. Thank you!

cons: None so far, only been two months on their package so don’t have enough time to report accurately.
pros: Incredible value for money, intuitive app and quick setup process. Customer support is excellent too!
title: It just works, very similar to the...
review: It just works, very similar to the other options out there but they have cheaper plans. This is the biggest reason why I switched and have stuck thus far. Plus their helpful staff made porting a breeze, so much so that it only took a little while to get things in order. Really happy with the purchase decision especially because of the massive savings over the other popular options.

cons: Been using it for a little while right now so I’ll get back to report with more details. Read the review for the complete picture.
pros: Been using it for a little while right now so I’ll get back to report with more details. Read the review for the complete picture.
title: I’ve had Vonage for as long as I can...
review: I’ve had Vonage for as long as I can remember and had it setup on my phone and the home-office line too. But the two lines cost me double digits and in this day and age, this simply wasn’t doable anymore. I considered removing VOIP entirely but I was told of Axvoice, and the rates alone have me converted. So far, it is indistinguishable from Vonage – except for the pricing of course. Lol

cons: Admin tools across functions are separate
title: We started with Nextiva back in Q4 of...
review:
We started with Nextiva back in Q4 of 2019 with just a handful of users. We now are over 200 users with other products turned on like contact center, auto attendants, IVR, etc. Overall, the system is easy to use and manage. It's very much self service, so you can do many tasks on your own.

For the end user, the options of physical phone, mobile app, or soft phone for PCs provides great flexibility.

I will say that the system does feel like it's a series of products that were built by different providers, and bolted together. This is from an administrator perspective. Some of the admin interfaces are completely different than others, depending on if you're managing new lines, the call center, or the IVR. It all works together, but you have separate URLs, IDs and passwords for each subsystem, and the UI for each is drastically different.

There are a few things we'd like to see added to the product suite, like intelligent chat for the call center, and better reporting, but for the price, we haven't found anything with the feature set we get. We will pay much more should we decide to move to a more advanced platform.

title: I love their support chat option,...
review: I love their support chat option, definitely better for me than calling. Always friendly representatives. From time to time I've needed technical help and they've always been able to guide me through it. Would definitely recommend if you do remote work with any employees, as support is always available they're always connected via desktop app or mobile device when they're away.

pros: FAST, easy to use- support easy for end users.
title: 8x8 is very easy to work with. Their...
review: 8x8 is very easy to work with. Their staff is knowledgable and friendly and always helpful and easy to understand. I was most impressed when we needed to reach support. The wait time was minutes, with my administrative issue quickly resolved. Issues resolved with one call. Terrific customer service and support.

title: Nextiva has greatly simplified our...
review: Nextiva has greatly simplified our office telecommunications and simultaneously reduced costs. And to date, we've had zero issues or downtime. Transfer from our previous provder was seamless and their support team was always accessible throughout that process. Truly a great service that I feel comfortable recommending.

title: I've been using Nextiva for a few...
review: I've been using Nextiva for a few years; it has been a very reliable service. I am only now using the advanced features like voicemail to email (a gamechanger) and the Nextiva App, which is super convenient for taking the show on the road while still being able to use your cell phone to call from the "office." All in all, I would not hesititate to use them if I had to do it all over again.

title: We have started using Nextiva VoIP...
review: We have started using Nextiva VoIP phone service a few months ago and so far are VERY satisfied with the quality. Our support staff are located overseas, despite that we get good enough calling quality. We were pleasantly surprised by the speed of answers we got through Nextiva Chat support. It was simply amazing. Pricing is OK compared to what we were paying before for a legacy phone system. The self-administered Call Flow feature is great too. Got our two 1-800 numbers ported to Nextiva quickly enough. It was our first VoIP business phone and the overall impression is very good. We hope the service stays at such a high level.

title: Both the phone and app work great. I...
review: Both the phone and app work great. I can't think of what more we would need from a cloud phone service. Most of all, I love that almost anything can be changed and/or solved via the chat or email. We're all busy and not spending a ton of time on the phone going back and forth is a major plus. Sales and support are super responsive via the chat and email.

title: We joined a month ago and I started...
review: We joined a month ago and I started using their phones. Within 2 weeks I couldnt send a text but I could receive it. I contact them and have been waiting for a Tier 2 Rep/Tech Support Rep to fix my phones. Every day I have to call 3-4 times a day begging to talk with a Tier 2 rep and every time I am told everyone is busy and they will call. No one ever calls. I finally got into the habit of waiting for someone to talk to me. They would put me on for 45 minutes and apologize for the problems and say they understand that ive been able to work for 2 weeks because the phones arent working. Ive been told for the last week that an account manager will call me.... funny thing NO ONE EVER CALLS. Every time I call Im asked my number, email address, company name, case number etc. The reps couldnt even spell out my email address correctly so of course I never got a notification. Ive asked to speak with a supervisor and I was told no. One time I called it sounded like the rep was in the bathroom. Can you hire people that WANT to do their job? Can you hire people that do as they say they will do. Youre tech support and customer support service is BEYOND POOR. I wouldnt refer your business to my worst enemy. Ive been unable to work for 2 weeks and not once have they offered a compensation for it. Not once have they CALLED me. Ive messaged them on Facebook and theyve ignored me. Ive posted reviews on Facebook and theyre also ignored. I email 10 times a day and Im ignored. They have NO PROS.

title: Nextiva is super easy to use and set...
review:
Nextiva is super easy to use and set up! Our operators have no issues when calling us and the calls are clear.

The customer service is always easy to use and they are very friendly. The auto attendant is a great feature and really helps streamline our office. I recommend this service to anyone in a small office.

title: The support team was quick in phone...
review: The support team was quick in phone /email communication and response. It Took a little too long to actually find the issue/problem, but once found, it was resolved quickly. I would recommend this platform and overall satisfied with the professionalism and quick response of tech support when issues do arise.

title: I cannot answer every second call that...
review: I cannot answer every second call that comes into my office. This is a law office and is happening on all the phones. I have been calling Ooma every day trying to get help to fix this problem. They keep saying that tier 3 will call me back, but no one calls. I am trying to go on vacation and take my office with us, so all I want is for this to work.

title: Overall, 8x8 is a good system/program...
review:
Overall, 8x8 is a good system/program and I would recommend it. I haven't had any significant downtime or technical issues, really, and the call quality is pretty good as well.

I do wish the actual programming with the system was easier to understand and a bit more user-friendly. Certain things can be confusing at times. Support is always helpful, and overall the system works well.

title: I took a subscription to 8x8 meetings...
review: I took a subscription to 8x8 meetings to have extra features such as session recording, and I'm happy with the service which works as intended. I was fortunate to get an excellent deal during a promotion period so that I only pay $2 a month for my account. The regular price is much higher, so if pricing is an issue you might wait for such an offer. I have occasional cases when screen sharing does not work properly.

title: Very pleased for 10 + years with my 8x8...
review:
Very pleased for 10 + years with my 8x8 business phones, app on mobile, toll free number, virtual office + e-fax system. Bravo 8x8.

The services keep on improving over time too. Their technology keep progressing and making my life easier. Big savings, and excellent quality.
Do yourself a favor and try it!

title: Since our company is hiring out of...
review: Since our company is hiring out of state assistants we are required to use VOIP and Nextiva is an excellent application to use. Aside from that, they have the best customer service. They will help you and will be patient with you no matter how busy they are. They treat their customers like babies :)

title: Glad to have been set up with an 8x8...
review: Glad to have been set up with an 8x8 account at my new employer. Had never used it before, but it's intuitive, packed with more features than I expected and has become the main hub of my sales battlestation. Rare to have an issue, with 8x8 but if you ever do their support team is responsive and helpful!

title: Ooma is the only voip I have ever used....
review: Ooma is the only voip I have ever used. I even recommended it to others. It started out great, clear signal, modem functioned flawlessly, no problems. Over the 6 years I have used it it became progressively worse and worse. Now it just doesn't work at all. It went from working well in the beginning to the modem not re-setting after a call, giving that fast busy signal, then dead air. Re-booting the modem 2-3 times would sometimes clear it, although it became common for it to not work for several days after it was stuck like this. Now it's just completely non-functional, with the blue light logo supposedly indicating it is booted up and ready. Another thing...if the power blips off it takes the modem 2-3 minutes to re-boot. Customer service was ok, they actually sent me a new modem when my last one began acting up, but all too soon, it became even worse than the original one. My honest appraisal is, their equipment is just not built well, not built to last. I would not recommend this service to anyone or ever use it again.

cons: No provision to block spam FAXes
pros: Easy to transition between handset, desk top, and mobile app.Voice quality is excellent
title: The services have proved highly...
review:
The services have proved highly reliable. We rely on our communication technology very heavily and 8x8 certainly meets our demands.
It would be nice to be able to integrate more calendars than Outlook and Google, use custom FAX cover sheets to meet agency requirements, and a folder structure for the calls, FAXes, and messages.

title: Its great to see a team that will not...
review: Its great to see a team that will not only respond incredibly quickly, but also resolves your issue just as quick! A rare find these days!

title: This company is horrible!!!!!  Do not...
review: This company is horrible!!!!! Do not use! First of all, their website is buggy. If you attempt to set up simultaneous ring, the website displays an error message. After getting tech support to set it up, it will work for a month, then stop working all of sudden. I just got tired of babysitting and fixing this issue. I rely on simultaneous ring for my business. This company does shoddy work at best. Also, I paid for 1 year of service all at once. After 5 months, I cancelled the service and they WILL NOT give me a refund for the remaining 7 months. I'm telling you, DO NOT BUY VOIP SERVICE from this company!

title: The system itself actually does work at...
review: The system itself actually does work at the phone when you try to do things within the system, ie download bulk, buy voice recordings, or setup Webex because they've changed the system. It's a pain to get the system to be administrated properly. And support, although they are polite, do not know what they're doing most of the time. I would stay away from BT and try to you than another VoIP system from another company.

title: We were satisfied with this provider...
review:
We were satisfied with this provider for many years but recently their support went down the hill tremendously. My issue was never resolved and they passed the bug to Microsoft. Also, the SLA in their ticketing system was never met. My P1 ticket was answered more than a day later via email instead of a phone call.
Other than that their product is robust for a reasonable price.

cons: Unreliable Service, Ineffective Support, Unaouthorized Billings
title: I canceled service with cause...
review: I canceled service with cause consistent with the contracted terms, including a notice to cure period. This was after multiple instances where our company phone lines were down for 24+ hours without explanation or assistance. Service requests regularly went un-responded to. After I canceled they continued to pull funds for several months. They To top it all of, they've attempted to charge me an outrageous cancellation fee even after acknowledging that my notice to cure and termination was in fact received. No one responds other than to say they're looking into it.

title: I have been a user of the 1-VoiP...
review: I have been a user of the 1-VoiP service for at least 5 years and every time I have had occasion to call the support line, even for things I could have looked up in the user manual, I have received nothing but absolute top grade service and professionalism. Having a USA based customer support service is a big deal as far as I am concerned and I can wholeheartedly recommend 1-VoiP for anyone looking for a VoiP provider. In an industry with not too much to differentiate the offerings, Service becomes the Unique Selling Point and I give 1-Voip 10/10 for this.

title: The system is somehow intricate,...
review:
The system is somehow intricate, however, I think the design concept
is to integrate functions and usability to give the clients the option to
scale up. Simple or complex setups and fixes to the setups driven by the client's business model are made easier by its adept technical support personnel.

pros: When I have problems I can get ahold of someone to help
title: We have used 8x8 for several years now....
review: We have used 8x8 for several years now. Even though our staff is geographically distant 8x8 makes it seem like we're in the next room. Our customers do not have any problems reaching us. The line quality is excellent. Their 8x8 Work software integrates my phone with my desktop computer while my coworkers choose to use their cell phones and laptops all seamlessly. I would recommend 8x8.

title: Ring Central was the WORST decision...
review: Ring Central was the WORST decision ever! Calls dropped all the time, and HORRIBLE customer service! You can NEVER get through to a live person & 2 months AFTER canceling the service I'm still getting billed & having to FIGHT to get rid of this terrible service!! I DO NOT recommend this service to anyone!

title: 8x8 has resolved every issue that I...
review:
8x8 has resolved every issue that I have reached out to support for, and I very much enjoy speaking with their agents over the phone.
Not only do they resolve issues, they also help me by educating me on features, functionality, and navigating the web portal. 8x8 offers screen sharing, I have experienced this support and I do value it very much.

title: I had a quick question about setting up...
review: I had a quick question about setting up new service and Paul at Voiply responded rapidly. Not only that, he provided an excellent solution to my issue and got me set up in a very short time. So far, I'm extremely pleased with the support and service. I have yet to use it long-term, but if the first day is any indication it will be great.

title: Our experience with 8 x 8 has been good...
review: Our experience with 8 x 8 has been good since we started with them. It was easy to setup 8 x 8 and make changes to numbers as and add lines as needed. The reliability has been good and we have experienced no issues with dropped calls, etc. When we have needed support we have been able to easily resolve issues.

cons: I need to reset system (unplug) it
pros: Can use it for remote calls
title: The system is typically running fine....
review:
The system is typically running fine. However, it seems to freeze up and simply unplugging and plugging back in seems to fix the issue. Other than that, no complaints.
Customer service can be challenging when I need to call. The language barrier that creates a challenge in understanding what information is being provided.

cons: No way to update credit card online
title: I used phone power for almost 10 years....
review:
I used phone power for almost 10 years. When google voice and OBI had their spat in the mid teens, OBI recommended phonepower as an alternative, so I used them and liked them. Since then it is has gone DOWNHILL.

Most recently, my credit card was hacked and I found there was no way to update the info online at Phonepower. So when the card started failing for them, they simply cancelled me without even trying to call me. Now I need to try to rescue my phone number with a port while everyone who calls me fails.

Phonepower sucks. Stay away.

title: RingCentral is an awesome company, they...
review:
RingCentral is an awesome company, they understand our company's mission and want to help us succeed.

My superiors and my coworkers all use this application with voice, fax, text, conferencing, and web meetings. There is no need to use separate applications for your day-to-day calls, conferencing, and online meetings.

We love it and it is a daily part of our work lives and culture.

cons: If you have an issue, good luck!
title: We have been using Ring Central for a...
review:
We have been using Ring Central for a few years and use it for our small business. We continue to have issues with our system dropping calls, and the answering function not working. Our latest issue has lasted two weeks and each time you talk to their support they ask you to "monitor for the next 24 to 48 hours". When you update the case, they ignore the notes. All they are paid to do is close cases, I'm sure of it.

Support is nearly impossible to reach and when you do, you are on the phone with them for hours getting nowhere. We had to open a new case after they closed the initial only because they didn't troubleshoot at all and jumped the gun. Don't even waste your time with their Escalate button. I'm convinced that's no different than pushing a button to cross the street, it just gives the delusion that you're doing something.

The functionality of Ring Central is good when it works, but their service and support are a disaster. I would just love to have competent troubleshooting skills for a VOIP company. You would think that's their bread and butter, but evidently not.

title: This is the only VoIP phone we have...
review: This is the only VoIP phone we have used, as we switched to this from a traditional phone, and it has been great! The mobile app is glitchy at times and the call quality isn't the greatest on their, but calls on our Cisco desk phones are almost flawless. The customer support at Nextiva has been great! Enough to make up for any issues there might be with the service!

title: Overall, 8x8 has been a decent enough...
review:
Overall, 8x8 has been a decent enough move for our company. I'm not sure why we paid for the elevated installation assistance, as I ended up doing the majority of it on my own.
