Service has been reliable (though our old vendor set a pretty low bar for that) but heaven help you if you actually need support. Calling into the support line is often simply yelling into the void: lots of transfers and finger pointing and waiting for resolution. 4 months is my current ticket record length. Thankfully, we haven't needed them often enough to sour my view overall of the service.

TLDR: If you can avoid needing service, you can do worse.

cons: Lack of capability to move a user between locations.
title: We just switched over from Verizon One...
review:
We just switched over from Verizon One Talk. Nextiva is a far easier service to get running compared to Verizon. What really stands out is their call flow system. The system uses a visual flowchart to show you the path your calls take. You can setup several of these depending on your circumstances. The teams section is also helpful. We run two businesses out of the same building and we can make this work with Nextiva’s system.

There are a few kinks I would love to see them iron out. It would be great to seamlessly move users to different locations. Right now that’s not an easy process. Also, I would love to have the ability to delete teams (currently not possible).

cons: A little bit of a learning curve
title: So far everything has been exceptional....
review:
So far everything has been exceptional. Very good client onboarding. Absolutely everything has worked as promised.

Only con, and it is a minor one, is that you do need to dedicate a couple hours to learning the system and setting it up. But they are there to help the whole way.

You get way more than you pay for with 8x8.

title: Nataliia was AMAZING!  Patient and...
review: Nataliia was AMAZING! Patient and thorough. A+++++ Great representative. She was able to assist me with a few items that were causing us trouble and stuck with me until the issue had been completely resolved. It's exceptionally hard to find representatives that are as concerned, helpful and attentive as Nataliia.

title: Our company of about 50 employees have...
review:
Our company of about 50 employees have been a Vonage Business customer for 7+ years. During that time "customer care"/support as gone from what I would say was good to absolutely horrible the last 2 years.

I used to be able to call support and speak with a person who could help me with any problem in under 15 mins. Support and overall service has significantly declined since 2018. A support call today (late May 2022) resulted in an nearly 2 hour call, where I was transferred 3 times and eventually disconnected. The background chatter of other agents on this call was so bad it was difficult to communicate with my agent. I spent nearly 2 hrs. trying to explain my basic needs (i.e. to add an new office location to our account). In the end I politely asked to speak with a manager. I was told they were all very busy and they couldn't take my call.

I want to be clear here that my review isn't based on this one support call but on the gradual worsening of support at Vonage over the last 4 years. I feel it is so bad at this point that I'm actively looking for another VoIP vendor. It is frustrating too since many of you know how difficult it is to move from one VoIP provider to another. So, I *would not* recommend Vonage Business. Save yourself the frustration and added cost of the now horrible support offered by this VoIP provider.

title: Great Service, agents are always...
review: Great Service, agents are always helpful and reliable. Promptly answered all of my questions and assisted me when setting up my computer to take calls from home. Taking calls from home has never been easier. Would recommend this service to businesses and employees working from office and remotely.

title: FUNCTIONS OF PHONES STARTED ADEQUATELY....
review: FUNCTIONS OF PHONES STARTED ADEQUATELY. BUT THEN ISSUES LATER. ***INSTALLER*** WAS RUDE, CONDESCENDING AND ARROGANT. GAVE NO SUPPORT. ONLINE REP WHO GAVE TUTORIAL WAS NO HELP AT ALL. TOO FAST AND NOT PATIENT. THE PRIME LINE SERVICE REP WAS SUPPORTIVE AND THE NEXTIVA PHONE REP WAS SUPPORTIVE. THE NEXTIVA ISSUES WITH EFAXES CONTINUES TO BE A BIG PROBLEM WITH MULTIPLE OFFIES TELLING US THEY CANNOT GET THROUGH. AND WE ARE HAVING TO SEND FAXES THROUGH OUR ANALOG FAX TO MANY AS WELL. SOME OF OUR OFFICES ARE HAND DELIVERING PAPERWORK THAT ARE LOCAL. OR MAILING IF OUT OF AREA.

title: Very pleased especially with the sales...
review: Very pleased especially with the sales and support staff at Nextiva. They are friendly and happy to help. The price is a bit better than we had with our old VoIP provider, and you'll have a contact person in sales you can reach directly with questions. Configuring an IP phone was fast and simple, done over chat with tech support. I have an auto-attendant and a call queue for my business. I found plenty of options that can make the phone system do whatever I need it to do. There could be a bit of a learning curve if you have a complex setup, but support is happy to help, so it's nothing to be afraid of. Just open a chat. Pleased so far.

title: The sales team was very helpful when I...
review:
The sales team was very helpful when I was deciding which provider to go with, and support was even more helpful to get my account setup and my numbers ported quickly.

Anna S. from Customer Support was very fast with helping me set up my IP Phones.

The iPhone and PC Desktop app is exactly what I wanted from a VoIP serice.

title: We have had Ring Central for a few...
review:
We have had Ring Central for a few years now and use it for a Retail and Commercial Sales Business. We continue to have issues with our systems going out and requiring resets. Our latest issue has lasted now 6 days and going and is costing us $1,000's in sales and labor to try to work around it and get it fixed.

Support is nearly impossible to reach and when you do, you are on the phone with them for hours often times getting no where. They claimed yesterday on day 5 that they resolved the issue and within minutes of getting this notification, our systems went out again and when we tried to email them back in the same thread, our email was blocked and we were forced to start a NEW CLAIM!

The functionality of Ring Central seems good, but their service and support is a nightmare when forced to use it. If they fix that, it would be solid. Maybe they will read this and actually work to fix our issue!

title: We had a problem with the setup process...
review: We had a problem with the setup process and your repersenative, Sipepa Faga, was an absolute pleasure to speak with and solved our issues. We really appreciate how well she knew the system and explained it to us completely. She would make sure I understood before we moved to the next section. We love Nextiva and will definitely recommend it!

title: Anna S, was patient and helpful. She...
review: Anna S, was patient and helpful. She even sent me links to follow as well and walked me through it.

title: Just Excellent Amazing Support Sales...
review:
Just Excellent Amazing Support Sales And Technical Support Team
I would love to work for NEXTIVA company as Customer Service Representative And I Have Applied Online I hope To Get A Positive Response From HR As 12 Years Of Call Center Experience Inshallah would like to get hired Mr Charles Miss Lulu And Christiana Helped Me Out Very Well Keep It Guys Fantastic Work

pros: Excellent service, very little down time
title: Nextiva has been a great company!  We...
review: Nextiva has been a great company! We have been doing business with them for several (5) years now and have had no issues. They are very helpful when it comes to any questions and even set up call flows and anything we have asked with no hidden fees and did it quite fast! I highly recommend them for all your VOIP needs! Great Company!

title: The call quality is perfect. We never...
review: The call quality is perfect. We never miss calls with our custom call flow. Anna S. helped me with establishing and adjusting our call flow. This was a very seamless change. I would highly recommend Nextiva to any small business looking for hybrid solutions for telephone service. Porting our numbers was done within days. Thank you!

title: I have been with several voice over ip...
review:
I have been with several voice over ip companies and Nextiva is by far the best.
The price per month is perfect!!! You get a real person and not a Bot..

Everytime I had an issue they corrected right away. They are pleasant to talk too.......

Again you don't get a Bot you get a live person after the promts

title: We have had our business phone lines...
review: We have had our business phone lines with Nextiva for over 10 years. Their service has always been dependable with almost no issues over the years. Help has been great, especially online chat. We always purchase our equipment through their website or over the phone and receive deliveries very quickly and again receive the support needed to set up lines.

title: Best rep ever. Professional, friendly,...
review: Best rep ever. Professional, friendly, extremely effective. I had called earlier a she solved my problem and best of all kept checking in me giving me updates while on hold………………………………………………. ……………………………………………. ……………………………………………. ……………………………………………. ……………………………………………. ……………………………………………. …………………………………………….

pros: Unbelievable support. All other providers should take lessons
title: Always excellent service at a very fair...
review:
Always excellent service at a very fair price. Support agents are attentive and knowledgeable. They demonstrate imagination and insight on every interaction.

The sales rep Kyle Berrera is excellent and always gets back to me immediately.

Plus even though many agents were in Ukraine they kept up the same flawless level of service.

They must have very special leadership to consistently achieve this level of excellence

cons: None. Porting was maybe slightly slower when I first set it up.
pros: Great call quality, free phone with the plan, cheap plans, cheap rates, the list goes on…
title: Have subbed to this service for 6...
review: Have subbed to this service for 6 months (more or less) and I can’t complain. Their customer service is very helpful whenever you have a query, and their call quality is the same as any other VoIP service on the market. Great purchase! I would recommend to all the VoIP users to at least get their trial version.

title: The APP works great, and is very handy...
review:
The APP works great, and is very handy when we are at an event to make follow-up calls with leads! It also allows for multiple users so there's no reason for missing a call!

Every time I have had an issue it's been quickly resolved, with a minimal headache! They are able to connect right in and get things handled remotely!

title: The features and customization are my...
review: The features and customization are my favorite thing about Nextiva. The instant messaging app helps my team easily communicate with each other, even if they've stepped away for a moment and can't answer a call. The variety of options you have on the web portal are awesome as well. You can customize wait music, phone hours, holiday schedules, call distribution across your team, a fully flushed-out auto attendant, and more. The price is very fair for everything that you get. I've never had an issue contacting Customer Service, and they've always been able to fix my issues. We utilize the HIPAA-compliant account type that Nextiva offers, which we appreciate that they offer.

title: Nextiva is the second company that I...
review: Nextiva is the second company that I have used for VOIP. The first was very difficult to navigate and call dropouts were a daily occurrence. When I made the switch to Nextiva I was amazed at the ease of using the system. The BEST part of this company is the customer service. If and when I have any issues they are promptly dealt with by the chat team.

title: We were forced to make a change to a...
review: We were forced to make a change to a new provider due to constant, unresolved issues with the prior provider. From the initial contact, through account set up, installation and support Nextiva has always been extremely responsive. When we have had an issue they were prompt with a resolution and got us back up and running immediately! I would recommend to anyone looking to make a change.

title: I've been using Nextiva for 7 years...
review:
I've been using Nextiva for 7 years now. With the app now, it's a very user friendly VOIP service.
We have ten users with me as the administrator. Customization is available for both individual users, and also entire call groups.
Both mobile and desktop versions of the Nextiva app, make portability and the ability to work remote a breeze.

title: I was unable to get into my Unity...
review: I was unable to get into my Unity Supervisor portal and we had an issue with your call center not following the "rules" we set up. I called customer service and the wait time was almost none before a rep answered. The rep was amazing. They were able to get me logged back into Unity and also explain what happened. They also were kind enough to spend the next hour on the phone with me walking through all our call center settings to figure out why it was not working properly. Overall a great customer service experience.

title: I’ve been using the Nextiva App for...
review: I’ve been using the Nextiva App for months for business calls. I recently ran into an issue in which I was not able to see my incoming calls. I was able to receive them, however my phone would not ring, it would just showed I had a missed call. I was able to call in to Customer Support where they made a quick and easy fix.

title: My SMS feature was not working. I tried...
review: My SMS feature was not working. I tried the chat support feature but wasn’t getting a response quick enough. I then called in and was immediately connected to a rep who went through several steps over the phone to make sure my service was working. After a few fixes, I was finally able to receive SMS messages.

title: Once call center licenses were...
review: Once call center licenses were approved, Oleksandr was able to set up the call center that was requested. Oleksandr was very knowledgeable and courteous during the support call. He resolved all my issues within one call and ensured everything was working the way I wanted before disconnecting from the support call.

title: Happy so far with service and support!...
review: Happy so far with service and support! Very surprised that things have gone this seamlessly and setup has been relatively easy. Generally the best phone system we have had. Porting a number has a bit more difficult but overall great services. Would recommend to a business small or large to fit their needs

title: My experience with Nextiva has been the...
review: My experience with Nextiva has been the best as we replaced the another provider, I could not be happier about the entire transition. Customer support has been absolutely top notch, always friendly courteous and superfast with steps on how to fix the error. The features are completely and easily navigable, they provide a transparent overview of how to manage all phones in my environment. Thanks Nextiva for being the best company out there!

title: Nextiva is a very good VOIP solution. ...
review: Nextiva is a very good VOIP solution. I'm still learning about all of the features. I'm looking forward to new enhancements like texting and improved reporting, but am satisfied with the service so far. Support has been excellent. The installation team was extremely helpful, making sure that all of the steps needed to be 100% functional were taken up front so that there was no downtime when I turned off my other phone service. I've chatted with support a few times, and find them (especially Anna S) to be knowledgeable, willing to teach and not just do it for you (although they will if you want them to). Thank you, Anna!

title: Major Nextiva partner and also use the...
review: Major Nextiva partner and also use the service here at our office. Most reliable VOIP provider with the greatest of features. Their price per seat is very attractive and wont break the bank. From sales, to onboarding to support, they have such great staff who are always willing to help! I also love that with this new technology, we are no longer tied down to our desks.

title: System has great many features, but is...
review:
System has great many features, but is difficult to set up. It has taken me about 6 weeks to get the system up and running, and I think we are getting close. The service has been hit or miss. They are serious about security, which I guess is good, but a bit challenging at times.

The service staff is friendly but due to how my account was set up, was difficult to navigate. Also had issues with licensing, which are now worked out.

title: I needed to assigned some numbers and...
review: I needed to assigned some numbers and the process was very pleasant thank you for the support and kind customer service.

title: Nextiva has such a great support team....
review: Nextiva has such a great support team. It is easy to get a hold of someone when I am having issues whether it be connectivity, troubleshooting, or updating new features. My favorite feature is their chat system. This allows me to multi-task while I try to resolve my issues and they walk me step by step without having to keep the agent on the phone as well. Today Alina F. helped me but so many other agents have helped me along the way. Thanks Nextiva.

title: Tetiana is among many of the support...
review: Tetiana is among many of the support personnel I have worked with over the last 3 years of being a Nextiva customer. Their support team is top notch, always accessible and always able to assist. They provide supporting documentation and assistance to troubleshoot future issues on my own. We have had minimal issues since switching from our previous provider to Nextiva. Highly recommend!

cons: Virtual fax interface and not integrated into the rest of the system is a little clunky
title: Nextiva has given our organization a...
review:
Nextiva has given our organization a great makeover. Previously, all of our sites were a standalone island with their own POTS lines. Now everyone is a simple extension away.

We have a mix of digital desk phones and ATA devices that flow together seamlessly. This allowed us to keep a lot of existing equipment in place and minimize training to all of our employees.

title: We have been customers of Nextiva for...
review:
We have been customers of Nextiva for more than 8 years and what we love most about the Nevtiva service is the reliability of the network. In eight years our service has only been down one time and that was because of a nationwide internet issue. Another thing I love is the service, its impeccable the support team is extremely knowledge of all of their services and products any problem we've or solution we ask of them being able to solve them. Our customer account is great he checks in with me frequently to make sure we're fine with our service to double check to see if we our in need of anything.

During this 8 year period I have been approached from a number of different VOIP providers with better pricing for the same service we have with Nextiva but for me, it's hard to make a change when everything is and has been working with a hitch for so many years because our phone service is mission critical to our business. I highly recommend Nextiva to any person looking for a good reliable VOIP service.

title: Wow, I tried four times to call Ring...
review: Wow, I tried four times to call Ring Central to give my business and start a new VOIP connection but it seems customer service never heard of some insurance products to understand what my needs were, that took terrible reception phone calls hearing through echoing, static calls. A representative called me back from the phillipines whom NEVER got back to the 2 calender meetings I requested to set up with no zoom or teams or software links to meet. THEN, I called to leave voicemail, phone call, and then customer service again and here I am with no service...I will probably stay with my current vendor. Disapointing experience when I was ready to sign up and have them take my money...fairly happy I have yet to do that. They need a real team in the USA...not the Phillipines with lousy "employees" who received basic training and no idea how to serve insurance owners for a voip product.

title: We did a Nextiva implementation a...
review:
We did a Nextiva implementation a couple of months ago. From the time that our IT team initiated the agreement through the onboarding, installation and go live process, the Nextiva team was great. We had calendared meetings to discuss the account set up and installation (how we wanted the system configured) and throughout the process the Nextiva team was timely, prepared and took the time to educate and inform.

Overall a very good install, activation and support with Nextiva.

title: Great customer service, no hold time...
review: Great customer service, no hold time when you call. Rates are good! I liked how user-friendly the app is. Very convenient for running a business on the go. The few times I have called in for support I have been very pleased with the service and everyone is extremely helpful and knowledgeable. The service is unbeatable!

pros: Great support staff, value who value account security and service.
title: As a contractor to the vendor using the...
review: As a contractor to the vendor using the product, Nextiva held client account security as paramount. Excellent technical support and information. I would recommend Nextiva as a fantastic option in the field of mediocre providers. Marshall (the support technician) was patient, knowledgeable and informative regarding their products and current system.

title: Setup took longer than anticipated,...
review:
Setup took longer than anticipated, also felt redundant. The porting process did not workout great. It caused us to have to extend our old phone plan for another month, making this transition quite costly.

We are still figuring out the phone system. So far it is okay. We do like the app feature, makes it easier for our hybrid workers. Most of the support staff is quite friendly and helpful as well. Alex M. was great to deal with.

Thank you!

cons: Can be challenging to get all the features working
pros: Great once it is set up
title: Great overall. Support has been great...
review: Great overall. Support has been great thus far. Takes a little time and research to understand the actual call flows and how to set them up. However, you do have access to control all features of the system. You can act like a large company with a sophisticated phone system as a small business. If you get stuck you can always contact support for help.

cons: It's hard to think of any
title: Nextiva has the best support. No matter...
review:
Nextiva has the best support. No matter what you call about it gets fixed in one phone call.
The one downside is the Nextiva app has issues from time to time. You need to sign in and out of it and that normally fixes it.
Otherwise they have the best call quality of any Voip providers. And I've used many others. Trust me Nextiva is far better.

title: James Towle was incredible with my...
review: James Towle was incredible with my setup and launch as a new customer. I had a setup question and support was quick to help me figure out the issue. The user friendly mobile app and desktop app makes the usage flawless, and the integration between mobile and desktop is crucial in delivering a quality phone product! 10/10 would recommend!

title: Great service and support is always...
review: Great service and support is always there to help when needed.

title: Our representative was excellent in...
review: Our representative was excellent in getting us set up with our new phones and portal system. She explained everything and helped us tremendously. I would recommend any business to switch over to Nextiva. She also provided us with support on pointing our old numbers from the old provider as well. Very pleasant and done in a little time.

title: Nextiva always helps when we have an...
review: Nextiva always helps when we have an issue or need to make a change to users/greetings, etc. I'm able to gain help either by calling the 800# or using the chat function online. I don't every have to hold to get to someone who can help. They will email you instructions as well to keep for future reference.

title: We had a change of implementation coach...
review: We had a change of implementation coach right in the middle which made for a rocky experience but ever since then we are back on track and it has taken our business to the next level. Our process are cleaner and the professional recordings sound great! We were even able to upload our own hold music!

cons: Sometimes on the Accounting side there has been hichiccups.
pros: Very flexible system for most users
title: Overall, I am the 3rd party IT vendor...
review: Overall, I am the 3rd party IT vendor for 18 accounts that use Nextiva and so far, everyone seems happy and 16 of the accounts have used the system for over a year and have been happy with the flexibility it offers. Our company will continue to offer this VOIP Solution to our new clients. Training is pretty easy as well.

title: Great service and excellent quality....
review: Great service and excellent quality. Customer service is to notch whenever I need them. We have had service with them for about 2 years and the flexibility with their system is amazing. We can have people working anywhere in the world and still be connected like they are at their office desk. Great company

title: Every time I've had an issue with the...
review: Every time I've had an issue with the phones (normally user error), Nextiva can be reached via phone call, chat, or submitting a ticket. We also appreciate that Nextiva will work with our secretaries and paralegals to trouble shoot issues when our law firm is in trial. Anna S. recently helped one of our employees adjust the music on hold volume, and her help quickly resolved the issue to allow us to get back to work. Workers like Anna S. and great tech support keep our office up and running when our attorneys cannot be reached. Our city workers recently cut internet lines while digging near our office building. Nextiva automatically rolled to our cells and we are NEVER without service or fabulous support. The stress this has taken off has been immeasurable!

pros: CRM, TEXTS, UNLI CALLS, GOOD NUMBERS
title: Always recommend this VOIP to all of my...
review: Always recommend this VOIP to all of my clients as it has a good price for all the features. All tech support are actual licensed techs. I get my numbers replaced easily especially when needed and I can change it in just minutes! I also get $500 referral fee for every clients I give to Nextiva! It's an all in one!

cons: You cant receive  calls on your app/cell phone if you on a call on your cell phone. Most customer service reps suck..
title: I really dont like the most of the...
review: I really dont like the most of the customer service reps. They dont know they job so how can they assist customers? I literally have to keep calling in after hanging up on them to reach one who knows the system. Many times they calm they cant find my account but l am giving all the correct info. They need to retrain a lot of them.

pros: Great Support - answered the phone fast
title: July was really helpful in getting a...
review: July was really helpful in getting a support issue done. it took maybe 10 minutes to get solved! She also spoke really well and had a pleasant attitude. She was also able to help me understand the user interface and show me how best to solve these problems in the future. if you are thinking on going with Nextiva i say go ahead!

title: We moved from another local AZ...
review:
We moved from another local AZ provider, about 3 years ago. We used to have many call drops and "outages" that were always blamed on our internal network. When I had the opportunity to purchase the business in 2019, I immediately switched away from that carrier and ended up going to Nextiva, where they got us ported over and up and running without issue. The transition wasn't perfect, but that is a statistical impossibility, so...

Anyway, our call drops and outages magically disappeared and we have had very good uptime, call quality, and administrative manageability. I am still happy 3 years down the road.

The customer support team remains good, even through the COVID environment. There just doesn't seem to be the struggle you sometimes get with trying to make a change to the account or provision / fix equipment. It gets handled quickly, the first time around. That says a lot for me.

The call monitoring and reporting module leaves a bit to be desired, but keep in-mind that they have a couple of systems and we are on the old one (3.0). So long as you come-in under the latest NextOS then you are fine, which should be everyone now.

Overall, we appreciate Nextiva for helping us keep our business focus where it needs to be...on the business and not the phone system!

title: Nextiva has been a rock solid provider...
review: Nextiva has been a rock solid provider for the past several years. Uptime has always been our main priority and we have not been disappointed. Customer support has always been great when we needed it. They take their time and have fixed stuff that I've messed up in the past without issue. I highly recommend giving Nextiva a chance.

title: This company has to have the worst...
review:
This company has to have the worst customer service and customer support I have ever experienced in my life. They have phone numbers on their website but none of them actually connect you to support. everything has to be done through chat and you have to jump through hoops to get an actual person on chat. Then when you finally are redirected to a live person on chat you are put in a queue first and will probably wait at least half and hour. Nobody ever calls you, there is no way to speak to anyone at the company.

I DO NOT recommend this company, simply because they have the worst customer support I have ever experienced. If anything goes wrong with your phones you are simply out of luck. They provide no help. There is no one to call. You are on your own.

Terrible, terrible service.

title: For  a  cloud  based  provider,  the...
review: For a cloud based provider, the service is exceptional when compared to all other providers we have tried in the past. The call quality and reliability of the service is top notch. We are able to make our own admin changes when needed and if necessary, the tech support team is great.

title: Nextiva had an onboarding...
review: Nextiva had an onboarding representative work with us to get the phone paths and automation set-up, the help create all the individual user accounts, and provided tutorials on how to utilize all aspects of their system. The only downside is that the SMS texting is not available on their desktop application. Their support is available anytime and has been quick to help resolve any and all issues. They have a call-in or chat feature!

title: Nextiva is awesome! The customer...
review:
Nextiva is awesome! The customer service is on point and goes above and beyond to get you set up and to fix any issues! Eric Mann was the guy that I signed up with and worked hard to make sure I was happy with the service!
Alex was my customer support agent and went above and beyond! If you are looking for a phone system, this is the one!

title: I've had Nextiva for over a year. I...
review: I've had Nextiva for over a year. I find them reliable and phone quality excellent. They have excellent customer service that answer promptly. Although their customer service reps are not local, I am able to understand them. Being able to communicate to whom I'm talkin with is very important to me.

title: We have used Nextiva for about 3 years...
review: We have used Nextiva for about 3 years and have not had any issues. As the business owner, I appreciate that I can always get in touch with the service team if I have any questions. I would highly recommend Nextiva and have referred other business owners to them. I know there are many competitors in this field, but make sure you look at all Nextiva has to offer.

title: Anastasiia O. was super helpful! I use...
review: Anastasiia O. was super helpful! I use another platform for call recording, but I often direct dial using my Nextiva phone. I searched around for how to record off the Nextiva platform and found out that there is an in-house feature. Anastasiia O. was able to get me set up with call recording and monitoring and even trouble shooted how to log in. Very knowledgeable!

cons: takes a little while to learn it
title: the Nextiva team is so helpful anytime...
review:
the Nextiva team is so helpful anytime I call. They always resolve any questions or concerns that I have immediately.
I highly recommend them.
Yesterday we had to call to change over the users for office phone and to change our voice mail. All that was accomplished.
Today I tried to bring up voice mail but my passcode didn't work, again, they quickly reset it. All was great.

title: Overall I'm happy with my services. If...
review: Overall I'm happy with my services. If they could add the possibility to do SMS messaging on your desktop it would be best! However, any issues I run into I can easily call support or contact them via email. Email is my choice since I'm pretty busy with appointments and having to take 30 mins out of my schedule to fix an unexpected issue sometimes it's a hassle.

title: The Nextiva fax service is so easy and...
review: The Nextiva fax service is so easy and convenient. Our restaurant sends weekly specials to over 70 businesses in the area every week. It always works great, and when it doesn't it's usually an issue with my computer, that Nextiva customer service is always happy to help me fix. Thanks Nextiva for offering such a great product at a very reasonable price!

title: There is nothing not to like. The...
review:
There is nothing not to like. The product is awesome, the support is amazing, everything is easy.
there is a lot of material there to learn and do everything you need by yourself and if it doesn't work, just use the online chat, they just saved my day.
Seriously, I use VoIP since 15 years now and this is the most professional and economic provider I ever had

title: you cannpt beat the price and high...
review:
you cannpt beat the price and high quality servie this company provides,
the only cons i have are the phones they provide, they could be a little better
but the gave me it for free so how can i complain.
all in all, I am very pleased with the company and service they provide ,
i would definetly recomend this company to anyone.

title: I was worried that my tech support call...
review: I was worried that my tech support call would take too long... I tried to squeeze it in between other scheduled calls. But they resolved my request in about 10 minutes... or less. Been a customer for, what, 10 years? Works great with our Polycom system. Tech support was able to handle our fairly complex configuration without any problems. Thanks Nextiva.

title: Some changes, like changing names on...
review: Some changes, like changing names on extensions, making sure the new name appears vs. the prior name, etc., take too long to make and you have to be transferred to a more advanced dept. If Nextiva was to simplify how to make certain changes, I think they would be far more efficient. Reps are great, though. They are always very polite and professional and get the job done, no matter how long it takes.

title: Nextiva is a great company. Their...
review:
Nextiva is a great company. Their product, features and customer service is excellent. Their phone/computer app isn't that great and needs some work. We had issues with using on our phones.

Overall we are happy with Nextiva. We have been a loyal customer for 2 years and have minimal issues. Would recommend.

title: Anastasiia O was wonderful - please...
review:
Anastasiia O was wonderful - please give this lady a raise - she's a gem!

She handled everything I asked with ease and was able to get both an old phone set up that I had laying around in addition to the one that I had provided by nextiva.

Very knowledgeable and direct to the point which I appreciate very much

title: I rarely write a comment but I want to...
review: I rarely write a comment but I want to let everyone who tries to join this know. This service is awful. The price they charge you is way over your expectation and the program is really complicated. Do not please experience this terrible thing. Now, I am trying to find another service...:((( I have to spend another time working it out.

cons: Sometimes the wait time is long.
title: We have been with Nextiva for over five...
review: We have been with Nextiva for over five years. Their technical support team is very knowledgeable and go out of their way to help you. Even when their Ukraine team was not available, they always had people answering the phone and getting you the answers you needed. We are very happy with Nextiva.

title: I love Nextiva ease of use. Allows me...
review: I love Nextiva ease of use. Allows me control of our call tree and services available on the phone. We save so much now monthly with Nextiva vs our previous carrier AT&T. I don't think we will be leaving anytime soon. We truly are hooked on the services and the ability to grow with us and our company.

title: I've always had excellent customer...
review: I've always had excellent customer support from Nextiva. Whether it's sharing my extension with an additional phone for working from home, or troubleshooting issues, they've always provided export support. I've also been vey happy with Nextiva's flexibility with hardware, such as my setup using a VoIP adapter and an analog Panasonic cordless phone with bluetooth - it works great!

pros: Full Admin Control of our phone systemem
title: We have just completed the conversion...
review: We have just completed the conversion to Nextiva. Their customer service has been outstanding. All technicians that I have spoken with have been extremely knowledgeable and efficient with answering all questions I have had. How refreshing to have a customer support chat that responds SO quickly! I didn't have to spend days waiting to hear back!!

title: Overall a great system for enterprise...
review:
Overall a great system for enterprise clients.

1. Support is very responsive and really helpful.
2. Easy to navigate the settings once you know where they are.
3. Easy to record calls, review calls, and manage users.
4. Detailed analytics when using Akixi reporting tool.

The phone system is very pricy but it's worth it for great service. Good features for users and support is helpful when issues come up.

title: They help me set up the phones.  Made...
review: They help me set up the phones. Made it easy and quick. The phone quality is amazing! i was able to do everything via Chat Room. The IT person was patient and instructed me on step by step process. I am currently waiting to port my numbers to the new phone system, but I am still able to use their temporarily assigned numbers. So far the quality is great!

cons: it took 5 hours and started last wednesday i was without a phone line for what appeared to be 3 hours
title: I am very upset right now.  I have been...
review:
I am very upset right now. I have been trying to get the phone service right in my office starting last Wednesday and it was finally fixed tonight by the last tech team member or i was switching to Verizon. I missed well over 40 calls and that is a lot to a small office such as ours.

this was ridiculous, look at the notes. I should be credited a free month for sticking around. The phones were not rolling over properly, then it was not ringing at all. This was a massive waste of my time.

I was also incidentally hung up on several times as well while the team over there tried to fix my phones.

title: I have used Nextiva for several years....
review:
I have used Nextiva for several years. Installation and changeover went smoothly because we took our time. Today I needed to change a couple of users due to staff turn-over. I spent about 1-1/2 hours on the chat feature with Ivan T, who managed the whole process (about 1/2 hour of that time was waiting for a live agent). I told Ivan what I needed to do, he worked on in it and kept me informed of his progress. I know stuff like this takes time to make sure it is correct, and that is what I want.
I do recommend Nextiva for its products and its support.

pros: No Waiting time on the line
title: We needed to update some settings with...
review:
We needed to update some settings with our company's Nextiva account, and we called instead of making the changes online because we needed to sort out some questions that we had for the specific use we were giving to the app.

As head of the Customer Success department here at Filter King, I'm responsible for making sure our customers are getting the best possible attention and support at all times, and I always value when we receive the same treatment. I had to call two times to Nextiva that day, and I was amazed by Nextiva's agents' outstanding service. Monica in the morning and Patti Clarke in the afternoon were excellent!

Thanks!

title: We switched from 8x8 because the...
review: We switched from 8x8 because the platform was overcharging us and we weren't utilizing the international calls. Nextiva has been amazing and I only wished I would have started out with them. Not only is the plan cheaper, the portal is so much easier to use and their support is amazing. The implementation was fast and our agent stuck with us the entire time to make sure things went smoothly. I am very happy with this decision and highly recommend Nextiva for any person looking for a VOIP Service.

title: The support staff is always...
review: The support staff is always knowledgeable and helpful. Always goes above and beyond expectations.... When I call or chat just to get information on how to do something, they always offer to do it for me, allowing me to get back to work. The best phone service I have found to date - above all of the name brand phone companies.

title: Alex M. is a top notch representative...
review: Alex M. is a top notch representative and is very helpful and efficient! I'd like to think that this is the only way customer service should be, and in exchange, people would be more inclined to spend their money with companies that make the effort to show their appreciation to their customers. Alex M. represents Nextiva in this capacity.

title: The tech support is always a pleasant...
review: The tech support is always a pleasant experience. they are so easy to work with and they get your issue resolved right away! I like the convenience of text messaging instead of waiting on hold. The technicians are always very friendly and they understand your issues right away. They are confident and do a great job!

title: Nextiva has been great with the support...
review: Nextiva has been great with the support especially Anna S. I appreciate the time and effort given even though her city is being bombed. The service has issues and the phones are garbage but the support I have received is stellar. The call flow function is almost impossible to use and I would really like to see the entire dashboard be reconfigured so as to be much more user friendly

title: I like the look and feel of the website...
review: I like the look and feel of the website and the app. It's easy to use and powerful. I love the 'teams' feature and the 'call flows' feature! I also appreciate Nextiva chat reps for always being prompt and available. Even though I experienced some bugs while downloading the app, they were helpful and solved my issues.

title: Getting started with the company took...
review: Getting started with the company took longer than we expected. It took months to get out of the installation phase. Anytime we have an issue and I use Live Chat it take such a long time for some one to answer. Half of the time they are helpful. Very expensive for such poor quality customer service.

pros: Phone line can be used whether you are in the office or not
title: Nextiva has been part of my job ever...
review: Nextiva has been part of my job ever since I started with the company and it is an application that has been working well even if I work off shore. Customer support reps are so helpful as well and I never felt unattended or being ignored. I just love everything with Nextiva. From the application to the support I get

cons: Administrator portal; apps cannot send/receive SMS texts with images
title: Nextiva quickly stood out during our...
review: Nextiva quickly stood out during our selection process for a VoIP solution, from the prospective of price, functionality and support. Having used the service for 2 years there have been times when something stopped working but the support personnel were responsive and quickly resolved the issue. I would like to see an new administrator interface that provides access to configuring all functions and features of an extension. Currently a support ticket is required to get SMS texting and voicemail to translated text via email. One feature missing from the apps that would be helpful is the ability to add images to SMS text messages.

title: excellent service and customer support,...
review: excellent service and customer support, i would highly recommend to the business. and also user it for large number of user there is perfect clearly on terms of voice, connection. They are very cost effective and have wide range for all type of business small, mid or large, they have also featured with some popular platforms

title: Unlike a previous carrier, Nextiva...
review: Unlike a previous carrier, Nextiva makes customer service easy, and updating systems a breeze. The service is very reliable and clear, and has many features every company needs. I would recommend Nextiva for any small business. It was easy to chat with the representative Anna S. and get changed what we needed

title: Love using this service for my...
review: Love using this service for my communication needs. All of the features make it easy to conduct business on the go. No longer being tied down by a desk phone. Their backend portal makes add and changes very easy. I would recommend this service to anyone looking to migrate to the cloud. They are also affordable.

title: I've been using the Nextiva phone...
review: I've been using the Nextiva phone system for 4 years now. Support has always been top notch. The phones work great and are fairly easy to use. I love the ability to have the app on my cell phone so that I can still answer office calls even when I'm not at my desk. This comes in handy when my co-worker is out and I need to step away for a moment. The online dashboard is easy to navigate with many features. The ability to go back and check the call log for certain clients has come in handy an many occasions. The only con would be setting up temporary out of office messages. When I first started doing them, they were a bit of a pain, but have become much easier since then. I would certainly recommend the Nextiva system for anyone looking to get a new VoIP phone system.

title: I received great assistance from...
review:
I received great assistance from Nextiva customer rep Anna S.

Anna S. had assisted me with troubleshooting and resolving numerous issues

with my Nextiva account. Anna was knowledgeable and knew how to resolve

my issues quickly. Anna assisted with fixing my Call flows, account

management, and setting up SMS via VoIP.

title: Cutting our LAN lines and moving to...
review: Cutting our LAN lines and moving to VoIP only reinforced the mobility of our workforce without interrupting our customer services. Found Nextiva to be be a very cost effective solution that allowed us to direct additional funds to our other technology demands at this time. Only recommendation is to be sure and take the time to think through your configuration before setting it all up.

cons: Sometimes the person I call cannot find our location; I give them the exact same number and they say there are  pages of users. But sometimes I call and they can find it right t away. It is a gamble everytime I call and very inconsistent.
pros: I love having access to all of the backend functions and being able to set auto reports  and change other functions if I'm not able to get through on the support line.
title: Today's experience with Support went...
review: Today's experience with Support went very well! I called early in the morning because I have noticed that the queque gets very long later in the day. I was suprised to have my call answered within a few seconds. The person I spoke to first was able to find my account quickly today and transferred me to an elite specialist. That person picked up right away and was the most helpful person I've ever had! He answered all of my questions and gave me very thorough step by step instructions on how to find these areas in the Admin Portal to view, hear, change and update greetings! I like to learn and be able to take care of these things myself and he was able to give me the exact information that I've needed in over a year! He even sent me an email with the step by step instructions so I would have it in writing! When I've called before to update the voicemails, they typically do it over the phone with me and it takes 30 minutes at least. This time, I got the info I needed to do it myself going forward. I cannot tell you how pleased I am with today's support call! :-)

title: Came from a company that provides...
review: Came from a company that provides internet and cable. Their system was atrocious. I can do everything myself now and if I have questions their support team takes care of it and actually gets it done too. Can you imagine that I used to have to call in to get an automated attendant set up and changed? Now I just do it myself in a few clicks. Call quality is also better. Very pleased.

title: I was notified by your company on May...
review:
I was notified by your company on May 2, 2022 regarding an alleged debt that you believe we owe. I do not owe this debt because we were no longer under contract with your company for the voice portion of our arrangement. Upon our cancellation of your services we were charged a cancellation fee even though we were on a month to month arrangement. We were still under contract for our Data services through July 2022 and that cancellation fee has already been paid to you. If you review the notes on our account you will see many interactions recorded in both 2020 and 2021 of me talking to Cindy, Mary and Janet (all at different times) asking the proper cancellation procedures and timing. I was given a small window of time to contact you to cancel the auto renew. I contacted you within that small window successfully being placed on a month to month arrangement for our voice services. On the day we cancelled all services with you (in February 2022) I spoke with Cindy because the cancellation department was stating that we were going to owe a voice cancellation fee. Cindy said not to worry about it because I was NOT under contract for our voice services and that if there was a cancellation fee on my final bill to put in a dispute. Well I did that, but they did not look far enough back in our notes and assumed that the voice contract ended in July 2022 along with the Data contract, but this is not accurate, the voice portion was on a month to month at this point.

To make matters worse, I have reached out 3 separate times asking for a fed ex return label and a list of what equipment you would like returned. That department said if I don’t get a label they don’t want anything back. Well I have not received a label yet, and they are charging me for not returning the equipment. Again, I ask that you remove that charge and send me a label and a list of what you would like returned. All of the equipment is sitting on my desk ready to go out.

At this time, I believe our account to be paid in full. The March 2022 final invoice that we received was paid in full less the voice cancellation fee of $7974.91 which would put our account at $0. Please review our account and let me know what to do with the equipment.

It is very disappointing that after 18 years of utilizing your service, first with Covad, then MegaPath and now Fusion that this is the final impression that I am going to remember about your company.

title: New client of Nextiva's for our law...
review: New client of Nextiva's for our law firm. So far we are enjoying the phone system. We've had to call to fix a few things to get our call flow set up how we prefer and there's always someone eager to help that answers right away. Don with Nextiva was great and set us up right away, he was very easy to work with as well.

title: My VOIP/efax provider is affordable and...
review: My VOIP/efax provider is affordable and at the same time reliable. Customer service response may not be instant (chat/voice) but wait is tolerable. We are a small healthcare business trying to grow and the current plan we have is just right with expandability in the future. We just added 1 extension after 4 years with Nextiva. I use Nextiva with my 2 other small businesses for years.

pros: Connective quality good - Sound quality good
title: I strongly depend on SMS on the desk...
review: I strongly depend on SMS on the desk top computer run my business- with texting. I was told when I purchase it that it was available--but in their new system is is not on the desk top any longer- I think back in 2020 per the website-- So I had to keep my old carrier system just to be able to SMS text at my computer -- saving no $$. But I am not getting consist dropped calls as I will with my old carrier.

cons: Static from cords provided, many updates
title: We love Nextiva, we joined about 4...
review: We love Nextiva, we joined about 4 years ago when they were pretty new so we have gone through all the changes/updates with them. We transferred serveral lines when we started and that was the biggest process I think we delt with. Overall, it is so easy to use and set up is a breeze. Shipping is super fast if we ever need to add a phone. The mobile app has been a HUGE hit with our firm especially during Covid having to work from home. Being able to spoof our direct lines as the main office line is a great benefit. So many customizable options makes it very handy. Support is great and never many problems. We would recommend Nextiva to anyone!

title: Nextiva is by far the easiest VoIP...
review: Nextiva is by far the easiest VoIP solution to implement. Support is fast and always available via chat and I've yet to have to call and speak to anyone. The price is right and the hardware works well for us. We're an international company and being reachable via the Nextiva app anywhere in the world is great.

title: System was a little bit difficult at...
review:
System was a little bit difficult at first to grasp, but the customer service has been amazing to walk me through it. We appreciate the help to get through it all.

We would definitely recommend Nextiva to someone else as I know they will get the help they need. There are also many other features that are offered that we don't even utilize.

title: Our sales rep, Sam, has been awesome to...
review: Our sales rep, Sam, has been awesome to work with from the start. We had some issues on our end with installation because of a strong firewall and Sam was sure to help in any way he could and was quick to respond to my emails daily. As for the phones and services, Nextiva has helped us to streamline our calls and the phones work great.

pros: Flexible service, accessible on various devices.
title: We have been using Nextiva as a...
review: We have been using Nextiva as a business account with multiple users. Our colleagues are scattered all over the world and have been able to use the service . Excellent customer service! I am very thrilled that there are options to access the app on multiple devices: the phone itself, computers, tablets, cell phone.

cons: Odd onboarding process and support at cutover.
pros: Features, portal, and availability of support staff
title: Nextiva attempted to make switching...
review: Nextiva attempted to make switching from our existing VOIP provider easy, but in some ways made it too laborious for us. Porting was good, but lacks direct communication to resolve issues in real-time. Turnaround time of two days is too long. Several issues could have been avoided during this phase. You support staff have been wonderful and have been helpful in resolving numerous issues before, during, and after cutover. They are the real heroes of this project. Kudos!

cons: I wasnt able to log in due to technical errors
title: Alex did a wonderful job assisting me...
review: Alex did a wonderful job assisting me with my issue. He took time to listen to my problem and help me resolve it the best we could. Unfortunately, we weren't able to resolve the log in issue but we were able to resolve the issue I was originally reaching out for. So kudos to Alex for helping try to come to a partial resolution!

title: I'm taking the time to do this survey...
review:
I'm taking the time to do this survey because of Priscella. She was excellent in solving my problem today, 5/12.
The ratings pertain to Priscella not Nextiva.

Yesterday, 5/11 was very frustrating and I'm hoping you will be able to see the activity of the reps that I was on the phone with.
1st issue: Why do reps ask for a call back # in case we get disconnected, and they do not call back.
2nd issue: I believe they are not properly trained. Today Priscella was able to solve my issue under 10 min vs yesterday I spoke to 2 people (really 3 but call was dropped, and I never received a call back).
It seems they do not understand call flow set-up and voicemail.

Nextiva should be the same care as when they were trying to get my business vs now that they have my business.

title: My Home Healthcare and Infusion company...
review:
My Home Healthcare and Infusion company has been with Nextiva since 2016 and overall I've been very happy with not only their product offerings and service but their customer service.

My only gripe would be their off-shored Croatian customer service. However I just found out today 05/11/2022 that they are bringing Nextiva customer service back to Arizona where it was when I started service with them!! Whoopee!!!!

Very satisfied overall... good company, happy helpful employees and you can always get a LIVE person to assist you.

cons: I would like to see more features on the phone app
title: I would like to say my experience with...
review: I would like to say my experience with Support on chat was great today. Anna S. was very helpful and provided valuable links for me to used later. I was unable to login into the mobile app for over a week and she was able to get me back into it in about 10 minutes or less. I would recommend Nextiva.

title: Nextiva product and support is amazing!...
review: Nextiva product and support is amazing! I have had only positive experiences. Their knowledge-base and customer service is great!

title: I do like that they follow up and do...
review: I do like that they follow up and do everything they can to provide a solution for any concerns or issues I may have. I have been using Nextiva for a year now and haven't had many problems where they weren't able to help me figure something out. I really like the fact they email you after a ticket is completed just incase there may be some issues. I don't have any complaints about them. Thank you for being a great company to work with.

title: I have been very pleased and impressed...
review: I have been very pleased and impressed with Nextiva's customer support. It is very important for me to be able to speak to a live and responsive rep. Nextiva's support team has been extremely helpful and patient with my previous questions and requests. I love being able to reach out and get things resolved within one phone call.

title: Support can be a little better. There...
review: Support can be a little better. There have been several times that I have made calls regarding issues and I have had to call back several times for the same thing. There has also been times that have done things that they were not supposed to. On a good note there has been times that I have called support and they were excellent. I had multiple problems and they were able to solve them relatively quickly.

title: Great Customer Service Everytime I need...
Nextiva has provided exceptional...
review: Nextiva has provided exceptional service. They are especially helpful (and patient) as I am merely a novice at IT. They are available after our business hours and on weekends to assist in fixing problems. I am most grateful for their assistance in setting up new employee phones and provisioning new phones.

title: I have spoken to the support team on a...
review: I have spoken to the support team on a few occasions and they have always been able to resolve my issue promptly. The support team members that I have spoken with have always been extremely friendly, professional and knowledgeable. I have been satisfied with the outcome after each interaction with the support team!

title: I switched to Nextiva a little over a...
review: I switched to Nextiva a little over a year ago and am very happy with the service. I haven't had any issues with the phones being down for any extended period of time. The customer support is easy, they have a great chat feature to solve easy problems quickly while multi-tasking on other things. I would highly recommend for other businesses.

cons: navigation of site and features is a bit difficult, also wait time for customer service via either chat or phone is slow
pros: Great Price, Awesome tech support, Lots of features
title: Very pleased with Nextiva. We are a...
review: Very pleased with Nextiva. We are a small business that had outgrown our hosted voice platform. After much research, we decided to give Nextiva a go. The salesperson answered all of my questions via chat. That was nice, as I was able to multi-task while chatting with him. Within a week, we received all of our new phones and had them set up. The site set-up was very simple. Step by step walk through. The initial go live was a bit rocky but we worked through it. Tech support realized our router/modem had been set up incorrectly from before Nextiva. Once we got that issue resolved, we called tech support again to have them modify some settings on our router and we've been golden ever since. The only downside is the wait time for chat support and phone support. But once you do get ahold of someone, you're in. They all know their stuff and are extremely helpful. We're so glad we have a phone system that has a menu to assist with the large call volume we experience. Very pleased we made the change.

title: I have been with nextiva for a little...
review:
I have been with nextiva for a little over 2 years and I am happy with service and product.
Support staff willing to help. Level 2 technicians are more knowledgeable than 1.
They verify account consistently to make sure that they are talking to authorized user.
Wait time to get support staff on phone varies.

title: Product is good but it's too complex...
review: Product is good but it's too complex to understand and most of the time support doesn't know how to fix problems. Would be good if you guys can design the system which is easy to operate and understand. For example to setup call centers in the right way is too complex. Overall it's better than other software I have used in the market.

title: Nextiva has been a great addition to...
review: Nextiva has been a great addition to our business. As first time VoIP users, we couldn't be happier with the service and support that Nextiva has offered us since signing on with them. We look forward to working with them further in the future and appreciate their willingness to help with our transition into this new technical advance in our company.

title: Support is fantastic. They will stay on...
review: Support is fantastic. They will stay on the phone until your issues are resolved, however, there have been very few issues. The initial VM routing set up is a bit challenging as well as subsequent updates if needed. Overall they are solid provider with excellent prices and service. Comparable routing services were easily over 2x the cost of Nextiva phone service.

cons: New Voice Portal isn't as straightforward as the older one
pros: Fast Setup, Reliable Service and Support Responses
title: Nextiva is a great VoIP provider, from...
review: Nextiva is a great VoIP provider, from start to finish they're hands-on and ready to help. Post-install the agents are great and they help out whenever something comes up, though so far I've just needed assistance adding new things, rather than fixing things. Both support agents and channel partner agents are extremely helpful, and tend to go above and beyond with finding a solution to just about anything thrown at them.

cons: you have to set up by yourself
title: I shopped around for a new phone line...
review: I shopped around for a new phone line for my startup, and Nextiva offered the most for the money. The sales guy was efficient and responsive, and worked with me on the price. I am slowly learning to navigate the system, not being a Compter person myself it takes me a minute to figure things out. overall great service.

pros: Great features and integration with my Zoho CRM. Price point is great as a new business owner to help keep cost low.
title: Upon starting my small business I...
review: Upon starting my small business I needed a business line. I like the price point of Nextiva compared to all the other competitors. The support team have been great and very responsive. They have helped me setup the integration with my Zoho CRM. Having the ability to have a mobile app on my phone to receive and make calls when I'm out of the office has been key. Allows me to keep my personal life and business life separate. Great features and integration with my Zoho CRM. Price point is great as a new business owner to help keep cost low.

title: I have been working with Nextiva for...
review:
I have been working with Nextiva for the past 5 years.
Great company, great service, excellent 24 hours customer service.
Lovely people worked there. I have no complaints. There is someone always nice there to help you when you need them. Phones work great and they have the best app to work remotely.

title: Great costumer service, any issues are...
review: Great costumer service, any issues are fixed promptly. Hold times are five to 10 minutes. Excellent step by step guides and if you can not find the answers through their tutorials, you can speak to a representative in a live chat. Staff is friendly and responsive. I would recommend this service 10/10.

title: Best VOIP system that exists. Reliable...
review:
Best VOIP system that exists. Reliable and affordable.
Support is available 24/7 and there is no long wait time for the support to answer (which is the case with most of the other VOIP providers)
Gregory from technical support has set my entire system and extremally complicated routing schedule

I would recommend Nextiva to everyone!

title: I had to encounter customer assistance...
review: I had to encounter customer assistance once after my initial activation with the company. I commend the representatives. They were patient, knowledgeable, and extremely kind. They made my experience with the company a pleasurable one. I have no qualms about recommending this company and it's staff.

title: Spent some time on the phone today with...
review: Spent some time on the phone today with customer service. Was a great service overall, they explain to you on the phone what to do and help you solve and technical problems you have. The phones are neat and do everything we want them to do including the SMS option which was an addition for us. Thank you for all your help today.

title: I believe that nextiva has one of the...
review: I believe that nextiva has one of the greatest customer service options out there. Although some of the customer service employees are less educated in how to help/support with issues, most of them are qualified and helpful. I appreciate the texting option for internal business use, where it helps keep employees informed through nextiva!

title: Super helpful support - got the phone...
review: Super helpful support - got the phone system installed and ready to use! Advanced features that will help us run our small business much more like a big business. Awaiting the porting process now. Love the advanced features related to the messaging and allowing the voicemail to be emailed to specific addresses.

title: I have had the Nextiva service for...
review:
I have had the Nextiva service for three months and could not be happier. With Nextiva you get a ton of extra features with the monthly service. Also, the customer service is great. They are very quick to respond to my needs and they will walk you step by step to fix any issues you are having.
Thank you Nextiva!

title: The system is very user friendly...
review: The system is very user friendly overall, very minor issues. customer service is always great at addressing any issues when they occur. we've had the service now going on three years, the only issue we ran into was with the CRM Login it was fixed within a reasonable amount of time, and one minor login issue caused by a security setting

cons: BroadWorks is looking a bit old.
pros: Amazing customer support - live chat is actually     helpful and availablee.
title: Great company, best customer service of...
review:
Great company, best customer service of any vendor I work with. Uptime is great - rarely have issues. Quite happy.

Would like to see a better mobile app, easier to use portal etc. The backend for BroadWorks is a little dated and confusing, especially setting up more advanced stuff like a call center. Would like to see SMS support added with the ability to send/receive SMS and Voice through the web portal etc.

title: Priscilla was patient and explained and...
review: Priscilla was patient and explained and answered all questions. Phone call in answered promptly. No long wait time. Very personable and helpful. Would request her and Nextiva for our business purposes. Good quality. Best service. Would recommend to anybody interested in VOIP options. Best ever

title: Great company. Highly recommend. The...
review:
Great company. Highly recommend. The support team has been very helpful with all the issues we have had setting up the phone and voice mail and fax
I will make sure I tell others about Nextiva
The porting transfer of numbers went very smoothly. I was very hesitant about this part but all went well and I did not lose any phone calls

title: Nextiva is a great phone service.  We...
review: Nextiva is a great phone service. We need equipment quickly to avoid any downtime with our business. They expedited the delivery and called us to ensure we were able to utilized the new equipment. The service reps are always friendly and helpful on all our needs. If I had to choose all over again who to go with, I would still pick Nextiva.

cons: Terrible support and miscommunication between tram members.
title: Lots of issues and challenges the first...
review:
Lots of issues and challenges the first week. Was told different, conflicting information by multiple people.

App crashes still and gives errors often at the beginning of the day.

Overall, has been stressful and these issues have cost me money.

More communication between departments and staff would help.

title: The Nextica service is great!  Customer...
review: The Nextica service is great! Customer Service is exceptional! The support agents are very patient and thorough. They are always available for immediate support. The portal is extremely user friendly. I have used a competitor in the past with poor outcomes and would highly recommend Nextiva to another provider.

title: There are excellent features that are...
review: There are excellent features that are very convenient for users such as the cellphone app and the desktop computer app. You can move around from desktop to desktop with the desktop app, which is very convenient if your call center has to move around to different locations. The Call Center Dashboard is very good at pinpointing how to effectively meet call volume. The customer support is very good in terms of the amount of time that they will take to help you understand the Nextiva Platform in term of resolving and troubleshooting your problems. In terms of reliability it is as reliable as it can possibly because of the VOIP which is internet/wifi driven. There are times when calls come in on a consistent rolling basis, and then there are times when we absolutely do not see any activity.

title: Nextiva provides a great service at a...
review: Nextiva provides a great service at a reasonable price. The service I have received has been excellent, both during the purchase process and during setup. I would note that support has also been great both live (by telephone) and by chat. Because of some issues on our end, we ran into some difficulties. The chat support technician was very helpful and did not hesitate to remain online and providing assistance until all issues were resolved.

title: We switched to RingCentral from 8x8...
review: We switched to RingCentral from 8x8 because I needed a company that we can actually speak to and get through to. I was assured that a live person is always available and the longest wait they have experienced is around 20 minutes, which is totally acceptable. During the implementation process, this was true. It wasn't the smoothest transition in the world but it was fine. Since then we have received two unauthorized charges that were never discussed. I have called 5 times and left a message. None of them have been returned. I emailed our sales rep who said, "call or email any time with questions or concerns" three times with no response. I am now having to dispute the charges with our credit card company. Aside from being a huge frustration, it an enormous waste of my time, which I don't have extra of. I will say we have not had any problems with the service itself. We are happy with that and the extra features that RingCentral offers, but if you care about customer service and upfront pricing you should probably look at some other companies.

title: We have been using Nextiva for about a...
review: We have been using Nextiva for about a month now. I have done 100% of the in-office setup of our nextiva system myself with help of Nextiva support. All support personnel have been patient and thorough. There are a few things that could be done on the front end to let new users know what all nextiva support can help with that would have saved me some time, such as the fact that you don't have to set up the phone interface yourself. It can be done online, and they are happy to do it for you. It turns out it is much faster that way as well, but I wasted several hours trying to program the phone directory and read through phone literature to figure out the terminology of WHAT I wanted the phones to do. I have contacted support several times now though, and I am very pleased with them.

title: I called earlier today, in order to...
review: I called earlier today, in order to resolve some Admin issues and it was all taken care of effectively and in timely manner. It was not easy since I couldn't provide some necessary information as requested but this did not prevent resolving the issues we had. Thank you Natalie for you patience and professionalism. Thank you Nextiva for a great customer service.

title: It's been a great experience with...
review: It's been a great experience with nextiva. All agents are very helpful and walk you step by step to get the resolution I need. Set up has been a breeze and the service includes everything our business needs and more. I would recommend Nextiva to any start up business for their comprehensive set up and pricing.

title: I love the agents but the service is...
review: I love the agents but the service is extremely unreliable. I'm having to spend "hours" each week keeping our seven attorney lines in working order. There's a constant issue with calls not going through but straight to voicemails and leaving me unable to transfer calls to any one of the recipients throughout the day. One day , I spend 5 1/2 hours on the phone an spoke to no less than four technicians, only to have the problem re-occur the very next day. Very frustrating and we are looking to end our business relationship in spite of the 24 month contract.

title: It took a while to get my problem...
review: It took a while to get my problem fixed, but in the end everything was ok. The support team was patient and courteous. My case was escalated to a higher support group. The original tech guy did the right thing when he realized he couldn't fix the problem. I would recommend Nextiva to my colleagues!

title: Adding my first teammate made me want...
review: Adding my first teammate made me want to go with more than just my cell phone number. This has been a great option! The flexibility, functionality and ease of use made this a very easy decision. And, it's something that I can grow with. One of the added bonuses was the vfax service. I was using a different provider and that wasn't working out very well. Vfax has been great, along with everything else.

title: Nextiva allowed me to get all of my...
review: Nextiva allowed me to get all of my telephone functions with service provider. I had been using Nextiva, Vonage and Spectrum for quite some time (years) but now my phone systems are streamlined under Nextiva. No reason to have things so decoupled, when Nextiva can do it all under one roof! Glad to get this accomplished.

title: Service and features are awesome for...
review: Service and features are awesome for the price would recommend for anyone starting a business. I was using my cell phone but wanted an actual business line and they let you make calls from your cell phone using your business line and also has a text feature which is really cool the only thing that I had an issue with was support but we got it figured out.

title: Alex was awesome in helping me set-up a...
review: Alex was awesome in helping me set-up a robo-call block-list for scam calls into our company, potentially saving us thousands in lost revenue as a small business. I'd recommend Nextiva to anyone in the market looking for a reliable and solid solution to their phone call needs. Thanks again for the help, Alex !!

title: Great customer service, normally...
