review: Great customer service, normally available immediately, including after business hours. Agents for most part are well-trained and know what they are doing. Features are customizable, changes done on the go, no termination or downgrades charges. Easy access to a lot of back-end features for people who prefer to configure service on their own. Been happy for 7 years.

title: My employer uses Nextiva for phone...
review: My employer uses Nextiva for phone service. I had a tech issue with my phone and went to the online Nextiva support chat to try to resolve it. Alex M was my assigned agent. pros: Reliable service, great modern solution for corporate and retail environment
title: Our employees have nothing but positive...
review:
Our employees have nothing but positive feedback now that we're on a reliable, modern, agile phone system that fits well with remote work. Overall, works well for us and is quite reliable. I see new features continually being rolled out; I get the impression RingCentral cares greatly about improving their product based on customer feedback.

Works great with physical handset devices, so we recently expanded our footprint and replaced all of our aging PBX phone systems at our retail locations with RingCentral handsets.

We had some confusion at first with our employees who didn't know which apps to use, whether they should be using the browser, RingCentral MVP, RingCentral Phone, etc. Some features such as updating voicemail greetings could use some improvements, making them more intuitive. Also I should note that getting our existing lines into the RingCentral system took quite a long time with several months of preparation, but this consisted of several hundred lines. Our employees had to do most of the heavy lifting in terms of planning and preparation of porting in the lines.

RingCentral tech support could use a bit of improvement, but is generally ok. They tend to call you by phone for even the most minor of updates, which is a bit irritating especially when they're calling afterhours. A quick email update or a message in the support ticket is often sufficient.

title: To start, when you "onboard" with...
review:
To start, when you "onboard" with Nextiva, they have a pretty rock solid process. You are assigned an onboarding manager that will continually update you as you navigate through the process of system design, network testing, and number portability. They also provide training on the physical phones and their app, which is wonderful. I'm more of a self-learning person, so I did not take the training, instead I used their online KnowledgeBase resources which were well documented and easy to follow.

The mobile app is easy to use. My only challenge with the mobile app is there's not a great way to "silence" it if you are paired with a desk phone. When I'm in the office I don't want my mobile app to ring, but the only way to make it not ring is to sign out. Just wish there was an easy way to not have the mobile app ring.

Support wise, I've only ever used their chat feature on their support page. Wait times vary based on time of day, etc but it's great since I can switch to other tabs and just check back when support "bings" letting me know they're there. Every time I've needed support, whomever the Nextiva support rep is on the other end, I got the feeling they *really* know their system as they provided quick answers to some of my even more complicated questions. Great support experience, and from there I think that is wonderful.

Some features I wish they had though:
1) Custom Music on Hold is limited to one file and max size is 2Mb .wav format. Would love to have a "playlist" option for music on hold, and be able to use .MP3 format.
2) Call logs are okay, but if an incoming call rings a calling group/hunt group, the call logs show the call twice. Wish there was a way to help filter that out without having to purchase the advanced calling data license.

title: We run a doggy daycare and our clients...
review:
We run a doggy daycare and our clients heavily utilize SMS to book appointments through Nextiva. We had to shut our business down for 2 weeks while we did a remodel on our facilities. After the 2 weeks were up, clients were frantically trying to get in contact with us to make appointments for their pups for the following week. We had dozens of texts coming in, but our outbound texts were not being received by our clients. We were in a panic, because 1, we were losing business, and 2, we were losing our customer's confidence.

We called Nextiva support on a Saturday and held on the line for over an hour to speak to someone. Needless to say, this was a sticking point for us.
We understand the situation in Ukraine is ongoing, but we feel that at this point, Nextiva has had ample amount of time to regroup and get an adequate amount of support in place to service their clients. If this rating was based purely on the accessibility of tech support, I would give it 0 stars.

Fortunately, Nextiva has a handful of superstars on their team. When we finally got through to someone, we got one of those superstars. Robert N. was extremely helpful in getting our SMS system working and we even recovered our lost texts! We are super appreciative of the support he provided and are relieved that we can now contact our clients and regain their confidence. Thanks, Robert for saving the day!

title: We've been using RingCentral for two...
review:
We've been using RingCentral for two years, and are finally giving up and looking for a new unified communications provider.

Pros:

* It's very convenient being able to make and receive texts and phone calls from a PC, phone, or tablet.

Cons:

* Texting is very unreliable. There are constant text outages (a day at a time every month or more) where texts never arrive, arrive a half hour late, and/or arrive out of order. Image texts (MMS) are particularly unreliable.

* Support is useless. Reporting text outages or other issues will result in an email back from RingCentral hours later from someone who doesn't appear to have read the problem report, and who will ask for a bunch of testing steps that have nothing to do with the problem. Hours later another support analyst will email back with the same questions answered in the previous email exchange. Support has never provided us with helpful advice, so now when problems happen we just wait until they go away on their own.

* Occasional phone outages -- several hours once or twice a year. As I write this, our business can't make or receive any phone calls, which for all intents and purposes means we have no business.

* Severe voice call delay. When you say something on the phone, the other person doesn't hear it for more than a second. As a result, our employees always talk over customers and vice versa.

It's become embarrassing how often we have to email our customers telling them our phones are down.

title: We chose Nextiva as our VoIP provider...

All the people that we dealt with bent backward for us to accommodate all of our needs. The implementation process was smooth. We like using the Nextiva phones and apps as they are modern and are feature-rich.

title: Nextiva is friendly for small business...
review: Nextiva is friendly for small business like our company. Installation is fairly easy and their plan is very flexible. My onboarding project manager was great to work with and guided me step by step for everything I need to do to get my existing numbers ported and working on the new phone system. Unlike another company I worked with before, there is no additional hardware needed and is purely portable as long as an Internet connection is available (and as VOIP is supposed to be).

title: Very happy Nextiva customer.  Service...
review: Very happy Nextiva customer. Service is great, all features work as advertised and the cost can't be beat. Saves me over $50K annually over my last provider and service is much better. I've been a customer at two different companies and would not hesitate to install again should I ever move to another. I recommend to all my contacts.

title: The Nextiva phones are working as...
review: The Nextiva phones are working as expected, but some features could be more simplified. There's about 5 steps to transfer a call to someone's voicemail vs 2 steps on our old phones and I don't like that you have to scroll pages to see other coworkers extensions on the screen, they were listed on the big screen on our old phones. We would also like to be able to page a coworker by clicking their EXT button, but that rings to their line like a call instead, so you have to press a page button, dial the EXT and press the confirmation button. We also had a terrible time porting our numbers over from Spectrum, this took about 6 months to finally happen. We're still getting used to using the phones, but they look nice and the app feature is cool.

title: Using Nextiva has been wonderful! The...
review: Using Nextiva has been wonderful! The set up and onboarding was involved, but we had an account manager to assist us every step of the way. Now that we are on the other side of on boarding, the Nextiva support team is always there to help. I highly recommend using them! The app blends seamlessly with the desk phones and some of our remote workers only use the app, which is also very easy to use!

pros: Fairly intuitive configuration, easy to add new licenses
title: Move on past Vonage. We have been on...
review:
Move on past Vonage.

We have been on Vonage for one year. I had an optimistic view of Vonage being that they were one of the first VoIP providers in the market. The sales process was simple enough and our rep was pretty good. Everything after that point has been a complete disaster. First, despite us checking with our onboarding rep for clarification multiple times, our service was activated on a Wednesday night roughly a week and a half before I told them that we could go live. This immediately took down all of our existing phone lines and put us in a mad rush to both train users and finalize configuration.

Call quality has been spotty at best. It is understandable that with any VoIP solution, the quality is at the mercy of the users’ Internet connections. That said, in our main office we have 1 gbps up in 1 gbps down via fiber. Even in this environment with switch and network settings configured as recommended, often one side of the communication will fade in and out. This is also present on user’s individual cell phones when using the mobile app from home or at the office.

Additionally, we have call queues and call groups set up for several departments. Sometimes, at random,
the call routing will stop obeying the rules of those queues and groups. I have asked support about this when I can reach them, but the only answer I get is that’s strange and that they will investigate. To date, I have received no report describing the findings and root cause. When I did receive a response at one point, I was told that even though call groups should work as expected, we would need to purchase a call queue to use instead. When I asked why this was the case as we were using call groups within their limits, I was just told the queues were better suited for the use.

Our initial sales rep has been completely MIA the spite of promises that he would stay involved should we have any issues. Furthermore, we were supposed to be assigned an account representative for support, but I was told by someone else within the company that they did not have enough account reps onto assign one to our account. We have more than the 50 users required to entitle us to this.

All in all a terrible experience that has brought much angst to users and admins alike.

title: The Nextiva team represents among the...
review: The Nextiva team represents among the highest levels of customer service I have experienced. Information was accurate, responses to queries were turned around very fast. Answers were clear and where necessary detailed enough for us to make informed decisions quickly, minimising the end to end time to process complex transactions among a number of parties.

Finally a nice rep called me and said he'd get it fixed and did, I think, but it took two more months plus no email explaining the credits. I just let it go as amounts were small. title: I was pressured into going over to...
review: I was pressured into going over to internet based system towards the end of my existing contract. I would have to pay a higher rate and a one off payment for the kit. I said that I was concerned that there was no choice of handset and that I wanted a range as good as or better than my existing (and old) Panasonic cordless phones. From day one the system did not accept calls and they had to fiddle around to get the the line operating as it should. I cannot stop the system from including my iPhone in calls which means that I get missed calls twice and answerphone messages twice and calls on my home phone when I'm in the car. I can not erase messages on 1571. It keeps asking me if I dial 1571 if I still do not want Fax (who does?). I then tried to cancell the contract inside the 14 day cooling off period. I was told that Business contracts only have a 1 day cooling off period. Very difficult to contact the guy who originally sold the package. Finally I managed to get someone sensible who said that I could go back to my old system for a lower monthly bill than I had previously. Why didn't they say that in the beginning? I will now see if I can get my money back for my wasted costs but am not holding my breath.

title: We are one week into the essential...
review:
We are one week into the essential service so far and now that everything is setup it appears to be working well and reliably.

Setup had 2 unexpected challenges, 1) We were unable to setup routing due to an error that was quickly resolved by support (911 setup issue of some type). And 2)The fax service is not integrated into the main voice setup website. This isn't a big issue but finding the access to the virtual fax system was not intuitive at all, and my username to that system was not provided in any of the initial e-mails. My suggestions would be to provide a link to the fax system from the primary setup website and also add the virtual fax information to the setup e-mails.

Other than those suggestions the service has been good to us so far. Vfax isn't quite as modern of an interface as the primary system but it has worked well for us without issue after some experimentation. Reliability has been good for the first week (no observed downtime). Fair price for the features, I would recommend.

After informing them that I would speak with our bank and block any future payments, she threatened to send our account to collections for non-payment!
In my opinion, they are UNSCRUPULOUS THIEVES, trained to steal from you!
STAY AWAY FROM THESE CON ARTISTS!
Protect yourself and your money from their LACK OF MORALS and HONESTY. Find a reputable and decent company. NEXTIVA is not one of them!.

review: Not a helpful company. We were left to our own devices to try to figure out (unsuccessfully) how to fix our problem. Support personnel were difficult to understand, spoke in tech jargon, and did not know any more than I did. When I complained to a higher department, I was told I could get help from "better support people - not the people you've talked to before". This, to me, smacks of something akin to fraud.

title: We absolutely love Nextiva. We have...
review: We absolutely love Nextiva. We have used them for years. Their phone support and online support are above grade. You never get stuck in a message loop and always get a live person on the line. Most issues are fixed right while I am on the line with them. Great Job Nextiva. We will continue to use your services for years to come~

title: Overall 8x8 is technologically sound...
review: Overall 8x8 is technologically sound and fairly easy to operate. Sometimes with issues it takes a bit too long for someone to reply to the ticket so it would be nice if larger businesses like ours who use 8x8 could have more immediate live help. Instead, we have to submit online troubleshooting tickets which make us have to wait to hear back. But issues usually do get properly resolved.

cons: When we do have an issue, it takes a long time to eexplain it to a rep. It often feels they are not all trained at the same level
pros: Customer service will stay on the phone until every aaspect of my issue is solved
title: I like the online portal, it helps to...
review: I like the online portal, it helps to manage things in the office to the best of our ability to avoid having to call into Nextiva; that can be very challenging on a busy office/patient day. We rely heavily on Nextiva to book new patient appointment so I say 98% of the time we can rely on our calls coming through! I would like the handhelds to be a bit more modern as some of our employees get confused with hold button and how long it takes to recover a call. Often they feel the call was disconnected, but in reality they didn't wait long enough for the phone to refresh. Thanks for your time and attention!

title: I've been very happy with the service...
review: I've been very happy with the service and support so far. My only critique is that the terminology was all new to me so I ended up ordering incorrect parts for my phone service. That was quickly corrected though. I've also had two needs for support assistance already, but they have been helpful and stayed with me until it was resolved. I'm not sure how you could make it more user friendly (you have the guides already) but I found myself more confused than with other software solutions I use and setup regularly.

cons: Nothing that I can think of now.  Maybe they can publicize all available features
pros: Very stable platform and Support is alway readily available to help us whenever we need.
title: Very stable service. We have been using...
review: Very stable service. We have been using Nextiva for two years now. We never had any outage that was perceived as critical. The support is always there to help and make the necessary changes that we need for the service. The only thing is if someone can update us on a regular basis to introduce us to all the features, and train us to be more proficient users of the VOIP system. Overall good stable service for and a great value for the money.

cons: Rip offs, Rude, Poor Qual & Support
title: I'm a business Owner who used to be...
review: I'm a business Owner who used to be with Birch until it switched to Fusion. Birch was fine but after it switched to Fusion my rates went from $300 to $600 per month with less service. With Birch I had two voice lines, one fax and 2- T'1's internet. With Fusion I have same except NO fax bc they dont have it. Fusion piles on the taxes, and fees, like FCC fee which they were charging me $117/month until I called my Lawyer who sent them a letter and, although Fusion doesnt admit to that being the reason, they reduced the fee to $34/month which is more like what Ive paid for last 20 years of business. Customer support wants your money and will go lengths to get it. They are rude, and unknowledgable. I could get into details, but trust me. You dont want to use this company.

title: We have had excellent service since day...
review:
We have had excellent service since day one. We like so much we recommend Nextiva to our partners and clients as well and they are pleased with their service too.
We love the phone and desktop apps. Our staff can WFH seamless and that has helped us a lot since all the disruption during COVID.
We have used Nextiva for the last 5 years and the service has been consistent and reliable and any changes that we request have been implemented in a timely manner.

title: Nextiva is a breath of fresh air;...
review: Nextiva is a breath of fresh air; allowing all sorts of options that local telecommunications companies don't offer or refuse to offer. Our company has been serviced by Nextiva now for over 7 years and we have never had an issue; the prices are very fair, the options are abundant and the 24/7 service is exceptional. Anytime I can't find the option I'm looking for, it is a pleasant phone call away! Thank you Nextiva! You allow us to do what we are supposed to be doing, running our business!

title: Consolidated two locations and needed...
review: Consolidated two locations and needed to adjust the call groups. Emailed Brian and he set up a phone appointment in a timely manner. Eugene and Brian listened to my needs and responded in an efficient and courteous manner. After the changes were made, they called in to be sure the fixes were made. Very nice customer service.

pros: Great service. Never any troubles or down time.
title: Excellent voip service and excellent...
review: Excellent voip service and excellent customer service. Have used for over a year now with no interruptions. Great pricing compared to competitors as well. I don't see making any changes anytime soon due to the great service and the customer service team is always so helpful. Would definitely recommend!!!

title: Nextiva has provided several of our...
review: Nextiva has provided several of our clients with a reliable VOIP service. Their support services although sometimes take longer than desired to make initial contact are always very helpful and are able to resolve my issues or make the changes I need to the call flows. Travis our account manager is a very knowledgeable and helpful contact.

title: Nextiva is great, been with them for...
review: Nextiva is great, been with them for almost 10 years. The system works great and the features are on point. SMS is not quite there yet, MMS and group messaging do not work. The cell phone app is a little on the unreliable side but is a great tool to have in your pocket. Highly recommend Nextiva over many of the others.

title: RingCentral is great! I really like how...
review: RingCentral is great! I really like how easy it is to use. There are a few features I would like, mainly an automatic feature to leave a voicemail, but all in all this is a great tool for my business! The only other con is not really a con of RingCentral, but if you lose internet or have a poor internet connection then you phone will not work.

title: Customer support is the best, always...
review: Customer support is the best, always available, friendly, and extremely helpful. I would recommend Nextiva to anyone! We have been with Nextiva for over 2 years now and their pricing is very reasonable. We have had a lot of minor technical issues, nothing major, but Nextiva support is always able to resolve in a timely manner.

title: We needed to set up a new phone for an...
review:
We needed to set up a new phone for an employee and needed to do a little troubleshooting during the initial set up. The representative was helpful and knowledgeable and was able to assist us appropriately.

The system works well for our needs but I have found that the conversation does occasionally become distorted during certain connections.

title: Being based in Alaska can present...
review: Being based in Alaska can present challenges with VoIP phone systems, however, Nextiva has made our experience amazing. We had assigned dedicated Nextiva reps to assist us from the initial quote to onboarding and now we have a dedicated account representative. During the onboarding, all our questions and concerns were addressed quickly and resolved before moving onto the next phase. We've had to contact Nextiva Enterprise Support and they'll been helpful, knowledgeable and urgent in solving our issues. Overall, were happy with the service, value and support that Nextiva provides.

cons: Off shore customer support can create communication challenges depending on the strength of the accent
pros: Relative ease of use.  Customer support is thorough
title: We have just begun installing 8x8 in...
review: We have just begun installing 8x8 in two locations. One went without a hitch, the other is more complicated and has had a few hiccups. Customer Support has been diligent to work though issues to get things resolved. Each person that I have spoken with has been patient, kind, understanding, and willing to do what it takes to resolve the issue.

title: Great all around. Ihor is amazing in...
review: Great all around. Ihor is amazing in customer service. Phones always work. Calls are always clear. People answer when you call support. Used to use 8x8 and switched because their server always crashed. We have used Nextiva for over 5 years and our phones have never been down once. Simply the best.

pros: Lots of features and great customer service
title: I just had a great experience with you....
review:
I just had a great experience with you. There was a feature I had but didn't know how to customize it. I called in, waited less than a minute and got put through to a rep. The shortest wait time of all of the support teams I reach out to.

The rep was very professional and he knew his stuff. What I really liked was I told him what my situation was-asked just a couple of questions and knew exactly what I was needing and hw to give it to me. Not only was he fixing my problem he was explaining why I had this issue in the first place and walked through step by step what he was doing. It was a really great experience. I highly recommend doing business with Nextiva.

title: I had this service for at least 5...
review: I had this service for at least 5 years. As long as you don't have to call support this is a great product. We use the service for work and it is great for call recording and call monitoring. The mobile apps work great. Another issue is call recording, the software is slow, and if you wanted to categorize your call recording it's difficult.

title: We have used Nextiva few years now for...
review: We have used Nextiva few years now for the phone service . Their price is reasonable, and they have good customer service. I just had some issues with the online login and had a great experience with the support call. The problem was resolved instantly, the technician was knowledgeable and extremely helpful.

cons: Security to get into account is exact, you need to have specific information.
pros: Remote features to work from home and office.  The support team  availability if I need help
title: My last troubleshooting with the...
review:
My last troubleshooting with the support was a customized challenge. I got on with a support agent named Romeo and he went to battle with me to figure out how to customize the new phones with images and logos for the business. I am so appreciative for his time and effort working out the configuration to get this to work. He really put great effort and hours to get this issue fixed. He did an awesome job and now we have unique Brand logo images on the phone background and it looks sharp and innovative on these brand new phones.
It’s these little things that make a brand like Nextiva stick out and support people like Romeo that bring home that final touch. We worked on the phone for a while and I greatly appreciated his patients and persistence to help.

title: I provide IT services and am handling...
review: I provide IT services and am handling the setup of a satellite office. They needed 3 extensions but didn't have network wiring in place. Nextiva had a great option with cordless desktop phone sets. The price was very reasonable, and setup was pretty easy once you get the base station added in the Nextiva portal. It took me less than 30 minutes to have all 3 phones assigned an extension and ready to go!

pros: Call Quality, Support, Ease of Use, Pricing
title: We switched to Nextiva from a POTS...
review:
We switched to Nextiva from a POTS system for all of our locations across the US approximately 3 years ago. From the start everything has been fantastic from the onboarding process, the instruction and guidance on using the system, to adding features and devices at a moments notice.

The quality of our calls and the slew of features available to our company since switching to Nextiva, that either weren't available with our POTS system or were extremely complicated to setup and use, has not only helped streamline our business for internal employees and our customers alike, but has made everything related to company communications so much faster and easier to manage.

I'm a one man IT team and I alone am able to make changes, manage, monitor, setup, and change anything that's needed from one dashboard with ease across all of our location in the US. If there ever has been an issue that I have not been able to resolve someone has always been available to quickly resolve the problem. Support is amazing. Everyone has always been friendly, professional, and helpful. Our account manager is just an email or phone call away and has always been more than willing to take over and resolve any issues we have by getting us directly in touch with support or trying to rectify anything himself without making me do much legwork.

Pricing is cheaper than the system we had before by at least half and we couldn't be happier with the features and quality of everything that comes with Nextiva. The ability for those of us who need VoIP and messaging functionality on our cell phones when we aren't at our desks has been great as well.

Even during this pandemic and crazy winter weather we have had lately the ability to literally unplug a phone and take it home with us when we anticipate work at home conditions without any need for reconfiguring or setting anything up again has been a HUGE time saver.

Anyone considering switching to VOIP phones that are hesitant, or even if you are with a company now who hasn't been up to snuff, I highly recommend Nextiva because we couldn't be happier with every single aspect of Nextiva as a whole.

title: This phone system does everything we...
review: This phone system does everything we need PLUS! The customer service is absolutely AMAZING and very helpful. I was needing help with setting up our call flow so I jumped on the chat to see if I could get some help. The customer service rep offered to set up a call with a Nextiva tech to get everything set up for me so I know its done correctly.

title: Reaching Nextiva was effortless! Less...
review:
Reaching Nextiva was effortless! Less then a 30 second wait for Mariia to answer.
Mariia was accurate, speedy, polite and a pleasure to work with. Very pleased with her service and professionalism.
Nextiva is very lucky to have a person as dedicated to perfect service like Mariia.
Thank you Nextiva for your excellent service and response

title: We have been using this now for a...
review: We have been using this now for a couple months and find it very helpful and reliable. The features are just what we needed and the app (both phone or Laptop) and website access works outstanding. Support is very helpful. I have contacted Support for clarification and both time have been very happy with the response and the support team

title: Great support staff. Attention to...
review: Great support staff. Attention to detail. Good documentation and review. We had an issue about a feature that we though had been installed but after learning more about this portion of the product we were able to get a better understanding and then adjust what we needed done. The follow up was very critical as it provided additional information that will help us going forward.

cons: The Nexitvia mobile could use so imporvrovement.
title: My company has been with Nextiva for 8...
review: My company has been with Nextiva for 8 years and the service has only been down once for a very short in those 8 years. I looked at switching mainly looking for better pricing, but to be honest, I'm afraid to mess with something that's been so reliable. The service and support are impeccable I've never had an issue that wasn't resolved. I also recommend Nextiva's service if I'm asked.

title: Price, reliability, features, all...
review: Price, reliability, features, all included is excellent. Highly recommend. The phones offered are of good quality, offered free of charge. The only drawback that I have had is with the support following the initial sale. The salesperson I encountered left out key information, such as how to port numbers, when to port numbers, when account was going live. All in all I would still highly recommend service as support has been fantastic since.

title: The service that Nextiva provides is...
review:
The service that Nextiva provides is great. I have had a few hiccups here and there with service but I believe its because of my service area. Now, I've only had the service for a month.

The support they provide when you have an issue is great, quick and resolved very quickly. Nextiva is great so far.

pros: Arsen was extremely helpful in assisting us for hours to ensure our settings were correct!
title: Arsen was so very helpful in assisting...
review: Arsen was so very helpful in assisting VidaVascular with their phones. He spent hours dedicated to completing the job over multiple days as we have multiple locations and do not staff those locations daily. He truly was patient with remote access issues & helpful in taking his time to ensure success with all phone systems in each locaton! Thank you Arsen, from the VidaVascular team!

title: I was facing an issue and The Support...
review:
I was facing an issue and The Support agent Mr Dmytro S helped me in resolving it.

i did wait 15 to 20 minutes for the support to come which i thought was pain as i needed urgent support , but once Mr Dmytro S connected with me , he was able to rectify it quickly .
he also shared me few links from where i can get some knowledge which i thought was really kind

Thanks

title: Reliable most of the time with...
review: Reliable most of the time with occasional and rare outages and issues. Have had some challenges with provisioning our phones but the online support is amazing. Had some minor irritating problems with one phone that Anastasiia O was finally able to resolve. I enthusiastically and highly recommend this provider.

title: I have been a customer of Nextiva for...
review:
I have been a customer of Nextiva for about 2 years now and they are the best phone service company I've ever worked with. Their plans are low-cost, setting up service is very doable on your own (but they have great tech support to guide you), and on rare occasion if we do have a service issue, I'm always able to quickly reach their tech support team via live chat online, and every time they resolve my issue patiently and professionally. No follow-ups ever needed. Why pay more for bad service? That was the case for our previous VOIP service.

With Nextiva, I get low-cost service without compromise on customer support. They rock on every front!

cons: hard to get to a CSR
title: Our company has been with 8x8 for...
review: Our company has been with 8x8 for several years. I rarely have issues but when I do I prefer to speak with a human that can resolve my issue. I do not want to be re-directed to the online robot for assistance. When calling the customer service line, it's fine to point out that assistance is available online, but I should still have the choice to speak with an agent.

title: The best advantage to anything Nextiva...
review: The best advantage to anything Nextiva is the professional Tech Support. No matter when I call or what my need is, they get me to the right person. Their answers are always in laymen's terms and they also provide detailed follow-up. I highly recommend a relationship with Nextiva for communication needs.

title: I have used the chat feature with...
review: I have used the chat feature with Nextiva to address questions and issues several times. My last session was with Oles and I was extremely satisfied with his technical support and professionalism. He was very clear and patient and addressed all my concerns. I would highly recommend him and this service.

cons: Set up does take a while
title: Customer service was very patient and...
review: Customer service was very patient and was quickly available. The new call flow setup and website to modify feature/flow are easy to navigate. The setup process does take a while. It took me about a half-day to get our phones set up, but the technician was patient and was diligent in getting us set up properly. The app for users is also very good and works great.

cons: The phone service stops working without warning, misinformation, poorly trained support reps
pros: The phone service works most of the time.
title: My company switched to Nextiva about 4...
review:
My company switched to Nextiva about 4 months ago and we are looking into switching to another company. The worst part, the phones don't work consistently, and you never know when they're going to stop working because Nextiva won't notify you. Nothing has gone smoothly with Nextiva. The day we switched to Nextiva we ended up having no phone service even though I spent the entire day on the phone with several support representatives trying to make sure it went smoothly.

The support representatives are poorly trained, but instead of admitting they don't know something and tranferring you to a person who does, they will try to fix the issue and will create more problems in the process. Even the advanced support representatives constantly give us contridictory information, and we're always second guessing what we're told.

The breaking point was when the phone system suddenly stopped working, and all calls were sent to a busy signal. And then it happened again. And again. Even though it's a known problem, Nextiva didn't attempt to fix it until we found out the phones weren't working and called in to Nextiva support. Our phone service has stopped working three times in the last month and a half, and one time we didn't know until they'd been down for nearly a week because, well, no one could call us to tell us the phone system doesn't work.

It's been one issue after another with Nextiva. At one point they said they'd refund a month of service for all the hassle, but they didn't do that. We had to call and ask them about it multiple times.

I would NOT recommend this company. They promised a lot in the beginning, but untimately failed to deliver. Thank goodness we didn't get a contract.

title: I have had the privilege of working...
review: I have had the privilege of working with Eugene and each time he has been courteous and professional...He is always willing to help...During the onboarding process... I have had several experiences where I have needed assistance with our new hires or issues with the system. In every call he is patient, takes time to explain the process and quick to take care of the situation. Eugene is truly an exemplary employee...Keep up the great customer service!

title: I don't understand this service. I...
review:
I don't understand this service.

I make a payment for the company and they continuously email me about late payments. The payment was never late to begin with.

When I reach out to customer service they promise to "reply within 4 hours" but 1 day later I get another late payment notice.

When someone reaches out to my email like a human being and resolves this issue, I will remove this review

title: Excellent tool. The support services...
review:
Excellent tool. The support services take the time to assist and in your convenience time such as late in the evening.
Furthermore, I have the ability to download the app in my cellphone and have the services remotely. That's very convenient.
Lastly, but not the least, having the record voice is very good idea!

title: Very easy to Install. Tech support...
review: Very easy to Install. Tech support gives 100% to resolve issues you have during installation. had issue wit an ATA device tech support worked as hard as they could to resolve the issue. On the same site installed an fax device had to register the device on the web site. After registration a message came back saying it could take up to 24 hours to activate. had a message in less the 30 min saying it was good to go.

title: Everyone is friendly and very helpful....
review: Everyone is friendly and very helpful. Plus service is quick. I had had this service for three years now and haven’t had any problems. I use Nextiva for my office telephone lines and fax machine number. The company makes service easy with just a text, email or phone call. I would highly recommend Nextiva!

title: Nextiva is a great VIOP provider due to...
review: Nextiva is a great VIOP provider due to its pricing and easy-to-use features. Support is very quick to respond to any tickets. Nextiva's service is very reliable and has very minimal downtime as compared to other providers, and the quality of their VOIP service is up there with other major VOIP providers.

title: Ring central has been amazing! there...
review: Ring central has been amazing! there customer service team is the best and their phones/app can do everything! we started our com[any 2 years ago and went out on a limb by picking ring central as our phone service provider! there is no end to the different ways you can set up the call handling. best choice we have made yet!

title: Netxiva's service and support has been...
review: Netxiva's service and support has been solid. They are always willing to help and come up with solutions, even when they are difficult to uncover. I would recommend Nextiva for your phone needs. The app on mobile devices is decent, but could use a little improvement. All in all, I would recommend them.

cons: the platform is somehow a bit confusing
title: They have a great support team and I...
review: They have a great support team and I had no problem with being connected with them fast enough and they try their best to solve any problem I had at the moment. Their price is also reasonable. But their platform is somehow hard for me to set up and control. Overall, I think Nextiva is a decent VOIP company.

title: The customer service agent was able to...
review: The customer service agent was able to swiftly answer my questions with ease. The agent was able to discover the root of my problem immediately and was able to resolve it by walking me through a step by step process. The agent had a great personality and made the entire process stress free. I would totally recommend this service to all of my friends!

pros: Once its working its solid along with support having gotten much better
title: Once the phone systems are setup they...
review: Once the phone systems are setup they work well. The setup process can be a nightmare. NextOS has gotten much better. In all installs I have had to go over the setup with a fine tooth comb as the onboarding techs set it up wrong more often than they set it up correctly. There is a miscommunication between the onboarding reps and the techs that need to be reviewed and tested before sent out. Short of that support is pretty good and the hold times have decreased a lot. If there are larger issues their higher level support techs are amazing and willing to take the time to help. I haven't had to do a phone install in about 6 months so onboarding may have gotten better. I think the devices work well it just takes a lot of leg work on the people who are setting it up to make sure its working to our clients needs.

title: Before Nextiva I was using regular...
review: Before Nextiva I was using regular phone service, I got a phone call offering theirxservices, in the beginning I was skeptical since I didn't know how it works, I decided to give it a try, its been over 2 years and can't see me life without Nextiva service, it makes look more professional and it's very easy to use it. I highly recommended it.

title: Nextiva has every feature we were...
review: Nextiva has every feature we were looking for and more - We started with a smaller setup and as the business grew Nextiva was able to change and adapt more features to help us - support is always very responsive and seems genuinely happy to help - the last time I was on the phone with a support member they were showing me tons of useful features I had no idea about that were unrelated to the call - truly above and beyond! Couldn't recommend them more to anyone!

title: We have been using Nextiva for the past...
review:
We have been using Nextiva for the past few years with little or no issues at all. No software is pefect and Nextiva has some areas in which improvement can be found. However, regarding their support and reliability I must say it is excellent and as such we no complaints in that matter. They always take our calls in a friendly manner and even show us how to resolve it ourselves in case this is needed. Today we had an issue with some of our profiles and they quickly took my call and were able to fix the issue in no time and explained to me the best way to fix it in the future if it happened again.
Nextiva is an excellent software and I hope it continues to improve and maintain its excellence.

cons: can be a long wait time for chat,
title: Overall I like the service and customer...
review: Overall I like the service and customer service is on point when you finally get ahold of someone on chat - the wait time is long. but I prefer chat. I also wish it was easier to make changes etc. I used to work at a phone company (sales and customer service) and I still can't get even the simplest thing completed through the website. On the other hand, I know that phone provisioning is not as easy as it looks.

title: We have a 6 person/phone office. ...
review: We have a 6 person/phone office. Simple issues took too much time to solve, like voice to text voicemail and then changing a greeting remotely. The software did not work like it should, and was not user friendly. I hear their new platform is easier, but that doesn't help us on the platform from 2018. Finally a level 2 tech support agent Eugene Khablenko resolved our issues TODAY. He was capable and found a solution!

title: We moved to Ring Central after...
review: We moved to Ring Central after experimenting with other options. They were the only solution that had an integration with Pipedrive and we are happy with our choice. The only feature we are waiting for them to implement is the tracking and analytics around SMS messages. Their support is all star and they respond very quickly. I would recommend them

title: 8x8 offers a great product and is very...
review:
8x8 offers a great product and is very user-friendly, the IVR is good and reliable. Integration with Salesforce can be a bit "wonky" but once set up correctly it works rather well.
The intelligent IVR is a bit more difficult to use and errors are not frequent but they happen, it will get better as time passes I am sure of that.

pros: Cost effective, Call Quality, and Great Support team
title: We've been with Nextiva for over 7...
review: We've been with Nextiva for over 7 years and we believe we chose the right provider from the start. They have always had great call quality and their support is always there to help if needed. Just got off the phone with Maria who helped me provision my new CISCO 8841 and it was a smooth process. Thank you Nextiva, keep up the good work.

title: I have been having app issues for a...
review: I have been having app issues for a while now but support her been great. I do like the phone system as it allows my clinicians to keep their cell phones private. This has been great as having clients know your actual cell number is sometimes detrimental. This has also been great for the pandemic as we are able to work from home easily without compromising anyone's privacy.

title: Your advanced support team was...
review: Your advanced support team was courteous and knowledgable in fixing my connectivity issue. Ihor was patient and took the necessary time to locate and correct the issue. If I ever need support again I will be confident that the advanced support team will be able to solve any issue that arises. Thank you!

cons: Sometimes challenging to get good help with issues arrise
title: If you can get a helpful...
review: If you can get a helpful representative, Nextiva works really well for operating both an in office and remote phone service. Vasylysa (Lisa) was top notch with her level of service today! Helped confirm all of issues were resolved and explained where we could go on the website to confirm corrections. If you get a representative that is less than helpful, TRY AGAIN! Because there are representatives who are able to solve your problems. Lisa fixed our issues with the auto attendant, even when it required her to test 3/4 different solutions. Nextiva isn't perfect and we have had some issues with the remote connection being delayed and not always clear, but overall things work well, and I love being able to take calls no matter where I am or what I am doing. Can be frustrating if you are constantly making changes to phone system, as the more you change the more likely you run into set up issues, but we only update about once a year. I just plan for that interaction to take up most of my day.

title: Thanks very much for your service. I...
review: Thanks very much for your service. I really appreciate the service. Please just help us tp customize some of the report especially when answering phones from the laptop my agent are strugglinh to input time in and our, so I will appreciate if something about it is done inthe near future, but otherwise things works well

title: Nextiva VOIP Services had been a...
review: Nextiva VOIP Services had been a fantastic system for our needs. It is very reliable and the support is quick to help us. Nextiva provides us with a host of organizational elements, such as customer relationships, collaboration, video conferencing, and VoIP services. Not only is the design conducive to high scalability, but its cloud presence effectively supports in-office, remote, and hybrid teams. Beyond traditional phones, team members can use any microphone-enabled device that can support the Nextiva application.

title: The support is phenomenal!  Every tech...
review: The support is phenomenal! Every tech I have worked with is knowledgeable and thorough and also very courteous. title: I switched my business lines from...
review:

Nextiva also gives you Technical Support from people who actually understand the products offered and can actually help you.

Vonage: Okay for an expensive home line ($50.00/month after taxes although MagicJack is far better [$40-$50/YEAR] than Vonage if you're only calling to the USA). For business Vonage doesn't offer most of the features Nextiva does

Nextiva: Well, I think I've blown their horn well enough. As they add more features it will get even better.

title: We recently switched over from Vonage....
review:
We recently switched over from Vonage. Main driver was price but Voiply has some other advantages. Everyone talks about their customer service. It's not BS. In the past month I have chatted with them several times. I believe you can get a real human in minutes 24/7. And they help resolve issues extremely well.

One feature that seems it should be better is the SpamBot. In our Vonage set-up, we used NoMoRobo via simultaneous ring. The SPAM call would ring once and then hang up. Voiply's SPAM management is supposedly an integration on NoMoRobo right into Voiply's system. Why on earth then would it take 2 and occasionally 3 rings to shut down a SPAM call. If it's not as fast or faster than setting up a simultaneous ring (like Vonage) then why not just do it that way and give customers a better experience.

I would also like to see better call log features. Number one on the missing list is the ability to download into Excel to slice & dice the calls.

A feature that we like better in Voiply than Vonage is how the app works in receiving calls on our mobile devices. With Vonage, it was a straight simultaneous ring where as in Voiply it comes into the Voiply app as data. Maybe a subtle difference but several advantages to this approach: 1) by not coming in as a call, it will never go to the mobile's voice mail if unanswered or if the mobile is turned off; 2) you can set a different ring tone from calls so you know it's a forwarded land line call; 3) If you are in a foreign country with no or expensive cell service, the home calls will come in as data. We were also pleasantly surprised to see that the app still connects to Bluetooth in the car.

I'm curious about some of these bad reviews because we had none of those experiences. We use it to call contacts in Europe, and it works beautifully! There is always a learning curve when changing any sort of "system", so beyond being as prepared as possible (or running some phones on the old system while you change over...), I'd wouldn't hesitate to change to Dialpad!

review: Our company moved from a traditional VoiP system (desk phones only) in late 2019. While there were issues in the setup, once we got everything transferred and set up with our employees, we had a good experience, just part of the learning curve...then the world changed in March of 2020 and we sent most of our employees home due to the worldwide pandemic, therefore, DialPad was a lifesaver for us. If we would have been on our old system when we sent everyone home, we would not have survived, or thrived, during the pandemic. It was a total game-changer for our company and I'm very thankful for the service they provide. It hasn't provided every single thing we thought it would, but our business wouldn't have made it through the year or so of WFH environment that we were all forced into. Overall, I'm very grateful for Dialpad and all the service they provide. Great partner in my mind!

Not sure whose idea this was or what the problem was but it is now corrected. It really works well when it works but those 8-10 days were a VERY stressful time as it really impacted my production. Understand that I had been using the program for many months prior to this issue occurring with no issues and it just started one morning when I logged in and continued till today.

title: We started using bOnline in April 2020...
review:
We started using bOnline in April 2020 for their VoIP services, and in all my years in business, signing up with bOnline has been one of my biggest regrets.

When the system is ‘working’, the calls constantly drop and the actual call quality is very poor with the lines constantly sounding like they are fuzzy or really crackly. Calls frequently don’t get through to us and sometimes they do get through to the software but it won’t let us answer. Sometimes the phone can be ringing and we’re all wildly trying to answer across all our devices. Like any business, missing calls is bad for reputation and the bottom line however bOnline just don’t seem to care. We are nearly a year down the line in a three year contract and I have asked numerous times to be let out of my contract and to part ways amicably as they genuinely seem unable to deliver a functioning product however this request has never been answered and all they’ve done for us despite daily issues is grant me a one time £30 credit.

I am the company director and they’ve left me with a phone line that works maybe 1 hour in every 24 for months now. The last communication I had with one of the support team was on the 13th of January when he said he was on a call right at that moment trying to sort things for me and would be straight back in touch after the call. There has been no update since, and I’ve emailed three further errors with no response.

I purchased a VoIP system that worked on both desktop and mobile to provide the ability for people to work from home during evening and weekends - bOnline barely works on anyones mobile so I’ve ended up in the office on the evening and weekends trying to use the desktop to make important calls and I’ve also had to pay staff overtime to stay in the office late during busy periods.

When we originally got the system we were asking frequently for support from the team to try to get things to work better, but they talked us through the same steps almost every time. Our Wifi and computer systems which operate every other software systems we use with no issue were continually blamed by BOnline. At one point we were told the latest Mac update was to blame and that we had to downgrade our software to continue using bOnline. When we advised we couldn’t do this as all other apps would eventually struggle to work with downgraded software the customer representative on the live chat sent us a sad face emoji.

Sometimes, you can get the app to work by deleting it, re downloading it and reactivating your soft phone. This is what bOnline suggest you do every time it stops working. The team can do this multiple times a day between all our phones with varying degrees of success.

title: Ive been using 8x8 for many years. The...
review: Ive been using 8x8 for many years. The support was absolutely wrecked when covid hit, understandable but it has yet to recover. I feel like at this point there is no excuse except they are in money saving mode and refuse to bring back phone support or make it as minimal as possible. Over the years the phones have definitely been hit and miss but I can't tell if its internet issues, router issues or phone issues. We are using 300MB commercial grade fios but we still experience a tremendous amount of dropped calls, ghost calls and lost people on hold. 8x8 always has an excuse as to why the calls get dropped but we still haven't resolved it or truly identified the issue. Now our phones are going "unregistered" often and I am having to completely wipe all the phones and reinstall them which has been a tremendous pain in the ass to do because they all have to be manually provisioned and setup on a FTP network for security. Also their MAC password system is a fucking joke! Please please please change the password entry method and the password entry types. Blind entering the mac password on these phones makes me just want to end it all and launch my minivan off a cliff. seriously, its the worst system ever. The positive part is that the phones have been "OK" but not perfect. The system does require regular maintenance and its not a set it and forget it system. The phone help used to be great but now you cant reach them, ever. You are forced to use an automated "Otto" that is terrible at identifying issues. The online chat system is OK when they answer but I have waited quite awhile to get through on occasion. The youtube videos are helpful but surprisingly the best youtube videos for help are not 8x8's and instead just some dude who got frustrated at following 8x8's guide and just made his own tutorial videos. The quality isn't as good but the info is on point and actually works versus the 8x8 training videos. Overall, be prepared to become an IT guy/girl if you buy these phones. Not for beginners.

title: I tried really hard to give this...
review: I tried really hard to give this company a fair shot, but as a small business that lost customers due to the communication/technical issues I faced, I can no longer support it. I spent an insane amount of hours on the phone with technical support and every time I called they had me reinstall the app which deleted ALL my contacts with no ability to retrieve them. The call quality was poor regardless if it was via cellular or wifi calling, technical support couldn't solve my problems, but above all else the customer service was truly awful. They offered to credit me $36 for an app that helped me lose customers not acquire them. It really is a slap in the face considering it cost me several hundreds of dollars in lost revenue. I do not recommend this app and want to save other small business owners from the hassle and dismissal I've endured while being a customer of Nextiva. Purchase another line, this service is most certainly not worth it.
