review: We have Twilio integrated with Salesloft and are BEYOND frustrated with their support in having international numbers allocated to us. For US only service, they may be ok but for international corporations, this solution is less than adequate. While they are bound by carrier rules, their timeliness and support is terrible. We will look to see if we can get another solution for our International dialing needs. It has taken more than 9 months and we still do not have a phone number for Japan. I am opt'ing to go post this as this needs to be fixed and I want others to be aware before they sign!

title: This company is a mess.  They seem to...
review: This company is a mess. They seem to have it together but that is only an illusion. The first problem you will have is setting it up. NOT EASY! After hours of talking and working with people for days. When it works it drops calls and people sound like they are in a tunnel. You will call them for help. They will suggest that you use cell phones with 5 G that will fix all your problems. So you sign up for extra lines on your cell phone plan when that doesn’t work they will suggest you get some desk phones. Out of Desperation you will spend that 300 plus and guess what they don’t have any it will be 2 months before you get them. I spent 1300 total and they won’t refund any of my money. One Business owner to another. Look Elsewhere!!!!!!!!

title: I've used the Nextiva service for our...
review: I've used the Nextiva service for our small business for over a year and it's been reliable and super easy to use. Their fax comes straight into your email if you configure it just right, which is convenient when you telecommute as it's so common nowadays in these current times. Their support staff try their best to make everything is done properly by the end of your call.

title: great service from the start good...
review: great service from the start good customer services, will recommended to our friend and family, after checking with other provided, 8x8 come up on top of there service, we hope we we do business for a long time ...............................................................................................

title: A shoutout to Axvoice for staying...
review: A shoutout to Axvoice for staying affordable even in 2022. And seriously, this is the first time in so many years, I am reconsidering using a VoIP phone over my Verizon while I am at home or in the office. Axvoice doesn’t have their app for phones so that’s quite a bummer. The app I downloaded from the app store is not great either, so the one-the-go calling experience is not there. The rest is absolutely great.

title: Had some issue with login at first, was...
review: Had some issue with login at first, was resolved by nextiva support, everyone iIspoke to was very helpful. Saving me a small fortune over my landline business phone plan. The app on my cellphone is extremely helpful as I am a one person office and work in the field at least some most days. One drawback, I was told texting would work to my phone, but I cannot receive texts.

title: Setting up was seamless thanks to...
review: Setting up was seamless thanks to customer support. Olga S. (Support Escalations Manager) was the most pleasant and knowledgeable expert on porting numbers and helping me setup my Cisco hardphone with Nextiva. I was unavailable for most of the week to receive calls but Olga called every day to make sure my issue was resolved until I picked up the phone. She patiently went over details with me to make sure I understood the process of porting my lines properly. These people really care about getting your issues resolved.

title: Terrible.  I haven't signed a contract...
review: Terrible. I haven't signed a contract ever, but they will not let me cancel one line without paying for 6 months of service. VOIP is supposed to bring flexibility not the lack of flexibility. Terrible. I haven't signed a contract ever, but they will not let me cancel one line without paying for 6 months of service. VOIP is supposed to bring flexibility not the lack of flexibility.

title: Moving from a PRI service to VoIP with...
review: Moving from a PRI service to VoIP with Nextiva has been a great experience from implementation to daily operation. The Implementation team helps a lot but the admin portal is really easy to use. I was able to set the X-885 phones by myself with no issues. Support is always available and it was one of my concerns before moving to Nextiva. I check reviews about Nextiva and they said that support was not helping enough but in my experience it is the opposite. Support is helpful and it is available in a short wait time.

title: Excellent VOIP services with functional...
review: Excellent VOIP services with functional cellphone App, I can answer the call from my extension number anywhere, or call up for a group meeting, specially the customer support, get problem solved whatever it is, technical support with good knowledge to answer any technical questions, 8x8 is the best provider in VoIP business. I definitely recommend to whoever need VoIP service.

cons: Sometimes support takes a while to resolve issuesues.
title: I have been impressed with the 8X8...
review: I have been impressed with the 8X8 system and its features. Their support has improved a lot. It is compatible with Salesforce and FMG Suite which make its very impressive for me. I have tried other services and have always come back to 8X8 because no one compares to the features available to the customer.

title: I left 8x8 over price. I regretted it...
review: I left 8x8 over price. I regretted it and came back to find the prices were lower too. VOIP providers ARE NOT THE SAME. Choose wisely, choose 8x8. Set up was easy, and guided by knowledgeable staff. The app works great, with good connection and sound quality. Call quality is also very good. Interface is also intuitive.

cons: Horrible customer service, do not give information well and notes not taken properly
title: Cancelled my account inside the billing...
review: Cancelled my account inside the billing cycle. TDS delayed and set cancellation in the next billing cycle and then charged me another full month for a service I no longer had. I also gave the reason for cancellation and the service rep did not put in notes so TDS said I gave no reason. Worst customer service I have dealt with in a long time. I would definitely stay away from them

pros: Very easy to manage and setup users anand ring groups.
title: We migrated to 8x8 from 4 different...
review:
We migrated to 8x8 from 4 different vendors and the migration went smoothly. If any issues were raised they were resolved quickly and efficiently.

Working with their transition team was easy and they were very helpful with their insights concerning our existing structure and how best to migrate to their structure.

Great company to work with and so far any ticket we opened has been resolved easily.

title: This company provides the absolute...
review: This company provides the absolute worst level of customer service, and the product performance is unreliable. We spend hours and hours of time on technical support, make corrections and adjustments only to have them default back to the problem a few days later. Then when you call back, it's like starting all over again. No continuity of service at all. No sense of confidence the problem is actually solved. We are a small nonprofit and we rely on our 24/7 phone service to provide critical care. We are locked into a scam contract, and I can't wait to be done with this company.

cons: It's a ongoing cost commitment, but it seems that way with anyone.
title: In our case we were having a difficult...
review: In our case we were having a difficult time with our old provider. Nextiva was very helpful for what they needed and specifics on what to ask for. We had on-site training and later support when the pool of our users wanted to change some of the options. There are few providers that I am 100% pleased with, but Nextiva is one of the few 100% scores for us.

title: I really like how this service feels...
review:
I really like how this service feels like an all-in-one platform. It has calls, texting, voicemail-- everything that you'd have with a normal phone but on my computer/app.

This is a nice way to have a "business phone" without the phone.

My only critique is the customer service bot. Although it is designed to streamline the troubleshooting process, my issue wasn't found within the system so it had trouble helping me.

I ended up digging around and finding a phone number instead, which was much more helpful! (Be prepared to wait for awhile).

cons: Clunky programs, website is not user friendly, almost
title: The app is fine, the website is awful...
review: The app is fine, the website is awful there’s so many portals you have to go into to do things, customer service is nothing but circles. Good luck trying to find a phone number to call as a paying customer who needs actual help. I can’t wait to leave 8x8. I have so much trouble with call quality even on Wifi calls, I just don’t understand.

title: Our service was switched with no...
review: Our service was switched with no notification or training on a Friday (our busiest day), it has been three weeks, still no proper training, my account manager will not return my call or respond to emails. I chatted and ask to speak with a supervisor, I was told that I wan not able to speak to a supervisor but they would review my chat. Really, this is how they treat customers.

title: My name is David and I am being scammed...
review:
My name is David and I am being scammed by Ring Central. I have been a customer since 2013. I raise donations to save animals who have been abused. I got Ring Central in 2013 so I can talk to the 600 nonprofits I support. Unfortunately, due to COVID-19, we had to close our doors and we no longer need Ring Central service.

I have spent over 4 hours on hold with 5 different reps and they refuse to help me. They keep transferring us around to different people and will leave you on hold and even just hang up on me. They are a total scam and their customer service is terrible to work with! I want you all to know how awful this is. We have helped save thousands of animals since 2013 and I cannot believe this is how they treat customers like me.

We have asked them to send me the signed agreements and they can cannot produce any other agreements they have that I supposably signed for an extra 2 years. Take a look at other reviews and see they use this same tactic with other companies. Laying saying they signed for an extra 2 years!

I have spoken to Ring Central customer service reps like Jesus and Ralph and neither will handle my cancellation and both have kept us on hold for hours. Anytime you ask for someone's contact information they say they do not have it.

We will contact our attorney to get this handled now and we have over 2 millions supporters, followers and fans on social media and I have no choice but to tell them how Ring Central is treating us and to never use their service.

I have already canceled the card on file and talked to our Chase Business Account manager and let them know how Ring Central is trying to scam us. They are taking further actions themselves with our case.

title: I used Nextiva for a few years. The...
review: I used Nextiva for a few years. The website was very difficult to navigate and make changes. Over the years the customer support went downhill. I switched to a new provider and canceled the service, but they continue to charge me. When I put in a dispute and asked to be refunded I was denied. This is the third month I have requested to cancel and I'm still not sure if they have. They are stealing money from the church that I work out. Horrible. Couldn't be more disgusted.

title: My issue was resolved in only minutes. ...
review: My issue was resolved in only minutes. The technician that helped me was very polite, understanding of the situation and made a quick resolution to the problem that got our office phone's back up and running in order for our patients to get the help they need. I would strongly recommend 8x8 to anyone.

cons: International cellphone phone adding to unlimited plan can be enticing.
title: Very easy setup with alot of features....
review: Very easy setup with alot of features. I am still exploring some of them. The best of all for business is unlimited international calling to many countries. I shop around to many VOIP providers bit no one out there has unlimited international calling plan. 8x8 features can be tweak according to your needs. Also 8x8 app for cellphone is great. Internet fax for each line another great feature for small businesses. Try for 30 days I guarantee you will love it.

title: I was a phonepower customer for a few...
review:
I was a phonepower customer for a few years from 2010 to 2013. The service was usually reliable and customer service was great. Fast Forward to 2022, as a returning customer, customer service has become incompetent and rude. Their website login does not work the second time you log in...you have to delete all cookies no matter what browser you use. Technical Support is dishonest and rude at best: self-contradictory and bold-faced lies...there really is no other accurate way to put it.

I am currently getting out of my contract because they evidently have changed hands, or have enough customers that they no longer care.

title: From the start Nextiva was was to work...
review: From the start Nextiva was was to work with from the initial sales pitch to our onboarding coordinator. They customized a solution that worked for our business needs. We came with our own equipment that was prechecked to ensure compatibility. Tech support is easy to reach via chat and seems quite knowledgeable. I would highly recommend Nextiva to other businesses looking to move into the VOIP world.

title: I’ve been using 8x8 for several...
review: I’ve been using 8x8 for several months now. The quality of their product is exceptional. It is easy to use and the support offered by 8x8 is beyond compare. I use their phone service for my business and would highly recommend them. I’ve tried vonage in the past and left them when I couldn’t get adequate support. Thank you 8x8!

title: Wanted to try out their services for a...
review: Wanted to try out their services for a month, was thinking I'd probably keep, because needed minimal services. I initiated a port of one of my numbers, and then they stated it would take a week to complete. So I canceled everything. I then tried to port to another company and it was taking a while. After a week, I got an email from 8x8 that the port had completed to the closed account. I spent 2.5 hours with 6 different reps trying to resolve this, and in the end the said they've reopened the account, but the # is still not in that account and usable. I've been working with small businesses like my own for 25 years and their dashboard is downright archaic.. and convoluted. It's like there was absolutely no thought given to time and ease of use to the end of user.

title: Very good service  highly recommended...
review: Very good service highly recommended for all user easy to use and good costumer service and with all the feature you need for business like call recording hold music and integration with Microsoft teams is the best option they have added in their and works great for business and pricing also they have good option.

pros: For phone, fax and other basic VOIP services it is fine.  However, if looking for any integrations, synchronization with Google or Microsoft 365, CRM or any program of any kind, look elsewhere because nothing works and tech support has no clue.
title: I have been Nextiva customer for over a...
review: I have been Nextiva customer for over a year for phone service and for about a decade for fax service. Nextiva was a mistake as most integrations and add-ons do not work, and tech support is clueless to help. SMS was not working for 2 months. An integration with another software program has been down for over a month. If you need CRM or any synchronization with Microsoft, Google, or any other software of any kind, do yourself a favor and look elsewhere.

title: A little hard to get to a the right...
review: A little hard to get to a the right people when inquiring about new service. I definitely recommend callingwhen you have enough time to sit. However its Excellent, service once you get to the right channels and the pricing is outstanding. I have no issues with the phone line and callers say it's very clear.

title: I have had them for 16 years and they...
review: I have had them for 16 years and they have been a great asset to my business. Especially helpful when traveling abroad and being able to make calls like I am at my home office. The ability to host meetings and link my team together is great and stable with call and video clarity unlike the free services. The ability to integrate across platforms like my CRM, E-mail, conferencing, and cellular platforms is really convenient.

title: Recently got on board the new VoIP...
review: Recently got on board the new VoIP connection for my home office and it just works. I’m surprised by how quick the setup was. Mind you, I’ve used plenty of VoIP connections before, and I’ve just renewed my license with them for a year. Everything works as advertised: call quality is excellent and limitless dialing is also available. Everything is smooth sailing so far.

title: The service is good. The features are...
review: The service is good. The features are what we need. The price is excellent for a cloud hosted solution. The one problem I have with 8x8 is that support can be a little slow to solve complex issues, and often there are hold times exceeding 20 minutes. They do always eventually fix the issue, however, so there is that. Overall, I am satisfied at the sites we use 8x8 at.

title: Our company needed a new VoIP service....
review: Our company needed a new VoIP service. We were obviously in the market for something that wouldn’t break the bank with setups and running. Most of the ones we found were $35+ per month, and that just wouldn’t be enough to justify the minimal use we needed out of it. AXVoice was recommended through a random Google search, and well, I guess it was exactly what we needed. Incredibly cost-effective as a business solution and works just as well as any other.

title: 8X8 has continued to provide reliable...
review: 8X8 has continued to provide reliable affordable service to our company for many years. Anytime I have ever had an issue or question, a knowledgeable representative was available by phone, email on online chat. My questions or issues are always resolved pretty quickly. You can't beat that kind of service!

title: Yuliia Geranina was both knowledgeable...
review:
Yuliia Geranina was both knowledgeable and helpful in getting our cordless phone back up and working. Nextiva Customer Support is always such a delight to call - instead of being annoyed that I have a problem, I actually look forward to speaking with one of their staff!

Thank you Nextiva for having some of the best customer service folks in the industry!

title: Tetiana was incredibly helpful and...
review:
Tetiana was incredibly helpful and patient! One of our phones did not work, and after trying to reset it, we discovered that the base unit was damaged. She was able to get us a new one sent out in short order.

I have always had great experiences with the staff at Nextiva, from onboarding to maintenance and customer service. Thank you Nextiva for having such a great customer service team!

pros: There are some benefits to VOIP in general
title: We have been using Ring Central for...
review:
We have been using Ring Central for about 2 years. The good thing is the general convenience of VOIP calls which allow texting and faxing from computers.
THE BAD FAR OUTWEIGHS THE GOOD. DO NOT USE this system!
The phone system itself is very complicated with the only instructions coming from YouTube videos. If you have any questions or problems, there is not even a chat for support. No phone numbers for support and the only message we have sent that has been answered was in such poor English that is was not discernable. We will be canceling our contract as soon as it has expired and will hopefully be able to find a company that can assist us with difficult tasks such as Voice Mail. STAY AWAY from this phone service, it has cost us clients and caused hours of FRUSTRATION!

title: I don't even know where to start - the...
review:
I don't even know where to start - the 8x8 experience has been so terrible, exhausting, financially and emotionally draining. This is my first review for them because I tried solving things on my own through their channels. As things stand right now, my phones aren't working on 2 of my 6 locations. I am being charged for locations I have had to shut down because of the pandemic. (8x8 is the only company that didnt offer us any support, discounts, or terms during the pandemic).

We are supposed to be a premium account, whatever that means, but have had no account representative assigned to us for months on end–essentially, no way to reach anyone in 8x8 with any decision making capacity. We must have spent over 200 hours trying to chase the cases and people within the organization, dozens of emails, scores of calls etc. I have spoken or communicated with over 20 people within various departments and offices but to no avail.

I have found that our setup was incomplete and the part that was done was poorly implemented. In fact, one of 8x8 people said that this product should not even have been sold to a business like ours without a full IT department. (we are a small business with 6 small restaurants).

This is my first review and I am of the mind to go on all social media available from here on out till I find some resolution that feels just. I have lost thousands on dollars paying for lines that dont work or havent been used, many tens of thousands not getting phone orders for months, and all I get is a runaround.

I am sure there are many satisfied customers of this company, but for my experience this is an opaque company with no accountability, no ethics and no customer service worth talking about.

title: I signed up for my small business to...
review: I signed up for my small business to integrate it with my new crm. I ended up not changing crms and didnt need the vonage account. I had it for 13 days without even using it and wasn’t told it was a year contract. I was under the assumption it was month to month. Even though i didnt make one phone call or use the system, they still charged me $250.00 cancelation fee. This is horrible customer service. I would have even excepted a prorated fee. I will be sure to tell everyone to not do business with vonage. This has to be one of the worst experiences for me.

title: I’ve been using AXvoice’s VoIP...
review: I’ve been using AXvoice’s VoIP service for a month now and initially found it difficult to get my existing Vonage number ported here, but managed to get it done. That is where I wish their customer service would’ve been slightly better at helping. But all in all, after the initial setup woes, I’m enjoying my experience. Call quality is great, and having to pay a fraction of the cost is always going to be a benefit for anyone.

title: Virtual agent was extremely thorough...
review: Virtual agent was extremely thorough and patient getting service restored on a phone that was not connecting to the internet. The total time was about 2 hours...yikes! Thankfully he walked me through several troubleshooting steps to help eliminate the cause of the issue. We finally found the issue and he was able to resolve the issue partially through chat and remaining via screen share.

title: Eugene Khablenko is wonderful man to...
review: Eugene Khablenko is wonderful man to have on your support team. Do not let this gentlemen leave Nextiva. He was incredibly patient and kind while working a huge problem with my phones. I was on the verge of quitting Nextiva but his brilliant mind found a solution to a problem that I was told twice was impossible. Even Eugene thought it was impossible, but he was determined to find a solution to keep me as a customer. BIG THANK YOU TO EUGENE.

title: I have just upgraded our service to...
review: I have just upgraded our service to "Nextiva Anywhere". I managed to test the inbound calls being transferred to assigned cellular numbers, but had an issue with placing outbound calls. Anastasiia P. just resolved this. She was confident, knowledgeable, polite, found the solution quickly . Excellent support work!

title: I just had Tonia for technical support...
review: I just had Tonia for technical support and she is awesome! She was knowledgeable and professional and fixed my problem in a matter of minutes. I would recommend everyone to Nextiva and Tonia for their VOIP phone systems. I could not figure out how to set up phone lines and extensions on my phone by myself and Tonia fixed it ASAP. Thanks so much for the great service!

title: Love the functionality! It is easy to...
review: Love the functionality! It is easy to set up new users and easy for new users to navigate. I like using closed caption on video calls and how easy it is to transfer from my desk to a mobile device. I wish that my users could have individual, private links for each video conference so that we do not have people barging into meetings because they join earlier than the scheduled time. If it does exist, I have not yet found where to change that in the system.

title: 8x8 has it's ups and downs but...
review: 8x8 has it's ups and downs but they're very good on fixing any issues that occur and they have regular updates which is a plus! I recommend companies to use this for their business as well, they have the most friendly reps and they're very patient as well. 10/10 for sure, and they offer very many ways to use the application.

title: Julian was very helpful with all of my...
review: Julian was very helpful with all of my questions. He helped me setup multiple schedules to prepare for the Holidays. He was also very patient throughout the whole process. Julian also assisted me with setting up one user to have the ability to text. This will be very helpful for our recruiting department.

title: If you record 100% of your calls as my...
review: If you record 100% of your calls as my company does then keep looking for your next vendor as I am currently doing. They did a system upgrade this past year that as far as their call recording feature and it takes you back to the dinosaur age. We record thousands of calls monthly, their new system allows you to capture 32 recordings at a time, scroll down to capture 32 more, etc, etc. Then you repeat this horrible procedure to delete the recordings otherwise they add $$$ hundreds of dollars to your bill because you now storing your recordings on their server.

title: If we have an issue, which is not...
review: If we have an issue, which is not often, they are very quick to answer the phone when we call tech support. We do not have to chat. The phone call is answered by an actual person not a computer. The tech support contacts are always very knowledgeable and can always correct any problems that we may have.

cons: Support is a nightmare to use and they rarely figure out the issue in the first few tries
title: Call quality is great on the office...
review: Call quality is great on the office phones. The office phones seem to work well. Call quality through the app is hit or miss. Many times the call is garbled. when using the app. Lots of features for the money, many above what we need came in our package. Price is competitive. Unfortunately, when there is an issue, it takes forever to get to the right person who might be able to fix it. Then it will take them a long time to correct. The few issues that we have had each resulted in well over 20+ man hours to repair.

title: Oksana S. was great. I had to serve as...
review: Oksana S. was great. I had to serve as middle-man between an exec who wanted things set up a certain way, an assistant who had to figure out the call flow to make the exec happy, and Oksana S. who was patient and understanding as everyone worked through numerous setups and tests until things were finally working correctly.

title: My company has just implemented Nextiva...
review: My company has just implemented Nextiva as our phone provider. In setting up my desktop phone, Andrii S. was the support agent designated to help me. He was extremely patient and very helpful. Once the implementation was complete, Andrii was able to provide me with information and tips that will be very useful. It was a great experience!

title: The support team at Nextiva has been...
review: The support team at Nextiva has been very supportive and attentive. Communicating via the integrated web chat is seamless and easy and most issues are resolved by the end of the chat. Support techs such as Oles K. and Yana have been particularly helpful and patient. I would recommend this service to anyone looking for VOIP.

title: Worst experience with a phone company....
review:
Worst experience with a phone company. I got set up with them in 2018 on an initial 24 month contract. I have numerous emails to my sales rep stating I did not want to do a contract and if I did what were the obligations and the pros and cons, I even asked him if it would auto-renew. At the time I was not happy because my old contract with cox was auto-renewed and it was a pain to exit with them. I have multiple emails from my sales rep Sean Thornock replying to me that the contract is only 24 months and that there is cancel fee if I cancel before that. I opted to go with the contract to get a discount on phones. I fulfilled that contract, and am now looking into another option for better analytics. I also know my calls with Sean were recorded and they said they could pull these calls and if it was clear in these calls that I was misled or that I was told otherwise then we would cancel. They put me on hold for about 10 minutes, and then came back and said sorry we won't pull these calls, you are stuck with the cancel fee even this it is way after the 24 months. So either they don't have the calls or they listened to them and they didn't fall in their favor?

On another note, I would likely have stayed with nextiva if they would have actually got back to me with my numerous requests to get a better look at our call analytics. I have numerous support request emails asking for a demo or to have these features on our plan and they never ever got back to us???

title: The Nextiva system is very powerful and...
review: The Nextiva system is very powerful and very flexible and the best part of it is that you do not have to master the system to take advantage of all this. Nextiva support is exceptionally good and they can make the things you need happen for you. Even better, they are also available after business hours so support people like me don't have to get our support calls in during our busy office hours. Tonight I spoke to Nextiva support person Dmitriy Sachenko and he solved a problem for me. Even better, he remoted into my machine and showed me how it was done so I could learn from it. So I got my issue resolved and I learned how it was done. Exceptional support!

title: Anytime a fellow attorney friend asks...
review: Anytime a fellow attorney friend asks about our phone system, I ALWAY recommend 8x8. We are able to answer our telephone remotely when necessary throughout the pandemic. We are in constant instant contact with our clients when we need immediate answers via the 8x8 text, which is phenomenal. It's such a great tool. 8x8 tech staff are always there if we have any questions. This is an incredible product an the service is excellent.

title: Great Price!  Great Service!  After...
review: Great Price! Great Service! After nearly two years of uninterrupted service, my VoiP Adapter failed. We could not make calls out, and all incoming calls went direct to our Voicemail. Thankfully, with Voiply's email notifications that we have a voice mail, we never missed an important call. The technicians at Voiply helped I.D. the issue, and immediately shipped a new Adapter. Upon the easy change of Adapters, our phone was back to proper working order within minutes. Thanks Voiply!

title: Worked with Anna S today on support and...
review:
Worked with Anna S today on support and she was awesome! got the problem and fixed it. We have been using Nextiva for several years now and our overall experience has been quite good. Service/support/clarity all meet our needs which are fairly simple. Voice mail features are good.
Thanks to the folks at Nextiva.

title: Terrell E. was an amazing...
review: Terrell E. was an amazing representative. He was very personable, easy to talk to and work with, and very educated on the system. The administrative website is not very straight forward, but with Terrell's help we were able to get everything situated and now I am better educated to do it on my own in the future. Amazing service from him!

title: Anna S. was able to assist me...
review: Anna S. was able to assist me immediately with my concerns and I thank you so much. She is very helpful and customer support never fails to assist me every time I ask for help. Anna S. keep it up, I really appreciate you. You were able to help me a lot of times and not just today. You should get a raise for being patient and helpful :)

title: I have had Nextiva for years. I have...
review: I have had Nextiva for years. I have zero complaints and will continue to be a loyal customer. The only challenge we ever have is sometimes special requests required me and the service center to be on the phone for a couple hrs. trying to figure it out the issue. Overall my satisfaction has been 100%.

title: Advanced Tech Support Alexander...
review: Advanced Tech Support Alexander Shevchenko was not only very knowledgeable but very patient and understanding of my questions and concerns. Took time to explain things and fixed everything we needed done today! We had ongoing problems that would be fixed but were never explained to us on why or how they may be happening. Great rep and I wish I could request him over and over!

title: My experience with the transition and...
review:
My experience with the transition and setup vs what was promised, the complete opposite. It has been so stressful. We transitioned about 25 locations and talk about a mess, it has been a battle every step of the way. We have had some great support people that have helped us get through, Alex M being one, he helped me in 20 minutes with something I have been attempting to get resolved for weeks.

We decided to switch from RingCentral to Nextiva, I was very clear on our needs, what we expected, etc. through the sales process, we were overpromised just to get the sale done. We moved for the Call Center features that RingCentral doesn't have and the promised account manager that would handle everything for us. What they didn't mention is that the account manager has over 200 accounts and getting anything does take a lot of time, which is unacceptable. I found ways to do most of it myself but there are two key things I cannot do myself, order phone numbers and phones. Being able to accomplish these things quickly is crucial to our growing business. Nextiva is anything but quick. In fact, other than the call center features, nothing else is special and not nearly worth the additional costs we are paying. Had I known how challenging this would have been I would have never moved services. Of course, the free phone we were promised expired after 30 days and they had done NOTHING to get our accounts set up in that 30 days. Don't fall for the hype.

title: I have been a customer of Vonage...
review:
I have been a customer of Vonage Business since 2009, more than 12 years as of the time of this review. To date, my service performance has been hit and miss, but there has been much more uptime than not. Support in the past has been helpful, however the experience I had today has totally turned me off to this company.

My business credit card expired last month and needed to be update, as it has many other times. I forgot to update it in their system and the company attempted to charge my monthly fees today. The charge was obviously declined. Normally, I would receive a courtesy email to update my card information in their system at my earliest convenience.

This time, it is the evening before Thanksgiving and I am already spending time with family. A support representative called me to let me know that I needed to update my card information with him immediately over the phone. When I told him that I was not comfortable providing that information to him over the phone, and also explaining that I was on vacation with family, he insisted that I get my credit card and update it over the phone. He even noted that I had been with them since 2009, and that I was a "valued customer"...

After this experience, I have decided to switch my VOIP provider ASAP. The card information could have been updated as normal within 24-48 hours rather than spur of the moment over the phone. I can't believe that a major provider such as Vonage would act so unprofessionally. I've always been on time with my payments for their service and they take payment every month via autopay...but not for much longer...

Buyer beware!!!

title: I needed to get a couple of numbers...
review: I needed to get a couple of numbers blocked from our main number however the option was not available on the Manager dashboard. The 8x8 specialist I spoke with informed me that we had to update our profile first to allow me to then complete the blocking process. The specialist was very kind, informative and knowledgeable.

title: We are using 8X8 for past 6 to 7 months...
review:
We are using 8X8 for past 6 to 7 months and so far going good. The support team is supportive and do followup on any query raised and my almost all query have been resolved.

We are happy but would request few additional customisation that would be really add-on on feature like to have our own personalised Greeting for Voicemail.

title: We have had a issue with our phones due...
review:
We have had a issue with our phones due to a change I made in call forwarding.
Oleg was awesome and completed my customer service need within minutes! Yay!
This has been the fastest and smoothest customer service resolution ever!
A short while I called back with another unrelated issue and Alex helped knock that one out in minutes as well!
Happy Camper
David

title: OUR COMPANY IS AN ACTIVE USER BECAUSE...
review:
OUR COMPANY IS AN ACTIVE USER BECAUSE WE CAN'T BREAK THE CONTRACT EVEN THOUGH WE'VE HAD THEIR PHONES 3 WEEKS AND THEY DO NOT WORK AT ALL! WE PAID $1500 FOR A PROFESSIONAL INSTALL AND THEY LEFT WITH OUR PHONES HALF RINGING, HALF CALLING OUT, AND DROPPING CALLS CONSTANTLY!

We have spent 4 months planning and making changes to our system to meet Nextiva requirements. They came and did the install and left without anything working properly. Our company has lost thousands of dollars because these phones do not work, we drop calls constantly, none of our phones ring correctly. They will not help us it has been 3 solid weeks on the phone with Tech support literally defining insanity repeating the same actions over and over that fix nothing and even make things worse. This has been the worst business experience I have ever had and the absolute worst and most horrifying and embarrassing excuse for a "Customer Support Team" I've ever had the displeasure of dealing with.

IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR COMPANY'S REPUTATION AND MONEY STAY FAR AWAY FROM THIS HORRIBLE, PATHETIC EXCUSE FOR A BUSINESS VOIP SOLUTION COMPANY. THEY WILL TAKE YOUR MONEY AND LEAVE YOU HIGH AND DRY WITH ISSUES WHILE TRYING TO CONVINCE YOU TO BUY MORE EQUIPMENT TO FIX IT THAT WILL COST YOU EXPENSIVE OVERNIGHT SHIPING, AND IN TURN - STILL NOT FIX ANYTHING OR WORK PROPERLY. THIS PLACE IS ONE GIANT SCAM!

cons: Not reliable for VOIPO to VOIPO calls
title: I have had VOIPO for many years, ...
review: I have had VOIPO for many years, however there has always been a problem calling another VOIPO customer, on average every 6 months tickets have to be opened because neither of us can call each other on our VOIPO numbers. The call simply fails to go through. And every time the troubleshooting is the same, reset the grandstream box, check the connections and then it goes to upper level support and they do something on their end and magically it starts working again for another couple months. Almost always calls will go through that are made from a landline or from another voice over IP carrier. I continue to believe its an issue with how voipo to voipo calls are being handled internally within VOIPO. It usually takes several days to get resolution and multiple email responses. They continue to insist that something is not connected but calls originating from outside the VOIPO network seem to go through most times. However recently even that has been working sporadically when we see this issue. Sometimes it works sometimes it doesnt. Note I have had very few problems calling and receiving calls originated from outside the VOIPO network. Im simply amazed that there is such an issue with VOIPO to VOIPO calls consistently.

title: Over the past 8 years I have...
review: Over the past 8 years I have experienced 8x8 Phone systems being reliable and configurable. I would recommend their VOIP products to anyone. After trying several systems, I have found that 8x8 consistently offers the best call quality and needed features. They do not require use of any special equipment for the business firewall, and provide configuration documentation for every firewall I have ever used them with.

title: I really tried to work with these...
review:
I really tried to work with these people and to push them to support their products and their offered services. In the end (three months) I failed to get any of the features they promise to be reliable, although the call quality was better than others. I changing my service, waiting for the porting to clear with the new provider.
The cons outweighed those features:
Incoming calls do not ring the local phone.
Voice mail doesn't work on their app.
Features have bad side effects (fail for no reasons).
Support's job #1 is to blame you for a problem. And to not tell what they did attempt to fix a reported problem.

pros: Able to get through by phone to support
title: I was setting up a new softphone.  I...
review: I was setting up a new softphone. I was transferred to Advanced Support, and Aaron (sp?) helped me solve the issue, along with some useful explanations about the SIP Username and the various devices I use to access Nextiva. I've been a Nextiva user for about 10 years and have had my ups and downs with support, but this was pleasantly effective and efficient.

title: Since working remotely, this service is...
review: Since working remotely, this service is excellent regarding having that flexibility. You can log into your dashboard and begin calling wherever you are. Plus, you have the option to send and receive text messages as well! Super convenient and awesome call quality. Plus, their customer service is great!

title: Absolutely terrible! Grasshopper,...
review:
Absolutely terrible! Grasshopper, MightyCall and many others are much better. We struggled to even get this service to work and we have iPhones! When it did work it constantly cut out. Then they try to lock you into a 12 month contract with no refunds and early termination fees.

Avoid this company at all costs!

cons: Support hard to contact a humane
pros: Easy system to use with great features
title: I use 8x8 express for my small business...
review:
I use 8x8 express for my small business and it is a very reliable and easy to use system that had all the features I looked for in a phone system. The customer experience was my main concern along with ease of use for my employees. Great price as well.

Because this is 8x8 Express, the support was all online which was not ideal as being able to contact a person would have been helpful on a couple of occasions but we did work through the issues.

title: The system has been excellent to our...
review: The system has been excellent to our firm for many years. It's really solid and that's what is most important to our business. The features are probably as good or better than any provider. We have only scratched the surface using mostly the basic system. It has the ability to fax with ease and the mobile app is terrific. Add in conference calling and business texting and so much more. All in a fixed price!

title: RingCentral contract is rip off. Do not...
review: RingCentral contract is rip off. Do not sign up with this company. Because of COVID and other economical reasons we have had to reduce our headcount in order to stay in business. Ring central is not willing to reduce the number of lines we originally signed up with and if we cancel and shut down our business they will still go after us with a cancellation charge. They have no problem charging us for phone lines we don't use but if we increase phone lines they would charge us for additional lines. They locked me in a 2-year contract that I have to pay for lines I will not use.

title: Today I needed to transfer our...
review: Today I needed to transfer our emergency line to a different no#. I had some trouble getting the right person after 3 attempts, I was helped by Olick and he got the task done for me. Thank you for helping. It will make our lives easier when our after-hour lines ring the right person. It could have been a disaster if someone had an after hour emergency and no one would answer the call.

title: This service is constantly having...
review: This service is constantly having issues. Every time we have to contact support it's a week long process before they reply to us. And then when they reply to us the information is generally wrong or we have to correct them. They gave a normal user the default super admin role and then said they weren't the ones that did it. However, we can not change that role only they can... so that doesn't make sense. We are definitely going to be switching to another provider once our contract is up in the spring.

cons: Support hold times are a bit long
pros: All of the features we needed
title: Although the features are there,...
review: Although the features are there, sometimes the portal can be a bit confusing. Some support issues seem to take longer than expected to resolve. We have all the features to move ahead and at a substantial savings to our legacy carrier. No issues with voice, chat or meetings to date. Would recommend taking a look if you have a legacy VoIP solution.

title: This company's sales rep misled us...
review: This company's sales rep misled us into a plan that does not match our needs and locked us in to a multi-year automatically renewing contract. We're a company of less than 10 users with basic phone system needs. They misled us into an enterprise plan suited for 1,000 users with full integration into several third party programs. They offer no recourse for changing our plan to something that matches our need, requiring that we pay the full plan amount in order to switch to something better suited to our company. The technical support is mediocre, the phone system is reliable but eccentric, and the company's sales practices are abhorrent. Do not recommend.

title: This product replaced our Cisco Phone...
review: This product replaced our Cisco Phone system. I like how we can manage the system. The system is very easy to use. You can insert your own music on hold. There are a lot of features which are included with the system. The support is great. You are not on hold for long. I would highly recommend trying out this product.

title: Have had lots of hiccups with phones,...
review: Have had lots of hiccups with phones, various aspects of setup, and the web interface. But overall experience has been fairly positive. The cost is definitely high but so are most voip companies. The desktop and mobile apps work pretty well so not many complaints with those. They keep changing the web interface which causes headaches trying to learn where everything is and the new flow. But appreciate the effort to update their processes.

title: In the process of switching our VOIP...
review:
In the process of switching our VOIP services to Nextiva. Tech support was quick and they solved the problem within a few minutes. (actually it was a config issue - not a problem)
With Nextiva you will get to talk with someone every time you call, rather than opening a ticket and waiting on email response (like with some other VOIP providers).

title: My company has been a RingCentral...
review:
My company has been a RingCentral customer since 2015. We replaced our legacy PBX system and never looked back. Today, we have 300 lines of service and almost 400 other users worldwide mainly in the US, Europe, and Asia.
The product is easily managed and fully featured. We initially used RingCentral primarily for voice calling. However, in the age of Covid, we've relied heavily on video meetings.
We have had a very good relationship with our RingCentral team from the start which includes a standing bi-weekly meeting to address any concerns.
The support center quality and response has varied over the years but has recently been excellent. All issues are addressed and escalated as necessary. They admit when there is a bug and work to resolve it.
Although the price is high, RingCentral have worked with us to find ways to reduce the overall cost.
The two areas that need improvement is the ability to remove lines of service and the federation of multiple accounts. It is very easy to add lines of service but you are tied in to the contract term once you do. One problem with federation is that the RingCentral App does not provide for 4 digit extension dialing with name lookup to federated accounts.

cons: tech support was not as responsive as I would have hoped when I had an issue
pros: ease of use for talking to my clients
title: I love the 8x8 system. It is so easy to...
review: I love the 8x8 system. It is so easy to speak with clients. My clients love that they can get their business done just by making a phone call. No matter what type of phone you have, no matter how tech savvy you are. The only issue I've had with them is that the one time I did have an issue I had difficulty getting a prompt response from tech support. But I've been using 8x8 for over 3 years no and only had 1 problem that required me to contact tech support, so I think that's a pretty good track record!

pros: Reliable service for the most part
title: The 8x8 phone system was very easy to...
review: The 8x8 phone system was very easy to manage. It went down every once in a while with absolutely no warning or communication from 8x8 support. The pricing is decent, but can add up depending on license type. Their support is terrible, sometimes it takes like 40 minutes on hold to be able to talk to a support rep.

cons: updates are not automatic and calls sometimes cannot connect immediately.
title: RingCentral is a great app for...
review: RingCentral is a great app for messages, calls, and meetings. The quality is good. A fantastic organization! Excellent customer support from beginning to end of the process. The team is informed and goes the extra mile at every stage. I would recommend them unreservedly. So far, the experience with this service provider did not give me any headaches.

title: We have been using RingCentral and...
review:
We have been using RingCentral and RingCentral Apps for over a year.
RingCentral is a complete tool for communication.
Either on your desktop, laptop or cell phone.
Its easy to use and great for calls, message, meeting and presentations.
You can schedule meetings, make presentations, share your screen and record.

cons: When more than 20 people in a meeting, all microphones need to be muted to  be able to
pros: Able to set and attend meetings via virtual
title: I recommend ring central. It is a...
review: I recommend ring central. It is a convenient way to do and set up meetings with collogues as well as outside supports. The quality is great and technical support is always willing and available. It is user friendly and simple to navigate. I am pleased and definitely recommend to other business and agencies.

title: My tech was fast and knowledgeable in...
review: My tech was fast and knowledgeable in helping me swap extensions. The client is happy to be back up and running. Satisfied with support overall. The new admin portal is also much easier to use vs the last iteration. Feels like things are headed in the right direction overall. Very responsive to trouble tickets also. Good work.

title: Once we got an engineer involved he...
review: Once we got an engineer involved he stayed on our problem until it was resolved. It took a day to get the ticket elevated but once it got elevated the engineer tried different logins to get the issue resolved. Over all the service is good and the phone system runs reliably 99% of the time. Every issue that has come up has been fixed.

title: I didn't even get the 14 day free...
review: I didn't even get the 14 day free trial like promised. They just charged my account then suspended my account without even sending an email why. I had to contact customer service. The guy that answered was rude and said "if you are worried about your money then contact Fraud Department." I contacted Fraud Department and they said they needed to verify my business. I understand verifying my business but that could have been done during the 14 day trial or before you take my money out of my account and suspending services.

title: Please notice that positive feedback...
review: Please notice that positive feedback about 8x8 it is always generic negative feedback is very specific. We have had the same issue repeat every 4-6 weeks, namely voicemail transcription stops working suddenly. Open a ticket and get no feedback for at least a week. There are no updates and suddenly a support technician will email you a list of things to do which will affect a resolution. Do none of them and BAM it starts working. An autoreply of WE'LL FIX THE PROBLEM WHEN WE FEEL LIKE IT would be refreshing for it's honesty.

title: I signed up recently the agent...
review:
I signed up recently the agent Alejandro Velazquez, offer me a plan of $30 dollars a month. The next day I am being charge ($25 + $15+ $99.94 + 37.87). I summit a request for a refund and they haven't gotten back to me. The agent that I file the complain said " I don't know why they are charging you that much".

I don't recommend it to sign up, the sales agent are not reliable and not trust worthy.

cons: We are a small company so sometime all the many features can be a bit overwhelming .
pros: Takes the worry out of handling our phone calls.
title: We have used 8x8 for a number of years....
review: We have used 8x8 for a number of years. We are a very small company and don't get to use all the amazing features of 8x8 but it helps support our plumbing business by getting our voicemails after hours. Whenever I have an issue I have always been able to work to a successful outcome with the tech help.

pros: Flexibility, available support and knowledge base
title: I've used other VoIP providers before,...
review: I've used other VoIP providers before, and they can be complex and hard to navigate. The advantage to that complexity is flexibility and avaliable features, but along with that comes technical problems that you eventually need one on one support to resolve. 8x8 tech support is quick to reply to cases with either links to articles or a phone call to walk you through the process with screen sharing, which is an awesome feature.

title: Please do NOT use this company. If you...
review: Please do NOT use this company. If you do, please read your contract very carefully. Thy have automatic long term contract renewals. It is not in the main contract. You have to click on a link to get to the terms. The renewals happen with out warning or emails, and can extend your contract for 3 years or more. They have no remorse and will not let you out of the contract.

title: Customer service is very slow to get a...
review: Customer service is very slow to get a response but once I got a support member on the phone for implementation he was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable. The system itself is good so far (we are new users) lots of great features helpful for a growing business. I look forward to implementing 8x8 at our other facilities.

title: After 4 months of non-working VOIP...
review: After 4 months of non-working VOIP numbers, after dozens of support calls and dozens of emails, I was simply informed by email that the number is disabled and it is impossible to port it to another provider. The support never knows what's going on, always telling that "this issue is on a high priority and will be solved ASAP". But after all words they do nothing.

title: My headset is used for Zoom, Skype...
review: My headset is used for Zoom, Skype calls, and Avaya app. however only Avaya gives an electrical echo when the volume goes up. However, because I cannot hear clearly the other party, who is also clear when talking via Zoom, that's why I have to raise the volume, which causes too much of pain when talking daily to other staff.

title: Our library has been using 8x8 for many...
review: Our library has been using 8x8 for many years now, and we love that we can set up multiple answering messages, phone tree and set a closing/holiday schedule over the computer from anywhere! Only downside is that there are so many options that it can be a bit complicated to navigate the options menus to find out how to make changes to the auto attendant profiles. Still, with practice it has become a very valuable tool to communicate with our stakeholders.

title: We are a busy Pharmacy and we...
review:
We are a busy Pharmacy and we transferred our phones to Nextiva
We ported 3 numbers as they advises
we received email last Friday confirming that our porting is complete
Today (Monday) all our incoming calls are not coming
Our outgoing is working but absolutely no incoming
we called customer service and after they keeping us on hold they realized that they have no clue on why our phone calls are not coming

They say they are escalating us to TOP TIER SERVICE TEAM who will take upto 72 hours to solve thi

pros: Shows on your cell if work call or personal
title: Great product and services. The polycom...
review: Great product and services. The polycom VX250 phone however does not come with a power supply or a USB cord to use, and I likely wouldn't have purchased the phone if I had known that, otherwise it's been great! I Have used it for many years at different firms, and now at my law firm. My favorite is that I can use faxing from the desktop app directly or even on the mobile app.

title: The costumer service it's excellent,...
review: The costumer service it's excellent, they're very patient and helpful. They always give a solution as quickly as possible and are attentive to the case when it is still not resolved, I highly recommend their services. I will definitely continue working with this platform as it has been very useful to me.

title: We transitioned over to 8x8 about 6...
review: We transitioned over to 8x8 about 6 years ago and haven’t looked back! Their enhancements continue to assist our business through the user-friendly desktop app and mobile phone app. We’ve been able to cut out a number of communication hurdles through the use of the 8x8 system. I would recommend any business to give them a try!

title: It is really great to work with 8&8,...
review: It is really great to work with 8&8, they support us 24 hours a day. I highly recommend to use this wireless contact system for your bussiness. Currently we are using their Polycom equipment which we have ordered reciently , reasonable prices, clear instalation and support.Thank you for your service and support.

cons: Installation can be complicated and confusing at times. They do have tech support to help, which is great
title: My overall experience has been very...
review: My overall experience has been very positive. Initially, the set up webinar was too fast, too complicated and extremely confusing. It is really for someone who already understands the platform and not for a novice. The personal consultation appointments were a godsend, however. While waiting for them took a week we were able to set up our system and get a basic understanding of it so that we can troubleshoot some problems ourselves. The staff member who helped was knowledgeable and patient. We are happy that we are with 8 by 8.

title: The biggest advantage I get from...
review:
The biggest advantage I get from RingCentral is the ability to pickup a phone call either from my computer desk or my cell phone. As an Engineer, I am frequently called away from my desk to check on things in the shop. When called away, I bring my cell phone and know I am not going to miss any calls from customers, suppliers or fabricators. I don't have a lot of voice mail messages that I have to listen to and make return calls. Plus, when I should happen to get a voice mail message, it is converted to text which I can read quietly to myself.

Second advantage to me, is the ability to direct message co-workers which they can read when they have time available. I don't interrupted co-workers at inappropriate times.

title: Amazing product, reliable and very...
review: Amazing product, reliable and very convenient. Prices are also good and their support is top notch. They also have an API that can be used to build your own app. Communication is clear and downtime is none existing. One thing I enjoy about this app is the management dashboard. It is very detailed and clear. I will definitely recommend this service to my friends.

cons: missed calls, missed voicemails, sabotaged our phones when we called to cancel
title: We missed call and voicemails. ...
review: We missed call and voicemails. Customers would let us know that they called and left voicemails that we did not receive and their numbers were not show in the call logs. We have used the service for approximately one year but have decided to change based upon unreliable service and a lot of customer complaints. When we called yesterday to cancel, the rep reset our phones and now they are dead. We were on the phone with customer service for 4 hours yesterday to no avail. I contacted my sales rep today and he said there is nothing he can do. So not only do they have crappy phone software but they have crappy customer service and will sabotage your phones when you cancel them. Unbelievable!!!!

cons: Initial set-up disaster. Very slow to respond and correct
title: RingCentral is a communication company...
review:
RingCentral is a communication company - so it is amazing that their communication is so poor. We are a traditional brick and mortar. We still are not able to provision our phones like an old school system. We have adapted - but this strikes me as crazy. With our old system we had 2 lines with 5 handsets. We could answer from anywhere in the building, place the call on hold, and someone else could pick up the line. We cannot achieve this simplicity with RingCentral.

PROS:
The techs are very friendly.
They try hard.
The entire customer service experience with people - pleasant.

CONS:
The system is really designed for call centers of single operators.
Cannot set up for small brick and mortar
Did not compute with several techs

I am too far in to get out - sunk costs (time and money)
Our team has finally adapted - but this is not the simple system we need.

If you are a small brick and mortar - consider more appropriate options.

title: It's okay! I wish it was easier to ask...
review: It's okay! I wish it was easier to ask for permissions to access another person's screen. As a person in IT it would be much easier. Also file sharing in the chat would be nice.

title: Their customer service is sub par. I...
review: Their customer service is sub par. I was sold services that do not work and continue to be charged monthly. Nobody from support responds in a timely manner and as a small business you do not receive a 1:1 contact person. You are stuck contacting email addresses that are never responded to and can never get a hold of someone on the phone.

cons: Support is not very great in most cases, we constantly have downtimes and getting a credit for said downtime is like pulling teeth.  It's not very user friendly.  You need two windows open to use their Contact Center phone system.
pros: The price can be pretty aggressive, depending on the package that you choose.
title: Overall, it gets the job done in most...
review:
Overall, it gets the job done in most cases; however, I would advise looking elsewhere for phone service (eg. RingCentral)

Just since I've been with my current company who uses 8x8 (~4 months), we've had 2-3 outages of our phone service, of which lasted hours to a whole day. It happens so often, 8x8 was the reason our last IT Supervisor left the company.

cons: Completely incompetent support, missed commitments, unreasonable wait times for basic issue resolution
title: Sadly we are moving away from 8x8 and...
review:
Sadly we are moving away from 8x8 and cannot endorse them in any way. Their support staff is poorly trained, their time commitments for resolving issues means nothing to them. They are impossible to through to on any level, emails are ignored as are voice mails. Complaints directed to the corporate office only result in an onslaught of marketing emails from a totally disinterested sales rep

We are moving away from them as quickly as possible

title: is easy to use and have very stable...
review: is easy to use and have very stable connection. Also, in comparation that differents companies or service they plans include send and receive text sms and another features that do more easy the contact with the costumers... The desing is super friendly too when you want contact somebody or you costumers fast.

title: AVOID VOIPO.  I've been a customer for...
review: AVOID VOIPO. I've been a customer for two years now, and another year back in 2011. In 2018 they moved their facilities (a week-long outage) and outsourced all of their support to India. The one time they answered the phone (I get hold music for hours at a time) it was a choppy, digital, unintelligible voice with an unintelligible accent. Online chat appears to have been abandoned as each attempt to chat will time out to a trouble-ticket screen. Replies to a trouble ticket is 24 hours, as they are at 2am US time. Replies are in broken, grammatically incorrect English. The ticket support staff is not trained to do much more than to tell you to restart the modem. I have had several outages more than a week long, as there is no longer viable technical support. The service itself is not the best either. Call are choppy and drop with anything less that 300 mbs internet service. The modem gets sick randomly and must be powerfailed, and you don't know how many calls you've missed. I advise you to avoid Voipo.

title: We switched to 8x8 after being with...
review:
We switched to 8x8 after being with FreedomVoice for several years. Very happy with the service, ease of use and the support is stellar!
The app is so easy to use. I have my voicemail set to send an email with transcription. Much easier app than FreedomVoice. The admin console is very intuitive and the customer support is amazing!

cons: No support unless you're on a high tier monthly plan.
pros: Video Quality is very good. Mobile app has been polished well.
title: I had a very rough go when I first...
review:
I had a very rough go when I first signed up for Zoom. I couldn't make phone calls but paid for the monthly plan. After several attends through the live chat, I had to beg the agent to review my account and see why it wasn't working. I spent an hour basically begging, trying to explain that I paid for a service and wasn't getting it.

Finally, when I did get up and running, it was pretty smooth. I currently bounce between the mobile app and an IP desk phone.

The monthly price I think is very reasonable compared to the other services out there., I have a toll-free and a couple of local numbers. The web portal is constantly upgrading with some elegant features,

title: Being using Nextiva for 4 years and...
review: Being using Nextiva for 4 years and find them easy to work with. No support issue has ever gone unresolved on the first call. Knowledge base is helpful, but the tech support is great. If the tech doesn't know the answer they escalate us to the next tier. They have always fixed the issues was have had.

title: I needed assistance recently to...
review: I needed assistance recently to complete a task and RaghuRam in technical customer support was extremely helpful. He stayed on the call until a solution was found. I really appreciate his expertise. He suggested a conference call with an IT in my compqny to coordinate, did a screen share to further diagnose the problem and even followed up via email to make sure that my problem was solved. Thank you.

cons: Poor support and product does not work
title: I have been a customer with Nextiva for...
review: I have been a customer with Nextiva for 3 years and have had problems with missed calls, missed messages and with changing our company address. I recently purchased 3 new phones from NEXTIVA with WIFI dongles, called Nextiva X815, that were sent directly to me from the company. None of the phones worked when plugged into ethernet and my secretary has spent over 30 hours speaking with basic and advanced technicians to set up the phones over the past 2 weeks without the issues being resolved. The phones temporarily work on ethernet, but never work on WIFI through the WIFI dongle. The customer service have no recommendations other than continue to speak with technicians or sign up with a new company and port your numbers. It is hard to believe that it is so difficult for them to set up their phones and that they have wasted so much of our time. I have used 2 other VOIP providers in the past without any issues and will change services soon if these issues are not soon worked out.

cons: Gutted customer service, getting help is like pulling teeth,
title: I used to love 8x8 universally, but it...
review: I used to love 8x8 universally, but it seems that they’ve obscured access to customer support. Calling in for help, you’re hung up on and redirected to a website. This is both insulting, and unacceptable for a critical service like this. I will no longer be recommending 8x8 going forward, which is a shame because they have impeccable reliability.

cons: if you hav an issue, it is impossible to get connected with a tech in a timely manner.
pros: Easy set up and decent connectivity generally
title: The set up and service is fine, but if...
review: The set up and service is fine, but if you run into any issues, it is impossible to get help. We've used their services for over three years with random fixable glitches. This year, their techs left us hanging for two weeks with error messages on our phones after setting up multiple appointments for call backs. No one called.

cons: You will need to have a support tech person, if you aren't one.
pros: This system gives you the opportunity to control your entire phone system.
title: I spent time with the tech...
review: I spent time with the tech representative Oleg. This man really knows he's stuff! He helped me in many ways. Now I have obtained the knowledge on how to customize everything I need.. I'm very grateful to have had him on the line. I know from my personal experience with so many professionals claiming that they can do the job, but fail to act through. Oleg made it happen!!!

title: Oleg assisted me today in setting up a...
review: Oleg assisted me today in setting up a call flow with the call queue setting, and he did a great job! He was very patient and very thorough in explaining the details to me. He was an expert! He also walked me through on how to see the call flow online and also helped me in how to set up the voice mail feature. GOOD JOB!

title: TLDR; Great service if you don't need...
review:
TLDR; Great service if you don't need support.

Installation was fairly straight forward, the assigned account techs are great and very helpful. Once you are out of the new customer stage though, you're left to their helpful KB articles. Need more support, chat is largely unanswered and will just create a case for you, then you call in and speak with not very fluent English speakers, who may or may not be able to resolve your case. Usually ends up escalating it - with a promised call back that hasn't happened for me in 3 cases so far.

title: Today I spoke with Robert N. over at...
review: Today I spoke with Robert N. over at customer support and he did a wonderful job with troubleshooting all my issues. He was clearly very knowledgeable with the system and quick to recommend short-cuts and more efficient ways to operate within the Nextiva interface. My prior experiences within the support team have been ok, with me ending the call not entirely convinced my issue was fixed. However, after speaking with Robert, I feel that I am in good hands.

cons: Over Pricing, Hidden charges, poor support.
title: I was using Avoxi but when bill came it...
review:
I was using Avoxi but when bill came it was to my surprise they charge me 700+ USD extra, when asked them theu said US government taxes and other expenses we forward to customers. And it can vary according to they got taxed. I told them that i am not in USA nor i am beneficiary for that tax. They simply said we cannot do anything.

There sales & support is in EST time zone so for Asian and other countries you have to waut USA to open and then only you will get support, for us it was 12 hours diffrence.

Also there website is misleading they will publish like 300 mins with the package..but later find out its incoming minutes.

Do not go for these scamers.

title: My company used two different voip...
review: My company used two different voip systems before we settled with Jivetel. Jivetel has excellent features and quality. Overall, I'm most impressed with their level of customer services. They are very accommodating and pleasant to work with. I highly recommend Jivetel to anyone who cares about having a pleasant experience and wants to be treated well. I wish I had started off with them originally.

title: 4 years a customer and when the...
review: 4 years a customer and when the pandemic hit we needed to downsize. Many other service providers were understanding but 8x8 stuck to their early termination fees and offered to cut off our service and sue us if we did not pay them. They offshored support a year ago to India-good luck fixing anything

title: Excellent VOIP product, easy to make...
review: Excellent VOIP product, easy to make changes to your phones from anywhere and can access your phones / calls from anywhere with virtual office. Easy to set up new products and can always get support reps on the line when needed for assistance. Have not had any significant reliability issues, and 8x8 always has very high call quality! As well the 8x8 video conference has very high quality video conferencing.

title: My phone line has been on and off for 3...
review: My phone line has been on and off for 3 weeks. I can't figure out the issue. There is not a customer service phone number, only chat. The wait is always an hour, the reps close the chat if you don't respond immediately. I'm trying to switch to another carrier now, still can't reach anyone at Vonage.

cons: System is a bit extensive and have to get to k ow it bu on the other hand very complete
pros: So far no issues. Connectivity is great. Support is great. System is a bit extensive .
title: All in all very complete system with...
review:
All in all very complete system with all features of the big boys. Lots.of room to expand and grow your office. Easly have a work from home team that is easly manageable. Both wit internal and external chat.
So far great system and greT support team. Would definitely recommend. You get a fre 30 day trial so nothing to lose by trying it out. You won't regret it. Oh and I forgot extremely affordable for the price.

title: I wouldn't use this company due to the...
review: I wouldn't use this company due to the lack of customer service. If you need immediate help good luck. You will have to put a ticket in and it takes a couple days for a response and it's by phone and not a scheduled time. Can't call back. No live chat or call center agents available. i was on hold 2 hours and still no one picked up

title: Their support is horrific and the...
review: Their support is horrific and the phones are hit and miss if they work or not. We have requested service and they just ignore us. They have done nothing. They just say sorry we have noone to come out we can only try to trouble shoot remotely. They have been doing this for weeks and say the same thing every day so essentially I am just paying for phones that do not work.

title: I bought these phones off eBay and Mike...
review: I bought these phones off eBay and Mike at 8x8 helped me set them up. Mike was awesome and he went above and beyond in helping me setting these phones up. The phone had one issue and it was a big problem, firmware, we had to downgrade and etc. to get this fixed. Mike is very knowledgeable and a great agent at 8x8!

title: I am using Nextiva for my business for...
review: I am using Nextiva for my business for more than a year and the only reason I still have it is that I am too busy looking for another provider. Worst decision of my business. I have lost so many hours trying to fix the issues that I had with my fax. They even lost a fax number that I had listed on my business cards after almost a year of assigning it to me and had to provide another fax number!

title: Excellent VOIP with a unique set of CRM...
review: Excellent VOIP with a unique set of CRM features that makes Nextiva a diamond in the rough.

title: Support nightmare: mediocre at best,...
review: Support nightmare: mediocre at best, and unavailable outside of regular business hours, which is problematic for a 24x7 call center. Problems take days and weeks to resolve rather than hours. Trying to engage our account manager has been an exercise in frustration and ignored Emails / phone calls.

title: I think 8x8 is a very good option if...
review:
I think 8x8 is a very good option if you need a centralize system for your people to manual dial, you have the basic needs like call recordings.
Also support is very good some thing we appreciate when there is an issue.
Is very easy to set up and what i like more about that is that you don't need a computer with very high requirements like other systems, 8x8 works fine with very basic computers.

title: Most recently, received excellent rapid...
