review: Most recently, received excellent rapid answer to find accidental call block implemented by a user. against another user . However, the 8x8 System is always available, works flawlessly in the office and from mobile devices, and works for great conference calls mixing staff in the office, staff in home locations in the US, staff in locations in the UK, and staff in India all flawlessly.

title: Our company has been using 8x8 for...
review: Our company has been using 8x8 for several years. It was a replacement for AT&T system that only had physical phones. We liked it from the beginning but only during the COVID pandemic we realized how good it is. It is our daily communication tool between company staff since we started to work remotely. We use "Meet Now" to share screens and discuss projects many times during a typical workday. We schedule meetings with our clients using Outlook plugin. We installed the mobile apps on our cellphones so we can place and answer calls while away from our desks (in the office and home offices). Overall, it has been a great investment in productivity.

title: I am a current customer. I called in...
review: I am a current customer. I called in for support on one issue and ended up with a few additional questions. Oleg helped me with my issue and answered my questions. He was patient and knowledgeable. He took the time to understand my issue and questions. My questions and issue were answered and resolved in one call.

title: I am a 13 year consumer user of Vonage....
review: I am a 13 year consumer user of Vonage. We moved to their service because of the international plan and ability to call the UK for 'free'. After years of price increase, ok we stuck with Vonage, but then 12 months ago our home 'modem' stopped working. After much research on the web we learned that we needed to buy our own replacement or pay around $90 for a replacement box from Vonange. I call them to get the new modem activated. Customer Service tells me I have to purchase a new modem from them. ok, I agree and pay the $90 which appears on my bill. It never arrives. A month later I call them back to get the refund, which they did."Oh, we no longer provide modems. You need to get your own". Turns out I have a new un-used one. I ask them to activate it then and there, and the story changes. "Oh, you have to get one from us, and just pay the shipping". I say ok. They bill me for the shipping ( around $9 ). The modem never arrives. At this time we have been using the Vonage Extensions App on our mobile phones. It does not work with some international numbers. This company was great at one time, but now they are a disaster. The CEO should be fired. The Customer Service is complete crap. When I called to cancel the line yesterday it took the agent 30 minutes to cancel one residential line. Hello people... this is 2021. That's two HTTPS transactions to cancel a line. Disaster of a company. Avoid at all costs.. Oh, and after 13 years as a paying customer, when I called to cancel, the agent offered me the same $40+ plan for $10.99/month. Ludicrous.... I hope they go bust.

title: We had a cloud phone line installed at...
review: We had a cloud phone line installed at work, in theory a great idea, but it does not work, we I can hear the clients but the clients can't hear me. The internet is also slower with the smart hub than it was before, and I have spent a month trying to get them to fix it, and no success. This is a useless and painful company, do not use!!

cons: Virtual Contact Center has some maturing to do
pros: Promising, but stick to 8x8 work for now
title: My organization uses 8x8 work and I’ve...
review:
My organization uses 8*8 work and I've been happy with it.
Management made the decision to switch to VCC for call coaching and more granular reporting, that is beginning to be regarded as a mistake.

There is no central app or Chrome extension, it is all managed from a web portal, something that I thought I was going to prefer.

Instead we lost global click to dial functionality; though through an integration with Salesforce, it is available in a single Salesforce tab (don't try using multiple tabs, you'll get kicked out of VCC), and need to navigate to a separate page to view call history.

I've also heard complaints of bad call quality from my customers. My team has heard same complaints.
A series of service outages over the last few weeks have left us dialing out of the more reliable 8x8 work application.

Silver lining, I called support and Erwin was OUTSTANDING.

title: Excellent customer service and tech...
review: Excellent customer service and tech support! My office has been using 8 x 8 for several years now and have had minimal tech issues, etc. Call quality and ease of use. The app for my iPhone is also helpful and provides a seamless experience. I can call from my mobile device and it appears that I'm at the office, likewise if a call comes thru while I'm out of the office, I can answer which helps the overall experience for my clients

title: when we started to use there were just...
review:
when we started to use there were just a few question from our users, we are running 8x8 since 1 month, they give you training for admins, for users and have guides in case you miss some trainings.
all this has been realized with no issues, the best part of 8x8 for me is that this integration with MS TEAMS is extremely helpful. phone wherever you be.

title: 8x8 is useful in making communication...
review: 8x8 is useful in making communication convenient with its online features. When you are finally able to get in touch with a live representative to address any concerns, they are very knowledgeable and helpful. The representative that handled my concern of knowing how to reset my voicemail password stayed on the phone to ensure that all the changes that needed to be made were successful, which was much appreciated.

title: I have used 8x8 for several years now...
review: I have used 8x8 for several years now for my practice. I easilyutilize this through my cell phone and stay in touch with my clients via text as well. I am able to review faxes remotely and not be concerned about confidentiality while in transit. I highly recommend their HIPPA compliant service. The customer service has been excellent!

title: This is a feature rich unified...
review: This is a feature rich unified communication solution for all your communication and analysis needs. Whether a small company or a huge company, you have access to a full suite of features, from analysis to video conference to direct IM to mobile and desktop apps. They don't nickel and dime you for everything you want or need. Some companies may need everything, some may only need voice services. Whatever you want or need, you can add features without extra fees. The voice quality of the mobile app is outstanding. They are constantly improving their services yet never disrupt current versions of their apps. Their support group is also outstanding. We are very satisfied customers and I would highly recommend 8x8 to anyone considering a VOIP solution for their company.

title: I recommend for any business it's a...
review: I recommend for any business it's a great alternative to regular land line service all the features and video conferencing is wonderful. Support and customer service could be better every time I have had to call or need support I need to go through the first level technician who knows next to nothing and it takes forever to someone to call or get an escalation. No one takes ownership of a support ticket and follow-ups are snail speed. It truly is a shame because the service is actually quite good but the support not so much.

cons: Support is difficult to get ahold of and can take way to long to answer simple questions.
pros: 8x8 has been an easy to deploy system that overall has been a great solution for us.
title: From its easy set up process to its...
review: From its easy set up process to its function integration partners, I am truly grateful for 8x8 as our phone solution. Its integration with Microsoft Teams helps keep all our office communication in one place, and allows for easy communication. Its standalone 8x8 Work app is also a phenomenal tool. Whether you use its video conferencing, SMS/MMS text options, or just its phone solutions, 8x8 is a fairly easy to use. The admin portal is easy to make changes. The only drawback I have with 8x8 is technical support is very difficult to get ahold of and can be a point of frustration.

title: I would not recommend Nextiva to...
review:
I would not recommend Nextiva to anyone. I signed up for service and was charged for my initial month. Then I had to send financial confirmation and was told that I would be contacted to setup my account. Days went by and I didn't hear anything so I tried to set my account up on my own. I tried to call Customer Service for support and was on hold for 45 minutes. I was then told that they couldn't help me and that I would need to schedule a setup call for 10 days after my phone numbers were supposed to be ported. I indicated that I wanted to cancel the account and was transferred to the cancellation department. The representative in the cancellation department was very polite and helped me cancel the account and the port requests for my phone numbers. I received a confirmation email that my account was canceled and that the ports were canceled. A couple days later I received an email that one of my phone numbers were being ported and would be activated the next day. I tried calling and was on hold for almost an hour again and spoke to a representative for a few minutes before my call disconnected. I am now on the phone on hold again and hoping to get this issue resolved.

If you are going to ignore my warning and sign up with Nextiva, make sure they get your account setup the same day you sign up for service and make payment. DO NOT REQUEST TO PORT YOUR NUMBERS UNTIL EVERYTHING IS SET UP.

title: We have been with 8x8 for over a year...
review:
We have been with 8x8 for over a year now, the service is stable as the best from any other. Quality of calls are superb.
Issue is on the transition and setup, if you come from another vendor, prepare a good transition with at least 2 months.
Price wise is ok, not the cheapest, but the quality of calls are like it.

title: We have used multiple VoIP systems over...
review: We have used multiple VoIP systems over the last nine years in business. We switched to Zoom shortly after they started offering VoIP service and it was an instant upgrade. It's been more reliable and feature-rich than any service we have used in the past. We've been with them for roughly 5 months and they've been flawless.

title: Support is a maze of telephone prompts...
review:
Support is a maze of telephone prompts and you can never get anyone on the line. The software is grouped together clump of unusable, unfriendly junk that is wrapped up in a pretty bow for you to buy it.

If you still choose to use them, you will find out that all of the negative reviews on the site have merit.

pros: stability, even in video calls to far ccornerners  of the earth
title: I introduced Zoom to the organization I...
review: I introduced Zoom to the organization I retired from by now. It was early days but ever since I have had almost exclusively positive experiences with Zoom. The exception was when I ordered phone service for my own business in Switzerland. There, Zoom phone service is horribly bad to the extent that we simply could not use it. Nevertheless, I have no hesitation in recommending Zoom for everything else.

title: We replaced a different VOIP system...
review:
We replaced a different VOIP system with ZOOM, and have been astounded with the quality and reliability... and the companion smart-phone app is very elegant ... Have recommended to associates as opportunities arise.
Cost savings by eliminating multiple other services is a pleasant bonus.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED...

cons: had issues with setup and proting numbers
title: happy with service now  setup was...
review: happy with service now setup was painful and had account linked to another customer and proting numbers were painful but price is great and would change now that we are using them. like the auto attendant and the easy to change message when clients call and get ease of getting messages left from clients and having message hsitory as well as phone number history

cons: Sometimes my screen freezes and sometimes I get cut off.
title: I love Zoom.  It was developed at just...
review: I love Zoom. It was developed at just the right time to help us through COVID-19, or maybe that's when I learned about it. My church uses it and I am becoming more and more comfortable with all the features. I recently learned about "breakout" rooms and I am eager to learn this feature. Thank you for providing this service.

title: Great Service always! quick easy! the...
review: Great Service always! quick easy! the customer support team is always willing to help they get it done fast and are so kind! I appreciate this as it is so hard to find in Company. When I have a issue I appreciate the quick manner in which they get it done. I can email or call in at anytime with the same quick results from the customer support team. I appreciate their great service and this is why we will always be loyal customers of Nextiva!

title: Shubham in the support team helped me...
review: Shubham in the support team helped me connect, he was outstanding. He didn't ask me for feedback, but I was so impressed with him that I wanted to find out how to give feedback. He was excellent.

title: We have used 8x8 for several years now...
review: We have used 8x8 for several years now and, it's been a wonderful experience. Customer service is outstanding. Any time I have had questions on how to set something up, tech support has been right there to help. Our calls have been clear, and we haven't had any drop. I would highly recommend it.

title: We implemented 8x8 for the school a...
review:
We implemented 8x8 for the school a couple of years ago. The migration was all in-house, as they don't really have professional services to help us.
It was a little difficult since they didn't have a proactive implementation model, only reactive support. So we missed a lot of things and didn't understand some things.

However, fast forward today... and we have a great system up and running and working as intended. WHich during the pandemic all the apps and softphone features really helped us out a lot.

The product, if the network is configured well, really works well with minor outages over the past two years.
I would recommend them for smaller offices, not over 100 people.

title: Have been using it for a couple of...
review: Have been using it for a couple of years now. The phone, the app and and the software have run perfectly. Would recommend this system to anyone. Easy to install, sound quality is great. The only thing I wouldn't recommend is writing this review as I have run out of things to say, which is a bit of a nuisance.

pros: Highly usable even for those who struggle with other technology
title: We have been able to utilize Zoom to...
review: We have been able to utilize Zoom to hold important meetings and avoid being in person with one another as we attempted to escape spreading Covid. Even as we have now been vaccinated, our people now enjoy the convenience of staying at home but still being able to hold meetings and conduct official business

title: We have a small company of 25 people in...
review: We have a small company of 25 people in the office and 8x8 gets the job done for us. It is easy to use and I find it intuitive and all at a reasonable cost. We never experience any issues and I have also found their customer support to be very knowledgeable and they are persistent in their efforts to solve any problems.

cons: No call blocking, doesn't work with most VOIP add-ons
title: We are happy with 8x8 support, and it...
review: We are happy with 8x8 support, and it is a better price than we could get elsewhere. That being said, the software lacks compatibility with common add-ons for blocking the many many spam calls we receive every single day. The software also lacks an easy way to add numbers to a "block calls" list that actually works. Calls can be blocked at the user level only. Ring Groups and Offices are incapable of blocking numbers at their level which is the only way to actually block a call. There is a complicated workaround that is passable, but takes a lot of extra steps and time to manage. If the software worked with any of the call blocking VOIP add-ons, then I would have no complaints.

title: I appreciate the good service and...
review: I appreciate the good service and support when we need to get assistance on a task or help with an existing issue. The support team is available via chat or through a callback feature reliably. They usually call back within the same business day under two hours of total time waiting. Thank you for all the help.

title: The sales and installation were a...
review: The sales and installation were a dream. Easy to work with that staff, very helpful and knowledgeable of what I needed. A few years ago, the regular support was spotty for a while but has greatly improved. It's a powerful system and with that comes some complexity but once you've figured it out, it's very easy to work with. Pricey, but powerful.

cons: Requires logout and religion to switch profiles
title: We’ve been using 8 x 8 for the last...
review: We’ve been using 8 x 8 for the last 15 years. They are always responsive when needing an assist with configuring an option and have been instrumental in making sure we’ve been able to connect with our clients. We primarily use Use the service in the form of the desktop and mobile apps. This allows us to be engaged with clients no matter where we are at

title: 8x8 has been our vendor of choice for...
review: 8x8 has been our vendor of choice for reliable phone service since 2006. Their desktop and mobile platform keep us connected whether in the office or the field and help ensure we never miss a call. Any time we've needed tech support, they have been helpful and and timely. We highly recommend them.

cons: Don't accept bank cards easily, always problems with billing,
title: Had to go through a huge loss coz of u...
review: Had to go through a huge loss coz of u guys its ridiculous that a person can't add a different credit card on thier account. My account was been used by my employees they tried to use their credit card to pay but not accepted my phone stopped working & my buisness ran out. Thanks for your service.

title: I switched from another VoIP provider...
review:
I switched from another VoIP provider and am saving $100 per month. The tech support person who helped me to configure my VoIP phone spent an hour with me to get it all working correctly, and the transfer of my phone numbers went without a hitch.

I've been using Zoom meetings and webinars for several years, and having the phone integration makes it easy with everything in one tool.

I've had no problems, and am happy with the switch. It all just works, which is what I wanted.

title: I am thankful for the opportunity to...
review: I am thankful for the opportunity to host meetings. The zoom platform makes my experience a pleasurable and easy to use solution for my meetings needs. I will definitely spread the word about Zoom. The experience, the customer support. Also the different options for the needs of the customer. Keep up the good work I am definitely a happy Zoom user!

cons: A little time consuming to get started.   But worth the effort.
title: I was hesitant to switch to this type...
review: I was hesitant to switch to this type of phone service. However, Spectrum kept raising prices and would not offer any incentive to stay with them. I did a lot of research and ended up choosing Nextiva. So far so good. I needed assistance in getting our system set up and their online and person-to-person support has been terrific.

title: We have been with 8x8 for over 6 years....
review: We have been with 8x8 for over 6 years. We have had nothing but good things to say about their products. Whether the admin and configuration system, to sales and support, it has been a great experience for our group, and even during the last year of the pandemic, the softphone connectivity and video meeting calling has been great along with the 8x8 app to allow your to use your cell phone to call with the 8x8 service.

title: I love 8x8 phone system ever since we...
review: I love 8x8 phone system ever since we switched. All of our offices can connect easily. We were not able to dial extentions for our other office locations before we got 8x8, but now we can. I love it and would not recomment anything else. It is the best phone system we have ever used. I can't even imagine going back to what we had before.

title: I have been using 8x8 for an office and...
review: I have been using 8x8 for an office and now home office for going on 10 years. The flexibility to be able to change your work environment and still maintain the integrity and flexibility are fantastic. With virtually 0 downtime the whole system works flawlessly. 8x8 offers many features that i'm not able to take advantage of, but larger companies can for sure.

title: Nextiva is all sales and show.  We...
review:
Nextiva is all sales and show. We struggle every day with dropped calls and dead air in our call flows and call centers. We have recorded and documented numerous instances of poor call quality but support consistently claims we need specific examples. We have recorded calls from inbound calls, exact times and highlighted the calls from the call reports. What more could you need?

Nextiva will show the beautiful front end with CRM and modern design but in reality the system runs on a Broadsoft platform the real configuration and reporting looks nothing like Nextiva promotes on their website. The call flow graphical tool is garbage and what should be simple transfers between call centers are configured as external calling because the platforms are not connected. One call looks like 3 in all the reporting.

Reporting looks great but is not usable. First you must be a full admin to access "Nextiva Analytics" I can't make a sales manager who wants to run reports a full admin. This seems fake but has been confirmed by 3 different Nextiva Engineers. If you do have rights the reporting can's do something as simple as save a layout after removing or adding a column. There is no API or method to extract data other than email a link.

20 years managing VOIP systems. Was a test case for Cisco's first VOIP offering. Worked with on-prem and host such as Vonage Business, Ring Central and Mitel. Nextiva is all show no go. As of writing this we can't log into the management interface and calls to support are being dropped.

cons: Dashboard could use some work. Having to use multiple systems for call center. Reporting is good but slightly limited.
pros: Pricing is good. Easy to use. Reporting capabilities is good.
title: As a customer of 8x8 and admin for the...
review: As a customer of 8x8 and admin for the system for the last year and a half, I would say this product is great. I love that I have full autonomy over everything in the system related to my call center. I never have to submit tickets to update anything for our center. The ability to customize my reports is also a big plus. We have a large number of queues and 8x8 provides me with the ability to customize each and every single one with scripting. The customer service is also great. Till now I have not had any issues with tickets being resolved or getting help with functions from the 8x8 support team. Kudos to them. Some of the cons I have are the needing to use two systems for Call Center to function. The dashboard not being able to alert managers on extended Offline codes. Reporting is good but also limited in many ways. Overall I still recommend 8x8 for the pricing and the quality of the system. Much better then our more expensive previous servicer.

title: The products are great and very easy to...
review: The products are great and very easy to work with. They are very flexible and easily customizable to meet our business needs. Virtual Office is very easy to navigate and use. VCC also very user friendly. The only area that I can say needs work is getting support. When you need tech support it can take some time to get assistance. other than that everything is great

title: I have been an 8x8 customer for years....
review: I have been an 8x8 customer for years. Their product and their service are so good that I have never even thought about trying another service. I will recommend them to anyone I can. I have never had an issue that hasn't been solved in just a matter of minutes. I have never been left hanging by them and they stay in touch with me several times throughout the year.

title: 8x8 is less than half the cost of our...
review: 8x8 is less than half the cost of our previous provider. However, support is difficult to get in touch with. Phone rental is weird to me. Most of my at home team suffers from not being able to answer calls when ringing to them via the 8x8 app, and are constantly having to restart their phones. Still not 100% sure this even solves the issue. Mailbox limit is subpar - we are a very active company and the limit on voicemails drives me insane. Overall, it is a user friendly interface phone solution, that is cheap. I would probably recommend but with the heads up of the issues I've mentioned.

title: We are a small startup that needed a...
review: We are a small startup that needed a public phone number for our website. We don't get many calls, but the call quality has been great. Set up is a bit cumbersome, but very customizable. We have a public line and then one personal extension. Really great once you get the hang of it. Would recommend it to other small businesses.

title: Trying to get support to program a...
review: Trying to get support to program a phone is beyond frustrating. One call took almost 4 hours and the problem was not even resolved. It was forwarded to a Tier 2 representative of which I never heard from. I had to call several times only to be on hold for 30+ minutes. The reps are nice people. Just frustrating process to get support.

title: Vonage phone support representatives...
review: Vonage phone support representatives have been a great feature to the Vonage product. On the occasions when I have called they have taken their time to clearly explain processed to me and ensure I was able to obtain a clear understanding of my options. The Vonage representative was also very professional and ensured account access was completed in a secure and appropriate manner.

title: This is a great company to do business...
review:
This is a great company to do business with.
Their tech support is great. Their pricing is transparent. The product itself works well and is flexible for our business' needs. It is orders of magnitude better than our previous solution provider. I like how the company is investing in building a community among its users with webinars and other actions to be not just a product purveyor, but a thought leader.

pros: Locked in rates regardless of contract
title: I have been a customer of Nextiva for...
review: I have been a customer of Nextiva for almost 2 years now & currently operate multiple businesses on the platform. The service is amazing. The price is amazing. I can't wait to obtain the new products that Nextiva may offer in the future. I love the fact that they also gave me Free video conferencing & Free hardware for my businesses. It's obvious to see why they are the leader in the market.

title: products and services are solid, easy...
review: products and services are solid, easy to integrate into teams. kb is pretty abundant and easy to follow. support is good once you get a response, this can at time take a few days so you may need to escalate, past that they will be able to resolve most issues within a couple of responses. overall pretty decent for a comms company.

title: I have been using 8x8 for a year and...
review: I have been using 8x8 for a year and half so far and this has proven to be so convenient! Not being at the office anymore I control everything and manage my calls from my computer. I need to call from time to time abroad and it is working perfectly! Great service, I never had any issues and I would recommend it to any company looking for a VoIP.

title: Worked with Ivan Kotsubynsky in support...
review: Worked with Ivan Kotsubynsky in support to setup a Nextiva fax account for a Nextiva client. I have been a Nextiva partner for over 7 years and I have never had the fax account setup process be completed so quickly and efficiently! With Ivan's help, the new account was setup in minutes and I was able to send a test fax. Ivan was very knowledgeable, professional and efficient in handling my request.

title: Great option for todays work...
review: Great option for todays work environment. With the app you can take your office anywhere you need to. I like the setup for contacts and the option to text customers who prefer that method. It would have been much better if we would have received some training there were functions that were not completely intuitive.

title: Our company has used 8X8 for over 10...
review: Our company has used 8X8 for over 10 years. Our needs have changed and 8X8 has adapted with us. We have been able to decrease and increase our users with little effort or problems. It is easy to have calls forwarded to cell phones which works best for most of our employees, especially since everyone now works from home.

title: I enjoy Nextiva because they are...
review: I enjoy Nextiva because they are consistently improving their systems and have a good suppport team. No service like this is perfect, which alot of people can expect but at the end of the day it's drastically improved my business work flow and made my ability to be remote workforce a reality. Highly recommend.

title: Great service, got exactly the guidance...
review: Great service, got exactly the guidance I needed. I had a question about giving remote users with no physical phone access to an extension, using only the softphone app and my representative helped me in a timely manner so that I was able to continue doing my good work. It was a great time wow so nice.

title: It has been easy to use. We would just...
review: It has been easy to use. We would just recommend easier way to reach out to support for questions. We also appreciate an email notification in case there are outages. Right now, updates are cascaded through email. There should also be an improvement in the way we communicate with our sales agent. Right now we are trying to reach out and learn more about the new features.

title: 8x8 has been our main provider for call...
review: 8x8 has been our main provider for call solutions for the entire time that I've been with my company and it's become even more user friendly with the new updates. I really like the new sleeker design that shows the interface all in one place for easy transfers and the ability to review multiple things at once.

title: A very solid company for the VOIP...
review:
A very solid company for the VOIP system.
The sound quality is crystal clear,
easy, and straightforward to purchase and install a new device,
very reliable, for the past 5 years we don't have any connectivity issue
there are some lacking features in the video conferencing compared to the popular one,
also, it is challenging to maneuver in their new administration portal but
this was countered with their responsive and helpful customer support

title: 8x8 has been a huge blessing for our...
review: 8x8 has been a huge blessing for our agency. It has streamlined our processes significantly. With covid, we have had to interact virtually now more than ever. All the features that 8x8 has to offer have made this a seamless transition. Our agency rarely misses important phone calls from clients or patients.

title: As the administrator for a small...
review: As the administrator for a small business, I absolutely love 8x8! Being able to set the hours I receive notifications for work has helped prevent my work from taking over my personal life. It has provided an opportunity for me to more personally connect with clients, and streamline communication through text (while not giving away my personal number)! After using this service I couldn't imagine going back to the use of landlines for a business. 8x8 has revolutionized how I approach communication in the office, with both clients and team members!

title: Packet 8 used to be the best kept...
review:
Packet 8 used to be the best kept secret in Silicon Valley. Once it became 8x8 the quality of the service went south. Billing is 50% taxes and bogus fees other vendors do not charge.

Their service is almost nonexistent with tech that google solutions rather than actually know the product.

When approached, 8x8 Senior management does not care.

title: Ivan Kotsubynsky was extremely helpful...
review: Ivan Kotsubynsky was extremely helpful and patient. He assisted me the best way that he knew how, by first listening to my concerns, then second he searched for the best possible outcome. I had 2 request, one of which he was able to help and resolve my request. The other request, was out of his control and more of a systems issue that I was not able to get resolved. However, that did not affect Ivan's overall performance.

title: RingCentral is the worst when it comes...
review:
RingCentral is the worst when it comes to ethics. They sneak a 2 year renewal into the contract and there is no way to cancel ahead of time. They offer you to "buy out" the contract but all that means is you pay them all of the money up front. The service is okay but very expensive.
There are far cheaper options out there and I would absolutely recommend going to them as they have better service, ethical contracts and are far cheaper.
I would highly recommend never choosing RingCentral and would seriously question their ethics and leadership.

title: Sometimes its difficult with the...
review: Sometimes its difficult with the overseas support, but I had to activate a buy a new phone, activate a new phone and revise ring groups and a few other details. The support staff takes ownership of their cases, and checks back, and takes pride in resolving technical issues. Currently running smoothly thanks to all the help!

title: I have been with 8x8 for almost 20...
review: I have been with 8x8 for almost 20 years. They have grown too big and have minimized customer contact and support. Very hard to speak with a human and their platform is stale as stale can get. Back in the day I was able to speak with tech support and get the help I needed very quickly. Now tech support from 8x8 takes you to chat and links that cause the customer to work way too hard to get answers. Not my cup of tea any longer.

title: Ok I am a new business owner who has...
review:
Ok I am a new business owner who has been rapidly growing and needed more than just a “hi hello thank you for calling system”. Nextiva was able to help me scale my business to the next level with the option of continuing to grow with them. I utterly enjoy all the hands on help I have received in setup, scaling and understanding their system .

P.S Owner @ Secure The Bag Financial
Donnareen

pros: Features and functions for the price
title: This is my third time in using 8x8 for...
review: This is my third time in using 8x8 for my VOIP solution. Each time I have had a better experience due largely to the added functionality. The price points for functionality cannot be beat. I know that wherever I am I will always receive any call coming in on my office number with 8x8's great call forwarding capabilities. The system is easy to manage myself and very tailorable. Finally, I am a great fan of 8x8 Work video conferencing. I use it all the time, easy to integrate with gmail calendar and the built in no extra cost recording and closed captioning set it apart. I highly recommend for any business.

title: Easy to deploy, manage, and integrate...
review: Easy to deploy, manage, and integrate mobile workforce solution that allows for effective and productive intra-team collaboration as well as clean voice channel to securely communicate with outside parties. 8x8 offers voice solutions for mobile, desktop, and hardware-based phones, as well as video conferencing.

title: I have been using 8x8 with several of...
review:
I have been using 8x8 with several of my clients for over 6 years now. Over that time their feature set has continued to improve and their support has been getting worse. About a year ago they implemented tired support that you need to pay additional for, and that made the general support even worse. I am an experienced IT person and when I call it is always a system issue and not a "user issue". Yet I always need to go through the first level technician (that is a very kind description) who knows next to nothing and it takes forever to get an escalation. No one takes ownership of a support ticket and follow-ups are glacial in speed.
It truly is a shame because the service is actually quite good when it works. Their latest technology officer promised great support and has fallen miserably short on that promise. If you are not experienced in IT and have no on-site staff, I cannot recommend them due simply to their support. It must get better.

title: My experience with 8x8 is in comparison...
review: My experience with 8x8 is in comparison to Vonage, Nextiva and Ring Central. I’ve tried all of these services. Vonage should not even be considered if you’re looking for a business line. Nextiva has a great customer service but I always call quality issues that was always attributed wrongly to my internet connection and they were never resolved. Ring central had also call quality issues and is expensive in comparison to o 8x8. Finally 8x8 was referred by a friend, I find the company name very unrelated and didn’t give me any confidence when signing up for the service but I was wrong. So far they have the best service, many instructional videos, great mobile app and tons of features which in my use case I don’t need and never use use it. But I can’t emphasize enough the value of not hearing your echo while you’re on a call. I highly recommend their service.

title: Our company added our 8x8 account to a...
review: Our company added our 8x8 account to a company cell phone so now we have 24hr access. Since Covid-19 we have not staffed our office full time, and were missing calls. Since we are not located in the United States it was important to have a number in our target marketing area. 8x8 was able to give us a number that suited our needs.

title: The support is fast and efficient.  The...
review: The support is fast and efficient. The account management team is attentive and there is you need to escalate an issue. We were on 8x8 and the company was miserable. Transitioning phone systems is never fun, but Nextiva made it as smooth as possible. For the first time in years, there are no more complaints about faxes not working or calls dropping.

title: My office has been using 8x8 for  a few...
review: My office has been using 8x8 for a few years. Like most services, we have had some hiccups along the way but I would say we've had more good experiences than bad. Customer service is pretty resposnsive and have always resolved the issues we've had. The last customer service person that helped me was particuarly exceptional. In additional to their servies, they also offer trainings that can help businesses to better communications, especially during this time. I would recommed 8x8 services.

title: We are using 8x8 as a dedicated line...
review: We are using 8x8 as a dedicated line for our charity. Basically, it is far cheaper than having a dedicated BT line put in and everything is seamless. To date, everything is working very well and have not have the need to contact support. I have persuaded other teams in our charity to consider using it to keep admin costs down. Highly recommended!

title: Working with Nextiva to get the phone...
review: Working with Nextiva to get the phone system up was a pleasure. The entire team is very organized and made implementation a breeze. The training they provided me was to the point and very easy to follow. The quality of service is great. All of our users are happy with the ease of use and all the features that are included. Highly recommend Nextiva.

cons: Phone service irregularities, Terrible Web m Meeting appliclcation
title: 8x8 looked like it would be a great...
review: 8x8 looked like it would be a great system, but its not. The Web Meeting Application sucks, all sorts of errors and meetings have to be canceled. The phone service works well for the most part, but some exchanges you just can't reach, and I have no idea why. 8x8 also gave up our 1-800 number in our move over to them, after promising to preserve it with us, and now it belongs to another company. Support is a live person, but they are slow to respond, and often time can't understand the plain-English problem. We should have gone with another vendor, and will son. AND YES, their subscription renewal is hidden and automatic, so you get screwed over trying to make a switch.

title: Excellent company for our VOIP needs....
review: Excellent company for our VOIP needs. 8X8 is very responsive for any questions or issues (though we never had any issues). They will walk you through and provide you with any tools needed to help you understand and use their services. They even provided us with a discount on purchasing their VOIP phones for our office.

title: Our church has been with Nextiva for...
review: Our church has been with Nextiva for years, always reliable and friendly customer service. Never had an issue, and love the new UI , and how easy it is to learn the basics. Also the team like the calling and answer app feature via mobile. I would recommend this company to those looking for a easy voip office / team solution.

title: We really like the App and the ability...
review:
We really like the App and the ability for our employees to use it while working remote. We have never had calls drop or miss calls because the system wasn't working like we did with our old provider.
Their Customer support is also very good. They are quick to help and able to talk to through any problems you may have.

title: I love the features of the IP phone and...
review: I love the features of the IP phone and the fact that my office phone is directly tied to my cell! The ease of the system is amazing. Our IT professional manages the system, so we have no issues with our phones. We have found it to be very reliable and cost effective. I would definitely recommend the system.

title: Vonage is an awesome service that...
review: Vonage is an awesome service that allows me to work from home for my office and their support team it great when you need their help. I would recommend Vonage as a VOIP provider. I have been using them for over 2 years and they have always been there for our company. Thanks Vonage for your service.

title: worst customer service ever.  they have...
review: worst customer service ever. they have been unable to invoice me, and cut off my business phones for nonpayment. i've been trying for 5 months to get them to email me invoices, i've created 5 ticket, wasted at least 7 hours, had phone calls, still nothing. they just close tickets and can't even update an email address, for FIVE MONTHS. it's insane, it'll drive you crazy. this company is horrible.

cons: Live Chat is unable to resolve my issues
title: When I started my job, my employer was...
review: When I started my job, my employer was already using Vonage at our 2 office locations. Long story short, our sister office decided to switch to another phone service, but my office continued to use Vonage. That's when I inherited the monster. Ever since our sister office split off the plan, we have had nothing but unresolved glitches for the past 11 months. In 11 months, I've just today received a call from a human at Vonage, and that was only after I informed my Live Chat rep that I was considering switching to another phone provider. Here are the glitches we deal with daily: We have 4 extensions at our office, and sometimes the texts from our clients appear on all of our mobile apps, and sometimes they don't, which means we sometimes accidentally "ignore"our clients. When I live chatted about this, I was told, "if it isn't happening right at this moment while we are chatting, there is nothing I can do to help you." Our outgoing call numbers are not the same number our clients are familiar with. I was told there is no way to resolve this, since we each need our own extension, our outgoing calls are the internal numbers associated with our unique extensions. This means that clients often ignore our calls, because they don't recognize the number. Finally, when setting up our account Vonage mis-titled our business name, and after several attempts to get it changed, it is still wrong.

title: We've been a Vonage Business Customer...
review: We've been a Vonage Business Customer for 12 years. Up time and quality of service is great. BUT, if you have ANY technical problems you're SOL. They DO NOT OFFER LIVE TECHNICAL HELP "unless you call new accounts" and ""demand"" help. Simple issue I'm having getting a existing handset to register. Nothing special! Only service they offer is Chat. Chat is low level and they can't help. On hold again right now with a NEW Customer CSR. Even he can't get a Tech to answer or three way. It's 10am CST. The Tech CSR that did call me at my appointment time earlier this morning placed me on hold for 30 min. Then their hold timer timed out. He DID NOT CALL BACK!!! Back on hold with New Customer CSR waiting. As of this note I've been working hours to get the issue resolved over two days. The message in my ear says they are too busy and somebody will have to call me back. And to press 1 for call back, only pressing 1 does nothing! Still on hold listening to music... now one hour...

title: This is absolutely the worse company...
review: This is absolutely the worse company I've ever used. Had countless issues with them. I have never ever been able to use the service yet I'm billed for it monthly. It took me 2.5 months to finally speak to a Human because their customer support system is SHIT!! Then when I finally got the chance to talk to them and tell them that I was unable to use the service and I want to cancel this horrible shit they tell me I have to pay an additional $271 for something that never worked in the first place. ABSOLUTE GARBAGE!! Don't Waste Your Money!! Take your business some where else that its really appreciated.

cons: An hour of hell cancelling service
title: I have had vonage for years and...
review: I have had vonage for years and recommended the service to many customers, but they are real scammers, liars and cheats when you want out. They transferred me around the world to different people trying to put me off from cancelling. They would make me repeat my phone number time after time, spell my name, as for credit card number saying they wanted to make sure it was actually me cancelling. They transferred me to the Uk and then to the US and have to answer all the same questions again and again when wanting to cancel. Each time I would explain I was in Canada. I was under 2 minutes signing on to vonage and over an hour when cancelling. I cannot recommend this company.

cons: Servers go down frequently, Technology is old and out of date. Nickel and diming of fee’s was too much
pros: Price are fair for the limited services and technology ay at $45 a seat. Now others are paying $115 a seat way too much.
title: DYL Service was worth the $45 a seat I...
review: DYL Service was worth the $45 a seat I was paying, but our agency needed more integration and Automatic Intelligence (AI) behind our sales and service team. We were doing well with ROI and this product until unlimited text messaging was no longer unlimited. DYL gave no notice, but stopped us from texting prospects and clients, asking for more money. We are currently piloting another system with more AI services at $115 a seat instead of DYL price of $45 a seat. So far DYL isn’t worth the $45 a seat. Shop your CRM carefully

title: The software is extremely buggy. It's...
review: The software is extremely buggy. It's clear none of the "features" were thought through before they were released. I've been setting up for a small team for 2 weeks. Anytime I can't find a setting in the terrible user interface, I have to chat in, just for the person to tell me it's something that they have to change on their side, or the engineers are working on it, or that it's not available. A complete mess of a system that I regret signing up for.

cons: Expect to Pay too Much on a Long Contract
title: We signed a 3 year agreement for 16...
review:
We signed a 3 year agreement for 16 phones and within a month realized that we didn't need that many. They refused to allow us out of the contract and stated we needed to pay for the full remaining years. I offered to pay a penalty or for the phones, but they demanded the entire amount. This violates contract law as a penalty clause versus being liquidated damages. They are asking for a class action.

Beyond that, now nearing my 3 year end, I realized they added another line on 8 months ago from their sales department despite me only now using 5 of the lines/phones due to a smaller staff. I asked for that to be refunded (about $80) and they refused that! Worse the customer service person (Sara Ann) told me to go read the fine print of the contract. That is exactly not what any customer wants to hear.

I won't be back and can't wait to dump this company that I think is not interested in actually helping consumers.

title: This company is a joke!  They do not...
review: This company is a joke! They do not have a number to call for support and this is a phone company, granted it is VOIP but still not number to get support! Call quality is poor, when you do get support all they do is blame your internet connection. I have a T1 line so its not my connection is is there poor service. They are cheap and you get what you pay for, so don't waste your money. If you cannot understand your caller you have wasted money and time. When you get support you realize you have made a HUGE mistake!

title: This is a service that is not fit for...
review:
This is a service that is not fit for purpose.

The app looks really good, but don't be fooled by what it promises; that's just a smokescreen. What is going on behind is a clown riding a bicycle.

If you want the future of your business in the hands of clowns go ahead and sign up. I did, don't do what I did.

pros: Fully integrated Voice, Video, and Chat
title: I switched to Zoom Voice when I grew...
review:
I switched to Zoom Voice when I grew frustrated with the limited functions of my previous business line. Zoom has all the features a small business needs in phone service. The system is customizable to meet the needs of the overall business and anyone that is added as a user to the account. The cost is affordable for the services offered and when bundled with the classic Zoom, the price is even better.

I found a desk phone on Amazon that was super easy to set up with Zoom Phone.

title: Ring Central Sales will just Lie to...
review: Ring Central Sales will just Lie to you, about the easy to use feature and easy to reach customer support, totally misrepresents the contract and the fact that you can cancel anytime. They left our the hefty cancellation fee is a large portion of your contract even if you've been paying for over 10 months with the same issue. Since day one I've had the same issue. I want the Ring Central issued custom phone number to on its first ring to go directly to my live answering service. I do not want any rings on my cell phone. I spent dozens of hours watching there supposed support videos and reading online Q&A. Online written solutions to previously made questions. If you can find the number to get a live person its usually someone with a thick accent that is very hard to understand and doesn't seem to understand English. You have to spell things out very slowly to communicate what is happening and repeat your self numerous times. No call was less than 45 minutes with hold time no matter what day or time you call. No matter who you online chatted with or spoke to would say the same thing. The settings are correct, it must be your apple phone. Or it must be you Phone provider. It took 3 months to get the number ported out from Ring Central to Nextiva. I obtained the information for the account name, address, account number and attached the most recent bill, to the porting form submitted to Ring Central. It would takes weeks before I got notified it was rejected with no explanation as to why by Ring Central. After 2 months of submitting paperwork even with a live person from Ring Central helping it was still rejected. Until I found my 12 month old original online request form in an email for ring central service. It had my name and not my business name that was on the bill and my personal address that also was no on the Ring Central bill. So this time filled out the porting out form with this old info and once again attached the latest bill to the port-out request to ring central. This finally wasn't rejected. Now the original Ring Central Phone number is with Nextiva and doesn't ring 1-2 times on my cell phone if, I have it set to go to my live answering service. Guess all the support people at Ring Central were wrong it wasn't my cell phone or provider but Ring Central that was the problem. So today I call to cancel my Ring Central account. The woman told me that there was no record of my ever reporting any issues and I would have to pay the cancelation fee. She said that I would receive a bill in my email from Ring Central within 10 days!

title: Virtual meetings have been our primary...
review: Virtual meetings have been our primary mode of operation for 5 years now. We've worked with two other providers in past years. The last two years Zoom's platform has exceeded all others in performance, quality and offerings. We love it.

title: The good: support is very good...
review:
The good: support is very good throughout installation and startup. So far there has been no issue with network reliability. Features are reasonably good and price is fair.

The bad: finanl costs ran way above the quote. The sales guy didn't fully understand my needs and multiple features had to be added to replace my previous system. You have to install everything by yourself but they do provide good support. You need to be quite technical and handy, or it can quickly become very frustrating and extremely time-consuming to install and start up all the phones.

pros: Call forwarding to a cell phone was the only useful aspect of this system.
title: I spent 24 hours on the phone, and sent...
review: I spent 24 hours on the phone, and sent over 150 emails with onboarding and support over the 6 month span from opening account to closing it. They cancelled my numbers before a successful porting, so we almost lost our business's 25 yr old number. Support was always a new person, with little communication between support members. Having no local support option was extremely detrimental to our business. This phone company was extremely detrimental to our business. I will never recommend Nextiva to anyone, friend or enemy.

title: We moved our phone system from...
review: We moved our phone system from RingCentral and have been happy with the move. The phone system is flexible and reliable, especially for a company that has been doing the virtual office "thing" for a decade or more. The ability to have a central phone system for people across the US and in two other countries is great. We have all decided on using software clients for phone service as well as meetings and it has worked out extremely well for us.

cons: need to login each time you switch devices
title: If you have more than one computer that...
review:
If you have more than one computer that you switch between, you need to login each time you switch computers. This is a pain, and a poor experience compared to the phone feature on slack.
The voice quality is excellent on a computer, but on my phone it is not as good.
I wish the companion chat function was better. My team won't use it because there is only one notification sound and it is exactly the same as a text message, making it hard to know if the text is for work (zoom) or social.

cons: Phone will ring and auto answer - very bad
pros: Easy to use, reliable, great features, great price point
title: Overall i really love Zoom Phone and...
review: Overall i really love Zoom Phone and use this internally and have replace our PBX. Great quality and features. I can't stand though how every now and again I will get a call while in a meeting and it will autoanswer and I need to quick disconnet the call. Also, support is really bad - we have had 3 CSMs and then it just changed to a pooled resource. The turn around time on getting support is horrible and stop sending articles as an auto-support and please just have a real conversation.

title: This company is the worst.  DO NOT SIGN...
review: This company is the worst. DO NOT SIGN UP WITH THEM. The sales guy was great, promised how available he would be through the installation, and answered all my questions right up to the point I signed. Then he would farm out each of my questions to someone who couldn't answer them. Almost all of my tech support calls take almost an hour and they are FREQUENT in the beginning, so forget about getting any of your actual work done. You will talk to tech support and think the issue is fixed, but it is not. They will blame your internet speed, so you speed the money and increase it. It doesn't work. They blame your headsets. So, you spend more money on new ones that they say they say are compatible. It doesn't work. You will deal with dropped calls, customer complaints that they can't hear you, crackly lines, and online tutorials to do things that are out of date. What can you do? Jack squat. You are locked into a 13 month contract so you muddle through in a rage with incompetent albeit very polite support people. I am 6 months into this contract and 13 months can't come fast enough.

title: I have been with VOIPO for about 6...
review:
I have been with VOIPO for about 6 years now ever since Sun Rocket folded up. The service used to be great and any issues you had, they went out of their way to resolve.
Well that all changed a few years ago as they got too big and needed to upgrade their servers. I was without service for months(hard to pinpoint exactly as its not often used). the only way I knew it was down was the once in a blue moon that I would call it and I would get a busy signal. Some times I could just unplug everything and plug it back in and it would work again, other times I had to call them and they would change setting on their equipment. During the outage, i had called several times, some times being on hold for almost a hour, only to have them say that the were experiencing network issues and that it should be resolved shortly. I finally decided to cancel my contract when i received an email from them saying i was expiring in a month when i really had a full year of service left. I had to call them and wait 45 minutes before getting an agent. then going thought the hassle of arguing with them as to when i paid and that it was for 2 years and not 1 year. after being put on hold several times, they finally admitted the mistake. I had been contemplating canceling my home service for years as it's mostly robo calls. Well them trying to get me to pay in advance for a year was the straw that broke the camels back. i guess if you want a cheap unreliable service, these might be the guys for you. For me, they were a lot of headaches

cons: no manual to explain in detail.  No Rollover feature provided.
title: Price is good, and the calls come thru...
review:
Price is good, and the calls come thru OK...but the "Call Scenarios" are not explained well.
No detail provided, and no manual is provided, not even one you can download.
Terminology is confusing, mixing "phones" with "lines" and some other ambiguities.
Portal instructions seem to have been written by someone who does not understand the English language very well.

I'm trying to stick it out because of price, but may have to change back.

title: Nextiva has been a great phone service...
review: Nextiva has been a great phone service provider. We switched from a very robust expensive system to Nextiva. I wish we had switched earlier. Not only is Nextiva cheaper it is better! I have more control over the entire system, more options and features that were not available to me previously. I highly recommend Nextiva for any small or medium size business.

title: I was a RC customer for about 8 years...
review: I was a RC customer for about 8 years before coming to Nextiva. They are great at sales but the execution was terrible. It took 3 months to get numbers ported over after I was told they had been ported. I have had several multi-day outages. The wait times for support are over an hour. I've spent at least 30 hours in 3 months with support. The calls ques go down if you make any changes. Call analytics are terrible. I can't search for a number or download the call log as a .csv or any other searchable format. When I add features through sales I have to then call support to activate the features, am told they are activated and they are not, so the cycle continues. Level 2 support - if you can get your call escalated high enough - is generally good. However, do not take them up on the option of leaving your number for a call back - my experience is you never get a callback. Mine might be an isolated case, but the experience has been extremely frustrating. It's also a huge pain to port all the numbers a business has to another, so these VOIP companies know they have you almost hostage - and the service shows. I would have rated RC a 1 and I'll give Nextiva a 2.5. Are there any good providers out there?

cons: nothing works the way it should
title: Nextiva sounded like the perfect...
review:
Nextiva sounded like the perfect solution for our needs. The feature set was exactly what I was looking for. I was so excited.

Then my devices arrived, and from that day forward, I have been filled with regret as I count down the days to my contract expiration.

The platform was not ready for primetime. None of our devices were apportioned. My call flow builder broke so badly that technical support could not repair it; they had to recreate it from scratch. Nearly every time I go to update a recording in the call flow, the entire call flow breaks and I cannot bring my phones back online without calling support.

I have wasted untold hours of my workweek on too many occasions to count.

This was a terrible mistake. Don't make my mistake.

title: Easy to rollout and administer. It's...
review:
Easy to rollout and administer. It's just another tab in Zoom, really intuitive for staff to start using; required only minimal training - in many cases we only provided a Quick Start guide.

Leverages their high quality and reliable backbone. The service has experienced 100% up-time and 0 complaints of call quality or reliability.

Has all the features you would expect from a UC system, light on Call Center capabilities which are not needed at our firm.

title: We were with Voipo for 6 years and in...
review: We were with Voipo for 6 years and in fact just concluded our third 2 year contract. The only reason we changed service is because we do not wish any more long-term contracts. (Voipo requires signing up for 2 more years to get a good rate). However, although we changed providers, we thought their features were fantastic, the Vpanel was easy to use and the free international calling worked great. There were a few issues once in a while over the 6 years but the company was responsive in taking care of them. Bottom line - we were satisfied customers and would still be with them if we could have had the long-term rate on a month by month basis.

title: Ring Central is beyond terrible,...
review: Ring Central is beyond terrible, horrific and worthless. Their cusomter service department NEVER is available. They can NEVER fix any problems you have. They take WEEKS and WEEKS when something has gone wrong. I wouldnt recommend this company to your worst enemy. Find someone else to use. My text messages are coming back undelivered and they say they are waiting to hear from a technician but nothing has happened. Whats the point in paying for a service that DOESNT EXIST. Spread the word around in hopes we can get a better service or a better company.

pros: Multiple ways to connect to other users
title: We have been with Nextiva since 2017...
review:
We have been with Nextiva since 2017 and we love their phone system, applications and portals. All very user friendly! They provide excellent customer support in a very timely manner.

I would not hesitate to recommend Nextiva to anyone that wants immediate connectivity and multiple communication options to stay constantly connected to other users.

cons: I put up with the other end of the pendulum swing for nearly 10 years with my old service provider.
pros: Stunningly capable and customer aware team
title: I am one of the many new customers that...
review:
I am one of the many new customers that my Communications Consultant added to the Nextiva customer base in the last few weeks.

Expressing how well cared for and assisted I felt as a new customer would sound contrived. Not withstanding that risk I was astounded by how well cared for I felt and how well managed my transition as a new customer was handled. From the moment my Communications Consultant picked up my call to tell me about Nextiva to her careful step by step process of bringing me through the sign up and transition process I am both amazed and extraordinarily comfortable with Nextiva's onboarding process. All of the people in particular my Communication's Consultant and managing of the onboarding experience made the transition into the Nextiva customer family absolutely painless for me and my firm.

The Nextiva tech support personnel are every bit as good and, stunningly capable. The few times I have needed support during the transition, they were there in spades and to use a medical analog, their bedside manner for the ‘sick’ patient was exceptional.

Your user website user interface provides a surprisingly straight forward access to system controls. After ten+ years with 8x8 the Nextiva experience is breathtaking. Thank you for all your work on my behalf and thank you to all the extraordinary support folks I have had the good fortune of working with.

title: I run support for a medium sized...
review: I run support for a medium sized company and we have had three times as many issues with out internet/network than with our phones system. And when we did have an issue with phones Nextiva was very quick to help out. The representatives are always friendly on the phone and understanding. While the admin portal interface is not the easiest to interact with, the agents on the phone are more than willing to step in and help out if anything needs to be adjusted. My only ask would be to have a few more people running chat, although phone response is almost immediate, so chat is not a major concern.

title: Our company has one primary phone...
review: Our company has one primary phone number that goes to three separate locations (miles apart) and we are very pleased with Nextiva. We are able to have so many options and anytime we have an issue or want to make a change we call the Cust Support team and the items are handled. We really like the dashboard which has a lot of options and the owner likes the ability to see the number of calls and duration to each hunt group, extension, etc. The Cust Support is available 24/7 so it works with anyone's schedule. In our opinion the cost is reasonable, there are terrific features available and Customer Service has been excellent. We recommend Nextiva!

title: Jeremy from Vonage is truly the best...
review: Jeremy from Vonage is truly the best customer service worker I have ever met, and maybe in general, one of the most professional, hopeful, and patient professionals I have met in general. I am an office manager and needed a new phone system ASAP, as our old one blew out. I had never set up a phone system and was feeling overwhelmed. I reached out to a few VOIP providers, including Vonage, where I met Jeremy - and ultimately decided to go with Verizon VOIP, which was our current provider and gave us a great rate. However, after a few days on Verizon VOIP, we realized it was not going to work and didn't do what we needed. I emailed Jeremy, after I had already turned Vonage away, and asked if it was too late to switch over. Jeremy was so helpful this past week in helping me set up, configure, and get used to Vonage, and talked me through everything. Even if you are not great technically, Jeremy will make it easy for you to decide what you need, and how to use it. I asked the same questions multiple times, being forgetful, and he never made me feel bad. He is, long story short, amazing and I cannot recommend him, or Vonage enough.

cons: Bad user interface, non existent support, poor support
title: So many things wrong that when i found...
review:
So many things wrong that when i found the article saying customers rate it 4.9/5 i had to leave a review. I see others share my frustrations.

1. i worked with support to set up the main number and extensions, and they were not done correctly. When we discovered this and called support - i was "told that the thing that needed to be done wasnt done"

2. Im still with them - looking to change now - and when i go to use it on Windows 10 there is no sound. Mic or speakers. I call support. She tells me to uninstall - THERE IS NO WAY TO TROUBLESHOOT THE SOUND?

Its been uninstalling now for 10 minutes.

3. Agents do not call back when the call drops even though they have asked for the callback.

4. the live chat is non existent. wait 30+ minutes.

The sales agent was fine - the service and customer service are bad.

The user interface is bad.

Is anyone making a better product? how can this be rated highly?

cons: Dropped calls, dropped signal, bad phone connections
pros: Could be great resource if worked p
title: If it worked as it should, this would...
review: If it worked as it should, this would be a great app and resource for working remote. However, it is constantly dropping calls/signal, or there's a bad connection - hesitates, skips, can't hear the other person...constantly having to sign back in to see if connects better... so frustrating and makes it difficult to work well. It's not a good choice in the current way it is working. I would not recommend this at this time to anyone.

title: My company went out of business 12...
review:
My company went out of business 12 months into the contract - I called to cancel and was advise I needed to call 30 days before the contract expired. I was not aware the default for auto renewal is typical business practice with Vonage. The customer must elect out of this function.

I had to pay an eleven month early term fee to get out of the contract. They lowered my monthly price to offset the cost of early term fee - can we say shady business practice?

I was floored with the entire cancellation process. You are transferred from dept to dept, place on hold, told to call back if you do not have all your acct info, and no one can lookup your info by name of business.

Horrible company and unethical business practices.

BUYER BEWARE!!!!!!!!!

title: THE WORST COMPANY EVER.  THEY TRIED TO...
review:
THE WORST COMPANY EVER. THEY TRIED TO CHARGE ME OVER $12,000 IN FEES ALL AT ONE TIME....HERE'S WHAT HAPPENED----->

(Nextiva Lie #1) I talked with James Munday. He was the salesman who promised great customer service and support.

(Truth) the customer service was awful. My staff was on the phone for hours trying to work with their team. I myself spent over 2 hours just trying to cancel the service. It was near impossible to set tech support appointments to help us get onboarded.

(Nextiva Lie #2) He also promised that we had a 30 day out clause. Meaning after 30 days of using the Nextiva service we could cancel at any time. He promised me (I mean he lied to me) and explained that we'd be able to use the service for 30 days. This was very important because we are a medical facility and I needed to try the Nextiva phone service to ensure that it was functional and reliable for patient care. Well, their onboarding process was awful! It took them over 30 days and we were not even onboarded yet. The experience was so bad that I canceled the service. However, Katie (who was actually very nice) explained to me that her "leadership" told her my 30 days started from the moment on signed the agreement not the moment the phone service was up and running. She stated I'd have to pay over $12,000 to cancel the contract.

Essentially we are now going to be taking Nextiva to court and filling legal action against them. RUN RUN RUN AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY.

title: Terrible company that charges you for...
review: Terrible company that charges you for fictitious phone calls. Be very careful with them as they are dishonest and will charge your account without authorization. I am now dealing with the 3rd consecutive day concerning overages for phone numbers that never even called the phone number. They then further more lied stating I actually accepted these calls.

cons: Their UC simply does not work
title: If you value field communications, run...
review:
If you value field communications, run from this company and do not look back. They will lie to you as much as necessary to sell the product then leave you with absolutely NO support, and none of your issues will ever be fixed. Their UC is inherently flawed and their developers have no idea how to fix it. Their guy literally told me this himself, although I already knew this. I've been in the industry for 25 years and never seen such oversold trash.

We've tried to no end to work with them and get our dozens of issues resolved and they just give us the run around. In a nutshell, the desktop phones work fairly well, although calls are OFTEN dropped. The mobile and desktop apps are pointless and do not work on Android devices whatsoever. We've PROVEN this, although they will lie and tell you the opposite. The app works moderately on an Apple device but still has so many issues that my users just use their own cell service.

Nextiva needs to be sued. They are THE WORST.

title: Issues in transferring my home phone...
review:
Issues in transferring my home phone number for over a month now. Customer support is in India and they do not have enough knowledge and will not transfer to the porting team or anyone in US that can help.

Web site would show old carrier refused port out which was incorrect (found out after FCC complaint). Vonage is not requesting the port out properly. Now have requested FCC to assist in the transfer by reaching out to Vonage.

Does anyone know if there is a way to contact someone at Vonage in USA that can help?

title: Avaya is a terrible cloud based system....
review: Avaya is a terrible cloud based system. We are so unhappy and are stuck for now. My company has lost money using it. So frustrated with the inconsistency. Each day begins with new problems. Our clients can't reach us and no one in the Avaya company seems to be able to solve our daily problems for good. I would stay away.

title: In a busy work place a reliable phone...
review: In a busy work place a reliable phone system is a huge need. Sad to say, this system is the apocalypse of phones. Calls are dropped, people get stuck in a perpetual abyss and picking them up in the first place requires more work than technology should allow. Simple, reliable and dependable is not this system. Work orders put in fail to make it better. I have never in my 21 years of using phones have experienced a hell like this....Buyers be warned.

title: I signed up with Voipo in 2019.  In...
review: I signed up with Voipo in 2019. In early 2020 they had a lot of technical problems. However, my service was still functional for most of that time (unlike those who say they had no phone service for three months). Since then everything has been okay. They are very inexpensive, although they have warned that their rates must go up because of additional government fees. I don't regret signing up with them.

title: tried to cancel and they lied about the...
review:
tried to cancel and they lied about the term of the agreement. Mine ended in 2015, but they told me it was 2023 and wanted tens of thousands of dollars for a service I wasn't consuming.

For incoming and outgoing calls it worked well. The up-tieiring on price was too aggressive. If you want to use a queue, it costs much more. Seems like the gui got worse over the years.

title: Working with Fonality is a nightmare....
review:
Working with Fonality is a nightmare. I'll admit, there are very few outages with the system, but trying to handle any issues with them is almost impossible.

When you call in to get assistance, the agents sound as if you just woke them up from a nap, literally yawning into the phone, slow speech, lots of "ums" and "I thinks". I feel like the agents don't understand urgency or concerns in general. Their responses to your questions makes it sound like they're guessing the entire time.

Customer service aside, their system is outdated. The HUD needs Java 6 to run... and if you have any newer version it wont download. The admin dashboard looks and runs as if it hasn't been updated since 2005. Getting any kind of real, useful reporting is a pain and requires you to do a lot of the leg work through spreadsheets.

Overall, I would not recommend this company. They may have been a legitimate contender in the early days of the internet, but they need to update their system and educate their staff so they can actually answer customer questions.

title: I have been a customer for over 10 yrs....
review:
I have been a customer for over 10 yrs. Everyone connected to Viatalk has been wonderful to deal with. There is a 'glitch' once in a while, normally just rebooting the device works it out...otherwise a call to someone at Viatalk...and it is done in no time. The price is certainly right too...

I like the two lines coming in.

title: Hi there to all I use flowroute to...
review:
Hi there to all
I use flowroute to send some of our text messages, unfortunately, we lost 3 clients already this year because of the SPAM filter, to flag all genuine and legitimate messages as spam, is the reason that our company searching to find another provider
On the other hand, prices are so expensive and they sub charge messages that not going you get the picture
