title: Support is great along with price but...
review: Support is great along with price but the phone app works when it want to and the home phone is the same way. I have call support about once a week because one or the other not working. Who would think that a minimum 300 characters need to right a review. This service really suck. I am going to find another company for my phone service.

title: I was struggling to find a solution...
review:
I was struggling to find a solution according to my specific needs even though the website interface is pretty easy to gauge. I called the Support line and got connected with Robert N and he was able to understand what I wanted and how it could be delivered. He stayed on the call with me and made sure that changes were made according to my requirements.

The best thing about Nextiva is Customer Support.

title: RUN FAR AND FAST... DO NOT make my...
review:
RUN FAR AND FAST...
DO NOT make my mistake.
Since 2019 I have had over charges to my credit card during initial set up, reported more than 20 service outages, some taking up to a month of constant complaining to resolve. Hours of my time wasted going back and forth between my ISP and Voipo.
7/9/2021 I am once again without reliable service.
My longest span of time has been 133 days of working "service" the rest of my complaint tickets to Voipo are 1 - 3 months apart, some of those taking up to a month, of back and forth to resolve.
This company has offered NO compensation for what has accumulated to months without service, not to mention the added cost, of relying on a prepaid cellphone, when service fails.
This Company has been not only unreliable, but Fraudulent.
At this time I am collecting all of my outage data to calculate exactly how many days of service I have been robed. This information is going to be forwarded to my Attorney Generals office to register a formal complaint.
Voipo has taken several years of advanced payments, for a phone "service" that at its best has been spotty.

title: Made decision to switch to OOMA. Began...
review: Made decision to switch to OOMA. Began in early June 2021 - still in process month later, refusing to port. Customer service has been lacking - on emails - any point you require management escalation contact X. Did that only to have management say "Why me?" Still in process - can't wait to be free.

title: Buyer beware. Be careful of the...
review: Buyer beware. Be careful of the contract. When your service doesn't work, you will be hit HARD. If you don't have time for trouble-shooting, don't purchase. If you don't jump through the appropriate hoops and need to cancel due to lack of service, you will pay a HUGE fee. I as a business owner cannot take the risk of phones not working. This should be effortless but they want LOTS of your effort. This company is running a scam. If they stood behind their product, they wouldn't feel threatened by people leaving - they wouldn't need early termination fees.

cons: Unreliable phone service and Unreliable Customer and technical  serivce. No cost savings when everything is applied
title: Unable to contact technical or customer...
review: Unable to contact technical or customer service after hours, holidays or weekends. Only method is by email. No live chat either. Contracts are ambiguous and they will charge you for things you already paid for or don't have. I was left once without phone service as they set up the phone incorrectly the first time. Then I switched modem which should not cause a problem and was without service. Very frustrating. Takes a long time for the call to connect.

title: Do not use this service.  They will rip...
review: Do not use this service. They will rip you off. When I set up my account they gave me a recycled number that must have just been closed that day. I received about 20 calls and voice mails from people looking for the old company that had the number before. Over 50 the first month. But what made it so bad was they charged me for them. There is no one to talk to and when you email them they just kept repeating that it was because of overages from the VM. They would not even acknowledge my emails saying that none of the VM were mine. (I would repeat this in emails over and over again.)

title: Confirmed Nextiva would integrate with...
review: Confirmed Nextiva would integrate with out software and it was the reason we chose to Nextiva as it is the most important feature for us. We were crystal clear of this requirement but after being told repeatedly it will work with our software, it does not. Cancelled in four days and they still have not given a refund in almost a month. After I said I would dispute the charge, they said they would try to make an exception but they do not give refund. Note, there policies clearly state a refund. Our sales person was super responsive up until I let him know Nextiva did not work with our software then he wouldn't respond. super unprofessional. Nextiva really seems like a scam.

title: RingCentral is a complete scam. They...
review: RingCentral is a complete scam. They promise you the world, but fall through on almost all their promises. The worst part would be there customer service. There is no communication between the various support groups and you end up being on the phone for hours with no solutions to your problems. I tried out RingCentral earlier this year, and after more than three months of complications and trying to set up our system, I decided to cancel because they couldn't follow through on any of their promises when we initially signed the contract. After I confirmed that I wanted to cancel, they have now stopped responding to all my emails and calls. The most unprofessional service. Our company issued a stop payment because they are still continuously trying to charge us when we were never able to use their service to begin with!! I would 100% NEVER recommend RingCentral.

title: From the first interaction with...
review: From the first interaction with Dialpad, I was promised amazing features and operations. We had 3 experience sessions, in person and over video calls. I was promised SMS and Mobile DID and so much more. It was only AFTER I signed the contract did Dialpad start to backtrack on ALL their promises and told me that actually NONE of the key items are available and can not be delivered. WORST experience ever!!

title: Terrible customer service and user...
review:
Terrible customer service and user interface that looks like its from 1992. All i want is some phones, we had an old Mitel system that stopped working so we got a new one, and I wish I'd gone with someone else.
They've been sending the invoices to a random employee at our company instead of our accounts payable, so the bills didn't get paid so they shut our phones down during a business day. It took us half the day to get in contact with someone to find out why. Then we paid the bill and got it turned back on so we could continue operating as a business. They promise they've fixed the billing. Next month, i get an email forwarded from that employee again, they're still sending it to the wrong person. I have to call and wait an hour to speak with a person who assures me they've updated it . . . again. I ask them to send me the invoice so i can prove it so they don't cut off our phones again, and they are unable to do that. Here's to hoping they got it right. I have no idea why a company would make it so difficult to collect money. Worse customer service than Charter and AT&T combined.

title: I've been using Panterra Networks for...
review: I've been using Panterra Networks for 6 months when my school went remote. I only work off of the mobile app on my cell phone and it has been a lifesaver! I have had no problems as of yet and am completely satisfied with their communication and service. Being able to work from my cell phone, anywhere I'm and not be confined to a laptop has been a game changer for me. Highly recommend!

title: easy customer service to make changes!...
review: easy customer service to make changes! the chat agent got right in and asked the right questions and changed my forwarding information with ease. i never had to call and wait to even speak to anyone to get done what was needed. i haven't had any negative experiences with nextiva and its been at least 6 months now!

title: The worst company ever, if you get into...
review:
The worst company ever, if you get into a contract with them, be aware, you are giving up your soul, and it's extremely complicated to cancel. their whole system is made to suck as much money they can from you.

the first time I wanted to cancel, they told me I have to pay because I was bound by contract, so it would be easier If I just let the contract finish... which I did. but here is the thing... I don't use the service anymore, however... as soon as the contract finished... IT AUTO RENEW and bond me again with another year under contract, and now I have to pay a ridiculous amount to cancel this... agreeing to pay to cancel, they still are going to contact me to tell me how much do I have to pay.... it is a joke! be aware!

pros: We are loving the call forwardingg
title: I had an issue with my new number, but...
review: I had an issue with my new number, but when I notified Voiply they resolved it within moments. I am loving the call forwarding and the voice message/email transcribe features. The price is better than many other services as well. The setup online was easy, the equipment arrived in a timely manner, and was easy to install. Win/win.

title: I have been a customer for over 10...
review: I have been a customer for over 10 years. For the past 6 months, I answer the phone and it is blank, nothing. I hang up and call the other person back and they say they can hear me, but I couldn't hear them. Then, when talking to them, there is an echo and about a 1 second delay. Via Talk Support Manager, Tanya Runyon, tells me 1 second is normal. My telecom friends tell me that is enough time to travel around the globe and is not at all acceptable. I have been submitting tickets for over 6 months. They give me a list of tasks to complete. Thus far, we have put the router in DMZ, I have replaced cables, purchased a new phone, run internet speed test etc.. etc.. and then they clear the ticket without resolving the matter. I resubmit and they want to see all the same stuff. The only thing they haven't done is replace the telephone adapter (TA).. I have requested they do so multiple times, but NO offer to send a new one. The one I have is over 6 years old.... maybe, just maybe it is outdated. You would think that would be taken into consideration. When I requested some credit now that everyone calls me on my cell phone, they offered $10.... Are you kidding me? I have spent over 40 hours messing around with their requests... STAY AWAY.... They are simply milking a dead business using outdated equipment.

title: This company was fantastic. They...
review: This company was fantastic. They provide excellent service, and their prices are reasonable as well. They are efficient and professional and care about their customers. Both the technology and customer service were fantastic. They are great leaders and role models for others to keep the business going strong.

title: Pedro is an amazing employee. He helped...
review: Pedro is an amazing employee. He helped me understand the entire phone system we have with Nextiva. He also helped me painlessly set up an auto attendant and a new hold line. He is an excellent teacher and I now feel 100x better about understanding my phones. This last sentence is to fill up the required character number.

title: We've been using VoIP now for about...
review: We've been using VoIP now for about two years for my father's real estate office. I knew everything about VoIP before and explained everything, and they helped me save money on telecommunications. We had no issues or problems with this company. Their technicians have been very informative and responsive.

cons: They will stick you with the annual contract
title: Very frustrated with 8x8.  They did not...
review: Very frustrated with 8x8. They did not send me out any reminders about my annual subscription renewing. I called within a couple weeks of it renewing to cancel and they said I was stuck paying the entire year. No compromise at all. They never sent me an email, never called, not pop-up warning in the app or online. Nothing. Stay away from 8x8!! They only care about themselves and not the customers.

title: I couldn't be happier with VoIPo and...
review: I couldn't be happier with VoIPo and the whole team for a job well done. They have among the best customer care that I have ever experienced. Their phone system has helped me manage my work phone calls from my calls. Not only has every transaction/interaction been positive, but the actual service is delightful. They deserve my highest recommendation.

It took over a month before I could try and send out a message, because I could not find a number and there was no one to speak with. title: We had two separate issues for Nextiva...
review:
We had two separate issues for Nextiva to figure out when our phones weren't working correctly, so this review is for two different employees who gave me the same solid service that can apply to both.

It all started when my manager at a store said the calls were going straight to VM without the phone ringing. I gave her the support number and any other credentials she would need to make the call. Unfortunately, she was not on the approved list for my company to troubleshoot problems. This is a FCC rule that I understand but don't agree with as it takes time out of my working day. This is not a fault of Nextiva.

The first tech I reached was named Robert. He was very pleasant to speak with, had a decent demeanor and was very patient in understanding the issue. He quickly located the problem in our VOIP system and had it fixed very quickly. Then he looked for the same problem with any other of our lines in the system. That's a good worker in my opinion as he just doesn't want to be done with me after we fix the original problem, but has the patience to look for other problems. We also learned from Robert about Shared Call Appearance on their system. I learned quite a lot in the short time talking with Robert.

Right after I hung up the phone, my boss called me and wanted me to forward a line to my phone since she was going to be out in the field for the day. She told me how to forward the number, but I wasn't sure I was doing it correctly so I called the tech support again. This time, I spoke with another capable and friendly member of Nextiva, named Joel.

Joel showed me where to make the changes and also helped me fix my mistakes when I tried to setup the forward. He was very patient and spoke on a level which I could understand. He explained to me in great detail on how the forwarding works with Users/Auto Attendants/Groups. It was very complicated but very clear when we spoke. He then checked to make sure everything was working, once again not rushing me off the phone.

Overall, my experience with their tech support was great! I'm not sure how the issues started, but sometime mistakes can happen. I'm just glad that I was able to reach effective communicators and troubleshooters for the issues I was having today. Nextiva gets a gold star for outstanding tech support!

title: Our company was experiencing a problem...
review: Our company was experiencing a problem with (2) of our Panasonic phones in that we could not send/receive calls and our data did not populate. Once my phone was fixed, they were able to fix second phone as well. Very helpful, very professional, great support!

title: I love Voiply. I now have it on both my...
review: I love Voiply. I now have it on both my phone lines and you can't beat the pricing. I switched from a large telecom to another VOIP and landed on Voiply and couldn't be happier! I have now recommended them to my extended family, who will soon be making the switch as well. Thanks for all the savings and great service!

title: The absolute worst phone service I have...
review: The absolute worst phone service I have encounter and all I have is regret for ever giving them my business. Constant problems with the app, so if you plan to use any smart devices, you may as well forget about it. Then when you call to try to resolve issues, you are referred to online chat. Cannot say enough about what a slap in the face this is, completely horrendous to get things resolved. In fact, they often do not, gave business I never should have. I highly suggest staying as far away from Vonage as possible.

title: Signed up for a "free" trial period....
review: Signed up for a "free" trial period. I was advised that my credit card info was only being used for collateral in case I didn't send the test phones back to them. BIG MISTAKE! I cancelled the trial because Sales and their tech support were on completely different planets. First issue, they told me to purchase something then had no idea how to get it working with their system once it was purchased. Using excuses like "We just provide dial tone, we don't do this." Ok, maybe you shouldn't tell the customer to spend $500 on a product you have no experience with. One of their technician's expert opinions was to factory reset our firewall during production. I cancelled the trial, got forwarded to billing who would close the account. This was two weeks ago. I get a charge this morning for almost $500. Billing was unable to immediately tell me what the charge was for. After about two hours on hold (to get their stories straight I imagine) they tell me it was for licenses purchased during the trial period. Hmm, apparently I am being charged for a "Free" trial. They said the billing person requested a refund for this two weeks ago. So they submitted a refund request for purchases apparently made during a "free trial" period. I was charged this morning for this. So now, they have charged me two weeks after they closed my account and now want me to wait 30 days for a refund. So they literally just stole about $500 for a month. When asked why billing charged me for something this morning that I cancelled two weeks ago. Now they are pointing fingers back at sales saying they didn't set up the account correctly. No one takes any accountability at this company as can be seen clearly. Please! Save yourself a terrible experience and steer clear from these guys. I thought I was done with headache weeks ago only to resurface in the form of a bill which only can be construed as spite for not signing up.

cons: Support is horrific, and offered services list is very basic
title: Have had TDS managedIP phone service...
review:
Have had TDS managedIP phone service for more than 6 years and would never recommend their service to anyone. If TDS is all you have access to, I suggest you get two cans and a string and your service will be better. After the install is done and the account teams gets paid, do not expect to hear back from them...ever. Our experience has been that if you call because your service is down or degraded, they will refer to you as; and I quote, "a pain in the ???." Their support representatives are rude and offensive every time we have called.
As for the service, They oversubscribed their network and do not apply quality of service to the voice so when the network is slow, you may not even be able to make or take a call...and they don't care. Our service is so bad with TDS that we are paying out the last of our contract to move to a new service.
Regarding features, even though they are using IP phones, they restrict where the phones can register from so that you can't take a phone home to work without paying extra fees for mobile services. They charge significantly extra if you want to use your cell phone with the phone system, and even more if you want the ability to get to your voicemail from anywhere other than the phone itself. All of these are basis features includes in almost every competitor out there. Avoid TDS hosted/managedIP voice at all cost.

title: Read this before signing a contract...
review:
Read this before signing a contract with Nextiva!

Be sure to read the fine print and be warned – I do not recommend signing a contract with Nextiva! As a small business owner, I would highly recommend sourcing another digital phone provider that delivers reliable phone service, easy to reach tech support, plan flexibility, competitive pricing and most importantly, the option to cancel if the service does not function properly or meet your current business needs.

Almost immediately after switching to Nextiva, we regretted our decision. When originally comparing phone providers, we now realize our first warning sign should have been Nextiva’s sales department pressuring us into a 3-year contract by offering a date sensitive promo on monthly rates.

When we first began using Nextiva, all our locations had significant issues with call quality. Our team had trouble logging into Nextiva’s online platform and the call audio was so poor that we couldn’t hear many customers through all of the static. Daily calls to Nextiva service were often needed for multiple team members at multiple locations. Beyond customers lost and team hours wasted, even calling Nextiva’s tech support was made more difficult since anyone calling tech support was required by Nextiva to be an account admin.

Key members of our leadership team have been constantly burdened with Nextiva service issues and have spent countless hours attempting to troubleshoot Nextiva’s problematic platform on their own since calling and emailing support seldom yielded any resolution. In addition to countless leadership hours wasted on internal troubleshooting, our company has initiated hundreds of support requests over our first 2 years of service with Nextiva. Nextiva’s service never improved for us during these years, so we have no hope that it will improve anytime soon.

During the COVID pandemic when our locations were closed for several months, including some which never reopened, Nextiva would not offer any assistance by pausing monthly fees or even reducing the number of lines in our contract. We were forced to pay for services that could not be used during an unbelievably difficult time for small businesses. Except for Nextiva, all our other service vendors were flexible.

Nextiva has been a constant source of frustration for our team, and we feel this has very likely contributed to employee burn out. I personally experienced many of the same call quality issues and stopped using the platform because it was so infuriating. Poor call quality has also likely contributed to irreparable damage to our brand as customer calls are so frequently dropped or missed due to Nextiva’s problematic online platform and phone app.

To summarize: we are locked into a 3-year Nextiva service contract with no apparent accountability from Nextiva in terms of service and call quality. We are still 1 year from being free of Nextiva, yet all 3 years have been a complete waste of money and team resources. YEAR 1: consistently terrible call quality and tech support. YEAR 2: multiple lines could not be used for most of the year due to COVID, then Nextiva’s phone service was even more problematic with our remaining team members working from home to keep our business alive with a heavy dependence on the phone. YEAR 3 is just beginning and we can’t move away from Nextiva fast enough, yet we are being forced to pay out for the last year due to an unfair contract that has no remedy for Nextiva service not functioning properly. Please don’t make the same mistake we did and get trapped by Nextiva!

title: I use Dialpad as my work number. I use...
review: I use Dialpad as my work number. I use it for texting and calling, and to record my calls. I never have audio issues with it. It's reliable, though occasionally the recording function doesn't work. I also with I had an option in settings to toggle the "this call is now being recorded" message on and off.

title: An absolutely amazing and easy to use...
review:
An absolutely amazing and easy to use app. Conveniently have an office line with voicemail that has transcription services and the ability to text clients and coworkers has never been easier. Plus you can use it from your phone, computer, or tablet. Keeping track of clients has never been easier through their contacts and call tracking!

Customer service is top notch too! Our representative reaches out often to tell us about any upgrades and to ask if we have had any issues or are looking for any additional as they want to improve their company based on client feedback.

title: We've been Dialpad customers for 4...
review:
We've been Dialpad customers for 4 years, and have grown from 2 users to over 30.

Dialpad is extremely easy to use, set up and administer, and this is a strength again other providers on the market. As we've grown, we've run into growing pains with reliability and cost. We consistently have team members complain that calls drop, or when a call is answered, their audio is not clear to the caller.

From a cost stand point, we have many different departments that require their own 'Office'. In Dialpad, an Office allows you to assign a group of users who can receive calls to that office based on a round robin, waterfall or simultaneous calling pattern, among other features like IVR.

Dialpad's standard plan for $25/month only gives 5 offices, which is not enough for us. Even if we upgrade to the next plan for $35/month, we only get 10 offices, which is still not enough.

Furthermore, many of our users infrequently need access to Dialpad - they might make 2-3 calls a month, or need to be assigned to an office as a 'last resort' if other team members are not available.

This makes pricing hard to justify if half your users fall into this category, especially if you need more than 5 offices and have to upgrade plans.

Dialpad office no form of pricing for 'light' users.

Because of all the above, we have decided to move over to Zoom phone. Their app isn't as 'pretty' and 'usable' is Dialpad, but they provide more robust features at a lower price point, and have 'light' users. Zoom phone is around $10/user, and they offer more feature that comparably priced Dialpad plans. To get access to these Zoom phone features, you'd need to be on the $125/user Dialpad call centre plan.

All and all, I would highly recommend Dialpad if you're a team that wants an VOIP app which is easy to use, easy to administer, and if all your team members will use Dialpad frequently.

If you're looking for a cheaper, more flexible and feature robust platform, it would pay to evaluate alternatives on the market as well.

title: Dialpad has good all-around features...
review: Dialpad has good all-around features and convenient integration with Salesforce. So far, the program has increased our connection with our clientel (university students) with the texting feature. Recently though, there have been some crashing/freezing with limited support response from Dialpad. Hoping to resolve our issue soon as we are still big fans of the program.

cons: Lack of Support, Lack of Tech Support Knowledge, Lack of Communication between Tech Support and Sales, Seriously Deficient Response Time (measured in weeks), Lack of Reliability of Service, Lack of Consistent Functioning of Web Portal, and more.
pros: Call Flows, if you can figure them out and get them to work correctly.
title: Nextiva was a grave disappointment.  It...
review:
Nextiva was a grave disappointment. It took three weeks for them to even set up my service to work correctly, and I was billed for all three weeks, even though I did not have a functioning product yet.

Once I had a functioning product, it was unreliable. Sometimes it would ring through, and sometimes it wouldn't, and I would never know when it was working and when it wasn't. Nextiva support blamed it on the app, but offered no solution.

Their "call flows" actually work pretty well, but they're a beast to figure out (I'm a former web designer by trade, built my own computers, and worked tech support for HP, so I'm by no means lacking in technical savvy). However, editing call flows in their portal sometimes take and sometimes don't, and when they don't take, you aren't notified that something was wrong. It just doesn't work. Once you realize that a call flow didn't take, you can't go back and edit the call flow. You have to completely delete it, and rebuild it from the ground up.

There are also limitations within the call flow that aren't explained in the documentation (that I found), and the call flow won't work correctly if you exceed those limitations. However, there is no warning or message that tells you that the call flow is set up incorrectly. You just have to find out that it doesn't work by hard testing the call flow with an actual call from an outside phone.

They also have the ubiquitous "higher than normal call volume" excuse on their support line and their online chat. It's not "higher than normal" if it's the same amount of call volume everyday. It's called "we're too cheap to staff enough people to adequately support the demand for our product".

I give Nextiva a flat out "F". If they had reliable service, a properly working portal, a properly working app, and decent support, I'd give them a "B". Sigh.

title: My formal complaint is twofold.  We...
review:
My formal complaint is twofold. We have a fairly comprehensive Call Flow using professional voiceovers and music. The Nextiva Voiceover service has no idea of how a call flow works and can give you no advice. Plus, they intentionally mislead you by only giving you working samples of voices with no music. Then, if you want to add music then add another sneaky fee to do that. Shame on them for not being upfront and honest. To me this is very unethical.

It was much cheaper to hire my own voiceover talent and recording studio to accomplish this goal. However, their support team told me that the Nextiva system would automatically provide a call by name directory. So, I did not pay to have that recorded.

Now, after all of my studio time and voiceover talent have completed their jobs, I am being told by Nextiva that they do not provide that dial by name directory. To resolve this I have to rehire my talent to record the message and that which means another studio rental.

If the Nextiva Support Team were properly trained they would have saved me another $200 in additional cost. Plus, they are now delaying us from launching their system until I can get the new recording.

Bottom line is that I am really irritated. This could so easily have been resolved.

One more complaint. Their system information about the telephone instruments from Polycom is non existing and they do not even provide you with referral services. A company, as large as they are, should be much more professional and provide this type of information.

We called to talk to support, they would not speak with us - our plan (which we paid for a year) was not high enough to warrant support. Which was really rough since they ported our number and then refused to talk to us about getting setup. Talked to a random sales person, who helped, but we spent days setting up what took me 30 minutes to setup with Gotoconnect. The phone features are seriously lacking compared to Jive. Call quality seems fine, meeting software is good, so it's not all terrible, but the transition was rough, and they make you feel second class.

I'm supremely disappointed - I had a good opinion of Zoom, but that's shot. My recommendation is DO NOT pay for a year up front to get a discount. If I had not paid for a year, I would have fired them today.

title: We selected them to replace our aging...
review: We selected them to replace our aging phone system for our medical clinic. We set our our needs and expectations from the beginning that we needed phone trees and queuing of calls and ways to monitor the queues and were assured that was all possible for a reasonable cost. This was sent in a written format as well. But However when we started setting up the service the technical team let us know that they intended to set us up as a call center and the requirements that we had were not included in the plan or the cost and it would cost us considerably more to get what we needed. after going back and forth trying to get the system we need for the cost we had been quoted and not getting calls returned for a few months, and by the way being charged for a service we were not using, we backed out. It took them 8 weeks to send shipping labels to return the 30 phones and in the end they called after business hours, after our clinic manager had been on the phone daily trying talk to thier management, to let us know that they refused to refund the cost of the phones which were supposed to be no cost.

title: We've been using for 3 years and I'm...
review:

We have three branch offices and the requirements for each is unique yet they integrate perfectly as a whole. Many tools for Management & Monitoring online and user consoles for PC managed softphones. Smartphones and Tablet applications are integrated as well as Exchange-Outlook voice recognition and wav file attachments. ( I would like to see better directory management on the polycom phones but I think that is a function of polycom api not Nextiva) We also have 2way warehouse paging systems support.
It is clear to me that Nextiva is obsessed with quality support and can usually get the answer I need on the first call. Everyone seems to have a highly consistent level of knowledge which is exceptional considering the complexity of configurations in a modern office environment. I would highly recommend Nextiva for enterprise IP-Phone solutions.

title: Dialpad has been an essential tool for...
review:

The audio quality is great, it's only limited by the quality of the phone at the other end, and the recordings are just as great.

Additionally, the delay from long-distance calls is minimal. It's very easy to have calls from the US to New Zealand with minimal lag.

title: Run like the wind! Once you are signed...

cons: Residential service is thin on features
title: 1-VoIP residential provides top notch...
review:
1-VoIP residential provides top notch voice quality and customer support at a great price. They don't offer a lot of features, but it does everything I need and they have a similar, more full-featured business service. They offer a free network box and don't require a contract commitment.

I tried them out by forwarding my AT&T landline to a 1-VoIP number on my home PBX, to test the Nomorobo spam blocking. It blocked about half the spam calls. After a month, I ported my number over. There were a couple of glitches, but I always got a support person on the phone and a quick response by email, and everything got resolved quickly.

title: When you get this service you can talk...
review: When you get this service you can talk to a live person. When you get the service you literally only can talk to a bot. This company wants you to open a case and someone will call you back. It is very difficult to understand the call back from the heavy accent. It's frustrating when you really need your problem fixed. We had lots of dropped calls and issues. We chose to go to another service. That was January 27th we put our request in through the bot making a case. Then they emailed back and we emailed back to say "yes please cancel". Please remember our numbers were ported out and we were no longer using 8 x 8. It is now 3/16 and we get a notice saying that our payment did not go through. So, I just got off the phone with one of their representatives. She stated well you did not respond to give us your passcode so we could not cancel your account. Now please remember this is after we have requested our account to be closed twice already. Then she said, "well we called your office and no response". We have three offices and what kind of company does not get the contact information of their CEO's. They will not refund us the months that we were not using their service and they would like us to start a whole new cancel case. Please remember they will make it difficult to cancel. So the worst service and the worst customer service as it's nonexistent besides the computer bot.

title: I had Axvoice for 5 months. At the...
review:
I had Axvoice for 5 months. At the beginning of month 6 outbound calls started failing. Nothing changed on my network or configuration. I even tried the device on another network with a different router and internet provider. Still broken. So, like everyone else who has reviewed them, I tried to find the "Live Chat" on the web site. There is none. I tried to find a customer service number (or any phone number) for them. There is none. So I emailed them. One day later I get a reply: "reboot your device". I replied "Already did that" Two days latere another reply: "we reconfigured your device, reboot your router". I do that, nothing is fixed. I reply. Two days later, another lame suggestion "reconfigure your router" ??? it was working before and my router hasn't changed!!! I make a couple suggested router changes. Same problem. It is now three days with no more email replies.
Buyer beware. This service is okay when it works but if anything breaks, you are on your own. They will not help you, and they will not refund your money. For me it was just *slightly* better than a total scam.... but not much.

review:

I particularly like being able to forward my business calls to my cell phone when I am away from my desk along with the ability to take my laptop with me anywhere and being able to receive or make calls to/from my dedicated business phone number. This way I never miss a beat. Dialpad's customer support department is superior and all of this is included in a very low monthly rate. I would highly recommend.

title: I have been a dialpad user for over a...
review:
I have been a dialpad user for over a year.

I have recommended and installed this as multiple customers as they were not getting a fraction of these features for a higher price

Really like the product and the support behind it. Even when i have has small issues with the setup, the support team has resolved those issue in real time within a few minutes

Very Happy

title: I have used Dialpad for over 2 years...
review: I have used Dialpad for over 2 years now and really enjoy it. It is the system we use in our office. When the pandemic hit and our office closed and we all had to work from home it was very easy for me to upload the app to my mobile phone and take all my calls from anywhere. I even receive text messages using this service which is really great. I also like that I can choose to take the call on my mobile device using HD or Carrier service which helps when my carrier service is spotty.

cons: I was unable to tell if the call was coming to my  personal or work number. Found a workaround but can't tell who is calling m e
pros: great price, you actually get two lines for the price of one,, , easy to reach a person or support
title: They have pretty good service. The...
review: They have pretty good service. The calls are typically clear and I like that they can piggyback off my carrier when there isn't Wi-Fi available. It's not impossible to reach an actual living person when you need help, which is nice too. My only real complaint is that I was not able to differentiate between when calls were coming to my personal number and when they were coming in to the dialpad number. I spoke with tech support and was able to set it up so that it looks like the calls to dialpad # are coming from my dialpad #. So, at least I know which greeting to use when answering the phone, although the downside is that I am unable to see the number of the person who is actually making the call until after the call ends - and then I can do so by looking at my recent call log. It would be nice if they could fix it to where you see a dialpad logo with calls to dialpad, or maybe change the ringtone or display or something.

title: DialPad was easy to set up and is easy...
review: DialPad was easy to set up and is easy to use! There have been a few issuse with connecting to calls and not the best connection but the customer service has been excellent. The chat feature is a great addition to the service. I like being able to block spam and robo calls. Would definitely recommend to other business owners.

title: Integration with other apps is easy. I...
review: Integration with other apps is easy. I LOVE that I can see all my customer information and history on one screen whether it be talk, text or email. The transcribed voice mail is second to none. I tried three other VoiP products before settling on DialPad. I have been a user for a little over a year. They are always adding features and improving. I do wish for an "unresponded" to featured for voicemails, like unread for emails.

title: I have been using Dial paid from way...
review:
I have been using Dial paid from way back about 6 years and i have enjoyed it, a lot of updates and upgrades and its juts getting better, simple but got a lot of functions .

I say : go for it" very easy to use but meet all your needs in this time and age .

I hardly got problems with it and I cant even rem, when ever there is a glitch, I assure you there will be an update soon

pros: Internet based, user friendly mobile app, the ability to create a phone book for future reference
title: Overall this is a great platform for...
review: Overall this is a great platform for small or large-scale businesses. Loved being able to answer phone calls from my cell phone and still have most of the features available on the desktop version. A+ review. Highly recommended. I would ask that in the future they offer more integrations with other software platforms.

title: I have used RingCentral, Nextiva and...
review:
I have used RingCentral, Nextiva and Dialpad, and ONLY Dialpad offers 'ring through' or use of the cell phone network to work around spotty data when using my cell phone out of office.

Dialpad is simpler than the rest when it comes to setting up and managing departments, routing, voicemails, etc. I have a restaurant with multiple sites, we run our main office with 3 employees with Dialpad and have learned we don't need to be chained to our desks.

title: I'm very please to use DialPad for the...
review:
I'm very please to use DialPad for the 2020 year especially in this difficult year.

Dial Pad is very simple and easy to use. The voice and quality that I get in my calls are outstanding and it makes my work much easy.

I like very much the option that I get of voice mail dictation.

Texting to other callers, cellphones and more.

Every day is great to use DialPad.

cons: Would love to have a notes section for contacts.
pros: Easy to use. Nice iPhone app.
title: I have been using DialPad in my...
review: I have been using DialPad in my business for roughly 2 years and am very pleased with the product and overall feature set. I use it on my laptop, iPad and iPhone and it works effortless and seamlessly. We haven't had any issues with receiving/placing calls, call quality or texting. I highly recommend DialPad to anyone looking for an easy to use, yet powerful, option for their business.

title: Overall, it's a good product and very...
review: Overall, it's a good product and very helpful for work. It has moments where it crashes and requires me to sign completely out and get back into the program to refresh it. Very helpful, but inconsistent. It has a lot of features that help out with the job, but calls randomly getting discreetly dropped and audio not always coming through holds it back.

title: We have been using Dialpad for our team...
review:
We have been using Dialpad for our team for almost 2 years. I can't say enough about the service. The quality is great, it's reliable and user-friendly.
Our marketing team is located all over the US. Adding new users to the Dialpad softphone is a simple process and never an issue. If I have any kind of problem with anything to do with the install, service, or billing, their support team is amazing and always quick to respond. We have used many VOIP providers and I have to say that Dialpad is top on my list.

title: What a rip-off! I can't believe how...
review: What a rip-off! I can't believe how this company treats its customers. I was with them for about a year using several different numbers. I had to call in about once a week for technical support because something wasn't working right. I finally found a company to switch to that I tested and worked with 0 issues and I started the port process and then canceled the account before the billing cycle renewed. They sent me a bill for the following month and to this day say I still owe them money. It doesn't matter I constantly had problems, it doesn't matter their service didn't work well or the apps. I still owe them money for not using their service. I would not use them again if someone paid me to do so. Horrible!

title: Dialpad has worked wonders here in the...
review: Dialpad has worked wonders here in the agency. I recommend it for business processes, national calls, and general phone uses. The mobile platform works well, no complaints. The Desktop platform works well too, use it everyday dialing non-stop. Very satisfied with the service and operating platform.

cons: Conference quality can decrease for larger groupsps
pros: Excellent feature set that is updatedted
title: I've used dialpad for ~1 year. It's...
review: I've used dialpad for ~1 year. It's an excellent full-service phone system that is very easy to set up & use AND is upgraded regularly with enhancements AND new features. It easily integrates with iPhones, texting, laptop-based calls, caller ID, Gmail ... The voice call transcription capability for voicemail messages and live calls is GREAT! It recommends when to let the other caller talk AND identifies possible issues & advice/solutions based on what's said during the call. The messaging system is also GREAT with the ability to add groups, receive & respond to text messages, & search conversations for keywords, specific people & potential issues based on content. The only drawback is occasional call quality issues during larger group conference calls (10+).

pros: Easy to use on my laptop and with a headset.
title: To be honest, I love Dialpad. Working...
review:
To be honest, I love Dialpad. Working remote from home I no longer have a phoneline and just use the headset. The UI is easy set up, send to voicemail, do not disturb and I can even send/receive text messages too. When I'm travelling, I just pack up my laptop and headset and my office is ready in 30secs from a hotel room.

The transcripts for Voicemail could be tightened but otherwise, an email comes through and gives me all I need to know. I don't need any other service for my phone when it comes to work!

cons: Updates could change few things, No automated voicemail feature
title: I would say that Dialpad has been my go...
review: I would say that Dialpad has been my go to when I need to make VOIP calls. I use it for work everyday. I've done trails with other providers but this one feels better. The interface and the way it's setup makes my day easier with a lot more calls done. Only small gripe that I have is that it doesn't have an automated feature in which a clients voicemail can be answered with a pre-recorded message by just hitting a button. I think Dialpad is great overall and I'm happy I gave it a shot.

title: Been using Dialpad for about 2 years....
review: Been using Dialpad for about 2 years. It works great for what I need it for. Incoming calls, outgoing calls and international calls. I've enjoyed using it so far with no issues to date. I am not part of the IT team so I cannot comment on the support, purchase price or installation. But I would recommend to any of the end user base :)

title: Really fits the needs of our business....
review: Really fits the needs of our business. The app works well, we utilize the texting feature which really simplifies things for us. Call quality is probably an A-/B+ works well the majority of the time. Sometimes our clients report they cannot hear us. We have not found a solution other than to disconnect and call again.

cons: some features have a learning curve, but once
pros: Super easy to use and all in one provider
title: Dialpad allows for connectivity and...
review: Dialpad allows for connectivity and features that a normal phone doesn't offer. The ability to seamlessly transfer calls, forward calls to assistants, record calls, and even receive a transcription of the conversation have all proven invaluable to my team and myself, as an LO. I would definitely recommend this to anyone!

pros: Tons of features that make sense
title: We've used other phone systems and...
review: We've used other phone systems and this one is hands-down the best. There just so many features it's kind of crazy. It can be a bit overwhelming but if you want a feature rich phone system that can do just about anything you could imagine, some complexity comes with the territory. However, I would also say it's really pretty user friendly. As a big fan of automations, I love how much stuff I can automate within the system or by using Zapier. I couldn't imagine switching.

title: I would wholeheartedly recommend...
review: I would wholeheartedly recommend Dialpad as a phone/communication service. We switched to it within several years ago, and we've been delighted with it. The interface is very clean and aesthetically pleasing, and more importantly, the quality is exceptional. It's a product that makes you feel good while you're using it.

title: I have been a dialpad business customer...
review: I have been a dialpad business customer for a few months and am enjoying the service thus far. I was hesitant at first, but am definitely enjoying the service. I am using it as a back office line, but will likely port my number soon since we have been happy with the service. Call quality is good. messaging feature is super helpful.

title: I would like to say BIG "Thank you"...
review:
I would like to say BIG "Thank you" for Nextiva in these tough times. They saved a lot of money and time for our business.
Nextiva support is on the other level of business, every issue could be resolved in minutes without million transfers to different departments and different people.
I would like to say Thank you To Oxana from the Ukrainian office for today's help!
I really appreciated it.

title: I’ve been using Dialpad for 4 months...
review: I’ve been using Dialpad for 4 months and this application is very easy to use. The interface is very user friendly and easy to navigate and most glitches can be fixed with a simple refresh. The integration between Salesforce and Dialpad relieves the pressure of jumping onto calls blind as I am better able to prepare for all of my inbound customers. All in all Dialpad seamlessly fits in my day to day work.

title: This is a great option for VOIP...
review:
This is a great option for VOIP service. We use it at work on our computers and it seamlessly integrates to our cell phones, eliminating the need for standard phones sitting on our desk. Very reliable service with pretty good sound quality.
It was a bit difficult to learn how to use all of the features at the beginning like transferring calls and transcribing calls, but once you find where everything is, it's very simple to use.

cons: No caller ID on mobile app
title: I've been using Dialpad for over a...
review:
I've been using Dialpad for over a year for my Real Estate career and it has become an essential for my day-to-day business. Having the ability to call from my computer has proved extremely useful. The app also functions great on mobile devices.

I would highly recommend Dialpad to anyone that makes a high volume of calls or is looking to keep the personal and work numbers separate.

title: I've been using dialpad for 1+ year...
review: I've been using dialpad for 1+ year and it's an AMAZING tool! They have a great support team that will help you anytime. 10/10!

title: Very good service to contact clients...
review: Very good service to contact clients and conference calls. Use this in legal practice. The setup is very good. Can call and text clients and colleagues. Able to save and forward messages. The translation of voice mail messages is not great so it’s best to listen to the messages. Would recommend.

pros: Allows SMS and calling, connects with Gmail
title: I've used Dialpad for over three...
review:
I've used Dialpad for over three years. I love that they keep adding features like voice transcription, call summary, it connects to my work's Google Suite, etc.

The Google connection is especially great because I can see my email and call history in a single place. It's great for prepping before a client/prospect call.

I use it to text my clients, which is also a great feature.

I don't know the price as my company pays for it, and I've never had to use their support. That's why I rated them 3/5 (neutral) - I wish there was an option for N/A.

Everything I know about Dialpad is great and I highly recommend them!

title: I appreciate having a single number...
review: I appreciate having a single number that rings wherever I am and the ability to reference calls. We went from standard desk phones to headsets and that was nice too. This is the easiest phone system I've had to learn and has all the features of a PBX with none of the physical requirements. Keep up the good work!

title: Dialpad is great. It allows us to...
review: Dialpad is great. It allows us to communicate internally with other employees in other departments. We also use Dialpad for our call center to support our clients. Dialpad has great features such as populating articles and suggestions depending on what's being said on the call, tracks duration of the call and allows for reviews. We've been using it for years and it is crucial to our Support team.

title: Dialpad has been an invaluable platform...
review: Dialpad has been an invaluable platform for myself in creating a division between work and personal space. The mobile platform is great and allows me dexterity thru the day on my personal phone but also allows me to disable notifications at the end of the workday. Group lines have created a helpful shared resource across our department as a whole. Useful features include call recordings and call logs. Bugs appear to be addressed quickly and efficiently for a growing platform.

title: I've been using Dialpad for a very...
review: I've been using Dialpad for a very long time now, it's easy to use has all the possible features a phone could have I enjoy using the texting feature, and the caller Id hiding one. Plus the main benefit of using dialpad is it's compatibility across other devices it can like windows android honestly I don't care about apple so didn't tried dialpad on it.

cons: occasionally calls don't connect on the first try
pros: Easy to use, apps for mobile devices,
title: I've been a Dialpad user for a few...
review: I've been a Dialpad user for a few years now and I think it's a great value for the money. Service tends to be reliable. There are great features in the paid accounts. The apps for mobile work well. And, when I've needed support, which has not been often, they were very helpful. Overall, I am really pleased with the service and highly recommend them.

title: Dialpad changed how we do business, and...
review:
Dialpad changed how we do business, and saved us 70% off our previous dedicated PBX vendor combination. We have a small call center that had to suddenly work from home, and Dialpad was the perfect solution. Their sales team was extremely responsive and flexible, with perfect follow-through to the support process.

Number porting took a bit too long, but ultimately was resolved. Any problems we've had were promptly fixed.

We've had around 99.5% uptime since installtion. The AI components are excellent, particularly for a very small company, and have helped us significantly improve our overall service.

title: My company switch over to Dialpad...
review: My company switch over to Dialpad several years ago and it works well overall. The connection between dialpad accounts is crystal clear and calls to users outside dialpad sounds good as well. The only issue I have is that the system will occasionally have any issue switching a call from the mobile device app to the desktop app, but only 1 time out of 50. I'd recommend this service be considered if you are looking for a VoIP solution.

title: I have used this system for a few...
review:
I have used this system for a few months. I love how well the app locates me on computer of mobile phone. If data is not good, defaults to cellular provider. That is awesome. There is a deskphone option for those who cannot do without, but I prefer the apps for mobile and desktop.

Setting up call tree for company directory is easy. I used Mitel before and hated it. Dialpad is way easier to manage and make changes to it.

I love the integration with Google as well. When a call pops up, you can see recent emails related to the caller if your contacts are up to date.

title: Dialpad has been a great addition to...
review: Dialpad has been a great addition to our business! While not everything works exactly how we would like it to, it is much better than any desk or standard phone system. We love it and whenever we have an issue the Dialpad team gets back to us in a timely manner with real solutions. They even take our suggestions and turn them into new features.

title: We have been a dialpad customer with...
review: We have been a dialpad customer with our call center for the past 2 years and have loved all of their service. Easy to setup and maintain, easy to spin up call centers/queues and powerful reporting. Agents can see all their status with the team and other team members who are spread out in different geo's. We have used dialpad as a VIOP service for the past 5 years. Been very satisfied with their serivce, account management and all the folks who work for them. They have a great product and great support.

title: Dial pad works great for my Nutrition...
review: Dial pad works great for my Nutrition practice. It allows me to have constant access to calls and text without having to carry a separate phone. In addition I love being able to turn off Dialpad on weekends and holidays. The call quality is great and I love being able to read voicemails. The only downfall is when it ring to my phone it just shows up as my office number rather than the number of the person who is calling. Other than that its AMAMZING.

title: As a current user still getting the...
review: As a current user still getting the feel of the product, sometimes I have to reach out to customer support. Today, I received help from Tonia B., who resolved the issue and was able to point me in the right direction on some of my more general questions. It always feels great to have a pesky problem resolved, or to understand something I didn't before!

cons: Spam phone calls through Dialpad number
pros: Easy to use, great audio quality of recordings
title: Dialpad is amazing for conducting phone...
review: Dialpad is amazing for conducting phone interviews, as I do for my job as a journalist. It's simple for me to record the phone call and download the audio for transcription into Otter.ai. Unfortunately, since subscribing to Dialpad, I get a large number of spam phone calls through the Dialpad number assigned to my account. I'm not sure how to prevent this.

title: Dialpad has helped our Agency offices...
review: Dialpad has helped our Agency offices to connect and communicate better. We love the ability to call/text as an outbound work line from our PC, tablet, cell phone, etc. There is a lot of flexibility and that is important when you are not always working from an exact office location. The call logging is important to our service and being able to set up different departments to direct calls to is very helpful.

pros: Very convencional web and app base
title: I make hundreds of calls every day due...
review: I make hundreds of calls every day due to my profession, and DialPad has helped me following up with my clients and not miss a single opportunity, 100% recommended.

title: I have been using Dialpad for over two...
review:
I have been using Dialpad for over two years now and have really enjoyed it. They have grown so much in that time and are always being innovative with the features that they release.

The product is an excellent value with outstanding sound quality. Hope it will integrate with a new CRM provider in the near future.

pros: A texting feature, can use multiple headsets, sound quality is good, search feature
title: Very good product for working from...
review: Very good product for working from home. I don't particularly like the random phone # choice they gave me but I use it to my advantage. I enjoy the text feature because it is a quick way for me to get in touch with my clients. The only issue is that you may run into connection issues but the restart is exceptional in retrieving the call even after closing and reopening the browser. As long as the person doesn't hang up the call will resume. Really neat feature.

title: I use dialpad at my job and it is a...
review: I use dialpad at my job and it is a very good tool. We can use it anywhere and on any device, it gives us inputs on what to say in real-time and provides a call transcript if we need to go back to review some information we might have missed. In this home-office setting we all live in, Dialpad makes it easy to talk to customers or anyone really.

title: Dialpad is a cost-effective VOIP system...
review: Dialpad is a cost-effective VOIP system that allows consistent calling & text message quality. It's become an essential tool replacing our desktop phone systems. Only major areas for improvement are more automation & mass texting / emailing capabilities. Additionally, it would be a significant upgrade if you could export a CSV or Excel file of contacts.

title: We use this service to basically assign...
review: We use this service to basically assign to one phone. When setting up, it requires at least 2 phone numbers. This is overkill for what we need. We simply needed a single line to serve as a phone number to our business. However, for larger businesses, this would be great. I could see how you could set your entire business up on this service and not have any issues.

title: The Dialpad app is so easy to navigate...
review: The Dialpad app is so easy to navigate through, call, send SMS texts and fax. It truly is a great expeience! I use it day by day and just keep loving more and more. This was a great addition to the company. The notifications are perfect and always keeps me up to date. I will recommend this to everyone!

title: Dialpad is a great solution for our...
review: Dialpad is a great solution for our business. Setup was easy including a digital port built into the portal. Single sign-on has been so easy, just login via office365. Our last provider we need 5 different logins. The app is the best in the business. Most UCaaS providers use the Broadsoft app which is terrible. Great product that we will keep using for years to come.

cons: Personally, what I don't like is that I can not change my phone number because is managed by my superior, so is a problem when he is not around and I have make a call with a different area code.
pros: Something I really like about dial pad is the availability to be able to download a app on my phone that way I can use it while on wife and don't miss my work calls related.
title: Overall I would say DialPad is by far...
review: Overall I would say DialPad is by far the best virtual phone platform I have ever used. I work in an outbound cold calling marketing environment and have used so many different virtual phones like Zoiper, Avaya, Grasshopper, and DialPad have given me the best experience so far. Would highly recommend it.

cons: not sure, i am using it individually, and its useful.
title: I have been using a dial-pad for almost...
review:
I have been using a dial-pad for almost 6 years and I am enjoying it. No network issues. Can use it anywhere, anytime.
Do not see any issues so far.
I am using it on MAC and with google setup. It's user-friendly.
It's easy to set up and reliable for hassle free business.

I would recommend using Dialpad.

title: Dialpad has been fantastic! My company...
review: Dialpad has been fantastic! My company uses the program as our calling platform and it has been great. I use my personal phone for work calls but there is surprisingly no overlap with my personal phone number. There are so many features available to create a healthy work/life balance. It is easy to customize features that work best for me!

title: We switched from a traditional phone a...
review: We switched from a traditional phone a few years ago. The ability to forward calls to cell phones, live voicemail transcription, and call analysis are things we could only dream of in our old phone system.

title: Have been a user of Dialpad since what...
review: Have been a user of Dialpad since what seems like the beginning. Their feature set has increased by leaps and bounds over the years and they have all the bases covered to include web based, easy to manage, flexible as the organization grows and support when you just can't figure something out. With their addition of Uber Conference you and your team have a great powerful and cost effective tool.

title: We have been using this service for...
review: We have been using this service for approximately a year now, as an organization. The overall consensus is that we glad to have a phone routing service. We have struggled with Transfers that are unsuccessful across the office. This is an above average technical product overall, and we are appreciative.

pros: Great features and a Great APP
title: I've been using Dialpad for a while...
review: I've been using Dialpad for a while now and they continue to improve it. One of the features they just updated that I love is the ability to change your ring tone when someone calls you. With the number of calls I get in a day it helps to change this up every once in and while to keep things fresh.

title: ~Integrates into other applications for...
review:
~Integrates into other applications for easy activity logging.
~Available on all of your devices
~Love the text functionality. I can text a prospect from my desktop!
~Settings are easy to navigate.

I was able to easily track any calls and texts. Allowed me to connect with prospects on a different level.

title: Our division had to shift to remote...
review: Our division had to shift to remote work within a matter of days due to the pandemic. We were worried about how to make this crucial pivot as we needed a service that would provide us with a seamless transition. Dial Pad saved the day for us. Within two days our service was up and running. The call quality is really great and the features are amazing including the transcription, call memory, texting, and user analytics. I would recommend this service.

title: Been using Dialpad for nearly 1/2 a...
review: Been using Dialpad for nearly 1/2 a year, and I love it. Jump from cell phone to desktop app, and then back again, with a push of a button to continue your call when you are away from your office. Transcription of calls is great -- doesn't always work if strong accent or bad connection -- but works most of the time and beats taking notes. Support is quite helpful.

title: We have used dialpad for about 6...
review: We have used dialpad for about 6 months. We couldn't be happier with the price and support for this service. We were able to solve our law firm phone issues by switching from a landline to Dialpad in a matter of a week! The price for the service is among the best in the industry. We couldn't be happier!

title: I love this app! I can be on my...
review:
I love this app! I can be on my computer and phone at the same time and get all the required information I need at a single mouse click. I love the way I can customize the contact information so that if I need to call again, I have that information at my fingertips. I also love that I can read a voice message instead of just listening to it!
This is a wonderful app!

cons: I wish i had more backend control and settings regarding desk phones.
pros: Easy to use, Easy to setup, Easy to make changes
title: Great VOIP service. Setup was simple....
review: Great VOIP service. Setup was simple. Its a little confusing at first but once you get familiar with the admin settings, its a breeze to use. We use DialPad as our main phone service. We are a small plumbing and drain cleaning business that dispatches drain techs and plumbers all over the area. During business hours, customers call in and ring desk phones, bluetooth headsets and cell phones (each dispatcher is able to use what they want to use.) After business hours, since we are 24/7, we have calls going to technicians on their cell phones that are logged into our system. Anytime we need to change the order in which calls go thru the office or change who and when people are on-call - its simple. I dont even need to be on a PC to change settings. We are about 4 months in on our DialPad service and so far its been great! I'd recommend.

title: As we are working from home, for now,...
review:
As we are working from home, for now, DialPad is very friendly user for our entire call center. Easy calling out, tracks your calls. Gives you a script you can read later, and records the calls. This is a great feature not being in one location. Being a supervisor, you can listen and review calls with dispatchers, learning curve.
And the support, if needed, is spot on!!

title: Overall I'm very happy with the value...
review: Overall I'm very happy with the value and functionality of Dialpad, I use it for my office line and also to send/receive texts from the same numbers from both the desktop and mobile app. I haven't had any major problems with dropped calls, especially after upgrading my internet service to fiberoptic. My only gripe is with all the features, the UI is cluttered and confusing to navigate at times, especially switching between multiple lines.

title: I enjoy the ability to call and text...
review: I enjoy the ability to call and text clients and customers from the convenience of my computer. Dialpad is easy to use and super intuitive. The download process was smooth, the log in was simple, and it works with many of my other programs making it a powerful tool. I would highly recommend the use of dialpad.

cons: Sometimes my phone will mess up and i cant place calls but it is quickly fixed
pros: your calls are recorded so if you missed anything you can listen to them and learn of ways to improve yourself.
title: Dialpad is a great way to receive calls...
review: Dialpad is a great way to receive calls for you business. I would definitely recommend using it. It is easy to use and customer service is quick to respond. I like that the calls are recorded so that you can listen back and learn of ways to improve yourself. And the data is there if you have an unhappy customer, you can listen to the call and find out what happened.

cons: Connectivity issues, slight delay  when picking up calls, need new featuresres
title: Overall Dialpad is great call center...
review:
Overall Dialpad is great call center tools, if you are new to call center environment you will able to understood it and be able to manage it pretty quick. You can personalize the call sound and other features which is great.
But what needs to be improved is the connectivity issues, the slight delays, and constant bugs ( blank screens) that does plumed your experience.

cons: would love to be able to add on more than one team member to a call
pros: Great quality, easy installation, very reliable,,
title: Great product, works pretty efficiently...
review: Great product, works pretty efficiently with little issues. Just open the app and you are ready to go with ease. Able to connect with callers in a number of ways, including voice and text messages. Love being able to add on another team member on to the call when needed. Would highly recommend this product!

title: I have been using Dialpad for about 2...
review: I have been using Dialpad for about 2 years and its a great product. I love the fact that I can separate work calls from personal calls without having to carry a second phone. I have never had an issue with the service being down or reliability. It made a major difference while I was out of office last summer. I was able to put my Dialpad number on DND and casually check messages as needed rather than constantly have my phone ring. Highly Recommend!

title: I use dialpad for all of my day to day...
review: I use dialpad for all of my day to day work calls. It is a reliable software that I hardly, if ever, experience connection problems with. Everything is accessible/easy to learn. Navigating through dialpad is simple and keeping track of calls/editing contact information is very quick. Definitely would recommend!

title: Love how they actively transcribe...
review: Love how they actively transcribe during the call. I also love the great option to record the calls without it telling the client you are recording during the meeting. It's great for note-taking purposes and being able to go back and reference key points made. I would definitely recommend dial pad to a business.

title: Dialpad is easily accessible and easy...
review: Dialpad is easily accessible and easy to use. I like the quickness of outbound calls and the recording of calls that I can do back to and listen to. I do get choppiness from time to time but the updates seem to fix the issues. Dialpad is a upgrade from other phone systems I have used in the past. I'm happy customer of Dialpad.

cons: ANY service outage is problematic.  Ensure that your ISP is stable.
pros: Ease of use, feature set, portability
title: Small business, multiple locations...
review: Small business, multiple locations throughout US and relationship to partners abroad. Very good service and features set. Our own ISP issues can create an outage, but in 3-4 years, perhaps only 2X. Support has typically been very professional. Would recommend. We have linked Silicon Valley sites to the Midwest to the South and the convenience is a joy.

pros: Easy to use from my computer, OCR works pretty well to document calls, reporting is excellent.
title: I have been using dialpad for about a...
review:
I have been using dialpad for about a year now. Working from home these days and it doesn't require me to use my personal phones.

The quality of the calls has been excellent. The ease of use from my CRM is literally the push of a button to make a call.

I am pleased with dialpad and plan to continue using it indefinitely.

cons: VI call transcript accuracy, expensive Sell licenses, no video meetings for Support.
title: Overall, Dialpad is a pretty great VOIP...
review:
Overall, Dialpad is a pretty great VOIP option. You can choose your own area code for your business phone numbers, set up fax lines and landlines, set up department numbers, and the Admin interface and user desktop client are easy to use. The analytics/reporting is helpful.

Some things to note:

-Support is pretty responsive over Live Chat. However, support only allows correspondence via Live Chat or email (support will not set up a video meeting to screenshare, which can be frustrating if you have a specific issue you'd like to show them).

-The "Voice Intelligence" transcripts are not very accurate.

-Salesforce integration is easy, however you'll need to pay $$$ for Dialpad Sell licenses if you'd like to use Call Dispositioning.

title: Our company has been using DialPad for...
review: Our company has been using DialPad for almost 2 years if not more, and we like it. Once the Pandemic started we moved to working remotely and we took full advantage of everything DialPad has to offer, from recording conversations to use for training purposes, to the ability to call and conference call and text from your laptop, to assigning each of our team members their own numbers and so much more to successfully continue working no matter where we are working from.

title: Ever since adopting Dialpad as my go-to...
review: Ever since adopting Dialpad as my go-to cloud communication platform, my work life has become more efficient, effective, and productive. It seamlessly integrates with other technologies including Outreach, Google, and Salesforce, which allows me to be more effective with my time. Dialpad has enabled me to reach customers with greater ease, as well as communicate with my teams at a more efficient and effective rate. I highly recommend giving it a shot to take your game and business to the next level. Thanks Dialpad!

title: OK.. In Jan 2021 I decided to change...
review: OK.. In Jan 2021 I decided to change my “two” work phone numbers from Vonage to Nextiva as Vonage was becoming intermittent when speaking on a call. I wanted to keep my installed analog equipment as it works fine. Nextiva sent me two Cisco ATA-192 boxes. When they arrived, I called to get them setup from their support team. A woman who tried to help me after 90 minutes explained that both boxes were defective, and she would send two more to me. These arrived 4 days later. A second call to their support team, with the two NEW boxes in place, they still didn’t program the boxes to work. A third try to the escalation department a technician was able to finally get the boxes working. So, after 4.5 hours I had two working boxes for my two office phone numbers. Monday of these week we had a power outage and both boxes stopped working after the power came back on. They technician explained that the previous Nextiva technician didn’t set the boxes up to be static which would eliminate the IP from changing and the boxes to stop working. I worked with this technician for two hours and he said to press and hold the reset switch to get them back to factory specs. He needed access to the router and reset the router remotely disconnecting the call and never called back. So, I have two boxes and neither of them work. The next day I called and asked to speak to a manager. After 30 Mins they put me through to Elizabeth. Her title is “Retention Specialist.” (Kinda makes you wonder why they need someone with this title doesn’t it?) After 30 mins with her I was assured I would get resolution within 24 to 48 hours. Its is Friday. 72 hours later…no one has called, no one has emailed. I still have two dead boxes and no phone service expect through their app which only works for one phone number per computer. So, in total I have spent over 10 hours with Customer support, spoke to no fewer than 5 technicians, I haven’t had service that has “worked” fully yet for a full 30 days, and now no phones that work within my office for 4 days. I would suggest that if you are considering Nextiva for use within a business…. Don’t!

title: It is a good service and they have...
