review: It is a good service and they have continuously worked on getting it updated. The service are very nice and helpful. They just to get the app updated some more and also the call quality needs some work. They will continue to grow and get better. Also works very well on Mac and with Google setup. You will enjoy Dialpad.

cons: Porting can be troublesome at times
title: We have been using Dialpad for 4+ years...
review: We have been using Dialpad for 4+ years now and have really enjoyed it. They have grown so much in that time and are always being innovative with the features that they release. Our teams can easily manager their call centers, agents, analytics, call recordings, and basically everything on their own, which has helped free up our IT Support teams time to work on other projects. I am looking forward to what they will come out with next!

title: Dialpad is always showing innovation,...
review: Dialpad is always showing innovation, adding new features that we actually use, and that's cool, because you'll be sure that nothing wrong is going to happen if you are using the app, it has a great application support and will not leave you behind on any duty you might have assigned, finally, gives you with several tools for your business like recordings, auditing, voice intelligence, and more.

cons: Tech support email only and outside US.  D.  Do not stand behind their equipment
title: Service started out good but after...
review: Service started out good but after about 3 months the modem quit working. After working with emails back an forth to tech service and trying all sorts of settings, they ran out of things to try. They told me that modems do not break s it was may fault and they wanted to sell me a new one. I told them I would like to cancel my service and they said it would cost me $195 to cancel my service o it would be cheaper to keep it. I am an an "active" user with a system that is not useable. It was nice when it worked but that did not last that long.

pros: Amazing service and great customer support!
title: Great service and no complaints. Ivan T...
review: Great service and no complaints. Ivan T just helped me and was great. Everyone at the company has been helpful. We've been set up now for a few years, and have had very few issues. When we have issues, we can usually resolve them quickly on our own or with support, who are pretty quick to respond usually. Even when it said 30 minute wait, it was more like 5-10.

title: Tonia is an excellent technician who...
review: Tonia is an excellent technician who helped me solve and issue with my router that was disrupting our phone service after the big Uri ice storm knocked out power in Texas. I was frustrated that it was Nextivas fault but alas it was Spectrum. I would recommend this service because it has been very reliable when my network was active.

title: Customer service is great! Ivan was...
review: Customer service is great! Ivan was able to help me resolve the issues we were having. never a problem with customer service. For the phones I do wish there was an overall page. With our old system we had an overall page where we the entire building could hear us if we had an announcement. That would be a feature we would like.

title: Previously I would have recommended...
review: Previously I would have recommended this company with no hesitation, now they have decided that their new app is the way to go - new app - no instruction - nothing. I cannot do anything with the new app that is easy - they have made it so complicated and no instructions.. Save yourself a headache don't download the app

title: Unbelievably bad service.  The sales...
review: Unbelievably bad service. The sales rep was fine, but then after attempting to set up my account, I was deactivated for using a different IP address than when I set up. Sorry, but that shouldn't happen in today's world where people go from using computer to phone. Oh, you want to know the best part? They then said I'm required to give them a front and back copy of my DL, driver's license, and my CC, credit card. Are you kidding me? Not going to happen!!! At this point, I would highly discourage any small business owner or any owner from considering this company. In today's world, with everything being online, it simply shouldn't be this difficult to establish an account.

title: When a phone is provisioned, it usually...
review: When a phone is provisioned, it usually keeps working. The problem comes when you want to add a new phone or change a user setup. None of their auto provisioning seems to work, and contacting support is a crap shoot with most rolls ending in frustration. My last attempt at provisioning two additional phones ended with 6+ hours of "support" rebooting and factory resetting the units, and then ending with telling me there is nothing they could do and it must be network issue. What about the dozen other nextiva phones I have running on that exact same network? And btw, if you need to make a message for "longer than normal wait times", it's not "longer" but now "normal"

title: RING CENTRAL USED TO BE GREAT!! NOT...
review: RING CENTRAL USED TO BE GREAT!! NOT ANYMORE!!! Now they do NOT care when your phones are down, and nobody knows WHAT THEY ARE DOING or how to fix things. EVERY agent is at home and is not tech 2 support so don't think you will get urgent help if your phones are down like mine! My phones are down for so long and so many disconnected calls on my customers and no voicemails coming in and so many problems I can't list them. You would think that since its a phone system running peoples business that they would have QUALITY support WRONG!!!! They act like they have all these features but they do not work reliably every-time they have a new GLIP APP or a NEW update literally everything breaks!!! This has happened so many times and I am EXHAUSTED!!! The problems I have are SIGNIFICANT are costing me my CLIENTS!!!! THIS COMPANY NEVER FIXES THINGS!!!!!! They continually BREAK THINGS more! But nobody will call me to fix our phones!

title: Andy with Nextiva Support was very...
review: Andy with Nextiva Support was very patient and persistent in helping to provision my phone. In spite of how stubborn the phone was to reset without the previous provider's data, Andy stuck with it until he was successful. Our tech session was for 90 minutes. Throughout he was polite, insightful and explained the issues completely. I would highly recommend him and his company.

title: Writing this after a failed attempt to...
review: Writing this after a failed attempt to switch from Nextiva to Zoom Phone. We've had Nextiva for several years and been satisfied but I was lured by some of the new features Zoom Phone has and the ability to consolidate multiple systems (conference line and phone with same provider). Big mistake, Zoom Phone was TERRIBLE. Support was nonexistent (they would not let us access live support despite being on a paid business plan) and whenever we managed to get to anyone they were unable to solve issues. Going back to Nextiva my desk phone wasn't working properly. Nextiva support was amazing, answered quickly, worked through the issues expertly, and got me back up and running. The way they directed me on the support call showed they knew 1000 times what Zoom support did about phone systems. Very happy to be back with them, such a relief! It might be very slightly more expensive than some other VOIP providers but it is SO worth it to have good support from a company that knows what they're doing.

cons: Support is nonexistent even on paid plains
title: I recently tried to move my small...
review:
I recently tried to move my small business to Zoom Phone as I wanted to have conferencing and phone systems with one provider to simplify. This was a HUGE mistake and probably the worst IT support experience of my life. Zoom Phone apparently does not allow regular paid business plans to access live support. Rather you have to schedule an appointment with a phone specialist and only get 2 to 3 appointments. If you're not able to set up your phones during this time you are out of luck. We had a major issue with our desktop phones not provisioning and could not solve it on our own. Tried to access additional support which resulted in someone on the APAC support team getting back to us at 4 a.m. on a Saturday asking for a photo of the phone's screen. I'm sorry but I am not generally at the office at 4 a.m. And if there is a several hour delay on each back and forth when trying to troubleshoot an issue you can imagine how long this takes and how inefficient it is.

They also purposefully hide access to even remote support - if you submit a ticket with Zoom Phone as the item you need help with they will auto-close it, you have to submit with "other" to get to a human being. In the chat bot there is a special phrase you have to enter to get a human being. That is just underhanded. And when I reached out to my sales rep three times to ask if I could upgrade to a plan to allowed live support so I could actually get my phones set up he just didn't respond.

I struggled with trying to get the phones set up for three weeks. My remote IT team also could not get it set up. My husband, who is a CTO with 20 years of IT experience could not get it set up. The guidance they have for provisioning phones has no business being consumer facing, full of errors and gaps and exceedingly technical even for IT professionals. Do yourself a favor and stay FAR FAR away from Zoom Phone. I highly recommend Nextiva, I've gone back to them and am very grateful to be with a company that has competent live tech support again.

title: Absolute crap company. The worst...
review: Absolute crap company. The worst customer support and service I've ever experienced. You can't get in touch with anyone and we've had NOTHING but issues with their service. I even canceled my account, ported over my number and they are STILL charging me. Garbage. Don't get involved with this company.

title: Robert Norton is a best person I have...
review:
Robert Norton is a best person I have ever worked with on Nextiva project.
Fantastic knowledge of the subject, willingness to help in any way possible for me to understand the process. Best material for promotion for a higher level of management. Do not forget to raise his compensation. At lest the price I'm paying for a service will go to the best purpose. Thank you very much for amazing service.

pros: Sales, Onboarding, Support, Web Portal, Cell App
title: Getting VirtualPBX for my law office...
review:
Getting VirtualPBX for my law office has been an incredibly satisfying experience-- one of the better business infrastructure decisions I made. I had been with two previous VOIP providers (Ooma (eh) and Nextiva (ugh)) and Virtual PBX is by far the best in every way. As one might expect from any provider, sales was super attentive and helpful. However, whereas some of their competitors can be high pressure and slimy seeming just to make the sale, VirtualPBX sales is genuinely helpful.

Onboarding and support is on another level. US based, truly helpful, quick on the phone or in response to chat or email, and dedicated to fixing the problem for you. And this is my experience from an account with only two users on a lower tiered plan-- not a huge money maker for them. And yet they still have been treating my like I'm a 10k a month client.

The web portal (Dash) is straightforward and intuitive. It is very easy to set up systems and get things configured as you like. The cell phone app works as you would expect.

There are a lot of providers out there, so I clearly can't speak to all of them (Ooma was alright, Nextiva was truly awful). But I can honestly say that you absolutely cannot go wrong with VirtualPBX.

title: I would presume that if you are a huge...
review:
I would presume that if you are a huge company with a multiperson technical support IT department, this may be your system. For a small 1-5 man shop, YIKES.

I had to email the "Leadership" (guessing at their email addresses) to get help getting this thing setup. Got a great guy to help filter out the BS and make it work right.

Updates are crazy bad.

The quality of screen share while video conferencing (don't waste your time trying). Give it up if you want calls forwarded from one user to another. Our customers were laughing at us when they called and my tech person tried to forward them to me One in eight got through.

Had my guy work 1/2 of a day to get that problem handled and it still didn't work.

We finally gave up and went to another program. During the "trial period" we had NO PROBLEMS with video and screen share at the same time, no problem forwarding calls all through our company, and SETUP WAS A BREEZE. Dialpad is a game changer.

pros: Once logged in it's easy to use
title: Chat or phone support is great.  The...
review: Chat or phone support is great. The last three times I have used chat support to reset passwords. That has worked pretty good. The only concern is that sometimes resetting passwords by the users gets complicated. I'm not sure if that is a user issue or just the design of the password recovery platform. Other than that, I definitely recommend vFax.

title: Very reliable and great support.  Does...
review: Very reliable and great support. Does everthing we need, from faxing, meetings, phones. It is a communication package that fits the needs of our medium size business. Maintaining the phones can be done by anyone willing to call ring central support. Ring Central support has not disappointed at any point.

title: GEORGE O. IS THE BEST! Twice on...
review:
GEORGE O. IS THE BEST!

Twice on different dates and on diferent phone numbers, Geoge patiently helped me in connecting to Nextiva.

He does not have a scary voice, in fact a soothing voice that makes me feel like a high tech person . Very patient indeed.

Then when I couldnt find where to write this report, Ana kindly helped me to sent this link so I can inform Nextiva that you have good people. George O. most especially.

More power to all of you and God bless!
Evelyn
Beverly Hills Courier newspaper

title: After contacting support to cancel my...
review:
After contacting support to cancel my service after my original agreement ended over a year ago I was called back by to confirm my service would cancel the 11th of March 2021. It was confirmed my service would end. That reference for the call is XXX

That call ended and the nightmare began when "Paul" called back to insult me and tell me that the service was not cancelled. The service started on Mon, Sep 11, 2017. The 2 year agreement is over and the service has been month to month. I did not sign a new agreement at any point. Furthermore, Paul called back to insult me by saying the first call did not take place. When I provided the reference number he changed the story saying it was a mistake. He then threatened me with a $149 fee if I did not obey his demands. I can't believe Nextiva would employ such scare tactics. This is beyond the realm of thought for a modern company to not only encourage these scare tactics but try to implement them in 2021 with such competition for VOIP services. I used Nextiva since 2013 at a different company and still can't believe how much you have changed. Nextiva is a terrible and negligent company.

I spent HOURS on the phone with advanced support trying to fix your service. You have cost me $1,000's in time and lost faxes that never arrived due to your negligence.

Your Agent Paul called from XXX. He told me that his actions were encouraged by your company. I do not know of a better way to lose 8 year long customers than to employee and train people the way Nextiva does. From it's negligently bad service to its abusive scare tactics, Nextiva is the first choice if you want bad service and lost revenue.

I have wasted an additional 3 hours on hold through your chat and phone services trying to cancel. Nextiva, come for the bad service, stay because we threaten you when you try to leave ®

title: Great customer service and phone...
review: Great customer service and phone quality, I've been with them for years without 1 single issue! I highly recommend them to any small or large business that is needing high quality fast phone/voip services with 2nd to none customer service and reliability. Any time I have a question or want to upgrade they are there for me

title: I love this provider, they keep...
review:
I love this provider, they keep everything plain and simple..
They keep everything easy as in all personnel will understand even the non tech will be able to configure it. And the support is very accommodating and
very supportive and most of all they really know their stuff.

I love Ring Central....

title: Great job with a unique problem from...
review: Great job with a unique problem from getting our total phone system set up independently. Very complex scenario and did a great job with all of the problem resolution. Worked on it from multiple levels and go it figured out. A lot of troubleshooting with our network and setting our network for quick extensions. Very polite and A+ customer service.

title: Looking for a phone company that...
review: Looking for a phone company that doesn't answer your phone call? Support that takes HOURS on hold? Assigns you a phone number that belongs to another company? Mobile app that only partly works? If yes to any of these questions, go with Nextiva! Good riddance! I will find someone else! I've wasted enough time with them. Top rated? Baloney!!!

title: Both DJ and Tony Johnson were...
review: Both DJ and Tony Johnson were absolutely helpful. There was a 3rd guy that I also spoke with, I believe his name was Mark, he was a newer agent. All of these gentlemen went out of their way to help and assist me with my needs. I am very new to Nextiva and so there is so much that I need to learn, and need people who are willing to bare patience with me. These 3 did just that. Thank you!

title: After 6 hours trying to get account set...
review: After 6 hours trying to get account set up and then being told I'm not on the account i lost it, i would absolutely get in writing on contract that you have a 30 day cancellation policy, i was lead to believe that i did from Charles Leafblad the sales person who called me 3 times a day and now wont give me a call. I would do more research if you think Nextiva is the company to go with.

cons: The support, since taken over by GoTo is beyond abismal.
pros: It is a great product and service.
title: I started with Jive in 2009, it was an...
review:
I started with Jive in 2009, it was an excellent company to work with. The support was incredible, you could call and get someone who understood what you were saying, spoke English as their first language, listened to what the issue was, fixed the issue then and there on their own or connected you directly to someone who knew how the system worked, and most of all cared enough to do it the right way.
The software worked first time, every time, the mobile app as well.
Then GoToConnect took Jive over, as soon as it did the internal workings went to hell in a handbasket.
The app sucks now, it constantly just disconnects so you do not get calls, but you do not know you are not getting calls forwarded.
Then you call to get that fixed and they cannot tell you why it happened, but after you uninstall the app and reinstall and they do their thing it starts to work again.
But while the calls get forwarded to you there is no longer caller id. as before. So you call back again and they somehow fix that issue but now when a call is forwarded it is not a different ring tone as it was before, so you do not know if the call is someone calling your cell directly or a forwarded call from your work number.
Mind you, every time you call Jive Communications/ GoToConnect now you get someone in a foreign land who speaks maybe fair English but does not seem to either care, understand, listen, or all three. Support does not know what they are doing and does not know the system. They have a database available to look at only. If they did not listen, could not understand what the issue was, or cannot find a way to fix the issue they will tell you there is no way to fix it.
Since last week I have been on the phone with support 6 times, and am on hold with support again right now going on 42 minutes with a lady named Lourdes who has no clue in the world what it is I am talking about when I say there was a different ring tone when calls were transfered from my Jive/Work phone
I have right now been on the phone with three different people for an hour and 12 minutes. The current person, Adrian Lemos, just called me a liar. I told him that for the last 11 plus years I have had calls forwarded to the app on my cell phone, which came with the caller id. of the person calling me and a different ring tone that denoted the call was being forwarded from my work number. He called me a liar and said such a thing is not possible.
I will be finding a different service as soon as I can. I will also be telling everyone I know about how Jive Communications has gone to the dogs.

cons: Everything, the whole experience was super stressful.
pros: None, their customer service is the worst I've encountered in my Life
title: It takes two hours to reach a customer...
review: It takes two hours to reach a customer service rep. I cancelled my account and still got charged for 2 months. When I called in to resolve the issue, and spent several hours to reach someone, they refused to provide a refund. I began using Ring Central instead, and the difference was night and day. Do not waste your time and money with Nextiva. AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!!!

title: I have had dialpad for a few months and...
review:
I have had dialpad for a few months and the quality of calls is inconsistent. I spent 20 minutes just trying to get a good connection with the client.
The biggest problem is dialpad's lack of a very basic feature, text message notifications through my main number. Given the way people communicate, text messaging is as common as phone conversations and the lack of this feature makes dialpad very inadequate. Over that past 12 hours, I missed 2 text messages from clients that put my business at risk.

pros: Excellent price and great customer service
title: We have used Nextiva for 9 years. We...
review: We have used Nextiva for 9 years. We have had exceptional support with our call center. Our business together has been very positive and friendly. Whenever we need changes made to our fast paced and growing business, Nextiva grows with us and helps us accommodate our customers needs along with our internal phone system.

title: Honestly I do not know where to start,...
review:
Honestly I do not know where to start, I decided to have a 36 month contract with this company because the sales man made it seem so perfect, what made me want to add a line with nextiva was because they had a phone app so I don't miss any calls. Basically I got this bundle in November, I did not use the phone at all because my business was not running and I didn't have internet yet. 2 weeks ago I put internet in my building and gave nextiva a call to get it set up, when the representative asked for my number I gave it to him and he said that number is not in their records, I was shocked but didn't think anything of it so I provided him with my account number and he said that there was a different number on my account, in complete shock I explained to him that they cannot do that with my permission and I already put up my store signs, business cards and flyers, he said to give him some time and he will speak to the porting team and see what is going on, he put me on hold for more then an hour and couldn't get in touch with porting because it was a weekend, he didn't know how to set up the phone I rented from their company and told me he can almost guarantee that if I call on Monday they will solve my problem.

I called Monday and spoke to multiple people and explained my situation they all said we cannot give this phone number back because it is a broken number and they can only provide me with a different number, I asked to speak to a supervisor and all the representatives refused to transfer me, finally I decided to contact Chris Herrera the guy that set up my account he never answers the phone so I had to email him and tell him that I am going to leave him a review and his service was bad.... he gave me a call after that email and added his colleague, his collegue promised to ether solve my issue or do whatever it takes to make me happy and I should wait 24-48 hours, 3 days passed and I will constantly call and email Chris to see what happened, if he would respond he will say its still pending with the carrier, the last email he said was by Monday the earliest.

Monday which was 3 days ago I call no one has answers for me I end up speaking with a supervisor who was understanding and he informed me that the phone number is broken and there is no way to get it back. I was on this call for 4 hours, no solution, I asked for them to pay a partial amount of my loses because now I have to change all of my advertisements, he Said that it sounded fair but he has to speak to his manager, when he came back he informed me that they cannot do that and they are willing to give me 1 month free and lower my bill to 20$ a month instead of 25$ that's what he offered to right their wrongs, I obvisuoly refused, then he offered 2 months and then even three in which I still refused because that is not even 10% of the amount I am paying to fix there mistakes. Finally he transfers me Senior Customer Relations Manager and he offers the same thing and I refused again and told him my story again finally he says send me an invoice of how much your signs costed so I did and he told me to wait 24-48 hours he will call me and tell me what they decide. he did not call I had to keep calling and emailing. finally he called me today and informed me that they can online waive 3 months of payments for me and that's it I refused again and said cancel my account.... you guys will never guess what this company has the audacity to do,,,, he said that there will be a penalty if I cancel, so I freaked out and told hm I am not paying a dime and will be taking actions, then he put me on hold and came back saying he can lower that penalty fee which is over 900$ by 25% which would be over 700$, after I told him again that I am going to take legal actions and leave reviews he finally promised to "try"and waive that penalty fee... so there is my story now I have to wait 72 hours to see if my penalty will be waived.

This company is the worst I had to deal with 2 weeks of long phone calls and no solution!! the guy that started my account didn't even test the number in the first place, they changed my number without my permission after I payed and made all my advertisements and cannot give me that number back! and are trying to make me pay a penalty fee! my word needs to get out to everyone considering using this phone company please do not they're service is horrible and you aren't really saving any money verizon is cheaper and they give you a free phone!!!!

title: I've had RingCentral since I started...
review: I've had RingCentral since I started my small business and have found it meets all my needs -- calls, voice messaging, text, video mtgs, faxing. The service quality is great and I have everything in one pkg rather than having multiple servicers. Extensions are available and each user can set up their own voicemail and redirect calls if needed. They provide training videos and online live meetings so you can ask questions. I even have my own account rep at my beckoning.

title: Bohdan's the man! He fixed a nagging...
review: Bohdan's the man! He fixed a nagging issue for one of my clients, and they're very happy now. He was super friendly and knowledgeable, and it took him only a couple of minutes to correct the issue. He definitely knows more than your average tech support person at Nextiva because he immediately understood what I was looking to do, and knew exactly where to go. I had to put in very little effort in terms of explaining, and that always makes for a great customer experience!

title: Writing a review regarding Nextiva...
review: Writing a review regarding Nextiva support. I just worked with Ivan T. on a couple of voicemail issues, and found Ivan to be very patient and very thorough. Ultimately, he was able to solve BOTH of my problems to my full satisfaction. I really appreciated his time and dedication to seeing this through. Ivan was wonderful!!!

title: On Monday, February 15th, I worked with...
review: On Monday, February 15th, I worked with Bohdan Shevchyshyn. He was a TREMENDOUS HELP to provision a troublesome phone, reset on of our staff's jammed voicemail, change our external phone numbers, and various other smaller tasks. Bohdan was TIRELESS working with a troublesome Polycom VVX-601 phone. It took an hour, but Bohdan was patient and courteous. THIS ALONE will keep me a Nextiva customer for years. BRAVO, Bohdan! God bless you for all the help you gave me today with a very frustrating phone problem.

title: I had nextiva for a month and they...
review: I had nextiva for a month and they never got my account set up at all. It took 2 weeks to give me access to the app so I can use their softphone yet never could upload leads or use any of the "features" on the dashboard. Meaning it was just a glorified soft phone which I couldn't even text from. I had to contact their support daily for a month with nonstop issues and never got them resolved. I finally got them to cancel my account which I couldn't even use once and they still jerked me around. All they did was bump me to the same idiot I talked to the first time I tried to cancel and bounce me in circles. Still awaiting my refund a month late. TOTAL SCAM

title: I would like to take the opportunity to...
review:
I would like to take the opportunity to recognize and thank Lonnie Poarch for his excellent customer service skills.
I was at a stop while trying to get the system up and running and Lonnie had it working in no time. He was EXTREMELY knowledgeable and patient. He took the time to make sure I understood everything and waited while I tested each line. I can not thank him enough. Give that man a raise ASAP!!!!!! Thanks again Lonnie. You were awesome!!!

title: Lonnie Poarch exemplified the essence...
review: Lonnie Poarch exemplified the essence of customer service. He was kind, patient, and determined to make sure that I obtained what I needed for my business. We were on the phone for hours but Lonnie's disposition never changed. His commitment to quality customer service superseded any length of time, repetition, and technical difficulties that we encountered. I am very thankful for Lonnie!!!!

cons: not sure why so many bad reviews
title: We have business vonage for many years....
review: We have business vonage for many years. We have 11 phones. Support has been the best of any phone company we ever had over 35 years with out business. I think we have had system since 2015 and our original sales guy is there there. I think they have gone to chat only but only needed help last year one time. Just with a feature. I am shocked with the bad reviews here. Maybe only people with problems take the time to write a review. I do think AT&T is the worst company on earth.

title: I have been using Phone Power as my...
review: I have been using Phone Power as my VOIP for five years and have been happy with the service. My device stopped working on January 31st, 2021. Still showing soft call log online. I have repeatedly tried to contact both sales and support for the last week. No response. It appears the company is out of business.

pros: Quick response, efficiency with support and sales staff.
title: Siavash was amazing as he was...
review: Siavash was amazing as he was professional, knowledgeable and the best support team member I have worked with since having signed my contract with Nextiva. Sivash was able to test all settings, make updates and troubleshoot system glitches without difficulty. I have experienced several new system challenges with average assistance from support technicians, however this time the assistance was exceptional and complete without the need for additional follow up. Thanks Mr. Sivash!

title: Everything o.k. except they will lie...
review:
Everything o.k. except they will lie through their teeth to get you to pay for a higher priced package even if you do not need it.
When I asked to downgrade to lees expensive package they said I used more toll minutes and would end up paying more - but I do not make any toll calls - then they tried to say I use all kinds of fax minutes - but I do not send any faxes.
Beware they lie!

title: Lonnie was able to troubleshoot...
review: Lonnie was able to troubleshoot multiple problems and create resolutions for each of them quickly within the same phone call. One of the solutions required a creative solution that others hadn't been able to come up it. He was also very thorough and took the time to wait with my to ensure that each of my phone lines was working and that all of the changes made were functioning properly, even though it required my staff to log into and setup accounts. I am very pleased with the level of support I received!

title: I have been utilizing services from...
review: I have been utilizing services from Call Tower since September 2020. FIVE STARS for an outstanding level of customer service and availableness of the team for sincere help when needed! Best part: they even follow up! Big shout out to Richard Page & Frank Rusignuolo for going above & beyond! Thanks!

title: Nextiva has a lot of features and I...
review: Nextiva has a lot of features and I don't need most of them. That said, the product is excellent and the customer service has always answered my questions and solved any issues. I have had other VOIP providers and have had various issues but Nextiva is by far the best for my needs. I highly recommend them.

title: DO NOT PURCHASE. I should have paid...
review: DO NOT PURCHASE. I should have paid attention to all the red flags that presented themselves from Day 1. In my life I've never had the type of horrible experience that I'm having with Avaya. Completely disorganized. Zero support. Bogus charges. The phone system is adequate. The sales/support team feel like a band of con-artists. I keep getting charged random fees, but nobody can tell me what they're for. You have to email a specific billing email that takes 15 days to hear back. I still haven't heard back, but they keep charging me in the meantime. It took over a month to get my phones operational, and yet they still charged me. Customer support conveniently called me on the eve of being able to exit my agreement, giving me no time to find an alternative if I cancelled my service. If I didn't spend all the time chasing them that I did, my phones would still not be setup two months later. I'll keep updating on here with my experience, but it currently feels like I'm in some sort of scam. Looking into getting BBB involved, which I can't believe I'm saying. The amount of time/headache spent just trying to get the simple service I'm paying for feels criminal.

title: Unless you are very large they won't...
review: Unless you are very large they won't talk to you. you must use their chat feature. I spent 4 hours trying to change my plan only to be finally told no and that I must cancel and start a new account to take advantage of the current pricing. Under NO circumstances would I recommend Vonage to anyone. I will be canceling ALL my services with them and recommend my clients to do the same

title: We've been with Nextiva for a year and...
review: We've been with Nextiva for a year and have had minimal issues. Anything that needed attention was taken care of very promptly. Even callbacks (no waiting on terminal hold) usually occurred within 15-30 minutes. Support staff have always been courteous and helpful - even with us "tech-challenged" people!

title: CallTower offers many products and they...
review: CallTower offers many products and they work to find solutions to Microsoft Teams limitations. We use their paging solution with Algo devices. They have setup an Intercom solution for us as well. They have Microsoft Certified Engineers and many people working on the back-end to make sure the solutions all work together. I am very happy we went with CallTower to host our SBC.

title: Robert Norton spent at least 1 hr...
review: Robert Norton spent at least 1 hr helping me diagnose my VOIP phone's lack of sound both directions. Robert educated me on why my network is not ideal (unsupported), and best practices for me to get my network to "supported" so we can properly address my phones functioning. AAA+++ in care, explanation, and good advice. Thank you Robert!

title: Phone app works fine if that's all you...
review:
Phone app works fine if that's all you need.

In my case, I choose Nextiva for the phone and CRM integration as i do sales prospection. I eventually found out that the CRM is still in development which is something they failed to mention when i signed in.

I have now tried to work with the Nextiva CRM for 2 1/2 months and it is like climbing a mountain. Implementation is unintuitive and very complicated compared to other systems I have used. Support is uninformed on the CRM and their documents are sketchy and fail to point you in the right direction.

I was not told that this CRM doesn't have an inbox/outbox that would function like outlook does. I was not told either that if you write an email directly from a contact page, you can only see if you have received an answer when opening that contact page and refreshing it. Maybe it could work if you have 2 or 3 contacts. But will not work if you have hundreds or thousands of them. Can you imagine opening every contact every day?

Actually there is sort of a way you can know if you have received an email. From your contact page, you need to open a case. Write your email in the case you opened. Move the case from open to waiting an answer. When you get an email back, the case will move to open. Check every day as many time as required what cases have moved to open. See your message, change to awaiting answer again. Got it? Not sure if it could be made for difficult and time consuming.
Also I have tried to get my domain not just verified but authenticated so i can use my email and not the default nextiva email to send emails. I have tried for the last 10 days and it is still not done. My case has been on their support back burner for that long. I am still waiting for a call back from the department where my case was at last escalated 5 days ago. Called back this morning and still nothing. I was done the favor to upgrade my case to urgent just now. Not sure what can be more urgent than not being able to work with the CRM you rely on.

Bottom line, the frontline support team is just not trained in the CRM and struggle to get you meaningful help or answers. The more proficient support team is just not in a hurry to help. So much for their claim of fame that they are the best with support!

Now, after so much time invested with that CRM, I can only forge ahead and hope Nextiva will start taking their CRM and CRM clients seriously. I am waiting for the kinks to be resolved and for a streamlined approach to emails. I am also waiting for Nextiva to wake up on support and get things resolved timely ie same day or worst case scenario next day.
Am i just foolish?

title: I have been a member of Nextiva for...
review: I have been a member of Nextiva for years and years with my company. I need to consistently call for assistance with my service. I worked with Lonnie Poarch today and was so impressed with the level of service I received. Lonnie solved 3 issues in record time compared to others I have worked with. Typically when I call in for assistance, I am on the phone minimally for one hour for one issue and it is not always solved after all of that time. Lonnie solved 3 in less than an hour. He was pleasant to work with and I would recommend having him support your services whenever possible! Very impressed.

title: I had a very pleasant experience with...
review: I had a very pleasant experience with Rose M. via chat support -- they resolved my issue quickly and effectively. They also gave me a way to resolve the issue I was having with file conversion on my own in the future. Since I started using Nextiva with my company, technical support has been consistently fast and reliable.

title: Andrew P has been super supportive and...
review: Andrew P has been super supportive and so thoughtful. He helped me with my new device set up and advised me with possible solutions. I've been getting support from the support team several time last year. They were all nice but Andrew left me greater impression so I decided to write a review today :). Thank you for all the support.

title: An easy to use and simple to customize...
review:
An easy to use and simple to customize software.
I love the reliability of this amazing software. Moreover, I like the support team of this software. The tool has never ever disappointed the team I work with. I would like to take this opportunity to recommend this software to all the potential buyers or users.

cons: The dashboard could be more intuitive
title: I don\'t know what has happened since...
review:
I don't know what has happened since that terrible review in 2018 but I have been a customer since October 2020 and have been very pleased.

I came to Ringfree after having used VoIP since 2008. First with Vocalocity and then when they were bought out by Vonage. My bills kept inching up and I finally started shopping around. Ringfree cut my bill by about 30% rignt out of the gate. So that is nice but one of my biggest frustrations with my previous provider was customer service. I think that is the thing I like the most about Ringfree is the outstanding customer service.

When I have had a call for technical support it has been resolved, via email or telephone by an extremely patient, locally based techie. Then, regardless of how small the problem or question, I get an email at the end of the week making sure all my problems have been resolved. So back to that review from 2018? It was either a troll or the company has really stepped up its game. I highly recommend.

pros: Price, but only with contract agreements
title: I have a small law office with very...
review:
I have a small law office with very modest phone provider needs. I had a less than ideal experience with my former VOIP provider. So I started looking around, reading reviews, and landed on Nextiva as what seemed to be the best option. Man was I wrong. Once they lock you into a contract (which is required to get a reasonable price and promotions) everything goes downhill. The web application is incredibly convoluted and not user friendly at all. Setup takes a ridiculous amount of time. Nothing is intuitive. I still cant figure out how to set up voicemail by using the actual phone unit rather than my computer mic.

Oh, and you think support will provide help? Think again. After waiting on hold for nearly an hour, someone might connect to try and answer your questions. And will sound annoyed to have to help you. The absolute worst support service I have received from any company ever.

I can't comment on the reliability, since things are just getting started. But judging by how things have gone so far, I d not have high hopes.

Avoid Nextiva. Go with Vonage, Ooma, Ring Central, or anyone else for that matter. I cannot imagine any would be any worse than this.

title: Worst experience with a service. VOIP...
review: Worst experience with a service. VOIP set up is not user friendly. A great deal of time and phone calls were spent on issues. Each service seems to have a different department and different person to speak with. Service was not worth length of time it takes for them to set up the dashboard, the time I had to dedicate to do the setup configuration, the countless time I have been on hold or had to talk to representatives, and the quality/reliability of the calls. Cancellation of VOIP has been a nightmare. My VOIP account was renewed after I received cancellation confirmation. I was furious after the numerous time and phone calls it took to actually get the cancellation confirmed. The excuse was that they had to migrate fax history since I was keeping my fax number. For a company that handles large businesses, the fact that they cannot transfer a fax history timely is concerning. I wish I could bill them for the hours I have wasted with the countless phone calls with them. Stay away from Nextiva and save yourself a lot of wasted time and frustration.

title: Cheap is the word that describes...
review:
Cheap is the word that describes Nextiva... First the sales process; I found the salespeople are great salespeople. They will do/say anything to get your business. This however is where the problems start. I asked specific questions to make sure the needs of our system would be met. Of course, the answers are all yes, yes, yes.
Over a month into the service, we still do not have a usable phone system. None of the features we need are now available in the system. Every time you call Tech support it takes an hour and a half only to be told we are escalating this to higher support and they will reach out. If you email in, it takes 2-3 days for a response.
Lots of empty promises with Nextiva.

pros: There is a cell phone app
title: We have so far had to re-configure our...
review: We have so far had to re-configure our own setup to get call flows to work correctly. There were multiple times that we had pointed out something that was wrong during the on-boarding and we were told they would be resolved before the rollout but they never addressed our issues. If you need a Vonage re-skin with worse support and onboarding then Nextiva is your company! Their support has so far been a mixed bag. We either get transferred three times before we talk to someone that can help us, get hung up on or they just take our information and tell us they will call us back. We have subscribed to the enterprise support and so far I am not impressed, I can only imagine how bad would be if we didn't have enterprise support although it would mean you wouldn't need to get transferred to leave a message.

pros: Seamless, mobile, versatile, very accessible through various platforms
title: Nextiva is perfect for solo law...
review: Nextiva is perfect for solo law practitioners like myself who serves as lawyer, CEO, secretary, etc. It gives me the tools necessary to make the admin tasks easier, leaving more time to do the lawyering. The support staff is very patient and helpful and can walk you through any issue with the onboarding process or troubleshooting. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to spend less time on the admin and more time on their business.

title: We use Vonage for our small business....
review:
We use Vonage for our small business. Recently, they've discontinued customer service by phone, referring all service requests to online chat or their online "ticket" system. We pay for the Business Number Inbox feature, which hasn't worked in months. It broke mysteriously in November, and now it's almost February and they still haven't fixed it despite numerous support requests, each of which has been the height of infuriating with having to navigate through their support "tiers" with every new support attempt. They still charge us for this broken feature every month.

A couple weeks ago I had a device suddenly get blacklisted. It had been working fine for over a year, and then it suddenly didn't work anymore. This was in the middle of a workday. Customer service was unreachable. It took me over 4 hours to get it resolved on my own, and the solution ended up causing an unexpected loss of data for one of our employees.

Vonage is absolutely awful to deal with as a small business. We're planning to switch to another VOIP provided ASAP. I recommend against considering them.

cons: AxVoice does not offer a free trial version.
pros: It offers excellent call quality for long-distance calls.
title: It has only three weeks, and I can say...
review: It has only three weeks, and I can say it already that AxVoice is by far the most reliable VoIP service provider I have ever used. As my work demands numerous international calls, I needed to find a service provider that fulfill my requirements. AxVoice is the perfect solution for my business. My only complaint with the software is that it does not offer a free trial. I had to decide by reading the customers' reviews.

cons: Horrible service, useless tech, support very dishonest
title: THE worst service on the planet.  So...
review: THE worst service on the planet. So bad that I'm going to port my number, and tell them to shove it. Rather be out a couple hundred dollars than continue dealing with their very bad tech support, horrible service, and dishonesty. Paid good money for an 800 number, they assign one they had already assigned to another person, leaving me hanging for marketing material and upset customers. Run away!!!

title: Worked with April today to get an issue...
review: Worked with April today to get an issue resolved with the BLF on a users second phone that he uses at home. She resolved the issue promptly. All of my dealings with support have been positive. Their techs are knowledgeable, friendly and always helpful. The work the problem thru to resolution, on the rare occasion I have an issue.

cons: Only email support that takes days to respond
title: We had to choose a new VoIP service...
review: We had to choose a new VoIP service provider for my company, and we did a lot of research. I remember talking to different company owners to see what they are using to fulfill their communicating needs. However, I got to know about AxVoice after a whole month of research and reading reviews. On behalf of my team, I would like to say that choosing AxVoice was the best decision. One of the most convenient factors is that it allows you to use your existing number. However, we have struggled to get connected to its customer service sometimes.

cons: Only 5 stars under Service, should be 10!
pros: Great Service, great support, great Equipment!
title: Ivan went above and beyond to help me,...
review: Ivan went above and beyond to help me, especially after the incorrect information I provided that caused him to have to undo all that he did and redo my mistake on the correct line. He then helped me with an additional issue occurring on an auto-attendant line. Problem fixed with ease as far as I could see. Great job, you have a valued staff member in Ivan, thank you Ivan!!

cons: desktop app has room for improvement
title: Deployed in July 2020, Nextiva was our...
review: Deployed in July 2020, Nextiva was our first venture in to VoIP. Customer service, training staff, and tech support have exceeded expectations. Every representative I have spoken with has been knowledgeable, focused on the problem, professional, courteous and patient while I asked numerous questions.

title: I use RingCentral video and...
review: I use RingCentral video and unfortunately have a consistently poor experience - ongoing audio issues, there's often confusion around the invites and connection URLs, the admin side is horribly confusing (I think they have three different administrative interfaces??) and the other week I was locked out of my account for hours because of a glitch in their platform that didn't allow me to login nor reset my password. I had to call support to have them work on it from their side...and I will say their support is the only halfway decent experience I've had - kudos to getting something right. I don't know anything about their phone or other solutions, but until RC gets their platform in better shape I would recommend against using their videoconferencing.

title: I've had nextiva for about 4 months....
review: I've had nextiva for about 4 months. It works great, unless you have a problem. #1 setup takes a really long time. Like an absurd amount of time. #2 When I signed up I purchased the headset as well, so I wouldn't have any compatibility issues whatsoever. Well, the headset was on backorder and nobody said anything. I called three weeks later and was told what happened. It took another week to ship me a new one. At that point I was charged for a full month for services, which I could not use. I've requested a credit for that month on at least three separate occasions. Guy tells me he'll look into it and never gets back to me. I gave up. #3 I just made my third call to setup the caller ID. The first two times it wasn't done correctly. They don't even have a record of my second call. We'll see what happens. They are nice, but extremely incompetent. Either that or their "porting" department is on permanent vacation. I should have gone with vonage.
